title: Senior Analyst - Credit Analysis
description:
FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India), a part of First Citizens BancShares, Inc., a top 20 U.S. financial institution, is a global capability center (GCC) based in Bengaluru. Our India-based teams benefit from the company's over 125-year legacy of strength and stability. First Citizens India is responsible for delivering value and managing risks for our lines of business. We are particularly proud of our strong, relationship-driven culture and our long-term approach, which are deeply ingrained in our talented workforce. This is evident across all key areas of our operations, including Technology, Enterprise Operations, Finance, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, and Credit Administration. We are seeking talented individuals to join us in our mission of providing solutions fit for our clients greatest ambitions.

Job De ion

Value Proposition

At First Citizens India, you'll have the opportunity to be more than just an analyst, you'll be a trusted partner in safeguarding the Bank's credit portfolio.

  • Global Exposure: Collaborate directly with Senior Credit and Risk professionals in the U.S., gaining insights into global credit practices.
  • Impactful Work: Play a critical role in monitoring a multi-billion-dollar credit portfolio, helping the Bank stay resilient and client-centric.
  • Career Growth: Build your expertise in Credit analysis while having access to structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to move into leadership roles.
  • Innovation at Scale: Be part of a team driving process improvement and technology adoption in Credit monitoring.
  • Culture of Stability & Growth: Join a Bank that has thrived for over 125 years, balancing stability with continuous growth and innovation.

Job Details

  • Position Title: Senior Analyst, Credit Analysis
  • Career Level: P2
  • Job Category: Senior Associate
  • Role Type: Hybrid
  • Job Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka

About the Team: Credit Analysis

We are a diverse and highly skilled team of Credit professionals, experienced in Origination, Underwriting, and end-to-end Portfolio Monitoring.

Our team specializes in Technology & Healthcare Accelerator & Growth, Corporate Banking, Sponsor Finance, Fund Banking, Commercial Real Estate (CRE), Healthcare – Medical Office Building (MOB), Wine, Community Assistance Banking (CAB), and Community Development Finance (CDF) loans monitoring across Innovation Banking, Fund Banking, Commercial Finance and General Bank. Additionally, the team supports the Centralized Cash Management Team (CCMT). Team works closely with US-based Credit Solutions team, Credit Officers, and Portfolio Managers to perform monthly, quarterly & annual monitoring of the loans.

Impact

As a Senior Analyst in the Credit Analysis team at First Citizens India, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the Bank's credit quality and supporting informed lending decisions. This role is critical to enabling the Bank to make confident lending decisions, manage risks effectively, and maintain trusted relationships with clients. In this role, you will Leverage tools such as Moody's Credit Lens, and other commercial lending platforms to deliver accurate, timely, and actionable insights.

You'll Partner with Global Credit teams to ensure Risk management and strengthen Portfolio performance.

Key Deliverables

As a Senior Analyst – Credit Analysis, you will play a critical role in supporting the ongoing management of Bank's Credit portfolio. You will work closely with U.S. based Credit Officers, Portfolio Managers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality analysis and monitoring insights that help safeguard the Bank's Credit exposure while ensuring client success.

General Functions May Include, But Are Not Limited To

  • Credit Portfolio Monitoring: Support ongoing monitoring of assigned credit portfolio to identify potential risks and ensure compliance with Loan agreement and risk policies.
  • Reporting Tasks Monitoring: Monitor and track monthly/quarterly reporting packages (arriving from US counterparts) to check for completeness of client information on the portal.
  • New Client Addition and Modification: Set up/upload new client information in the portal in tune with Loan Security Agreement; monitor and update the modifications in the portal in accordance with Loan Modification Agreements.
  • Financial Spreading & Analysis: Spread and analyze financial statements of borrowers in Moody's CreditLens, identifying key trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Covenant Monitoring: Track borrower compliance with financial and non-financial covenants, raising early alerts on potential breaches.
  • Borrowing Base Calculations: Perform accurate and timely borrowing base calculations, ensuring alignment with loan documentation and lending practices.
  • Reporting & MI: Prepare recurring and ad-hoc reports to provide insights into portfolio performance, sectoral trends, and emerging risks.
  • Risk Alerts & Escalations: Support early identification of problem credits through financial deterioration, covenant breaches, or industry headwinds.
  • Collaboration: Partner with U.S. stakeholders across Credit, and Operations to ensure consistent standards, accuracy, and timeliness in deliverables.
  • Process Improvement: Contribute ideas to enhance automation, standardization, and efficiency in portfolio monitoring processes.
  • Quality Assurance: Ensure high level of accuracy in performance of all tasks. Adhere to reporting, financial spreading and covenant calculation KPIs/metrics, completing work within agreed to turnaround times. Report incidents of non-compliance items (e.g., differences in financial statements provided by client) to lead analyst/manager on a timely basis.
  • Mentoring juniors: Monitor tasks to be completed by other team members and support the manager in mentoring and training of new hire analysts.

Skills And Qualification

Functional Skills:

  • Hands-on experience in spreading, covenant monitoring, and credit reporting.
  • Strong knowledge of corporate lending products, credit documentation, and financial statement analysis.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently while being an active team contributor.
  • Efficient and well organized, able to work under tight deadlines
  • Outstanding attention to detail, accuracy, and ability to multitask
  • Ability to be flexible with shift timings (2 pm – 11 pm)

Technical Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Commerce / MBA(Finance).
  • Chartered Accountant / CFA / equivalent qualifications will be an added advantage.
  • Experience: 3–5 years of experience in credit analysis, portfolio monitoring in a bank, NBFC, or financial services firm.
  • Exposure to US accounting, GAAP, and IFRS
  • Proficiency in MS Excel and financial analysis tools; familiarity with SQL, Power BI, Tableau is an advantage.

Leadership Qualities

  • This is an individual contributor role; however, the role may require adhoc workflow management/ supporting team leaders/managers as warranted.
  • High level of ownership and self-drive towards proactive portfolio risk management
  • High on Self-management and situational leadership

Relationships & Collaboration

This role involves working with the Credit Analysis team, reporting to the Credit Analysis Manager. This role will have comprehensive training across credit analysis processes, owning and managing an independent portfolio and collaboration with the lending team and other stakeholders. This role also requires strong communication, and teamwork skills are essential.

Accessibility Needs

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring process. If you require accommodation at any stage (e.g. application, interviews, onboarding) please let us know, and we will work with you to ensure a seamless experience.

Equal Employment Opportunity

FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India) is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible environment and prohibit all forms of discrimination on the basis of gender, religion, caste, disability, sexual orientation, economic status or any other characteristics protected by the law. We strive to foster a safe and respectful environment in which all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. Our EEO policy ensures fairness throughout the employee life cycle.

title: Executive Business Partner
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Executive Business Partner based in the United States.

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and strategic Executive Business Partner to support multiple Research & Development (R&D) Vice Presidents in a fast-paced technology environment. In this role, you will serve as a trusted partner to senior leaders, helping them manage priorities, streamline operations, and drive important business initiatives. You will oversee complex calendars, coordinate domestic and international travel, and facilitate executive meetings and events. Beyond traditional administrative support, you will act as a key connection between executives, their teams, and cross-functional stakeholders. This position requires excellent judgment, discretion, and the ability to anticipate needs while navigating changing priorities. Join a collaborative, remote-first environment where your contributions directly support leadership effectiveness and organizational success.

Accountabilities

  • Partner with multiple executives to understand their priorities, manage complex calendars, and evaluate competing meeting requests, ensuring their time is aligned with the organization's most important objectives.
  • Independently make scheduling and administrative decisions on behalf of executives, exercising sound judgment and discretion when prioritizing requests and managing sensitive matters.
  • Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, including flights, accommodation, visa requirements, itineraries, and expense reporting.
  • Organize executive meetings, leadership summits, team-building activities, and special events, managing research, agendas, participant coordination, presentation materials, and logistical arrangements.
  • Build strong relationships with executives' direct reports and key stakeholders, serving as a central point of contact to facilitate communication, identify challenges, and advance business priorities.
  • Support executive communications by preparing presentations, drafting correspondence, coordinating written and verbal communications, and documenting meeting discussions, decisions, and action items.
  • Collaborate with other Executive Business Partners and administrative professionals across departments to coordinate activities and support broader organizational goals.
  • Develop a strong understanding of business operations, leadership priorities, and team objectives to anticipate executive needs and proactively identify opportunities to improve processes.
  • Support expense tracking, procurement, contract management, and administrative reporting as required.
  • Contribute to a collaborative administrative community by sharing best practices and helping improve operational efficiency across teams.

Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience providing executive-level administrative or business partnership support in a fast-paced technology environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple executives, competing priorities, complex calendars, and simultaneous deliverables with minimal supervision.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, professionalism, integrity, and discretion when handling confidential information and sensitive business matters.
  • Proven ability to build effective cross-functional relationships and collaborate with senior leaders, direct reports, administrative peers, and other stakeholders.
  • Experience coordinating domestic and international travel, including flights, hotels, visa arrangements, and expense management.
  • Demonstrated experience planning and facilitating virtual, in-person, and hybrid leadership meetings, executive summits, and team-building events.
  • Strong proficiency with administrative and collaboration tools, including Google Workspace, Zoom, Slack, and similar platforms.
  • Excellent time-management, organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate challenges and make sound decisions in ambiguous situations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare professional presentations, reports, and executive correspondence.
  • Preferred: Previous experience supporting Product or Engineering Vice Presidents.
  • Preferred: Understanding of business operating rhythms, leadership cadences, and organizational planning requirements.
  • Preferred: Experience with contract management, procurement processes, and tracking travel and entertainment expenses against budgets.
  • Preferred: Ability to conduct research, prepare reports, develop presentations, and adapt quickly when priorities change.
  • Ability to work remotely within the United States. Please note that candidates residing in San Francisco, Oakland, San Jose, or surrounding areas are not eligible for this position.

title: AI Operationalization Lead
description:
About Machinify

Machinify builds the AI operating system for healthcare payment intelligence, combining the minds of industry experts with the power of technology. US healthcare wastes billions of dollars a year inside the claims payment workflow, and Machinify has built a platform to fix that, backed by more than 40 years of payment integrity expertise and a product suite spanning the full claims lifecycle from pre-pay through post-pay. Today, 85+ customers rely on us, including 18 of the top 20 US health plans, covering more than 270 million member lives across commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid. We process over 3 petabytes of claims data and return more than $6 billion in savings and recoveries to our customers every year, with 99% customer retention.

We're now opening a new hub in Bengaluru that isn't a satellite office or a support function: it's a genuine extension of one global Machinify, where local leaders run real teams and own real product and outcomes. The problems our teams solve are hard by design, which is exactly why they haven't been solved before, and why the work is worth doing. Joining now means building Machinify's India presence- its people, culture, and way of working- from the ground up, with real influence over what gets built and how.

About The Role

Machinify is building a dedicated AI Operationalization team, and we're looking for a Lead to run it. Across the company, employees are already using AI tools — Claude, custom Slack bots, one-off s and apps — to solve real problems on their own initiative. Some of these citizen developer creations are genuinely valuable, but they were built to solve one person's problem quickly, not to run reliably at company scale, under the security, compliance, and support standards Machinify's customers and regulators expect.

The AI Operationalization Lead owns the pipeline that takes those grassroots AI products and turns them into tools the company can actually depend on — hardened, monitored, documented, and owned. Just as important, this role builds the platform, tooling, and repeatable process that make that operationalization faster and cheaper every time, so promoting a citizen-built prototype to a supported internal product stops being a bespoke project and becomes a well-worn path.

What You Will Own

  • Build and lead the AI Operationalization team, setting its charter, intake process, and prioritization model for evaluating citizen-developer AI tools.
  • Define and run a maturity/promotion pipeline that takes a tool from prototype to production: security review, code and architecture review, testing, documentation, and ownership handoff — with a PHI screen early in the pipeline to flag anything that needs to be handed to the US-based compliance team instead of proceeding locally.
  • Design and build the shared platform, templates, and golden paths (CI/CD, deployment patterns, reusable components, logging/monitoring hooks) that make it faster to operationalize the next tool than the last one.
  • Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal on internal AI governance standards before a tool reaches production. This team does not own HIPAA/HITRUST compliance work: part of the role is recognizing when a citizen-developer tool touches protected health information and routing or escalating that work to Machinify's US-based Security and Compliance teams rather than operationalizing it locally.
  • Work directly with citizen developers across the business to understand what they built and why, translate tribal knowledge into supportable systems, and mentor them in engineering practices that make their next build easier to operationalize.
  • Establish ongoing ownership: monitoring, incident response, versioning, and a clear support model for each promoted tool, so operationalized tools don't silently degrade or become orphaned.
  • Track and report on the health of the citizen-developer-to-production pipeline — what's in the queue, what's been promoted, what's been retired — to IT and business leadership.
  • Evaluate and recommend platform, tooling, and vendor choices (internal developer platforms, model routing/gateways, deployment infrastructure) that support the team's mission.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape and bring in newer approaches where they meaningfully improve speed, reliability, or governance — with tradeoffs clearly stated to stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including production ownership of systems built by others (rewrites, hardening, or platformization of existing prototypes).
  • Direct experience working with LLM-based tools and frameworks (e.g., Claude, OpenAI, LangChain-style orchestration, MCP-based integrations) at a practical, hands-on level.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms, CI/CD pipelines, or self-service tooling that other engineers or non-engineers use to ship work.
  • Enough working familiarity with HIPAA/HITRUST-style data regulations to recognize when a piece of work touches protected health information and needs to be flagged or escalated — this role is not expected to own that compliance work directly.
  • Experience with generalized process automation beyond LLM tooling — RPA, workflow orchestration, ing-based automation — since much of what gets operationalized will look more like automate this repetitive process reliably than integrate a language model.
  • Track record of leading a small team or function, including setting process, prioritizing intake, and reporting to leadership.
  • Strong communication skills — able to work with both non-technical citizen developer creators and engineering/security stakeholders, and to explain tradeoffs plainly.
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity: this is a new function, and part of the role is defining what done looks like.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Machinify

Machinify is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination on any status protected under applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruitment process, please let our recruiting team know.

description:
De ion

The Global Solutions Risk and Compliance (GSRC) team ensures that Amazon transactions satisfy legal and safety requirements in accordance to the guidelines across global marketplaces. We proactively identify risks involved for Amazon while doing business in various countries and enable smooth flow of products across international borders. A Sr. Compliance Associate(DE) is responsible for protecting Amazon customers from products that are illegal, hazardous, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited /regulated by Law and Amazon policies.

Key job responsibilities

As a Sr. Compliance Associate(DE), your responsibility is reviewing the latest product information as per Standard Operations Procedures (SOP) and cross-checking it against the relevant regulatory documentation. Using various Amazon-specific tools and systems you classify the products to ensure they meet the necessary compliance requirements for availability on Amazon. Throughout the day, you work closely with your manager and the Process Experts and address any deviations from standard SOPs, seeking their guidance when necessary. You maintain detailed records of your assigned tasks and utilize standardized reports to prioritize your work, ensuring you meet Quality, Productivity and Service Level Agreement targets. You may identify opportunities for improvement and collaborate with partner teams to explore ways to reduce manual effort, such as automating reports using Excel queries. You share feedback on the team's SOPs, contributing to the ongoing refinement of the operational processes. You participate in knowledge-sharing sessions, contributing with your expertise and learnings. As a mentor, you may support peers by answering their queries and providing process-level training.

Skills

  • Ability to use Microsoft Excel tool as per role requirements (filtering and sorting in data sets, cell referencing, pivot tables, data validation, etc.)
  • Basic understanding of SQL, can self-service defined queries and make simple changes to retrieve data from a database
  • Knowledgeable in Customer Relationship Management tools, managing customer data and tracking interactions
  • Attention to detail and ability to analyze and identify patterns across data sets and information
  • Problem-solving skills, with the ability to find solutions through logic, intuition, creativity, and design thinking
  • Commitment to investigation, research, and diving deep to seek facts
  • Ability to understand, interpret, critique, analyses and communicate data

About The Team

Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being the world's most customer centric company. Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.

The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon's product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon's worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

Basic Qualifications

  • 1+ years of data-driven business operations processes experience
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English
  • German B1+ proficiency in verbal and written communication
  • Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
  • Business Process Outsourcing, Operations processes; Database management is an added advantage

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of consumer product compliance processes and regulations
  • Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies
  • Experience in designing and implementing custom reporting systems using automation tools
  • Experience with data analysis in a variety of quantitative fields and experience building data and decision support systems
  • Advanced Excel skills (VBA)
  • Knowledge of database querying (SQL)

title: Deputy Manager - Boiler Maintenance
description:
Purpose / Objective

To ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operation and maintenance of Boiler Systems and Boiler Auxiliaries in large utility-scale thermal power plants. The role is responsible for executing preventive, predictive, breakdown, and shutdown maintenance activities to maximize equipment availability, improve reliability, reduce forced outages, and support generation targets while ensuring compliance with safety, quality, and statutory requirements.

De ion for Internal Candidates

About Business

Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the Adani Group, is India's largest private thermal power producer with a diversified portfolio of utility-scale thermal power plants across multiple locations. Adani Power is committed to operational excellence, reliability improvement, safety leadership, and world-class O&M practices.

Key Responsibilities of Role

Boiler Maintenance

  • Execute preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance activities of Boiler systems and auxiliaries.
  • Ensure high availability and reliability of Boiler equipment and associated systems.
  • Monitor equipment health and recommend corrective actions to minimize forced outages.
  • Support maintenance planning and execution in line with approved maintenance schedules.

Boiler Systems & Auxiliaries

Maintain and monitor the health of:

  • Boiler Pressure Parts
  • Water Wall Tubes
  • Superheater
  • Reheater
  • Economiser
  • Boiler Headers
  • APH (Air Preheater)
  • ESP (Electrostatic Precipitator)
  • PA Fans
  • FD Fans
  • ID Fans
  • Soot Blowers
  • Coal Piping
  • Expansion Joints
  • Dampers
  • Valves and Supports
  • PF (Pulverized Fuel) Firing System and associated auxiliaries

Shutdown & Overhaul Management

  • Participate in Annual Overhaul (AOH), Capital Overhaul (COH), and planned shutdown activities.
  • Execute major maintenance activities within approved timelines and quality standards.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Electrical, C&I, CHP, AHP, and contractor teams during shutdowns.
  • Support commissioning and post-maintenance trial runs of equipment.

Reliability Improvement

  • Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) of recurring failures.
  • Support implementation of Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) and predictive maintenance initiatives.
  • Participate in condition monitoring activities including vibration monitoring, thermography, thickness measurement, and equipment inspections.
  • Identify opportunities for reliability enhancement, equipment life improvement, and forced outage reduction.

Documentation & Maintenance Planning

  • Maintain detailed equipment history and maintenance records.
  • Prepare maintenance reports, technical audit reports, RCA reports, AOH/COH reports, and maintenance MIS.
  • Draft and update Standard Maintenance Procedures (SMPs).
  • Ensure accurate documentation in SAP PM and maintenance management systems.

Inventory & Cost Management

  • Monitor critical spare parts inventory and material availability.
  • Raise purchase requisitions and support procurement activities for maintenance requirements.
  • Ensure optimum utilization of maintenance resources and budget.
  • Assist in annual maintenance planning and budgeting activities.

Safety, Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure strict compliance with PTW, LOTO, EHS standards, and Adani Safety Protocols.
  • Conduct maintenance activities in accordance with safety procedures and statutory requirements.
  • Support contractor safety management and safety training initiatives.
  • Participate in safety audits, risk assessments, and quality compliance reviews.

Stakeholder Coordination

  • Coordinate with Operations, CHP, Ash Handling, Electrical, C&I, Engineering, Stores, and Contractor teams.
  • Support timely completion of maintenance activities through effective cross-functional coordination.
  • Assist section heads and maintenance leads in emergency handling and restoration activities.

Qualifications and Experience

Educational Qualification

Mandatory

  • B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized University / Institute.

Experience

6–12 Years of relevant experience in Boiler Maintenance.

Mandatory Experience

  • Must have hands-on experience in maintenance of Pulverized Fuel (PF) Boilers.
  • Must have worked in thermal power plants with unit capacity of 500 MW and above.
  • Experience in utility-scale thermal power plants is mandatory.
  • Exposure to Supercritical and Subcritical Boiler Units will be preferred.
  • Experience in maintenance of Boiler Pressure Parts, APH, ESP, PA Fans, FD Fans, ID Fans, Soot Blowers, Coal Piping, and associated auxiliaries.
  • Experience in Annual Overhauls (AOH), Capital Overhauls (COH), and major shutdown maintenance activities.
  • Working knowledge of SAP PM or equivalent maintenance management systems.

Essential Areas of Expertise

  • Boiler Maintenance
  • Pulverized Fuel (PF) Boilers
  • Boiler Pressure Parts
  • APH Maintenance
  • ESP Maintenance
  • PA/FD/ID Fan Maintenance
  • Soot Blower Systems
  • Coal Piping Systems
  • Shutdown & Overhaul Management
  • Reliability Engineering
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
  • Predictive & Preventive Maintenance
  • SAP PM
  • Condition Monitoring
  • Thermal Power Plant O&M

Preferred Candidate Profile

  • Experience in thermal power plants having 500 MW, 600 MW, 660 MW, 800 MW or higher capacity units.
  • Strong understanding of PF Boiler maintenance, outage management, reliability improvement, and equipment troubleshooting.
  • Good communication, team coordination, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work in a high-performance, safety-focused thermal power generation environment.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
Location: Bangalore, India – Hybrid

About The Role

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Staff Engineer to provide technical leadership for WebCenter-based content management, artwork, and leaflet automation solutions serving Life Sciences customers. The role combines software architecture, implementation, and squad-level technical leadership. It is intentionally backend-focused while requiring sufficient full-stack awareness to shape and review complete customer workflows.

You will help evolve the current solution into a scalable, reusable product capability that supports broader market adoption. The solution connects approved source content with template-driven artwork generation, including Adobe InDesign Server automation, content extraction and transformation, rule application and validation, preservation of existing styling, and generation or update of print-ready PDF artwork for packaging and patient-information leaflets.

The solution may also consume centrally maintained services delivered through the Esko Packaging Cloud platform, including content conversion, content extraction, and selected AI-enabled capabilities supplied by specialized product teams. This role focuses on sound application integration, workflow design, validation, and operational reliability rather than developing AI models or foundational AI services.

This is an individual-contributor role on Esko's technical leadership track.

As you build product and domain knowledge, you are expected to assume a significant technical leadership role within the Content Management and Leaflet Automation squad in our product operating model. The scope of that leadership may grow over time based on demonstrated capability and evolving team needs.

You will lead through architectural authority, hands-on engineering, mentoring, and influence, not through formal reporting responsibility. Success requires initiative and true end-to-end ownership: identifying what needs to be solved, shaping viable options, making clear decisions, and carrying them through implementation and production validation with a high degree of autonomy.

What You'll Do

Own and evolve the solution architecture: Define practical, secure, and maintainable designs across WebCenter services, Adobe automation, structured content processing, integration APIs, data storage, and user-facing workflows.

Remain directly involved in engineering: Write and review production code, build prototypes and technical spikes, investigate difficult defects, and carry key architectural decisions through implementation, testing, release, and production follow-up.

Assume a significant technical leadership role in the squad: Align engineers around a shared approach, help plan and coordinate significant initiatives, resolve technical blockers, manage dependencies, and break complex architectural changes into deliverable increments.

Design Adobe-based artwork automation: Architect and implement reliable integrations with Adobe InDesign, with particular emphasis on InDesign Server automation, using appropriate ing and application APIs to update template-based artwork while preserving layout, styling, and content integrity.

Engineer structured-content workflows: Design content models, transformation and mapping approaches, validation rules, traceability, and error handling for regulated or approved source content used in packaging and patient-information materials.

Design reliable integration contracts: Define API and data contracts, secure service-integration boundaries, compatibility and versioning approaches, timeout and retry behaviour, idempotency, data consistency, and handling of partial failures.

Apply Life Sciences quality thinking: Work with product management and domain experts to translate customer and regulatory workflow needs into testable technical solutions, with strong attention to accuracy, traceability, controlled change, and reproducible generated outputs.

Integrate shared platform services responsibly: Collaborate with specialized platform and AI product teams to integrate centrally maintained services where they provide clear product value. Own the WebCenter application-side integration, workflow behaviour, validation, observability, error handling, and fallback mechanisms. Independently verify service outputs and protect customer and company information. Development of AI models or foundational AI services is outside the scope of this role.

Improve production outcomes: Strengthen performance diagnostics, runtime monitoring, observability, testability, resilience, security, and operational readiness; lead root-cause analysis for complex cross-system issues.

Manage technical debt deliberately: Identify architectural risks and maintain a pragmatic improvement plan that balances long-term product health with roadmap delivery and customer commitments.

Mentor and grow engineers: Provide structured mentoring through pairing, architecture and design reviews, code reviews, focused learning, and ongoing technical guidance that builds team capability and independence.

Make technical decisions clear and discoverable: Author and maintain architecture decision records, design documentation, technical standards, and implementation guidance; explain alternatives, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Foster pragmatic innovation and AI-assisted engineering: Make effective use of the existing technology stack while selectively adopting relevant new technologies and engineering practices. Use AI-assisted coding and agentic engineering tools thoughtfully to accelerate analysis, implementation, testing, documentation, and code review, while retaining engineering accountability for architecture, security, correctness, maintainability, and understanding of the resulting code. Share validated practices and help the squad use these tools effectively and responsibly.

Minimum Qualifications

What We're Looking For

These are the must-have requirements for the role:

Relevant experience: At least 12 years of relevant software-engineering experience, including extensive recent hands-on work designing, developing, and evolving substantial production-grade web applications. Demonstrated architectural impact and implementation depth are essential; tenure alone is not sufficient.

Architectural and backend depth: Demonstrated architectural contribution to substantial production-grade web applications, including evaluating design alternatives, defining API and data contracts, applying software-design patterns, and guiding implementation across application tiers. Strong recent hands-on Java/J2EE experience is required to own service-layer decisions and review implementations with technical authority.

Adobe integration expertise: Proven hands-on experience integrating Adobe software into production workflows. Strong experience with Adobe InDesign ing or application APIs is required, together with practical InDesign Server experience or clear evidence of the ability to become effective with InDesign Server quickly. Experience must extend beyond end-user use of Adobe applications.

Enterprise Java runtime expertise: Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, monitoring, and troubleshooting enterprise Java applications on WildFly and/or Apache Tomcat. Strong understanding of JVM behavior, concurrency, transaction management, exception handling, performance diagnostics, and JMX or related runtime diagnostics.

Data and full-stack awareness: Strong relational-database knowledge using Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and/or Oracle, including data modelling, complex SQL, execution-plan analysis, indexing, transaction behavior, and safe schema or data migration. Sufficient full-stack awareness to understand and review how backend, database, API, and browser-side decisions affect complete customer workflows.

Secure web-application engineering: Strong practical experience applying secure-by-design principles to enterprise web applications, including authentication, authorization, trust boundaries, secure handling of credentials and sensitive data, threat modelling, security-focused architecture and code reviews, OWASP Top 10 risks, dependency and software-composition analysis, vulnerability triage and remediation, secure configuration, and secrets management. Able to work with security specialists, assess findings, prioritize risk-proportionate corrective actions, and help prevent recurrence throughout the development lifecycle.

Frontend architecture awareness: Good understanding of modern frontend concepts and frameworks, including component architecture, state management, browser-side behavior, and API integration. Sufficient knowledge of React and Type to review frontend designs and implementations, assess how user-facing components fit the overall solution, and guide sound full-stack architectural decisions; extensive hands-on frontend coding is not required.

Technical leadership and initiative ownership: Demonstrated leadership through architecture and design reviews, code reviews, structured mentoring, delivery planning, and cross-team alignment. Evidence of aligning engineers and driving significant initiatives from design through implementation and production, while managing technical debt pragmatically and building team independence.

Quality engineering: Proven ability to improve mature software safely through effective unit, integration, end-to-end, and regression testing; design software for testability; and validate automated artwork outputs against representative templates, documents, and edge cases. Able to use logs, debugging, and profiling to diagnose complex defects across system boundaries.

Communication and product-team collaboration: Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to document decisions and explain architecture, trade-offs, technical risks, and recommendations to engineers, product leaders, business stakeholders, domain experts, and customer-facing teams. Experience working iteratively in a cross-functional product team with product management, UX, QA, domain experts, and adjacent engineering teams to achieve measurable customer and product outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

These skills will set candidates apart:

InDesign and publishing depth: Strong production experience with InDesign Server, Extend , Adobe application object models and APIs, IDML, Adobe Illustrator, CEP and/or UXP, or C++-based Adobe plug-in development.

Structured content and document generation: Experience with XML, XPath, XSLT, XML Schema, content modelling, parsing, validation, transformation, multilingual content, template-driven publishing, content-to-layout mapping, or prepress workflows.

Life Sciences domain: Experience with regulated content, labeling, artwork, packaging, patient-information leaflets, controlled content approval, or traceability requirements in pharmaceutical or other regulated environments.

Automation engineering: Experience contributing to server-side document, artwork, or comparable workflow automation, with awareness of input validation, structured data exchange, actionable error reporting, compatibility, performance, and diagnosing failures across system boundaries.

Cloud-service integration architecture: Experience enabling an established single-tenant enterprise application to consume centrally maintained services hosted on a cloud platform. Relevant experience includes defining service contracts, secure integration boundaries, data exchange, compatibility, reliability, observability, and failure handling across application and platform boundaries. Familiarity with AWS-based or hybrid deployments is beneficial.

Integration of shared intelligent services: Experience incorporating AI-enabled or probabilistic services supplied by a specialized platform or product team into an enterprise application. Relevant experience includes validating outputs, handling uncertainty, defining appropriate safeguards and fallback behaviour, monitoring service behaviour, and determining when human verification is required. AI-model or foundational AI-service development expertise is not required.

AI-assisted software engineering: Practical experience using AI coding assistants or agentic engineering tools as part of professional software development. Able to structure effective development tasks and context, critically review and test generated changes, identify security or maintainability risks, and ensure that AI-assisted output remains understandable, supportable, and consistent with established architecture and engineering standards.

Distributed product development: Experience working effectively across geographically distributed engineering and product teams.

How Success Will Be Measured

End-to-end technical ownership: Significant initiatives move from problem definition and architectural decision-making through implementation, production validation, and follow-through on unresolved risks and operational issues.

Scalable solution architecture: The content-management and leaflet-automation architecture is clearly documented, understood by the squad, and reflected in delivered software that supports additional customers and use cases.

Reliable Adobe automation: InDesign Server and related automation workflows produce accurate, traceable, and maintainable outputs with clear failure handling, diagnostics, and compatibility management.

Stronger squad execution: Technical risks and dependencies are identified earlier, complex blockers are resolved effectively, and architectural work is broken into achievable delivery increments.

Improved product quality: Targeted improvements demonstrate measurable gains in reliability, security, performance, maintainability, test coverage, or operational visibility.

Responsible integration of shared platform services: Centrally maintained services, including selected AI-enabled capabilities, are integrated only where they provide validated customer value, with effective application-level safeguards, monitoring, failure handling, fallback behaviour, and independent verification of outputs where required.

Greater team capability: Engineers make stronger technical decisions and work more independently through effective reviews, mentoring, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

Market-enabling evolution: The solution advances beyond the initial implementation toward a reusable product capability that can support broader Life Sciences adoption.

About Esko

It's all possible with a role at Esko. Esko, a Veralto company, is a global provider of integrated software and hardware solutions that accelerate the go-to-market process of packaged goods. Our integrated platform and comprehensive tools empower retailers, pre-media and trade shops, manufacturers, and converters to manage best-in-class packaging design and print processes. Innovation is built into the DNA of our business: every day, we challenge ourselves to be better by seeking out new ways to elevate our products, our processes, and our people. We also know that innovation and ingenuity start with prioritizing a diverse workforce and a deeply inclusive workplace. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions.

title: Law Enforcement Response -LER- Specialist
description:
De ion

AMAZON | LEGAL

Law Enforcement Response (LER) Specialist

Level 5

  • Legal Operations & Compliance
  • Amazon India Role LER Specialist (Paralegal II) Level L5 — Individual contributor with team leadership Team Law Enforcement Response (LER), India Location Delhi NCR, India Work model Full-time
  • Work From Office People management Leads a team of 3 associates Experience 6–10 years of relevant experience

About The Role

Amazon is searching for a smart, motivated specialist to join its Law Enforcement Response (LER) team in India. The LER team is a dedicated group of specialists responsible for receiving, reviewing, and responding to law enforcement requests — such as notices, summons, and court orders — received from government agencies and police authorities across different Amazon India entities.

As an LER Specialist, your principal duty is to ensure that these requests are processed professionally and expeditiously, while safeguarding the privacy and security of business and customer information in accordance with the law and with Amazon's policies and procedures. The role sits at the intersection of law[ and demands sound judgment in challenging and ambiguous situations.

This is a high-judgment, high-ownership role. You will lead a small team, serve as a trusted point of contact for law enforcement officers, and help Amazon meet its legal obligations in India's rapidly evolving regulatory landscape. Candidates must be self-motivated, have a strong work ethic, and be able to work independently — at times with little supervision.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Triage high request volumes. Receive, log, and process law enforcement information requests arriving through multiple channels, internal portal, the dedicated police-inquiries mailbox, the government portals.
  • Respond lawfully and accurately. Evaluate and respond to each request in a manner consistent with the privacy and security of business and customer information, and in accordance with the law and with Amazon's policies and procedures.
  • Meet urgent SLAs. Triage and close requests in line with established SLAs and SOPs, recognizing that delayed responses can result in loss of customer trustin customers losing funds; periodically receive and process emergency requests on a set rotation, including outside normal business hours and sometimes overnight.
  • Manage external stakeholders. Communicate verbally and in writing with law enforcement officers, Amazon employees, and others — including significant phone-based coordination with officers who follow up on submitted requests. Explain what information Amazon can and cannot legally share, and guide officers on legally compliant intake formats (e.g., Section 94 BNSS notice requirements).
  • Lead a team. Manage and develop a team of 3 associates who actively process requests; help lead the training and development of other LER specialists.
  • Coordinate internally. Work with internal Amazon partner teams — some of whom run data queries to retrieve relevant information — and apply familiarity with data-retrieval concepts to challenge or validate the outputs you receive.
  • Use the right tools. Use a combination of web-based applications and data-extraction tools to compile information potentially responsive to a particular request.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, compliance playbooks, and process documentation
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows and partner with engineering/product teams to develop tools and automation for legal compliance processes
  • Spot patterns. Assist in the identification of patterns and trends evident from the processing of certain law enforcement requests, and handle the most complex and challenging requests and special projects.
  • Authenticate evidence. Sign and issue certificates / letters to authenticate digital evidence in response to law enforcement requests.
  • Represent Amazon. Travel periodically, including on short notice, to represent Amazon in courts and law enforcement offices as required.

A Day in the Life

You will start your day reviewing incoming law enforcement requests from government agencies for validity, scope, and compliance requirements. You will exercise independent judgment to determine appropriate responses, balancing legal obligations with customer privacy and data security. Because a large share of information requests you will lean on your team to keep the queue healthy, partner with internal data teams to retrieve and validate information, and escalate the genuinely hard calls.   • Experience working in fast-paced environments and managing workload even during times of stress or escalated activity.

  • Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities at once.

Officers can be demanding or aggressive, follow-ups come at all hours — including over weekends — and the right person stays composed, credible, and firm on what the law permits.

  • Builds genuine rapport with officers while holding the line on Amazon's legal and privacy obligations.
  • Guides officers toward legally compliant intake formats (e.g., Section 94 BNSS notices) rather than simply rejecting flawed requests.
  • Exercises independent, defensible judgment on complex and novel request types.
  • Owns outcomes end-to-end and raises the bar for the team through coaching and clear process.

title: Power BI Developer
description:

The selected candidate will be a full-time, dedicated member of the programme, primarily responsible for supporting Power BI-related activities, including migration of existing on-premises Power BI reports, datasets and associated storage to cloud infrastructure.

The individual will work closely with the Data Team in Brno (Czech Republic), the Data Team in India, the Project Solution Architect, Microsoft SMEs and business stakeholders to ensure successful migration, configuration and deployment of Power BI solutions.

Product & Technology plays a pivotal role in aligning the organization with its strategic objectives and enhancing shareholder value. Product & Technology is responsible for establishing unified standards and governance practices throughout the company. Additionally, we oversee the development and maintenance of core applications essential for the seamless operation of various functions across the organization. We are committed to driving and executing future roadmaps that are in line with the overall strategic direction of RWS.

With a global reach, Product & Technology provides support services to over 7500 end users worldwide. We take pride in managing the information security operation and safeguarding all our assets. Our core functions encompass Enterprise & Technical Architecture, Network & Voice, Infrastructure, Service Delivery, Service Operations, Data & Analytics, Security & Quality Compliance, Transformation, Application Development, Enterprise Platforms, With a dedicated team of over 500 staff, Product & Technology ensures a strong presence across all regions, enabling efficient and effective support to our global operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Power BI Data MigrationPlan and execute the migration of a large portfolio of identified on-premises Power BI reports, datasets and associated NetApp storage to cloud infrastructure.
  • Assess existing reports and datasets and identify migration dependencies and potential challenges.
  • Ensure data integrity, report functionality and consistency throughout the migration process.
  • Power BI Cloud ConfigurationConfigure Power BI cloud environments following migration.
  • Review and repurpose migrated reports to ensure they are business-ready and meet end-user requirements.
  • Understand and implement cloud configurations to support guest account access and collaboration.
  • Troubleshoot migration and configuration-related issues.
  • Solution Design & Stakeholder CollaborationWork closely with the Project Solution Architect and Power BI report owners to understand and document technical and business requirements.
  • Collaborate with Microsoft SMEs to validate the proposed technical approach and finalise the migration strategy.
  • Develop and maintain a migration and implementation plan in coordination with the dedicated Project Manager.
  • Coordinate with data teams in Brno and India to ensure smooth execution and timely delivery.

Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI, including report development, administration and migration.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with complex datasets.
  • Experience with SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).
  • Experience with Azure Storage and cloud-based data infrastructure.
  • Understanding of migrating on-premises Power BI solutions to cloud environments.
  • Experience in analyzing, troubleshooting and optimizing Power BI reports and datasets.

Desirable Skills

  • Knowledge and experience of SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS).
  • Experience with paginated reports.
  • Familiarity with Power BI On-premises Data Gateway.
  • Experience with RDL (Report Definition Language) and RDS-related migration requirements.
  • Exposure to alternative approaches for migrating or repurposing RDL reports where required.

Candidate Profile

  • Minimum 5–6 years of relevant experience in Power BI and the Microsoft data ecosystem.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with geographically distributed teams.
  • Experience working in enterprise-scale data migration or cloud transformation programmes would be an advantage.

title: Business Intelligence Developer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Intelligence Developer based in the United States.

You will play a key role in developing an audience intelligence platform that brings together donor interactions, campaign performance, engagement activities, and other behavioral data. Working closely with product management and data engineering teams, you will design AI-enabled dashboards, interactive visualizations, and analytical solutions that help organizations make better-informed decisions. You will also establish consistent performance metrics, improve data quality, and translate business requirements into effective technical solutions. This fully remote opportunity is ideal for an analytical and collaborative professional who enjoys building innovative data products and making advanced analytics accessible to a wide range of users.

Accountabilities:

You will lead the development of business intelligence tools and data-driven product capabilities, ensuring that complex information is transformed into clear, reliable, and actionable insights. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Business Intelligence and Visualization: Design, develop, and test AI-enabled analytics tools, dashboards, and data visualizations that highlight key audience intelligence metrics, including engagement, activation, retention, and attribution.

  • Data Analysis and Insights: Analyze campaign, CRM, donor, and audience data to identify meaningful patterns, behavioral trends, and opportunities for improved engagement and performance.

  • AI-Driven Development: Apply AI-native thinking and AI-enabled development approaches to create innovative analytical tools and improve the delivery of business intelligence solutions.

  • Product Collaboration: Work closely with product management teams to develop user-focused features incorporating relevant metrics, benchmarks, and data visualization best practices.

  • Data Engineering Coordination: Collaborate with data engineering partners to define technical specifications, use cases, and requirements for data models and analytics infrastructure.

  • Metrics Definition and Documentation: Establish, document, and maintain the business logic behind core product KPIs to ensure consistency, accuracy, and trust in reported metrics.

  • Data Quality and Testing: Validate dashboard outputs, investigate data inconsistencies, and participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) for new analytics features.

  • Client Data Onboarding: Support client onboarding by reviewing data mappings, interpreting source data formats, and recommending appropriate visualization and reporting approaches.

  • Technology Assessment: Evaluate available technologies and make recommendations to product and technology leadership based on business requirements, technical feasibility, and product objectives.

  • Continuous Improvement: Work iteratively, test solutions early, and refine analytics products based on user feedback, evolving business needs, and emerging technologies.

Requirements:

The ideal candidate is an experienced business intelligence professional with strong technical expertise, a product-oriented mindset, and the ability to communicate complex analytical concepts clearly. You should be comfortable working independently while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams and translating user needs into practical data solutions. The following qualifications and skills are expected:

  • At least 5 years of experience in data-driven business intelligence, preferably working with product teams to develop products and services for external clients or customers.

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience building data visualizations and dashboards using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Amazon QuickSight, Hex, Sigma, ThoughtSpot, or Looker.

  • At least 1 year of practical experience in AI-enabled business intelligence development.

  • Understanding and experience with semantic data models and semantic layers.

  • Demonstrated ability to create interactive, multi-layered dashboards and effective data visualizations.

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and the ability to independently query and analyze large datasets.

  • Experience working with marketing and CRM data, including campaign engagement, audience segmentation, and donation trends.

  • Understanding of customer journeys, conversion funnels, engagement metrics, and donor lifecycle analysis.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex datasets into actionable business recommendations.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate between user needs, product capabilities, technical requirements, and business outcomes.

  • Ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments, take initiative, and move projects forward through testing and iterative development.

  • Collaborative mindset, with a willingness to share knowledge, support colleagues, and build strong working relationships.

  • Confidence in communicating recommendations, influencing decisions, and providing clear direction when needed.

  • Enthusiasm, adaptability, and a proactive approach to continuous learning and improvement.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience using and developing APIs to access, integrate, and analyze complex datasets.

  • Experience building analytics products for external customers or users.

  • Familiarity with AI-powered analytics platforms and emerging business intelligence technologies.

Benefits:

  • Fully remote work opportunity.

  • Professional development and continuous learning opportunities.

  • Opportunity to contribute to innovative, AI-driven data products and analytics solutions.

  • Collaborative working environment that encourages knowledge sharing, creativity, and cross-functional teamwork.

title: Fullstack Developer
description:
About The Role

The role is based in the Pune R&D Center at the SAS R&D Pune facility. We are looking for a Software Developer to join the Visual Machine Learning (VML) and Visual Text Analytics (VTA) product development team in the Analytics area. In this role, you will help design, develop, test, maintain, and support enterprise-scale analytical products with a focus on quality, scalability, maintainability, and timely delivery.

You will work with modern technologies and engineering practices such as React, Java /Type , Golang, REST APIs, automated testing, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native deployment models. You will collaborate closely with local and global engineering teams, product owners, UX, architects, and test engineers to deliver features that integrate well with the SAS Viya platform and meet customer expectations.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality product features for complex analytical applications, with focus on scalable UI, API, and service interactions.
  • Collaborate with product owners, UX, architects, test engineers, and local/global development teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet customer and platform needs.
  • Translate use cases and design inputs into clear technical designs, implementation plans, and maintainable code.
  • Develop reusable, secure, accessible, and performant UI components and application workflows using modern front-end development practices.
  • Build and integrate REST APIs and related service interactions needed to support product functionality and end-to-end user workflows.
  • Write and maintain unit tests, integration tests, and supporting automation to improve product quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate actively in design reviews, code reviews, debugging sessions, and technical discussions to maintain high engineering standards.
  • Contribute to CI/CD and cloud-based development workflows, including build, deployment, troubleshooting, and environment readiness activities.
  • Track assigned work, communicate progress, dependencies, risks, and blockers in a timely and transparent manner.
  • Resolve product defects and customer-impacting issues by analyzing root causes and implementing reliable, maintainable fixes.
  • Mentor and guide junior team members through code reviews, design discussions, technical practices, and day-to-day engineering support.
  • Continuously learn and evaluate relevant technologies, frameworks, tools, and implementation approaches that can improve product quality, developer productivity, and delivery outcomes.

Requirement

  • 5 to 8 years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and supporting multi-tier software applications, with a strong understanding of the full software development lifecycle.
  • Strong programming skills in at least one modern programming language such as Golang, Java, Python, Java , or Type , with the ability to quickly work across related technologies as needed.
  • Hands-on experience developing modern web applications using React, Java /Type , Redux, React hooks, and related UI ecosystem practices.
  • Experience designing and developing scalable UI components, REST APIs, and interactions across multiple software components or services.
  • Good understanding of clean code principles, object-oriented design, modular design, data structures, and common design patterns.
  • Experience with unit, integration, and API/UI testing, including writing testable code and using automated test frameworks as part of day-to-day development.
  • Working knowledge of Git and GitHub based development workflows, including branching, pull requests, code reviews, and collaborative development practices.
  • Familiarity with Agile software development practices and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug complex issues across the UI, API, and service layers.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly to local and global stakeholders.

Good to have

  • Exposure to cloud-native development practices and deployment models in public cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, containerized applications, cluster concepts, and troubleshooting in distributed environments.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, build automation, deployment automation, and quality gates used in modern software delivery.
  • Exposure to microservices, distributed systems, service-to-service communication, observability, logging, and monitoring practices.
  • Experience working with analytical, machine learning, text analytics, data management, or enterprise-scale software products.
  • Awareness of accessibility, internationalization, performance, security, and usability considerations for enterprise web applications.
  • Experience contributing to technical design documents, developer documentation, or knowledge sharing within an engineering team.

title: Orthopedic Technician II - Boston
description:
Orthopedic Technician II - Boston

Job Profile Summary

​This role focuses on providing medical and clinical support services to patients. In addition, this role focuses on performing the following Surgical Services duties: Responsible for medical services involving the excision or incision of a patient's body, such as interventional pain management and other procedures. This position also works to provide a safe environment for patients undergoing invasive procedures or surgery. A clinical technologist role that has specialized knowledge or skills gained through a combination of vocational education, training, and experience. This role will be most commonly applied to patient care and/or scientific/laboratory jobs. An experienced level role requiring basic knowledge of job procedures and tools obtained through work experience and requiring vocational or technical education. Works under moderate supervision, works through problems of a routine nature, but may at times require interpretation or deviation from standard procedures and communicates information that requires some explanation or interpretation.

Job Overview

This position is responsible for continuous, efficient, and smooth patient flow in the Surgical Services setting. This position provides support and assistance for physicians and registered nurses before, during, and after a surgical service procedure based on standards and protocol. Responds quickly to urgent patient needs by notifying a Physician or Registered Nurse. Demonstrates a detailed knowledge of the different types of surgical equipment and their use. May perform various diagnostics and screening tasks.

Job Description

Minimum Qualifications:

1. High school diploma or equivalent.

2. Basic Life Support (BLS) certification.

3. Two (2) year of operating room experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

1. Associate’s degree in a Surgical Technologist program.

2. Three (3) years of same day, orthopedic, endoscopy, LASIK, or other relevant surgical experience.

3. Specialty certifications

Duties and Responsibilities: The duties and responsibilities listed below are intended to describe the general nature of work and are not intended to be an all-inclusive list. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

1. Assists the Operating Room team with specific routine clinical activities. acts under the Supervision of a Registered Nurse during surgical procedures.

2. Sets up daily procedure rooms, with established surgical protocols and physician preferences.

3. Turns over procedure rooms in a timely manner.

4. Prepares surgical equipment and instruments for specific procedures. Demonstrates and verbalizes knowledge of aseptic technique. Informs clinical leader of any equipment problems.

5. Circulates regularly throughout unit to assist nurses and physicians as needed in pre-, intra- and post-procedure.

6. Escorts patients into the procedure rooms and obtains baseline vital signs and connects patient to monitoring equipment.

7. Under the review of the RN, obtains pre-procedure data, including but not limited to; height, weight, allergies, NPO status, post-procedure ride contact and call back number.

8. Assists during procedures as appropriate. Assumes responsibilities specific to the role of the Patient Care Technician.

9. Verbalizes clinical knowledge of patient identifiers and time out procedure.

10. Properly collects, handles, label and transports specimens in accordance with policy.

11. Cleans and disinfects all surgical equipment, utilizing sterilization techniques and asepsis.

12. Assists the nursing staff in transferring the patient to the Recovery Room.

13. Communicates order supplies and needs with other departments.

14. Participates in restocking of rooms and checking and cleaning equipment on a daily basis.

15. Maintains collaborative, team relationships with peers and colleagues in order to effectively contribute to the working group’s achievement of goals, and to help foster a positive work environment.

16. Adapts to changes in work schedule in a positive manner.

17. May assist physicians in application of casts, assembling materials (making splints, selecting webril and stockineete, cutting felt, etc.), holding limb removing casts with cast saw, and trimming casts with cast knife. May assist in the application of CPMs, cooling machines, braces and other devices.

Physical Requirements:

1. Ability to work within the semi-restricted and restricted environment of the Operating Room and other Perioperative support areas.

2. Stands under hot surgical lights for prolonged periods of time.

3. Possibility of muscle strain from lifting patients and heavy equipment, shocks and burns from cautery units and autoclaves. Possibility of cuts from sharp instruments.

4. Frequent exposure to hazardous chemicals, blood and bodily fluids, extreme noise levels, radiation, lasers, drastic fluctuations in ambient temperature, etc.

5. Ability to wear a protective lead apron for extended periods of time and exposure to radioactivity, harmful anesthesia gases and septic infections.

6. Requires frequent lifting and positioning of patients, materials, equipment, power tools, instruments, etc.

7. Frequent contacts with patients, physicians and nursing staff in Operating Room.

Skills & Abilities:

1. Advanced knowledge of aseptic technique and infection prevention practices.

2. Basic knowledge of anatomy and physiology, medical terminology, microbiology, and pharmacology to ensure that optimal patient care is provided.

3. Basic knowledge of computers, surgical equipment, and infrastructure.

4. Basic knowledge and skills necessary to provide care to patients throughout the life span.

5. Excellent interpersonal skills to effectively interact with staff, patients, physicians, vendors, and other departments within the hospital.

6. Demonstrates essential knowledge in all procedures related to their surgical specialty area and has sufficient general knowledge to assist in other specialties as needed.

7. Knowledge of personal and patient safety with the use of electrical cautery.

You will work closely with clients, senior stakeholders, business users, and technical teams to translate complex business needs into effective solutions. A key focus will be supporting technology transformation initiatives within the life insurance and annuity domain, particularly new business and underwriting processes. You will facilitate stakeholder discussions, manage evolving requirements, and proactively address delivery risks. In addition to leading analytical activities, you will mentor junior team members and promote best practices across the business analysis function. This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to influence complex client projects in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Accountabilities:

You will lead business analysis initiatives, ensuring that business requirements are clearly defined, translated into functional solutions, and successfully implemented. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Lead requirements elicitation sessions with clients and internal stakeholders to identify business needs, workflows, business rules, and functional requirements.

  • Develop clear business requirements documents, functional specifications, process flows, and supporting technical documentation.

  • Collaborate with business, product, development, and quality assurance teams to translate requirements into effective solution designs and implementation plans.

  • Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and solution discussions to align stakeholders, clarify expectations, and support decision-making.

  • Support test planning, test case development, and validation activities to ensure solutions accurately reflect business requirements.

  • Evaluate requirement changes, assess their impact on project scope, timelines, risks, and resources, and communicate recommendations to relevant stakeholders.

  • Identify, investigate, and help resolve business and system issues by coordinating with development, QA, and support teams throughout delivery and after implementation.

  • Act as a subject matter resource for new business and underwriting processes, particularly within LifePRO implementations.

  • Support end-to-end project delivery, ensuring alignment between business objectives, technical solutions, and implementation outcomes.

  • Mentor junior business analysts, share knowledge, and promote consistent analytical practices and documentation standards.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across business analysis processes and project delivery methodologies.

Requirements:

The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis expertise with experience delivering medium to large-scale technology projects, preferably within the life insurance and annuity industry. You should be comfortable managing complex requirements, influencing stakeholders, and coordinating cross-functional teams.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • At least 5 years of experience in business analysis, including preparing business requirements and functional specifications.

  • Experience working on medium to large-scale technology implementations or business transformation projects.

  • Strong understanding of requirements management, solution delivery, stakeholder engagement, and testing support.

  • Experience in the life insurance and annuity domain, particularly new business and underwriting processes, is preferred.

  • Term Life Insurance.

  • Whole Life Insurance.

  • Disability Income.

  • Universal Life, including Indexed Universal Life.

  • Fixed Indexed Annuities.

  • Annuity Riders.

  • Variable Annuities.

  • Experience facilitating client workshops, process mapping sessions, and cross-functional solution discussions.

title: Commodity Trader - Quantitative Strategist, Indian Commodity Markets -Contract
description:
About Meridian Capital

Meridian Capital is a proprietary algorithmic trading firm active in the Indian markets. We run a fully automated, end-to-end systematic trading platform with no manual intervention in trade execution. Our options desk is already live and profitable. Now we're expanding into commodities, and we need someone to build that algo from the ground up.

The Role

We're looking for a sharp, results-driven commodity trader with a quantitative mindset to research, design and build a new algorithmic strategy for Indian commodity markets (MCX). You will own this from first idea to live deployment. The engagement has two phases:

Phase 1: The 2-Week Sprint

Within the first 14 days, research the Indian commodity markets and deliver at least one profitable, mathematically robust strategy that we can deploy straight into our live trading platform.

Phase 2: Build and Scale

For the rest of the 3 months, develop additional strategies and refine the models, risk controls and position sizing across instruments. The aim is a diversified, consistently performing commodity book.

Target Performance Benchmarks

Sharpe Ratio > 1.5

Sortino Ratio > 1.8

Win Rate ≥ 45%

Monthly Return: minimum 5% consistent growth

Compensation

Performance share: 15% of all trading profits generated by your commodity strategies.

It activates the moment your logic goes live and remains in effect for the full 3-month engagement.

There is no fixed stipend. This role is 100% performance-linked.

Must-Have

Hands-on trading or research experience in Indian commodity markets (MCX: crude oil, natural gas, gold, silver, base metals)

Strong understanding of contract specifications, expiries, rollovers, margins, lot sizes, liquidity and slippage

Proven experience with statistical modeling, backtesting frameworks and algorithmic trading logic

Deep understanding of risk-adjusted metrics (Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, Max Drawdown)

Ability to rapidly prototype, stress-test and deploy under tight deadlines

Academic foundation in Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Computer Science or a quantitative engineering discipline

Preferred

Proficiency in Python, R or C++

Experience building systematic strategies from scratch, whether trend, mean reversion, spreads, seasonality or volatility-based

Familiarity with global commodity drivers (crude benchmarks, USD/INR, inventory data, weather and monsoon)

A pragmatic mindset that prioritizes live-market performance and robust execution over theoretical perfection
