title: Pediatric Cardiologist

title: Associate Manager FinCrime
description:
About The Company

Founders today are building global companies from day one — but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!

We're building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building.

Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment.

Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50,000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J.P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we're building for the next generation of global companies.

About The Team

Aspire's FinCrime team protects the platform and its customers from money laundering, fraud and other financial crime. Working closely with Compliance, KYC, Payments and Transaction Monitoring, the team builds and runs the controls that keep Aspire compliant and safe as we scale across Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia, the EU and now the US. You'll sit within the FinCrime Ops team, reporting to the Global Head of FinCrime Operations, and act as the FinCrime Senior Analyst for our US business.

About The Role

We're hiring a FinCrime Operations Senior Analyst to support Aspire's US expansion. This is a hands-on ops role covering both Fraud and AML: you'll investigate cases, file SARs, handle US-specific payment fraud and AML typologies and help shape the controls that protect our US customers. You'll bring a working understanding of how US businesses are formed and operate, how they move money, and how criminals exploit each of those, and you'll turn that knowledge into playbooks the wider team can run.

  • Investigate AML, Fraud and Scam cases for US customers end to end, from alert or referral through to decision, offboarding where needed, and documentation
  • Draft and file SARs in line with FinCEN requirements and timelines, and maintain audit-ready case records
  • Identify and act on US-relevant typologies: business email compromise and payment redirection, account takeover, ACH debit fraud and return abuse, wire fraud, money mule and funnel accounts, synthetic and shell business onboarding, check fraud, investment and romance scam proceeds, sanctions evasion and trade-based laundering
  • Assess US businesses at onboarding and through their lifecycle: entity type (LLC, C-corp, S-corp, sole proprietorship), state of formation, Secretary of State records, EIN, registered agent and virtual office use, beneficial ownership and foreign-owned US entities
  • Run US payment-specific processes, including ACH unauthorized returns and NACHA timelines, wire recall and beneficiary bank outreach, and OFAC screening alerts
  • Handle law enforcement requests, subpoenas and 314(a)/(b) information sharing in coordination with Compliance
  • Act as day-to-day FinCrime liaison with Aspire's US partner bank(s) on cases, escalations and reporting
  • Partner with Compliance, Onboarding and Engineering to adapt rules, onboarding checks and monitoring scenarios for US rails and customer segments
  • Build and maintain US SOPs, typology guides and red-flag training for onboarding, CX and ops teams
  • Track fraud losses, case volumes, alert quality and SAR metrics, and report trends to senior stakeholders

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years in AML, fraud/scam typologies, with at least 3 years handling US-market cases at a fintech, neobank, BaaS program or bank
  • Practical experience across both fraud and AML investigations, including drafting and filing SARs
  • Strong understanding of US fraud and AML typologies affecting business accounts and payments
  • Solid working knowledge of how US businesses are registered and operate, including entity types, state filings, EINs, registered agents and beneficial ownership, and the red flags that separate real businesses from shells
  • Good understanding of US money movement: ACH (including NACHA rules and return codes), domestic and international wires, and business card programs, and how fraud and liability work on each
  • Familiarity with the US regulatory framework for financial crime: BSA/AML, FinCEN SAR obligations, OFAC sanctions, and how sponsor bank oversight shapes fintech programs
  • Understanding of the kinds of businesses Aspire serves in the US, such as venture-backed startups, e-commerce sellers, SaaS companies, agencies, import/export businesses and foreign-founded US entities, and their typical risk profiles
  • Strong grasp of AI concepts and the ability to apply AI tools (e.g., Claude, n8n) to real workflows

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a US sponsor bank or within a BaaS program, including exams or partner bank audits
  • A self started with experience building or scaling a US FinCrime ops function at an early-stage or high-growth company
  • Exposure to RTP/FedNow, stablecoins or crypto on/off ramps, and cross-border FX
  • Hands-on use of tools such as Sardine, Alloy, Unit21, Middesk, Socure or LexisNexis
  • Basic SQL or data-querying skills (e.g., Databricks)
  • CAMS, CFE or equivalent certification

description:

What do you need for this opportunity

Must have skills required:

data models and data contracts, dbt and modern ELT pipelines, Debezium, or other CDC, Kafka, API Integrations, Data Ingestion, Data Integration, Integration Framework, Python, SQL

The AI-Native Connected Finance Operations Platform is Looking for:

Tech Lead — Connectors

Location: Hyderabad

Experience: 8–10 Years

Job De ion:

About BC

BC is an innovative finance operations automation platform that empowers modern finance teams to streamline operations, automate reconciliations, and gain real-time business insights. We're redefining how finance teams operate by bringing together technology, data, and financial expertise into a seamless product experience.

We are a fast-growing fintech backed by top-tier investors, serving high-growth companies with complex financial workflows. If you're passionate about designing systems that move money-critical data at scale, BC is the place to be.

About The Role

As Tech Lead for Connectors, you will lead the team that builds and runs BC's data integration platform. This is a hands-on role: you will write code, review designs, and guide a team of engineers building integrations with ERPs, SaaS applications, databases, payment platforms, APIs, and file storage systems.

Your success will be measured on three things: how quickly the team can launch new connectors, how reliably those connectors run in production, and how easily other teams can use the data they produce.

What You Will Do

Connector Platform

  • Design the connector platform so that a new production-ready connector can go from planning to launch in weeks, not months.
  • Build a shared framework that handles the common parts of every connector — authentication, schema discovery, extraction, pagination, incremental sync, retries, checkpointing, and error handling — so engineers write only the source-specific logic.
  • Set clear standards for how connectors are built, tested, monitored, and updated, and make sure the team follows them through design and code reviews.

Enterprise Integrations


  • Build and ship connectors for systems such as SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, HubSpot, QuickBooks, Zoho Books, Stripe, and PayPal, each supporting both full and incremental sync.
  • Make sure every connector handles API rate limits, pagination, retries, partial failures, and long-running sync jobs on its own, so customer syncs finish without anyone stepping in manually.
  • Build integrations across REST/SOAP APIs, SDKs, webhooks, SFTP, relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server), and file storage (GCS, S3, Azure

Blob, Google Drive, OneDrive).

Data Correctness and Incremental Sync

  • Design CDC and incremental sync patterns (using Debezium, Kafka, or similar) so that data moves exactly once — no duplicates, no gaps, no silent data loss when a job fails and restarts.
  • Build checkpointing and recovery so that connectors resume safely after failures and keep working when a source system changes its schema.
  • Deliver clean, validated data into BigQuery, Snowflake, or Databricks that finance and product teams can use without double-checking it.

Data Models and Contracts


  • Map source-specific objects to Bluecopa's standard business entities, including custom fields, custom objects, and metadata.
  • Define and maintain schemas and data contracts so that connector output stays consistent and predictable — a breaking change should never surprise a downstream team.

Reliability, Monitoring, and Cost


  • Set and meet clear targets for sync success rate, data freshness, and time to recover from failures.
  • Add monitoring to every connector — health, sync latency, API failures, throughput, and data quality — so the team finds problems before customers do.
  • Build automatic data checks and reconciliation that catch errors at the point of ingestion, not during a customer's month-end close.
  • Keep API usage and cloud costs under control as data volumes grow.

Team Leadership


  • Lead and mentor a team of connector engineers through code reviews, pairing, and clear standards.
  • Turn the integration roadmap into a realistic plan and deliver it on schedule, balancing new connectors against platform and reliability work.
  • Make the final technical calls for the connector area, lead design reviews for complex integrations, and solve problems that cut across multiple connectors.
  • Work with Product, Customer Success, and data teams to decide which integrations matter most to customers, and clear blockers quickly when things escalate.

What We Are Looking For


  • 8–10 years in data engineering, data integration, or backend engineering, including at least 2 years leading engineers or being fully responsible for a technical area.
  • A history of building and running production integrations or data pipelines — systems you can point to that worked reliably for years.
  • Strong hands-on Python and SQL, with a solid understanding of relational databases.
  • Experience building API integrations (REST and/or SOAP) that deal with real-world problems: rate limits, pagination, retries, checkpointing, idempotency, error handling, schema changes, and data validation.
  • Hands-on experience with an integration framework such as Airbyte, Singer, CData, or Meltano.
  • Experience loading and modelling data in BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, or a similar platform.
  • Working knowledge of at least one major cloud (GCP, AWS, or Azure).
  • Good engineering habits: Git, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and handling production incidents.

Nice to Have


  • Direct integration work with SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, or similar enterprise applications.
  • Experience with Debezium, Kafka, or other CDC/streaming systems.
  • Experience with dbt and modern ELT pipelines.
  • Experience with Temporal, Airflow, Prefect, or similar orchestration tools.
  • Kubernetes experience.
  • Experience designing standard data models and data contracts.
  • Experience handling custom fields, custom objects, and metadata in enterprise applications.
  • Experience with webhooks and event-driven integrations.
  • Time spent at a SaaS or high-growth startup.

What Success Looks Like


  • In 90 days: You have shipped or unblocked at least one major connector, set up a regular design-review process, and picked the top three framework improvements that will speed up future launches.
  • In 6 months: New connectors launch faster than before, sync reliability is tracked against clear targets on a dashboard, and the team works to standards you have set.
  • In 12 months: Customers can turn on new integrations in days, production issues are rare and fixed quickly, and the team you have built ships good work without needing you in every decision.

How to apply for this opportunity


  • Step 1: Click On Apply! And Register or Login on our portal.
  • Step 2: Complete the Screening Form & Upload updated Resume
  • Step 3: Increase your chances to get shortlisted & meet the client for the Interview!

About Uplers:


Our goal is to make hiring reliable, simple, and fast. Our role will be to help all our talents find and apply for relevant contractual onsite opportunities and progress in their career. We will support any grievances or challenges you may face during the engagement.

(Note: There are many more opportunities apart from this on the portal. Depending on the assessments you clear, you can apply for them as well).

So, if you are ready for a new challenge, a great work environment, and an opportunity to take your career to the next level, don't hesitate to apply today. We are waiting for you!

title: Manager
description:
Does working for 150+ million children of Bharat excite you

Then this opportunity is for you!

About us:

ConveGenius is an impact-first organisation, building platforms and systems for public education and skilling at population scale. We work closely with governments, ecosystem partners, social enterprises, philanthropies and individual & institutional investors, with a goal to deliver the highest return on investment across offerings that improve learning, teaching, and governance.

Unlike traditional ed-tech companies that deliver content, we build infrastructure platforms that integrate deeply into public delivery systems, while enabling our partners to scale their missions with measurable results. Today, we operate across 22+ Indian states, trusted by governments and institutional investors alike, for aligning policy priorities with last mile impact. What started with belief and hope 13 years ago is now backed by evidence.

Our offerings include

  • SwiftChat (the platform on which we build with ecosystem partners)
  • SwiftPAL - validated by a two-year RCT led by Nobel laureate Prof. Michael Kremer (Development Innovation Lab, University of Chicago), whose team found students gained almost an additional 2 years of extra learning in just 17 months
  • Swiftee (the AI learning tutor built for Bharat).

Our team comprises of thinkers, builders, innovators, and doers who show up every day with a strong action bias to build for Bharat.

Learn more about us: https://linktr.ee/convegenius11

We are looking for a Manager to lead strategic engagements with government and ecosystem stakeholders across education, skilling, vocational education and others. The role will involve working closely with senior government officials to understand priorities, identify system-level opportunities, design and drive high-impact interventions, and translate evidence into actionable policy and program decisions.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of government systems, excellent stakeholder management skills, strategic problem-solving capabilities, and a strong bias for execution. They should be comfortable operating at the intersection of government, technology, data and social impact, and be able to move seamlessly between strategic discussions with senior bureaucrats and ground-level implementation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Government engagement & strategic partnerships

  • Build and manage trusted relationships with senior government officials across education, skilling, and other adjacent domains.
  • Engage with senior bureaucrats and department leadership to understand priorities, decision cycles, institutional constraints and emerging opportunities.
  • Represent the organisation in strategic discussions with state and central government departments, Sector Skill Councils, industry bodies, employers and other ecosystem stakeholders.
  • Act as a strategic thought partner to government stakeholders, bringing evidence, insights and practical recommendations to support policy and program decisions.
  • Identify opportunities to align organisational interventions with government priorities, schemes, budgets and existing institutional structures.

2. Strategy, policy & program design

  • Lead the design and execution of large-scale education and skilling programs in partnership with government, private sector and philanthropy.
  • Analyse government policies, schemes, budgets and implementation frameworks to identify opportunities for convergence, optimisation and system-level innovation.
  • Develop strategies and program models that address challenges across education, skilling, employability, placement and workforce outcomes.
  • Drive evidence-backed policy advocacy and support government stakeholders in translating insights into actionable reforms.
  • Work with leadership to develop proposals, partnership models and new program opportunities across states, central government and thematic areas.

3. Data, research & evidence

  • Translate large and complex datasets into actionable insights for government decision-makers and organisational leadership.
  • Develop analytical frameworks, policy briefs, dashboards, visual reports and presentations that enable real-time decision-making.
  • Lead research and ecosystem assessments to understand implementation bottlenecks, user needs and opportunities for reform.
  • Build evidence bases around outcomes such as learning, skilling, employability, placement, wages and workforce participation.
  • Use data and field evidence to identify course corrections and strengthen program design and implementation.

4. Program execution & impact

  • Own delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programs from strategy and design through implementation and scale-up.
  • Work closely with internal teams across product, technology, analytics, training and program delivery to ensure timely and integrated execution.
  • Monitor program milestones, risks, dependencies and impact indicators, proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks.
  • Lead impact articulation through clear measurement, reporting and documentation frameworks.
  • Ensure that learnings from implementation are systematically captured and translated into improvements in program strategy and delivery.

5. Field engagement & implementation intelligence

  • Conduct regular field visits to understand implementation realities, frontline needs and stakeholder experiences.
  • Engage with teachers, trainers, students, administrators, employers and other actors to gather ground-level intelligence.
  • Bring field insights into policy discussions, program design and strategic decision-making.
  • Identify gaps between policy intent and implementation and develop practical recommendations to address them.

6. Communication & thought leadership

  • Develop compelling narratives, presentations and communication materials that connect field evidence, policy priorities and program outcomes.
  • Communicate complex insights clearly to senior government and internal leadership.
  • Publish articles, reports and thought pieces that showcase organisational learning and insights from the education and skilling ecosystem.
  • Represent the organisation in relevant forums, conferences and ecosystem discussions.

7. Growth & ecosystem development

  • Identify and shape new opportunities across state government departments and relevant thematic areas.
  • Build relationships with ecosystem organisations to broaden policy recommendations and enable adoption.
  • Work with leadership to identify potential partnerships, funding opportunities and pathways for scaling successful models.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience in management consulting, public policy, government advisory, program management, education, skilling or other relevant domains.
  • MBA, Master's in Public Policy, Development Studies, Education or a related field preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience working with government stakeholders, with government engagement experience being essential.
  • Prior experience managing relationships with senior bureaucrats, ideally at the level of Principal Secretary/Secretary/Director and above in State Government.
  • Experience in designing or implementing large-scale, multi-stakeholder programs in partnership with government.
  • Strong understanding of government schemes, policies, institutional structures, decision-making processes and budgetary mechanisms.
  • Experience leveraging technology, digital platforms, data products or Digital Public Infrastructure for social impact is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience in using data and evidence to influence policy or program decisions.
  • Experience leading teams and managing complex programs with multiple stakeholders

What we are looking for

  • Strategic thinker with a strong execution bias — able to move from a high-level problem statement to concrete action.
  • High ownership and initiative — comfortable taking responsibility for ambiguous problems and charting a path forward.
  • Strong government orientation — able to build credibility and trusted relationships with senior public-sector stakeholders.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills — able to synthesise diverse information into clear recommendations.
  • Strong communication skills — able to communicate effectively with senior bureaucrats, frontline stakeholders and internal teams.
  • Collaborative leader who can work across multidisciplinary teams and bring diverse stakeholders together.
  • Data-driven and impact-oriented, with a demonstrated commitment to improving education, skilling and employment outcomes.
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous and evolving environments, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Why this role

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of government, technology, data and social impact, and to contribute to reforms that can influence education and skilling outcomes at scale. The role offers significant ownership in shaping government partnerships, translating evidence into policy and program decisions, and taking high-impact interventions from strategy to implementation to scale.

What We Offer and Why You Should Join ConveGenius:

At ConveGenius, we create an environment where purpose meets growth. You will be part of a mission driven organization that is transforming how learning reaches children across India, especially at scale and where it matters most.

  • Work with a diverse and passionate team spread across India, bringing together people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and expertise.
  • Be part of an organization with a strong on ground presence across more than two thirds of India, giving you exposure to large scale, real world impact.
  • Play a meaningful role in strengthening the education ecosystem and contributing directly to learning outcomes for millions of children.
  • Gain experience working at the intersection of education, technology, and public systems, building skills that are highly relevant and future focused.
  • Work in a culture that values ownership, learning, and collaboration, with space to take initiative and grow professionally.
  • Enjoy stability and peace of mind with employee friendly benefits, including health insurance coverage and other supportive policies.
  • If you are driven by purpose, enjoy solving complex problems, and want your work to create visible impact, ConveGenius offers a place to grow while making a difference.

title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Manager, Software Engineering based in the United States.

As a Manager, Software Engineering, you will lead a talented engineering team responsible for building and maintaining innovative healthcare technology solutions that improve care delivery and patient outcomes. Combining technical leadership with hands-on development, you will shape service architecture, guide engineering decisions, and remain actively involved in coding, code reviews, and production support. You will also drive the transition toward AI-native software development, introducing modern AI-assisted and agentic tools to improve engineering productivity and software quality. Working closely with product specialists and care management experts, you will translate complex healthcare challenges into reliable, user-focused solutions. This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership of end-to-end services, develop engineering talent, and contribute to technology that makes a tangible difference in people's lives.

Accountabilities:

You will lead the technical direction and day-to-day execution of an engineering team, balancing people management, software architecture, hands-on development, and continuous innovation. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing engineering team by recruiting talented professionals, providing direct feedback, and supporting individual career growth.

  • Mentor senior engineers and help them develop the skills needed to take on greater technical leadership responsibilities.

  • Define the architecture and technical direction of your team's services, making key engineering decisions in collaboration with senior engineers.

  • Design scalable, maintainable systems that can adapt to evolving healthcare requirements, care models, and regulatory standards.

  • Remain hands-on in software development by writing code, reviewing pull requests, resolving complex production issues, and contributing to features and fixes.

  • Champion AI-assisted and agentic software development by actively using tools in your own work, evaluating their effectiveness, and establishing best practices for the wider team.

  • Lead the transition toward fully AI-native software development, helping engineers adopt new technologies while maintaining high standards of quality, security, and reliability.

  • Partner with product teams and care management specialists to understand user needs and translate operational challenges into intuitive, effective software solutions.

  • Promote iterative development practices, delivering improvements through small, frequent releases.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of your team's services, including software quality, observability, reliability, and performance, while coordinating with infrastructure teams.

  • Lead incident resolution and ensure production issues are addressed promptly and effectively.

  • Integrate security and patient data privacy into software architecture and development practices from the outset.

  • Maintain healthy and sustainable systems by addressing technical debt, updating dependencies, and making informed build-versus-buy decisions.

  • Collaborate with other engineering teams to share knowledge, align technical decisions, and maintain consistency across the broader platform.

Requirements:

The ideal candidate is an experienced software engineering leader who combines strong technical expertise with a genuine passion for building products and developing people. You should be comfortable balancing management responsibilities with hands-on engineering, embracing AI-driven innovation, and collaborating across multidisciplinary teams. The following qualifications and skills are expected:

  • At least 8 years of professional software development experience, including 2+ years managing engineering teams.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for hands-on development and the ability to remain actively involved in coding and technical problem-solving.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals and current proficiency in a modern backend programming language such as Java, C#, Python, Go, or TypeScript.

  • Experience designing and developing distributed systems, APIs, and data models.

  • Practical experience using AI coding assistants and agentic development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or Cursor as part of your software development workflow.

  • Demonstrated ability to introduce AI-assisted development practices and help engineering teams adopt these tools effectively.

  • Proven experience building, deploying, and maintaining production software systems.

  • Strong knowledge of automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and incident response.

  • Experience working with cloud-based and containerized platforms.

  • Demonstrated success in hiring, coaching, mentoring, and developing software engineers.

  • A product-oriented mindset, with the ability to understand user needs, collaborate closely with product teams, and prioritize simple, effective solutions.

  • Experience designing and developing secure systems that handle sensitive or confidential information.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative, empathetic leadership style that builds trust with engineers and business partners.

  • Genuine motivation to improve care experiences and outcomes for people living with serious illnesses, with empathy for patients, healthcare professionals, and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience developing healthcare solutions, particularly care coordination, case management, or population health management platforms.

  • Background in healthcare or another regulated industry, with familiarity with HIPAA, SOC 2, Medicaid, or Medicare requirements.

  • Experience with ambient listening technologies, including ambient clinical documentation, speech-to-text solutions, or AI-generated summaries of care conversations.

  • Experience developing product features powered by large language models (LLMs).

  • Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as FHIR and HL7.

title: Associate Director, Commercial Learning & Development, Market Access Training Lead
description:
We’re here for one reason and one reason only – to cure cancer. Every moment is dedicated to developing treatments and every action moves us one step closer to our goal. We’ve made incredible scientific breakthroughs and our pioneering personalized CAR T-cell therapies have changed the paradigm. But we're not finished yet.


Join Kite, as we make even bigger advances in cancer therapies, and help shape where our business and medical science goes next.


We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfill their aspirations. Join Kite and help create more tomorrows.


Job Description

Kite is seeking a highly motivated and experienced individual to join the U.S. Commercial Learning & Development team as an Associate Director, Commercial Learning & Development, Market Access Training Lead.


In this role, you will lead the strategy, design, development, and delivery of learning programs that build the capabilities of Kite’s Market Access organization and other customer-facing teams whose responsibilities affect patient access. You will translate complex Market Access strategy, policy, payer, reimbursement, and access information into practical learning experiences that prepare teams to engage customers effectively and compliantly.


This position will partner closely with Market Access leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to identify capability needs, establish learning priorities, and develop training solutions aligned with brand, portfolio, and access strategies. The role will support onboarding, product and indication launches, business planning, national and regional meetings, and ongoing capability development.



Key Responsibilities


Market Access Learning Strategy


  • Develop and execute a comprehensive learning strategy for the U.S. Market Access organization that aligns with business priorities, portfolio strategy, launch plans, and evolving customer needs.
  • Partner with Market Access leaders to assess current and future capability requirements and establish annual and long-term learning priorities.
  • Create role-based learning journeys that support onboarding, foundational development, advanced capability building, and ongoing professional development.
  • Establish clear learning objectives, performance outcomes, and measurement plans for Market Access training initiatives.
  • Proactively identify emerging knowledge and capability gaps related to changes in the payer, provider, reimbursement, policy, and access environment.

Market Access and Cell Therapy Expertise


  • Maintain a strong understanding of the U.S. healthcare and access environment, including commercial and government payers, reimbursement pathways, coverage and utilization management, healthcare policy, provider economics, patient access barriers, and evolving access trends.
  • Build and maintain knowledge of the Market Access considerations associated with oncology, hematology, and cell therapy, including the complexity of the CAR T patient journey and site-of-care environment.
  • Translate complex access concepts and strategies into relevant, practical, and engaging learning experiences.
  • Ensure learning programs reflect the distinct needs of Market Access roles and the customer types they support.
  • Monitor changes in the competitive and access landscape and incorporate relevant developments into ongoing learning plans.

Account Management and Market Access Capabilities


  • Design learning solutions that strengthen customer engagement, strategic account planning, insight generation, business acumen, and collaboration across the access ecosystem.
  • Build capabilities related to payer and organized-customer engagement, value communication, reimbursement and access discussions, account planning, and stakeholder influence.
  • Create realistic scenarios, simulations, case studies, and application exercises that allow learners to practice navigating complex access situations.
  • Partner with Market Access leaders and subject-matter experts to define expectations for effective customer engagement and translate those expectations into observable skills and behaviors.
  • Support the development of cross-functional capabilities that improve coordination among Market Access, Sales, Marketing, Medical, Channel and Patient Services, and other customer-facing teams.

Onboarding and Continuous Development


  • Lead the design and delivery of onboarding programs for new Market Access team members, ensuring they are prepared with the knowledge, skills, tools, and resources required for their roles.
  • Develop structured onboarding pathways that may include self-directed learning, virtual instructor-led training, live workshops, field application, coaching, and certification.
  • Build continuous-learning programs that reinforce foundational knowledge while advancing strategic account management and customer-engagement capabilities.
  • Partner with leaders and subject-matter experts to identify appropriate readiness standards, assessments, and certification requirements.
  • Create reinforcement strategies that promote sustained behavior change and application after formal training.

Product, Indication, and Launch Readiness


  • Lead Market Access learning plans for product launches, indication expansions, label updates, and other critical business milestones.
  • Translate access strategy, value propositions, reimbursement considerations, customer resources, and approved materials into cohesive learning programs.
  • Coordinate training sequencing and timing with broader commercial launch-readiness plans.
  • Prepare Market Access teams to confidently and compliantly apply approved strategies, resources, and tools.
  • Identify launch-readiness risks and recommend learning interventions to address them.

Curriculum and Content Development


Design and maintain a Market Access curriculum covering relevant areas such as:

  • U.S. healthcare and payer landscape
  • Commercial and government payer fundamentals
  • Coverage, coding, payment, and reimbursement
  • Utilization management and access barriers
  • Healthcare policy and access implications
  • Provider and site-of-care economics
  • Cell therapy access and the patient journey
  • Strategic account planning
  • Customer engagement and insight generation
  • Value communication and approved payer resources
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Business acumen, analytics, and decision-making
  • Apply adult-learning and instructional-design principles to create effective live, virtual, digital, and blended learning experiences.
  • Ensure materials are practical, role-specific, and connected to real customer and business situations.
  • Maintain curriculum documentation, learning assets, facilitator materials, and participant resources.
  • Regularly evaluate and refresh content based on learner feedback, business priorities, performance needs, and changes in the external environment.

Compliance and Material Review


  • Partner with Medical, Legal, Regulatory, and Compliance colleagues to ensure learning content is accurate, balanced, appropriate, and aligned with approved materials and policies.
  • Guide training materials through the appropriate review and approval processes.
  • Maintain appropriate documentation and version control for approved learning materials.
  • Incorporate compliance expectations into customer-engagement training, scenarios, simulations, and certification activities.
  • Promote a culture of ethical decision-making and compliant customer engagement.

Facilitation, Coaching, and Leader Enablement


  • Facilitate engaging virtual and live learning sessions for Market Access audiences.
  • Equip Market Access leaders with tools and resources to reinforce learning, coach capabilities, and support development in the flow of work.
  • Develop facilitator guides, coaching resources, observation tools, and reinforcement materials.
  • Model strong facilitation, executive presence, strategic thinking, and learner engagement.
  • Build internal facilitation capability by preparing leaders and subject-matter experts to deliver consistent, high-quality learning experiences.

Measurement and Learning Effectiveness


  • Establish success measures for training programs, including learner reaction, knowledge acquisition, skill demonstration, application, and business-relevant outcomes.
  • Use assessments, observations, learner feedback, leader input, and available performance indicators to evaluate learning effectiveness.
  • Translate evaluation findings into clear recommendations for curriculum improvement and future capability investments.
  • Communicate learning progress, outcomes, risks, and recommendations to Market Access and CL&D leadership.
  • Maintain appropriate learning records and support organizational reporting requirements.

Program, Vendor, and Budget Management


  • Lead multiple complex learning initiatives simultaneously, managing scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Manage external learning partners and vendors from project scoping and selection through development, delivery, and evaluation.
  • Ensure external partners understand Kite’s business, learner population, standards, and expectations.
  • Manage assigned budgets and make thoughtful investment decisions based on strategic importance and anticipated impact.
  • Support the planning and execution of national meetings, launch meetings, workshops, and other high-priority learning events.
  • Identify opportunities to improve quality, consistency, efficiency, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.


Basic Qualifications


  • BA/BS and 10 years of experience OR
  • MA/MS and 8 years of experience OR
  • PhD and 2 years of experience

Preferred Qualifications


  • Significant experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology Market Access, Market Access training, commercial learning and development, account management, payer strategy, reimbursement, or a related function.
  • Experience supporting Market Access field roles and customer-facing teams.
  • Experience in oncology, with a strong preference for hematology, cell therapy, stem cell transplant, or other complex specialty therapies.
  • Strong understanding of the U.S. payer and reimbursement environment, including commercial and government payers, utilization management, coverage, coding, payment, and patient access considerations.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex Market Access concepts into clear, practical, and engaging learning solutions.
  • Experience designing and implementing onboarding, launch-readiness, capability-development, and certification programs.
  • Expertise in adult learning, curriculum design, instructional design, facilitation, and blended-learning approaches.
  • Experience developing customer-engagement, strategic account management, and business-acumen capabilities.
  • Strong project and program management skills, including the ability to manage multiple complex initiatives and cross-functional teams.
  • Experience managing external vendors and assigned budgets.
  • Strong executive presence and exceptional presentation, facilitation, written communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to influence without authority and work effectively across functions and organizational levels.
  • High level of initiative, sound judgment, and comfort operating in a dynamic environment with competing priorities.
  • Experience with learning technologies and content-development tools, including learning management systems, Microsoft PowerPoint, Microsoft Excel, and Adobe Acrobat.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, based on business needs.

title: Co-Founder
description:
Company De ion Interloop is the Talent Operating System, designed to follow individuals seamlessly from candidate to colleague on a single integrated platform. The company transforms traditional hiring by replacing spreadsheets, gut decisions, and manual screenings with structured, AI-driven voice interviews in 25+ languages, scored against transparent rubrics with robust anti-cheating measures. Interloop also closes the skills gap by using short AI voice assessments on real SOPs, products, and policies to verify actual knowledge, identify learning needs, and generate targeted training. Both hiring and upskilling run on one AI, one rubric, and one dashboard, backed by enterprise-grade security, audit trails, GDPR/DPDP compliance, and nationalization tracking. Interloop's mission is to help organizations hire and upskill with verifiable proof of competence, not just credentials.

Role De ion The Co-Founder role is a full-time, on-site position based in Kerala, India. This person will work closely with the founding team to shape Interloop's product vision, go-to-market strategy, and operational roadmap, driving growth across both hiring and upskilling solutions. Day-to-day responsibilities include engaging with customers and partners, validating product-market fit, leading sales conversations, and collaborating with product and engineering to prioritize features that align with market needs. The role also involves designing and analyzing experiments, using data and research to inform strategic decisions, and representing the company at events, demos, and investor meetings. The Co-Founder will help build the team, define culture and processes, and ensure responsible, compliant use of AI in line with Interloop's security and privacy standards.

Qualifications

  • Strong analytical skills to interpret product usage data, market signals, and business metrics, and convert insights into clear strategic actions.
  • Excellent communication abilities, including clear written and verbal communication, active listening, and confident presentation to customers, partners, and investors.
  • Proven sales skills, with experience in consultative selling, pipeline management, and closing deals in B2B or SaaS environments.
  • Marketing capabilities, such as developing positioning, messaging, and campaigns, and collaborating on content and growth initiatives.
  • Research skills to conduct market, customer, and competitive analysis, and to run structured experiments to validate hypotheses.
  • Previous entrepreneurial, startup, or early-stage leadership experience, ideally in HR tech, AI, SaaS, or related domains.
  • Comfort working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, with the ability to take ownership and make decisions with incomplete information.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven products, talent management, or learning and development is an advantage.

title: Customer Quality Specialist
description:
Job Summary

The Customer Quality Specialist will support the business to advocate for internal and external customers in resolving the most complex product quality, supply chain quality and process quality related issues.

Key Responsibilities

Develops understanding of customer expectations and requirements for quality. Leads the implementation and closes action plans for customer quality issues including product, supply chain or process related. Uses Customer Centric metrics to prioritize customer quality issues. Develops and maintains external relationships and supports developing key quality communications, in some cases communicates externally. Contributes to process improvement efforts. Identifies problems, prioritizes actions, leads, or participates in Six Sigma projects/continuous improvement. Supports the vision and strategy for the Customer Quality organization, including definition and meeting key performance metrics and goal tree initiatives.

Competencies

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Manages ambiguity - Operating effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.

Advanced Product Quality Planning - Leads the technical quality planning and ensures customer satisfaction through structured and measurable processes as defined by industry standard.

Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

Project Management - Establishes and maintains the balance of scope, schedule and resources for a temporary effort (a project). Ensures results/impact from temporary effort are fully realized as possible.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Drives vision and purpose - Painting a compelling picture of the vision and strategy that motivates others to action.

Quality Influence - Ability to recognize stakeholders, create a forum to professionally extract stakeholder perspectives, drive and engage in constructive conflict, and to influence outcomes in order to ensure Cummins makes a balanced decision inclusive of Quality priorities.

Quality 4.0 - Leverages cloud-based systems and digitization to drive improved quality outcomes. Knowledge and application of Quality 4.0 (Q4.0) and digitization of quality management. Examples of Q4.0 are cloud native software applications, digital twin, simulation, adaptive intelligence and connected systems.

Education, Licenses, Certifications

College, university, or equivalent degree required, Engineering or a related technical or scientific subject preferred. Green Belt Certification preferred.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience.

title: Platform Engineering Middleware Data Transport SRE - Assistant Vice President
description:
Who We Are Looking For

The State Street Middleware Data Transport Team supports enterprise Managed File Transfer (MFT) platforms across the Bank.

We are seeking an experienced IBM Sterling Connect:Direct (NDM) Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in engineering, implementation, production support, troubleshooting, upgrades, security, automation, and optimization of enterprise Connect:Direct environments.

This is a hands-on technical engineering role, not a managerial or administration-only position. The candidate must be capable of independently troubleshooting complex production issues across Connect:Direct, operating systems, networks, authentication, certificates, and file-transfer workflows.

Experience with IBM Sterling Connect:Direct 6.x, including recent versions such as 6.3, 6.4 and 6.5, is highly preferred.

What You Will Be Responsible For

  • Install, configure, upgrade, patch, maintain, and troubleshoot IBM Sterling Connect:Direct (NDM) on Linux/UNIX and Windows; z/OS exposure is preferred.
  • Provide Level 3 engineering and production support for business-critical Connect:Direct services and file-transfer workflows.
  • Troubleshoot PNODE/SNODE connectivity, Process failures, Netmap, authentication, permissions, TCP/IP/network, firewall, certificates, Secure+, TLS and performance issues.
  • Develop and troubleshoot Connect:Direct Processes, including COPY, RUN TASK/RUN JOB, symbolic parameters, conditional processing, checkpoint/restart, and Process dependencies.
  • Analyze Connect:Direct statistics, logs, return codes, message IDs, queues and session failures to perform root-cause analysis.
  • Configure and support Netmap, functional authorities, user proxies, Secure+, TLS certificates and cipher configuration.
  • Perform Connect:Direct upgrades, migrations, patching, vulnerability remediation, server refreshes, HA/DR and failover/failback exercises.
  • Work extensively with IBM Sterling Control Center Monitor/Director for node monitoring, alerts, SLA/SLC monitoring, configuration management, audit, inventory, and centralized management.
  • Troubleshoot end-to-end file-transfer issues involving application, Linux/Windows, network, firewall, security, storage, and external partner teams.
  • Integrate Connect:Direct workflows with AutoSys and other enterprise scheduling solutions.
  • Develop automation using Bash/Shell, PowerShell, Python or Ansible for monitoring, health checks and operational activities.
  • Participate in Incident, Problem, Change and Capacity Management and lead technical troubleshooting/RCA for complex production incidents.

Required Skills


  • 8+ years of enterprise file-transfer/MFT experience, with strong hands-on experience in IBM Sterling Connect:Direct / NDM.
  • Strong knowledge of Connect:Direct architecture, PNODE/SNODE, Netmap, Processes, queues, sessions, statistics and troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting Connect:Direct 6.x, preferably 6.3/6.4/6.5.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Secure+, TLS/SSL certificates, cipher configuration and node authentication.
  • Experience with IBM Sterling Control Center Monitor and/or Control Center Director.
  • Strong Linux/UNIX and Windows troubleshooting skills.
  • Strong understanding of SFTP, SSH, TCP/IP, firewalls, DNS, routing, authentication and file permissions.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex production incidents and perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  • Experience with enterprise scheduling, preferably AutoSys.
  • ing/automation experience using Shell/Bash, PowerShell, Python or Ansible.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.

Good to have


Additional Experience With Enterprise MFT Technologies Is Desirable:

  • Axway B2Bi / Interchange / Sentinel
  • Primeur Data One / MFX / Spazio
  • IBM Sterling Secure Proxy
  • SFTP / FTPS / HTTPS / SSH
  • PGP encryption/decryption and key management
  • AWS / Azure and hybrid-cloud environments
  • Splunk / Dynatrace / Grafana
  • MFT platform modernization and migrations

Education


  • BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Experience supporting MFT/Connect:Direct in a large-scale financial-services or regulated enterprise environment is preferred.

Work Schedule


  • Work model: Fully Work from Office; no hybrid working.
  • Schedule: APAC, 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM or EMEA, 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM.
  • Location: Bangalore or Hyderabad. Candidates unwilling to relocate need not apply.

Important: We are looking for a strong hands-on NDM/Connect:Direct troubleshooting engineer, not someone whose experience is limited to routine administration, monitoring, Process submission, or operational support.

From technology to product innovation we're making our mark on the financial services industry. description:

Als Cateringmanager ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor jouw team en zorg je ervoor dat onze gasten iedere dag kunnen genieten van een gastvrije en smakelijke lunchvoorziening. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen operationele, administratieve en leidinggevende werkzaamheden.

Je werkt op verschillende onderwijslocaties in de regio Eindhoven. Daarom zijn flexibiliteit en mobiliteit belangrijk.

Jij bent een echte regelaar die energie krijgt van afwisseling, verantwoordelijkheid én het aansturen van mensen. Met jouw enthousiasme weet je teams in beweging te krijgen en zorg je ervoor dat iedere locatie op rolletjes loopt.

  • Je bent gastvrij, communicatief sterk en denkt graag een stap vooruit
  • Je vindt het leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en beslissingen te maken
  • Je springt bij waar nodig en steekt zelf graag de handen uit de mouwen
  • Je bent flexibel en vindt het geen probleem om af en toe een avond of weekend te werken
  • Je beschikt over een rijbewijs B en eigen vervoer
  • Je krijgt energie van een dynamische omgeving waarin geen dag hetzelfde is en waar jij écht het verschil maakt voor jouw medewerkers én gasten.

Wat serveert Appèl

  • Per direct een functie als Cateringmanager Onderwijs met werktijden die doorgaans binnen schooltijd vallen
  • Een salaris passend bij jouw functie en ervaring conform hospitality cao

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer, of volledige vergoeding wanneer je reist met het openbaar vervoer

title: PSO-Executive Protection Officer
description:
Job Title: PSO

Location: Pan India (Deployment based on client requirement - corporate, residential, or diplomatic)

Department: Executive Protection / Manned Guarding

Reports To: Assignment Manager / Client's Security Coordinator / G4S EP Team Lead

Company: G4S Secure Solutions (India) Pvt. Ltd.

Position Summary

The Security Bodyguard cum Driver is a dual-role professional responsible for ensuring the personal safety of VIP clients during travel and at residence/work locations. This role includes acting as a close protection officer while also operating the client's vehicle with defensive driving skills, situational awareness, and utmost discretion.

Key Responsibilities

  • Executive Protection Duties:
  • Provide close physical protection to the designated client (VIP, CXO, celebrity, etc.) during travel and public appearances.
  • Maintain constant situational awareness to detect and deter potential threats.
  • Escort the client safely to and from designated locations, coordinating with site security teams if needed.
  • Conduct route surveys, risk assessments, and coordinate contingency plans in advance.
  • Driving Duties:
  • Safely operate assigned vehicle (sedan/SUV/armored, as per deployment) with full adherence to traffic rules and VIP protocols.
  • Maintain calm and control in high-pressure traffic, crowds, or emergencies.
  • Keep the vehicle clean, fueled, and roadworthy at all times.
  • Perform pre-trip vehicle checks and inform the employer/manager of any mechanical issues.
  • Emergency Response:
  • React promptly and decisively in the event of an attack, medical emergency, or road incident.
  • Evacuate the principal (client) to a safe location and alert law enforcement or control room as per SOP.
  • Administer basic first aid or coordinate emergency medical evacuation if needed.
  • Discretion & Confidentiality:
  • Maintain complete confidentiality of client's location, schedule, and personal matters.
  • Display professional conduct, courtesy, and appropriate language at all times.
  • Avoid sharing or discussing client information, directly or indirectly.
  • Vehicle & Asset Security:
  • Ensure security of the vehicle when parked or idle.
  • Monitor surroundings during halts or drop-offs for potential risks.
  • Report any suspicious activity near client property or vehicle.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Education: Minimum 10th pass (12th pass preferred)
  • Driving License: Valid LMV license with at least 3-5 years of accident-free driving experience
  • Experience:
    • Minimum 3-7 years in personal security or VIP driving roles
    • Prior experience as a bodyguard, ex-serviceman, or PSO preferred
    • Knowledge of security protocols, evasive driving, and first aid is desirable
  • Age: 28 to 50 years
  • Height & Fitness: Minimum 5'8 (172 cm), physically fit, alert, and well-built
Skills & Competencies

  • Defensive and evasive driving skills under pressure
  • Excellent situational awareness and reaction time
  • Courteous yet assertive conduct with the public

title: Senior Tax Analyst
description:
Job Category:

Finance

Job Family:

Tax

Job Description:

The Senior Tax Analyst - Indirect Tax is responsible for GST and Customs compliance, accounting, audits, assessments, litigation coordination, HSN/SAC governance, refunds, scenario planning, advisory and group reporting across the India business. The role works closely with outsourced consultants, tax authorities, auditors, supply chain, commercial, procurement, operations, IT and regional or global finance teams to ensure accurate compliance, timely submissions, effective risk management and identification of lawful tax-efficiency opportunities.

Essential Functions

1 .GST Compliance & Annual Reporting

· Work closely with the outsourced GST consultant for compliance, reconciliations, filings, assessments and advisory matters across all locations.

· Coordinate annual GST reconciliation for the statutory audit and ensure alignment between GST returns, books of account and financial statements.

· Coordinate preparation, review and timely filing of GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C.

2. GST Accounting, Reconciliations & Controls

· Prepare monthly GST accounting journal entries and ensure correct posting in the general ledger.

· Prepare and support approval of GST-related ARCS reconciliations.

· Reconcile GST portal records, purchase and sales registers, input tax credit, electronic ledgers and general-ledger balances.

3. GST Audits, Assessments & Hearings

· Coordinate GST audits, assessments, departmental inquiries and verification proceedings across Baramati, Kuppam, Fazilka and Mumbai.

· Compile technical and financial information and ensure timely, accurate submission to GST officers.

4. Litigation, Legacy VAT/CST & Legal Cases

· Coordinate GST litigation, appeals and legal cases with external consultants and legal counsel.

· Manage legacy VAT and CST litigation and maintain complete case records.

· Prepare factual briefs, reconciliations, supporting documents and draft submissions.

· Monitor hearing dates, appeal deadlines, disputed amounts, contingent liabilities and case developments.

· Assess indirect-tax risks and provide timely inputs for provisions and disclosures to the Controller through the Financial Statements & Tax Manager.

5. HSN/SAC Classification & Oracle Master Governance

· Maintain and update HSN and SAC codes at item or service level in Oracle.

· Apply classification rules consistently to products, services and transactions.

· Conduct quarterly reviews of HSN/SAC codes and applicable GST rates.

6. GST Refunds & Input Tax Credit Optimization

· Prepare and coordinate GST refund filings under the Inverted Duty Structure, where applicable.

· Monitor refund claims, respond to queries and coordinate follow-up with consultants and authorities.

· Review input tax credit eligibility, reversals, blocked credits and utilization.

· Identify lawful cost-saving and cash-flow opportunities under GST and Customs regulations.

· Quantify opportunities, risks and implementation requirements before recommendation to management.

7. E-Way Bill & Supply-Chain Coordination

· Coordinate closure of pending e-way bill matters with Supply Chain Management for applicable locations.

· Analyze exceptions and support corrective actions relating to e-way bill generation, cancellation, extension and closure.

· Provide indirect-tax guidance for stock transfers, returns, job work, imports, exports and other supply-chain transactions.

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams to collect technical and transactional information required for compliance or assessments.

8. Customs Compliance & Advisory

· Support customs classification, valuation, documentation and duty assessment for imports and exports.

· Coordinate customs notices, audits, assessments and consultant interactions.

9. GST Scenario Planning & Business Advisory

· Evaluate GST and Customs implications of new business models, pricing arrangements, contracts, supply-chain structures and capital projects.

10. Management & Group Reporting

· Prepare monthly GST insights for leadership covering outward supplies, inward supplies, input tax credit, reversals, refunds, assessments and litigation.

· Prepare periodic indirect-tax reporting required by regional or global finance and tax teams.

11. Digitalization & Process Improvement

· Support development and implementation of a Power BI dashboard for GST accounts, compliance, reconciliations and risk insights.

· Identify opportunities to automate data extraction, reconciliations, exception reporting and compliance workflows.

Qualifications

  • Cost and Management Accountant, law or equivalent professional finance or tax qualification preferred.
  • Typically 4 to 7 years of relevant experience in GST, Customs and Indian indirect taxation.
  • Hands-on experience with GST returns, annual reconciliation, GSTR-9/9C, audits, assessments, notices, refunds and litigation support.·
  • Experience in HSN/SAC classification, ERP master-data governance and GST accounting.·
  • Experience coordinating with outsourced consultants, auditors, tax authorities and cross-functional teams.·
  • Experience in a multinational or global matrix organization is an advantage Manufacturing, FMCG, food, dairy, consumer products or a similar industry background is beneficial.
  • Strong Excel and ERP skills; exposure to Oracle, ARCS and Power BI is preferred.

Role Overview

The role will work closely with Service Lines, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Compliance, and senior leadership to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting.

Financial Reporting & Month-End Close

Internal Financial Controls & Governance

  • Ensure appropriate documentation and testing of key financial controls.
  • Identify control gaps and drive timely remediation.
  • Strengthen financial governance and control frameworks across entities.

Lease Accounting & Fixed Assets

Balance Sheet & Month-End Governance

  • Ensure all balance sheet schedules are prepared, reviewed, and reconciled on a monthly basis.

  • Ensure appropriate cut-off procedures and completeness of expense recognition.
  • Investigate and resolve long-outstanding reconciling items and unusual balances.
  • Drive high standards of accuracy and financial discipline across the reporting process.

Stakeholder Management

  • Provide management with relevant financial information, analysis, and insights.
  • Partner with stakeholders to resolve accounting, reporting, and close-related issues.

Process Improvement & Systems

  • Financial reporting and financial statements

Saniket Kadam

title: Sr Software Engineer - Implementations
description:
Senior Software Engineer, Implementations

Team: Engineering, building tooling for the Implementation team

About Machinify

Machinify builds the AI operating system for healthcare payment intelligence, combining the minds of industry experts with the power of technology. US healthcare wastes billions of dollars a year inside the claims payment workflow, and Machinify has built a platform to fix that, backed by more than 40 years of payment integrity expertise and a product suite spanning the full claims lifecycle from pre-pay through post-pay. Today, 85+ customers rely on us, including 18 of the top 20 US health plans, covering more than 270 million member lives across commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid. We process over 3 petabytes of claims data and return more than $6 billion in savings and recoveries to our customers every year, with 99% customer retention.

Our Culture

We embrace complex challenges with curiosity, having genuine interest and drive to understand the hard problems at hand and how to move the needle forward. Our engineers empower each other to take action, learn deeply about our customers needs, and unlock innovation with a strong sense of product ownership. We build with our users in mind, thoughtfully shipping outcomes, not just features. The technology we build shapes real healthcare decisions, demanding a high bar for engineering excellence and what we ship carries real weight. We pressure-test new AI tools, shape how they're used, and set the example for what disciplined, AI-driven engineering looks like: fast, but always under structured human oversight.

About The Role

In this role, you'll build the tools and applications that help our Implementation team bring new health plan clients onto Machinify quickly and reliably. You'll create tooling that lets teams set up and launch implementations on their own. Where no tool exists yet, you'll do the configuration directly through our APIs, then turn what you learn into new features that remove that manual work over time.

You'll also build and maintain the internal applications the Implementation team relies on every day, working directly with the people who use them and seeing your work in use quickly.

You'll work alongside AI coding agents as a core part of how you deliver, directing and reviewing their output while holding the bar on quality.

What You Will Own

  • Build tools and automation that let the Implementation team configure and launch client implementations on their own.
  • Configure the platform directly through our APIs when no tooling exists yet, and capture each repeatable step so it can be automated.
  • Turn recurring manual configuration work into new tools and features that reduce manual effort over time.
  • Build and maintain the internal applications the Implementation team relies on every day.
  • Partner with implementation managers and specialists to understand their workflows and turn their needs into clear technical designs.
  • Review your peers designs and code, and write automated tests that keep tooling reliable as clients and requirements change.
  • Write runbooks and documentation so the Implementation team can use what you ship without coming back to engineering.
  • Support what you ship by triaging issues and fixing defects.
  • Deepen your understanding of the healthcare claims and payments domain.
  • Lead the design of larger tools, set patterns for implementation tooling, and mentor teammates.

How the Levels Differ

Software Engineer

  • Experience: 2 years building and shipping software tools, automation, or services.
  • Scope: builds tools, automation, and internal applications; configures through APIs where no tool exists and automates the repeatable steps.
  • Team: reviews peers designs and code.

Senior Software Engineer

  • Experience: 5 years building and shipping software tools, automation, or services.
  • Scope: all of that, plus leads the design of larger tools and sets patterns for implementation tooling.
  • Team: reviews peers designs and code, and mentors teammates.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5 years of experience building and shipping software tools, automation, or services.
  • Proficiency in at least one backend or ing language (Rust, Java or Scala, Go, or Python) with the confidence to work across the others.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building against and integrating with REST APIs.
  • Experience automating complex, repeatable configuration or deployment tasks, such as with s, command-line tools, or infrastructure as code.
  • Clear written communication, including technical designs, documentation, and runbooks.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools in a real production setting.
  • A service mindset. You treat the teams who use your tools as your customers, and you care about the outcome, not just the implementation.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with your engineering peers, implementation teams, and support teams.
  • BS or MS in Computer Science (or equivalent experience).

Preferred

  • Experience with Type and frontend development, since some of our tools have web interfaces.
  • Experience with Rust.
  • Experience with Terraform, Ansible, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with healthcare claims, payments, data migration, or client onboarding.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Machinify

Machinify is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination on any status protected under applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruitment process, please let our recruiting team know.

title: Director, Data Platform and Engineering
description:
Job Category:

Business Analytics & Data Science

Data & Analytics

Job Description:

The Director, Data Platform & Engineering defines, builds, modernizes, and governs Schreiber’s enterprise data platform and engineering capabilities. This leader develops and executes the strategy and multi-year roadmap for a simplified, scalable, secure and AI-ready data foundation. The role leads the retirement and obsolescence of legacy data models and pipelines, enables governed Medallion data layers, and establishes platform engineering practices that accelerate trusted analytics, machine learning, artificial intelligence and digital solutions.


Reporting to the VP, Data, AI & Venturing, this leader directs Data Platform capability roles, key Data Engineering teams and the Engineering Center of Excellence (COE). The role establishes architecture standards, governance, guardrails, reusable engineering patterns, reliability practices and cost disciplines while partnering with Enterprise Architecture, MDM & Delivery, Data Science/ML, AI, Security and business teams to translate enterprise priorities into durable data products and measurable value.


Hybrid: This role offers a flexible hybrid work schedule (Monday-Friday) located at our Home Office in Green Bay, Wisconsin. The hybrid work schedule is 3 days/week onsite at Home Office and 2 days/week from home.


Relocation Benefits: Receive a $10,000 relocation bonus PLUS a generous relocation package if relocating more than 50 miles for this position.


About our Green Bay, WI Home Office:

You’ll find lots to love in our beautiful home office in downtown Green Bay, Wisconsin. Our jeans-friendly environment has indoor and outdoor collaboration spaces, state-of-the-art R&D and sensory labs, culinary kitchens, a pilot plant, innovation center and more.


Take advantage of outdoor workspaces. Sample and provide feedback on new products from our R&D team. Enjoy free coffee, soda and popcorn. Take a short walk to restaurants, breweries, the YMCA and a weekly farmer’s market on the scenic Fox River. You can even see Lambeau Field from our top floor.


What you will do:

Data Platform Strategy, Architecture & Roadmap

  • Define and execute Schreiber’s enterprise data platform strategy, target architecture, investment priorities and multi-year roadmap.
  • Create a transparent platform portfolio tied to business outcomes, capability maturity, risk reduction, adoption, reliability and total cost of ownership.
  • Lead technology lifecycle decisions and recommend when to build, buy, partner, consolidate or retire capabilities.
  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture to align platform direction, integration patterns and technology standards.

Legacy Modernization, OBSL & Simplification

  • Own the structured obsolescence of legacy data models, pipelines, integration patterns and redundant technologies.
  • Establish migration waves, dependency maps, decommission criteria and adoption plans that reduce technical debt without disrupting critical operations.
  • Simplify the data estate through standardized patterns, common services and rationalized tooling.
  • Measure retirement progress, avoided cost, operational risk and platform simplification.

Medallion Data Layers & Data Product Enablement

  • Establish and govern Bronze, Silver and Gold layer standards for ingestion, refinement, conformance and business-ready consumption.
  • Enable reusable, discoverable and trusted data products with clear ownership, service expectations, metadata, lineage and quality controls.
  • Partner with MDM & Delivery to embed authoritative master and reference data into shared enterprise data products.
  • Enable fit-for-purpose access patterns for reporting, analytics, operational use cases, AI and data science.

Data Engineering & Engineering COE Leadership

  • Lead Data Platform capability roles, key Data Engineering teams and the Engineering COE with clear accountabilities and delivery expectations.
  • Establish engineering standards for ingestion, transformation, orchestration, testing, CI/CD, version control, documentation and reusable frameworks.
  • Create communities of practice, reference implementations, design reviews and technical coaching that raise engineering maturity across teams.
  • Build workforce plans, succession, skills development and vendor strategies aligned to the roadmap.

AI Engineering & Advanced Analytics Enablement

  • Build the platform services, pipelines and engineering patterns required to operationalize machine learning, generative AI and advanced analytics.
  • Partner with Data Science/ML and AI leaders on feature engineering, model deployment, monitoring, vector and unstructured data patterns, and reusable AI services.
  • Ensure AI-ready data is secure, governed, traceable, reliable and fit for intended use.
  • Enable responsible experimentation while creating production standards for scalable AI solutions.

Governance, Guardrails, Security & Risk

  • Define platform governance, reference architectures, engineering guardrails, access controls and approved usage patterns.
  • Embed privacy, cybersecurity, regulatory, retention, auditability and segregation-of-duties requirements into platform design and operations.
  • Partner with data owners and stewards to improve data quality, metadata, lineage, classification and policy compliance.
  • Lead technical governance forums and resolve architectural exceptions through documented, risk-based decisions.

Platform Operations, Reliability & Financial Stewardship

  • Establish service levels, observability, incident response, capacity planning, disaster recovery and operational ownership for platform services.
  • Improve reliability, performance and developer experience through automation, self-service and platform engineering practices.
  • Own budget planning, cloud consumption transparency, FinOps and vendor performance for the capability.
  • Report outcomes through availability, throughput, quality, adoption, delivery speed, unit cost and business-value measures.

What you will need to succeed:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics or related field. Master’s degree or advanced technical certification preferred.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience, including 5+ years leading technical teams and leaders.
  • Progressive leadership experience across enterprise data platforms, cloud data engineering, architecture, platform operations, data governance and large-scale modernization.
  • Demonstrated success creating and executing enterprise data platform strategies and multi-year roadmaps.
  • Experience modernizing legacy data models, pipelines and technology estates, including planned migration and decommissioning.
  • Hands-on leadership experience with modern cloud data platforms and Medallion-based architecture patterns.
  • Experience establishing DataOps, DevOps, CI/CD, observability, data quality and engineering standards at enterprise scale.
  • Experience enabling AI/ML workloads, production model operations and governed access to structured and unstructured data.
  • Experience managing budgets, technology vendors, cloud consumption, risk and service performance in a matrixed enterprise.



Additional Details:


Skills:

  • Data engineering, platform engineering, DataOps, DevOps, CI/CD and site reliability practices.
  • Medallion architecture, data products, metadata, lineage, cataloging, quality and observability.
