title: Industry Technology Specialist -ITS- Technical Service Distilling Biofuel
description:
Interested in a career that matters

At Novonesis, we work in close partnership with our customers to create a better world every day. We use science and biosolutions to help industries improve performance and make better use of our planet's resources.

Join our Grain Processing team within Planetary Health Biosolutions in Bangalore, India, where you will work alongside industry technology specialists and laboratory colleagues to support customers in the Distilling and Biofuel industry.

The role & your impact

As Industry Technology Specialist (ITS) – Distilling & Biofuel, you will provide technical service and expertise to customers in the grain processing, distilling, and biofuel industries.

You will lead plant trials and technical experiments, troubleshoot complex production challenges, analyze process data, and translate technical findings into practical recommendations. Through close collaboration with customers and cross-functional teams, you will help advance technical solutions and contribute to meaningful business outcomes.

Your Key Responsibilities In This Role

  • Provide technical service and process expertise to grain-based ethanol and biofuel customers.
  • Develop and lead experimental plans and plant trials and communicate findings and conclusions to support business development.
  • Troubleshoot fermentation challenges, including stuck or sluggish fermentation, contamination, reduced ethanol yield, and yeast performance issues.
  • Support optimization of grain milling, liquefaction, saccharification, fermentation, distillation, and DDGS processes.
  • Optimize process parameters including temperature, pH, nutrient levels, and enzyme dosage to improve production efficiency.
  • Support yeast strain selection, propagation, viability, vitality, and fermentation performance.
  • Conduct root cause analyses using process data, trends, and statistical tools to address production deviations.
  • Identify and help mitigate contamination through effective sterilization and CIP practices.
  • Collaborate with customers and internal teams and share technical knowledge to help prevent recurring production challenges.

What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role

  • A Bachelor's degree (BE/B.Tech), Master's degree, or Ph.D. in Biotechnology, Food Technology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Chemical Engineering, Bioprocessing, or a related discipline.
  • 5–10 years of professional experience in a grain-based distillery or biofuel production environment.
  • Practical expertise in grain-based ethanol production processes.
  • Experience with grain milling involving materials such as rice, corn, sorghum, or wheat, as well as liquefaction, saccharification, fermentation, distillation, and DDGS processes.
  • Practical knowledge of yeast selection, propagation, viability, vitality, metabolism, and fermentation performance.
  • Experience troubleshooting fermentation, yeast performance, contamination, and ethanol-yield challenges.
  • Ability to develop and execute experimental plans and plant trials.
  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently across India to provide technical services to ethanol-producing plants.

Additional Skills & Interests We Value

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including root cause analysis.
  • Experience analyzing process and statistical data and managing technical data using Microsoft Excel or other relevant tools.
  • Ability to clearly communicate technical findings and conclusions to customers and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • A collaborative approach to technical problem-solving and knowledge sharing.
  • A proactive approach to your work, with an interest in developing and implementing innovative technical solutions.

What We Offer You

You will join a collaborative technical environment where scientific expertise, innovation, and practical problem-solving come together. You will have opportunities to work closely with customers, cross-functional colleagues, and specialists while contributing to the development and application of biosolutions for the Distilling and Biofuel industry.

Our purpose guides the way

In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity's biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It's how we've gotten so far. title: Workforce Architect Analyst Lead
description:
Position Type

Full time

Type Of Hire

Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)

The future of money is being built right now. At FIS, we help the world's businesses, banks and communities move, manage and grow money with confidence. Join a team that values fresh thinking, works together to solve complex challenges, and creates technology that powers everyday life.

About The Role

You will support work redesign by uncovering how workflows operate today and translating future-state concepts into structured analysis, measures and requirements. This is not a traditional workforce-reporting role. You will facilitate discovery, gather data, map processes and tasks, establish baselines and KPIs, and support workflow design across people, AI, automation and agents. You will not just improve how work gets done today. You will help imagine how it should get done when AI is embedded into the workflow.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate discovery sessions with teams across the organization
  • Interview subject-matter experts and map current work at task and subtask level, including handoffs, workarounds, systems, data and controls
  • Collect and analyze data and establish baseline measures and KPIs
  • Use AI to organize discovery evidence, compare sources, identify themes and draft requirements and executive summaries. Validate findings against source material, distinguish evidence from inference, check calculations and preserve traceability from discovery through recommendations
  • Support decisions about what work should be eliminated, simplified, automated, AI-augmented, agent-enabled or retained for human judgment
  • Translate future-state designs into requirements, acceptance criteria, user stories and workflow documentation
  • Document and test human-in-the-loop checkpoints, review criteria, approval ownership and exception paths in requirements and acceptance criteria, including how unsupported or conflicting AI outputs are handled
  • Partner with principal designers, product owners and technology teams through backlog refinement and implementation
  • Analyze implications for roles, capabilities and workforce needs

What You Bring

Required qualifications

  • Experience in business analysis, product analysis, process design, workflow analysis or product operations
  • Strong process mapping, data analysis and discovery-facilitation skills
  • Experience writing requirements, acceptance criteria or user stories
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI efficiently to produce high-quality, audience-appropriate analysis and deliverables through effective prompting, iterative refinement, critical evaluation and accountable human review. Able to explain and defend the reasoning and evidence behind the final deliverable, with a design-thinking orientation and strong problem-solving and solutioning skills
  • Creative curiosity and comfort challenging established processes

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with process mining, workflow analytics, automation or AI-enabled products
  • Experience in product management, agile delivery, service design or user research
  • Experience with organization design, workforce planning, skills analysis or operating-model design

The impact you'll make

As a Workforce Designer - Analyst Lead, you will help turn ideas about the future of work into practical designs that teams can build and implement. Your analysis will connect workflow evidence, technology opportunities and human judgment, helping shape work that is simpler, more effective and ready for an AI-enabled future.

What We Offer You

Bring your ideas. Build your future. At FIS, you'll find the support, resources and opportunities to develop your career while helping shape the future of financial technology.

We Offer

  • Internal career growth opportunities
  • Opportunities to innovate in fintech
  • Inclusive and diverse team atmosphere
  • Professional and personal development
  • Resources to contribute to your community

Privacy Statement

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

Sourcing Model

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

title: MAR140-Vehicle Dynamics Design
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Senior Engineer – Vehicle Dynamics Design to lead the design, development, and engineering of vehicle dynamics components and systems, including chassis, suspension, brakes, and wheels.

  • Strong experience in automotive vehicle dynamics and chassis component design.

  • Understanding of two-wheeler vehicle dynamics and engineering principles.
  • Experience in engineering calculations and FEA boundary condition preparation.
  • Strong knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T).
  • Experience in DFMEA, DVP, design documentation, and component validation.
  • Knowledge of fabrication processes, welding, and manufacturing methods.

Experience

Candidates with 5–6 years of automotive engineering experience, particularly in two-wheeler vehicle dynamics and chassis development.

title: Senior Help Desk Support Specialist

Machinify builds the AI operating system for healthcare payment intelligence, combining the minds of industry experts with the power of technology. US healthcare wastes billions of dollars a year inside the claims payment workflow, and Machinify has built a platform to fix that, backed by more than 40 years of payment integrity expertise and a product suite spanning the full claims lifecycle from pre-pay through post-pay. Today, 85+ customers rely on us, including 18 of the top 20 US health plans, covering more than 270 million member lives across commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid. We process over 3 petabytes of claims data and return more than $6 billion in savings and recoveries to our customers every year, with 99% customer retention.

We're now opening a new hub in Bengaluru that isn't a satellite office or a support function: it's a genuine extension of one global Machinify, where local leaders run real teams and own real product and outcomes. The problems our teams solve are hard by design, which is exactly why they haven't been solved before, and why the work is worth doing. title: Loader - Steel Tech
description:
Love Sudoku, Tetris, or building things with your hands? You’ll use that same kind of thinking to load structural steel. Each trailer is a new puzzle. You’ll figure out how beams, columns, and other steel components of different lengths, shapes, and weights fit together, then work with your crew to put the plan into action.

This is a fast-paced, physically demanding job. It takes attention to detail, tenacity when the first layout doesn’t work, and the ability to safely operate overhead cranes, forklifts, and saws.

What you’ll do

  • Operate overhead cranes and forklifts to move, lift, and position structural steel.
  • Operate saws to cut material as needed.
  • Plan trailer loads around the size, shape, and weight of the steel and the order in which it needs to come off.
  • Match piece marks and quantities to shipping paperwork and flag missing, damaged, or incorrect pieces.
  • Coordinate with your crew during lifts and follow Company procedures for supporting and securing steel for shipment.

What you’ll bring

  • Required ability to safely operate overhead cranes, forklifts, and saws.
  • The ability to picture how pieces fit together before moving them.
  • Tenacity to work through a tricky load and adjust the plan as needed.
  • A sharp eye for details, including piece marks on beams that look nearly identical.
  • Clear communication and safe work habits while keeping up with a busy shipping schedule.

About the Company

  • Steel Tech markets, designs, manufactures, and delivers pre-engineered metal buildings. We deliver them to jobsites all across the U.S.A. .We are a privately held company that rejects a mindset that cares only about the bottom line. Our values drive our decision-making. With long-term, win/win relationships, our employees, dealers, and vendors come before a commission or profit incentive. Knowing that these strong relationships are key to success, it is paramount that our team members are successful and have continuous growth–personally and professionally. We are all imperfect humans, but we desire continually to be pursuing excellence in values beyond the status quo. Therefore, we intentionally focus on building a strong team culture.
  • We are headquartered in Monett, MO and are IAS AC472 accredited.

What We Offer

  • A team-based culture where you feel valued
  • Mentors who guide team-members' personal and professional growth
  • Recognition for work well done and for achieving goals
  • Competitive compensation
  • Competitive health, dental, and vision insurance packages
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer match

Steel Tech is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state, or local protected class. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, religion, or veteran status.

title: Senior Software Engineer Data Platform
description:
Location: Bengaluru, India

About Machinify

Machinify builds the AI operating system for healthcare payment intelligence, combining the minds of industry experts with the power of technology. US healthcare wastes billions of dollars a year inside the claims payment workflow, and Machinify has built a platform to fix that, backed by more than 40 years of payment integrity expertise and a product suite spanning the full claims lifecycle from pre-pay through post-pay. Today, 85+ customers rely on us, including 18 of the top 20 US health plans, covering more than 270 million member lives across commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid. We process over 3 petabytes of claims data and return more than $6 billion in savings and recoveries to our customers every year, with 99% customer retention.

We're now opening a new hub in Bengaluru that isn't a satellite office or a support function: it's a genuine extension of one global Machinify, where local leaders run real teams and own real product and outcomes. The problems our teams solve are hard by design, which is exactly why they haven't been solved before, and why the work is worth doing. Joining now means building Machinify's India presence- its people, culture, and way of working- from the ground up, with real influence over what gets built and how.

About The Role

This role sits within Data Platform Development, part of Machinify's Data Architecture, Tooling & Frameworks organization.

The Data Platform Development team builds the internal systems that power and extend the Machinify platform. We focus on scalable, reliable infrastructure for data processing, communication, and analytics across our products and customer-facing systems. We work closely with the core Machinify platform (written in Scala) as its internal customers: we design and build orchestration and supporting services in Golang and Python that sit on top of the core engine. Our team builds internal products and analytics capabilities that improve performance, reliability, and extensibility, so the platform can scale with our customers and AI-driven use cases. You'll design and build high-performance backend systems that power these AI-driven solutions, working with engineers, data experts, and innovators across the US and India.

What You Will Own

  • Design and build scalable, high-performance data software in Golang and Python.
  • Build and deploy Kubernetes-based systems that manage containerized applications in cloud-native environments.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to understand customer and internal needs, so our systems keep up with future requirements.
  • Optimize the performance, reliability, and security of our backend infrastructure.
  • Work on data modeling and transformation that support machine learning workflows and AI-powered applications.
  • Build agentic AI tooling and services that automate data engineering work (e.g., agentic ETL).
  • Own the design of services end to end, lead technical decisions, and mentor engineers.

Qualifications

Required

  • 6+ years of hands-on backend software development.
  • Strong Golang and/or Python.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI (building with LLMs or agents, not only using chat tools). Strong experience is expected for the Senior level.
  • Strong understanding of ETL processes, data pipelines, and working with large datasets.
  • Kubernetes orchestration, containerization (Docker, Helm), and cloud-native development.
  • Experience building scalable systems that handle high volumes of data and transactions.
  • A cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and its ecosystem tools.
  • CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for clean, maintainable code.

Preferred

  • Orchestration tools (Apache Airflow, Prefect).
  • Monitoring and logging for distributed systems (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack).
  • Data modeling, transformation, and integration experience.
  • Scala or other JVM experience (to work against the core platform).

Tech Stack

Golang, Python, Scala (core platform), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, AWS, Airflow, Prometheus/Grafana/ELK, CI/CD, LLM/agent frameworks, Claude Code.

Machinify is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination on any status protected under applicable law. title: Project Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project Manager based in the United States.

The Project Manager will lead the successful delivery of capital construction projects, ensuring they are completed safely, on schedule, and within budget. Acting as a key point of contact for clients, subcontractors, architects, engineers, and internal teams, this role requires strong leadership and construction expertise. You will oversee project planning, estimating, scheduling, cost control, and resource allocation while maintaining high standards of quality and accountability. Working closely with field and office personnel, you will guide teams through every stage of the construction process, from initial planning to final closeout. This position offers the opportunity to manage complex projects, build strong client relationships, and contribute to continuous improvement across a collaborative construction environment. Travel and assignments on out-of-state projects may be required.

Accountabilities:

As Project Manager, you will provide overall direction and supervision for assigned construction projects, coordinating project personnel and external stakeholders to achieve operational, financial, and quality objectives. You will be responsible for anticipating challenges, resolving issues, and maintaining clear communication throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Review project estimates and bids, contribute to project planning, and collaborate with management on the selection and assignment of project personnel.

  • Oversee subcontractor selection, contract arrangements, and the review of proposed materials and shop drawings from subcontractors and suppliers.

  • Coordinate the development and review of preliminary and detailed project schedules with project teams.

  • Ensure project management and administrative requirements are completed, including cash flow plans, subcontractor and manufacturer lists, submittal logs, and procurement records.

  • Monitor the submission, processing, tracking, and approval of project documentation and ensure required plans are properly administered.

  • Work with Project Superintendents to coordinate material deliveries and ensure that materials received at the job site or in outside storage are properly recorded.

  • Monitor construction activities, identify risks, and resolve issues related to project changes, deficiencies, and subcontractor performance.

  • Review monthly project status reports and billings, keeping senior management and clients informed of progress and relevant developments.

  • Ensure punch-list items are completed and oversee the submission of closeout documentation, including drawings, operation and maintenance manuals, and warranties.

  • Support the fair and timely resolution of final disputes, litigation matters, and payment arrangements.

  • Supervise and coordinate project management personnel and field teams, including Project Engineers, Superintendents, Assistant Superintendents, Project Administrators, and other assigned staff.

  • Promote a strong safety and quality culture throughout project execution.

Requirements:

The ideal candidate brings substantial construction management experience, with a proven ability to lead capital projects from planning through completion. You should combine strong technical knowledge with financial and operational management skills, effective communication, and the ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams.

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Construction Technology, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

  • At least 5 years of progressively responsible experience in construction management, including a minimum of 3 years in a Project Manager role with direct responsibility for delivering capital construction projects.

  • Demonstrated experience in project planning, estimating, budgeting, scheduling, cost control, subcontractor management, client communication, and project team coordination.

  • Strong ability to prepare, manage, and modify detailed construction plans, schedules, and estimates using computers and standard project management software.

  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, shop drawings, and technical specifications.

  • Working knowledge of mathematical concepts, including geometry, trigonometry, and algebra, as well as the ability to perform construction-related calculations.

  • Proficiency with personal computers and standard software applications.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide clear instructions and communicate effectively with clients, architects, engineers, subcontractors, and employees.

  • Proven leadership and delegation skills, with the ability to manage project teams and large groups of personnel while driving results.

  • Professional certifications such as LEED AP, DBIA, or ASHE are considered an advantage.

  • Willingness to travel or work on out-of-state project assignments when required.

  • Ability to meet the physical demands of the position, including standing, walking, climbing, bending, and occasionally lifting or moving up to 50 pounds.

  • Ability to work extended hours when project demands require, particularly during critical project phases.

  • Willingness to work in construction environments where exposure to machinery, elevated areas, uneven terrain, dust, fumes, weather conditions, and loud noise may occur.

description:
Tufts Medical Center is seeking a Full-Time CT Tech to join our team!

$15,000 Sign-on Bonus eligible for external candidates!


Hours: 30 hours weekly, day shifts


Job Profile Summary

​This role focuses on using various imaging techniques and practices to aid in the diagnosis and treatment of patients. In addition, this role focuses on performing the following CT Scan duties: Utilizes CT Scan Technology to provide images of internal organs, bones, and soft tissue. A clinical technologist role that has specialized knowledge or skills gained through a combination of vocational education, training, and experience. This role will be most commonly applied to patient care and/or scientific/laboratory jobs. An entry-level role typically requiring little to no prior knowledge or experience and requiring vocational or technical education. Work is routine or follows standard procedures, is closely supervised, and communicates information that requires little explanation or interpretation.


Job Overview

Perform Computed Tomography (CT) scan procedures on assigned patients according to the policies, procedures, philosophy, and objectives of the department and hospital. Perform CT scan procedures that follow radiological standards in a safe, accurate and timely manner, meet the American College of Radiology (ACR) imaging standards and allow the radiologist and/or physician to make a radiological diagnosis. Responsible for designated areas and/or procedures as assigned. Work cooperatively within departments and other service lines to create a system of quality health care.


Job Description

Minimum Qualifications:

1. Associate degree in Radiology or related field.

2. Radiologic Technologist Certification (ARRT).

3. CT Certification (ARRT) or (NMTCB).

4. Radiologic Technologist state license eligible.

5. Basic Life Support Certification.


Preferred Qualifications:

1. Healthcare experience.

2. X-Ray experience.

3. CT Technologist experience.


Duties and Responsibilities: The duties and responsibilities listed below are intended to describe the general nature of work and are not intended to be an all-inclusive list. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned.


1. Perform CT scans on patients as assigned according to policy and radiological standards.

2. Verify patient and procedure to be performed.

3. Provide clear and accurate instructions to patients.

4. Verify and perform correct imaging protocol, step, procedures, and scanner parameters for each patient.

5. Ensure patient and staff safety for CT equipment used.

6. Ensure IV access has been obtained and administer IV contrast.

7. Participate in ongoing education and training.

8. Perform quality control on equipment and devices as required.

9. Communicate with other staff/departments to coordinate care of patients.

10. Maintain supply stock and request stock to be ordered when necessary.

11. Keep all work areas clean and functional according to DPH and The Joint Commission.


Physical Requirements:

1. Frequent standing, occasional sitting, walking, and lifting 30-35 lbs.

2. Manual dexterity using fine hand manipulation to operate radiology equipment.

3. Hearing and visual acuity sufficient to perform examinations, observe patients, read monitors and documents, and hear audible equipment alarms.

4. Exposure to bodily fluids and communicable diseases.


Skills & Abilities:

1. Knowledge of radiologic equipment, examinations, and procedures.

2. Knowledge of radiation safety protocols.

3. Good communication skills.

4. Good customer service skills.

5. Ability to organize and set priorities.

description:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

MUFG, one of the world’s most trusted financial groups, is seeking an Assistant Vice President for Know Your Customer (KYC) Advisory within its Financial Crime Office Europe. This six-month fixed-term contract offers you the opportunity to join a globally respected organisation in London, where your expertise will directly contribute to safeguarding customers and the wider economy. You will be part of a dedicated team focused on consolidating and enhancing financial crime detection and prevention operations across Europe, Middle East, and Africa. MUFG values service-focused professionals who are committed to developing world-class anti-money laundering (AML) and KYC skills. The role promises exposure to complex corporate structures, high-risk clients, and regulatory challenges, all within a supportive environment that encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing, and personal growth. With flexible working opportunities and generous pension contributions, MUFG provides a workplace where your commitment is recognised and your professional development is nurtured.

  • Join a global leader in financial services with a strong commitment to trust, integrity, and compliance, offering you the chance to work alongside knowledgeable colleagues in a highly collaborative environment.
  • Contribute to critical financial crime prevention initiatives by supporting business activities, delivering risk-based assurance, and implementing new ways of working that enhance operational efficiency.
  • Benefit from flexible working arrangements, ongoing training opportunities, and generous pension contributions while advancing your expertise in KYC advisory for corporates within a dynamic international setting.

What you'll do:

As Assistant Vice President Know Your Customer Advisory (Corporates), you will play a pivotal role in supporting MUFG’s Financial Crime Operations team across EMEA. Your day-to-day responsibilities will involve reviewing KYC records for both new business opportunities and existing high-risk clients. You will process complex advisory requests related to intricate ownership structures or challenging transactions while ensuring that risk recommendations are thorough and reliable. Handling escalations from the Front Office will require you to review detailed memos for sign-off by senior leaders. You will also contribute actively to technology enhancements by providing valuable input into system development projects. Managing screening escalations for PEPs and Adverse Media alerts forms an essential part of your remit; you’ll assist with ongoing monitoring activities such as monthly adverse media reviews. Analysing data to generate insightful management reports will help drive informed decision-making at MUFG. Additionally, you’ll update procedures in accordance with evolving regulatory requirements—identifying gaps, rolling out local changes, delivering training—and collaborate closely with colleagues across group entities to promote consistent risk management practices. Success in this role hinges on your ability to balance multiple priorities with precision while maintaining a calm approach under pressure.

  • Review records of Know Your Customer (KYC) for new business, periodic reviews, and event-driven assessments for high-risk clients while providing clear recommendations to ensure compliance.
  • Process ad-hoc advisory requests from the centralised onboarding unit, including queries related to complex ownership structures and transactions, offering dependable risk guidance.
  • Handle KYC escalations from Front Office by reviewing escalation memos for sign-off by senior management or Money Laundering Reporting Officer as required.
  • Support technology and system development by contributing inputs into funding decisions, prioritisation requests, and business cases for enhancements or upgrades.
  • Manage screening escalations for Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) and Adverse Media alerts arising from overnight screening systems or manual checks.
  • Assist with monthly adverse media alerts as part of ongoing client monitoring and manage any resulting escalations efficiently.
  • Analyse data to produce management reports and Key Performance Indicators that inform business decisions and support continuous improvement.
  • Process Anti-Social Element Checks with accuracy and attention to detail as part of comprehensive client due diligence procedures.
  • Update procedures in line with UK and global regulatory requirements, identify gaps, provide advisory guidance, implement local rollouts, and deliver relevant training sessions.
  • Liaise with colleagues across MUFG affiliates and group companies to ensure efficient processes and consistent risk management practices throughout the organisation.

What you bring:

Your proven experience as Assistant Vice President Know Your Customer Advisory (Corporates) will demonstrate deep familiarity with KYC processes gained over at least five years within financial crime operations. You bring expertise in handling high-risk clients—including those involving complex ownership structures or PEPs—and have successfully conducted quality assurance testing on KYC procedures. While experience with Financial Institution or Correspondent Banking clients is beneficial, your core strengths lie in understanding regulatory frameworks such as JMLSG guidelines alongside UK legal requirements. You possess a general grasp of IT systems relevant to KYC operations which enables you to support process improvements effectively. Your excellent communication skills allow you to share insights clearly among colleagues while fostering co-operative relationships across departments. A results-oriented attitude ensures that tasks are completed dependably even when faced with large workloads or tight deadlines; your proactive nature helps you adapt quickly when priorities shift. Structured thinking combined with sound judgement empowers you to resolve issues efficiently while maintaining exceptional attention to detail throughout all client due diligence activities.

  • Experience performing Know Your Customer (KYC) duties within financial crime operations is essential for this position.
  • Proven track record of conducting KYC reviews for high-risk clients including those with complex ownership structures or Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs).
  • Experience in quality checking or assurance testing of KYC processes is required to ensure accuracy and compliance.
  • Familiarity with performing KYC on Financial Institution or Correspondent Banking clients is advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of KYC regulations including JMLSG guidelines and UK regulatory requirements is vital.

  • Excellent communication skills enable you to convey complex information clearly across teams and stakeholders.
  • A results-oriented mindset paired with accountability ensures tasks are completed reliably within tight deadlines.
  • Proactive approach allows you to operate efficiently under urgency while prioritising workload appropriately.
  • Structured problem-solving abilities combined with sound judgement facilitate effective decision-making in challenging situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail guarantees accuracy in all aspects of client due diligence procedures.
  • Strong interpersonal skills foster positive relationships within teams and across departments.

What sets MUFG apart:

MUFG stands out as one of the world’s most trusted financial groups—a reputation built on unwavering commitment to integrity, transparency, and responsible banking practices. As an employer, MUFG offers an inclusive environment where collaboration thrives among knowledgeable professionals dedicated to protecting customers and the global economy from financial crime risks. Employees benefit from flexible working opportunities that accommodate diverse needs alongside generous pension contributions designed for long-term security. Training programmes are regularly available so you can continue developing your skills within a supportive network led by experienced mentors who value teamwork above all else. At MUFG, your efforts are recognised through meaningful work that contributes directly to global compliance standards; here you’ll find both personal fulfilment and professional advancement within an organisation renowned for its ethical leadership.

title: ServiceNow Developer
description:
Job Title: ServiceNow Developer

Experience: 2+ years(Freshers not eligible)

Purpose of the Role

The ServiceNow Developer is responsible for designing, configuring, developing, testing, and supporting enterprise-grade solutions on the ServiceNow platform.This role requires a ServiceNow developer who can operate effectively in a larger, governed IT organization, where platform architecture standards, security requirements, documentation, testing, release management, and operational readiness are expected parts of delivery. The individual should be comfortable working within structured development processes while also using approved AI-enabled tools to accelerate ing, improve quality, support testing, and enhance code reviews.This is a hands-on technical role focused on ServiceNow configuration and development, disciplined SDLC execution, AI-assisted development practices, and strong collaboration with product, architecture, security, infrastructure, platform, and business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

1. ServiceNow Configuration and Development

· Configure, customize, and develop within the ServiceNow platform to support enterprise business processes.

· Build and maintain ServiceNow workflows, flows, forms, tables, business rules, client s, UI policies, catalog items, integrations, and automation.

· Support ServiceNow modules and capabilities as assigned, including ITSM, ITOM, HAM, SAM, Employee Relations, Employee Journeys, or other platform areas.

· Develop integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems using APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Server, web services, or other approved integration methods.

· Ensure ServiceNow development follows platform best practices, upgrade-safe configuration principles, and enterprise governance standards.

· Partner with ServiceNow administrators, platform owners, process owners, and business stakeholders to deliver practical and sustainable solutions.

2. AI-Assisted Development, Testing, and Code Review

· Use approved AI development tools responsibly to accelerate ServiceNow ing, configuration analysis, documentation, test generation, troubleshooting, and solution design.

· Apply AI tools as an enhancement to technical judgment, not as a replacement for developer accountability.

· Use approved AI tools to identify ServiceNow test scenarios, strengthen regression coverage, and document potential gaps that require developer validation.

· Participate in AI-assisted review of ServiceNow s and configurations while validating outputs for accuracy, security, maintainability, and compliance with enterprise standards.

· Maintain traceability for AI-assisted work by documenting how generated s, configurations, and test assets were reviewed and approved through established development and governance processes.

· Stay current on approved AI development practices, emerging capabilities, and responsible-use guidelines.

3. Governance, Architecture, and Enterprise Standards

· Work within established enterprise architecture, security, data, and development governance processes.

· Ensure solutions are secure, scalable, supportable, and aligned with approved technology patterns.

· Participate in architecture reviews, technical design sessions, and governance checkpoints as needed.

· Document technical designs, configuration decisions, integration patterns, dependencies, and operational considerations.

· Avoid unnecessary technical debt, duplication, unsupported customization, and one-off solutions that conflict with enterprise standards.

· Incorporate feedback from architecture, security, infrastructure, and platform governance teams early in the delivery process.

4. SDLC, Agile, and Delivery Discipline

· Participate in agile delivery activities, including backlog refinement, estimation, sprint planning, demos, retrospectives, and release planning.

· Develop against clearly defined acceptance criteria and ensure work is fully tested before release.

· Support release management activities including deployment planning, change documentation, validation, and post-release support.

· Identify technical risks, dependencies, blockers, and readiness concerns early.

· Communicate progress, issues, and trade-offs clearly to technical leads, product owners, and project stakeholders.

· Understand that code complete does not mean ready for production; testing, documentation, support readiness, and operational handoff are part of delivery.

5. Testing, Quality, and Operational Readiness

· Create and execute ServiceNow unit tests, configuration validation, integration tests, and developer-level platform validation.

· Support QA, UAT, regression testing, and production validation activities.

· Use AI and automation tools where appropriate to improve test coverage and development efficiency.

· Troubleshoot production issues and support root cause analysis.

· Ensure solutions include appropriate logging, monitoring considerations, error handling, and support documentation.

· Partner with support and infrastructure teams to ensure solutions can be successfully operated after go-live.

6. Collaboration and Business Alignment

· Work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, analysts, platform owners, and technical teams to understand desired outcomes.

· Ask clarifying questions to ensure requirements are complete, practical, and aligned with enterprise direction.

· Provide technical input on feasibility, complexity, sequencing, and risk.

· Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.

· Help identify opportunities to simplify processes, automate manual work, improve user experience, and reduce operational friction.

· Act as a responsible technical partner who understands both business needs and enterprise technology constraints.

Role Boundaries· This is a hands-on ServiceNow development role, not an administrator-only position.

Required ServiceNow Experience·

2+ years of hands-on experience configuring or developing within the ServiceNow platform.

· Experience with ServiceNow ing, business rules, client s, UI policies, flows, forms, tables, catalog items, and workflow automation.

· Understanding of ServiceNow platform configuration standards and upgrade-safe development practices.

· Experience supporting ServiceNow integrations using APIs, web services, IntegrationHub, MID Server, or similar integration approaches.

· Familiarity with ITSM or other ServiceNow modules such as HAM, SAM, Employee Relations, Employee Journeys, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, or related platform capabilities.

Preferred ServiceNow Qualifications

· Experience delivering ServiceNow solutions in a large enterprise environment with formal platform governance, architecture review, security review, and release management processes.

· Advanced experience with one or more ServiceNow modules, such as ITSM, ITOM, HAM, SAM, HRSD, CSM, Employee Relations, or Employee Journeys.

· Familiarity with ITIL practices as applied to ServiceNow implementations and operations.

Success Measures: First 12 Months

· Demonstrates effective use of approved AI tools to improve delivery speed, code quality, testing, and documentation.

· Produces ServiceNow configurations and customizations that are supportable, scalable, and aligned with platform standards.

· Actively participates in ServiceNow peer reviews, design reviews, testing, and release readiness activities.

· Builds strong working relationships with product owners, platform teams, architecture, security, QA, and support teams.

· Contributes to automation, simplification, and modernization efforts across the ServiceNow platform.

Cultural Fit Expectations

· Quality before shortcuts.

· Comfortable working within governance.

· Accountable for the code, not just the task.

· Uses AI responsibly and thoughtfully.

· Strong technical curiosity.

title: Automotive Video Editor
description:
Automotive Video Editor

Zuperspeed Automotive | Bengaluru | Full-time | Hybrid

Important:This role is exclusively for candidates with prior automotive video editing experience. Applications without a relevant automotive portfolio will not be considered.

About Zuperspeed

Zuperspeed Automotive is an emerging performance automotive company building a new generation of high-performance vehicles in India.

We believe automotive storytelling should be as compelling as the machines themselves. From engineering and design to performance and driving experiences, everything we create is driven by an obsession with automobiles.

We are building more than just cars. We are building an automotive marque, a culture and a distinct visual identity.

We're looking for people who share that obsession.

The Role

We are looking for an Automotive Video Editor who understands the visual language of performance automobiles.

Someone who knows how to make a machine look, sound and feel extraordinary on screen.

You'll work with raw automotive footage, prototype testing, cinematic driving sequences, behind-the-scenes engineering, brand films and campaign content to create distinctive visual stories.

This isn't a conventional social media editing role. We want someone with an eye for detail, an instinct for cinematic storytelling and an understanding of what makes automotive content compelling.

What You'll Do
  • Edit cinematic automotive films, driving sequences, vehicle showcases and brand films.
  • Transform raw automotive footage into visually compelling stories.
  • Work with camera movement, pacing, transitions, sound design and colour grading to establish a distinct visual language.
  • Create high-impact content for Instagram, YouTube and other digital platforms.
  • Edit track footage, rolling shots, vehicle walkarounds, prototype reveals and behind-the-scenes content.
  • Develop motion graphics, typography, titles and visual overlays.
  • Collaborate with the creative and marketing teams on campaign concepts and visual direction.
  • Organise and manage footage, project files and post-production workflows.
  • Maintain visual consistency across all Zuperspeed content.
What We're Looking For
  • Demonstrable experience in automotive video editing. This is mandatory.
  • A strong portfolio featuring cars, motorcycles, motorsport, automotive films or related content.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve.
  • Working knowledge of After Effects and motion graphics.
  • Strong understanding of colour grading, sound design, visual composition and cinematic pacing.
  • An eye for automotive cinematography, camera movement and detail.
  • Ability to work with different footage formats and deliver content across digital platforms.
  • Strong creative instincts and attention to detail.
The Kind of Person We're Looking For
  • Someone who genuinely lives and breathes automobiles.
  • Someone who notices the details others overlook.
  • Someone who understands the difference between simply editing a car video and creating an automotive film.
  • Someone who enjoys experimenting with visual styles, sound and storytelling.
  • Someone who takes ownership of their work and cares about the final output.
Why Zuperspeed

You'll have the opportunity to work on the visual identity of an emerging automotive marque, contribute to the storytelling around an actual vehicle development programme and create content that reaches automotive enthusiasts.

You'll be working in a small, ambitious team where creativity, initiative and execution matter.

Location: Bengaluru

Work Mode: Hybrid

Employment Type: Full-time

To Apply: Share your CV and portfolio/showreel featuring your previous automotive video editing work. Please include links to individual projects where possible.

title: Scientist III - Biotransformation/Metabolic Identification
description:
The Scientist of Biotransformation will assist with the identification of enzymatic pathways that metabolize drug candidates in preclinical in vitro and in vivo models, including human tissue and cellular models (e.g., P450, non P450/AO/FMO, conjugative/UGT). Working primarily with preclinical species and human tissues/organ subcellular fractions, the individual will utilize contemporary mass spectrometry techniques (LC-MS/MS) to identify and elucidate the structures of drug metabolites (small molecules, peptides, oligonucleotides). The individual will contribute to the development of in vitro-to-in vivo relationships related to drug clearance & half-life predictions. The individual will collaborate with Pharmacology and Toxicology laboratory leadership to establish Novel Approach Methodologies (NAMs) to address mechanistic inquiries and/or platform screening processes for same.

Join us in embracing research and science to impact the health and well-being of people all over the world.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Design and execute laboratory studies aimed at identifying the enzymatic pathways that metabolize small molecule, peptide, and oligonucleotide therapeutics employing a contemporary approach methodology to establish the primary enzyme(s) contributing to the in vitro metabolism of a drug candidate(s).
  • Design and execute laboratory studies to elucidate primary drug clearance mechanisms in vitro, employing contemporary approach methodology to establish in vitro to in vivo correlations for anticipated drug clearance towards the prediction of human half life.
  • Design and collaborate with in vivo pharmacology & toxicology team members to execute ADME studies (non radiolabeled); elucidating the disposition of drug candidate molecules as it pertains to absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion; supplementing with in vitro protein binding, and blood distribution
  • For oligonucleotide and peptide molecules, design and execute in vitro studies aimed at elucidating the exonuclease/endonuclease and peptidase(s) metabolism of drug candidates, respectively.
  • Collaborate with the Toxicology Department to establish cellular models of drug metabolism, induction, and predictive toxicologic mechanisms.

Skills and Abilities

  • Experience conducting in vitro and ex vivo biotransformation assays utilizing LC–MS/MS techniques for quantitation and structure elucidation.
  • Experience, skills, and abilities must include knowledge of contemporary bioanalytical techniques, including wet chemistry separations, liquid chromatography, and mass spectrometric analysis, instrument operation, and data processing. Knowledge of enzyme kinetics desirable.
  • Ability to incorporate software in the maintenance of databases to collate and catalog records and inventory.
  • Independence in the laboratory and data work-up phases of research.
  • A working knowledge and awareness of general laboratory procedures.
  • Good written and oral communication skills.
  • Ability to adhere to all safety regulations and procedures.

Education and Experience

  • PhD in Organic Chemistry, Biochemistry, Analytical Chemistry or related discipline with 2-5 years direct industrial biotransformation experience following Post Doctoral training
  • M.Sc. in a discipline previously described with 5-7 years direct industrial biotransformation experience
  • Working command of in vitro kinetic analysis and utilization of contemporary mathematical models to effectively analyze, interpret and/or model drug clearance, predicted half life, and drug-drug interactions
  • Ability to perform mass spectrometry data collection, analysis and interpretation experience via LC-MS/MS
  • Candidates possessing a command of Pharmacokinetic modeling, analysis, interpretation and simulation desirable

Physical Activity and Working Conditions

  • Work is normally performed in a typical interior office work or laboratory environment
  • Work environment involves exposure to potentially dangerous materials and situations that require following extensive safety precautions and may include use of protective equipment
  • The noise level is usually moderate
  • This position will frequently be involved with radiant/electrical energy, solvents, grease, oil, irritants, acids, bases, and other hazardous chemicals, electro-mechanical hazards, flammable materials and bio-hazards. Due to exposure to hazardous biological material (which may include HIV positive specimens), immunization to Hepatitis B and/or other diseases may be a requirement.

Salary will be commensurate with experience and responsibilities. Benefits include health and dental coverage, short- and long-term disability, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401K participation with company match, and more!

Make a difference to the lives of children, young people and vulnerable adults across Hull

Hull City Council is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Passenger Transport Delivery Manager to lead the delivery of our Passenger Transport Service. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in ensuring some of the city's most vulnerable residents can safely access education, day care, respite services and opportunities that support their independence and wellbeing.

The successful candidate will manage the Passenger Transport Team, including Planning, Performance and Internal Operations, ensuring the delivery of safe, efficient, high-quality and value-for-money transport services to children and young people with Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND), Looked After Children (LAC), pupils attending alternative provision, post-16 learners and vulnerable adults.

This is a challenging and rewarding leadership position where no two days are the same. You will be responsible for leading operational delivery, managing performance, developing staff, driving continuous improvement and ensuring compliance with statutory responsibilities and safeguarding requirements.

Working closely with Children's Services, Adult Social Care, Fleet Services, school leaders, care providers and elected members, you will ensure services are responsive, resilient and focused on delivering positive outcomes for customers.

If you are an experienced operational transport manager with the leadership skills, technical expertise and passion to deliver high-quality customer-focused services, we would welcome your application.

ROLE AND PURPOSE

To manage the Passenger Transport Team, including Planning and Performance and Internal Operations Team, to contribute to delivering a safe, high quality, efficient, value for money Passenger Transport Service for Children’s, Young People and Family Services and Adult Social Care that supports independence and attendance at school or Day Care Centres / Respite of significant numbers of Special Educational Needs Children, Looked After Children, Pupil Referral Units, Post 16 and adult clients.

Ensures that the council’s statutory duty of providing free “home to school” transport for eligible children of compulsory school age living in the local authority area is discharged and compliant with national legislation.

Provides and interprets key performance indicators that informs service decision making, service development and reports performance against agreed standards to Elected Members, Safeguarding Boards, Corporate Strategy Team and stakeholder Management Teams.

Manages the provision of the school crossing patrol service throughout the city.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:

1. To promote and safeguard the welfare of children, young people and/or vulnerable adults.

2. Customer Focus: To lead a team with responsibility for delivering a “home to school” and “extra-curricular” transport service to a number of young people including those with special educational needs and disability (SEND); looked after children (LAC); pupil referral unit (PRUs)s; young people post 16 and adults to Day Care Centres / respite to support their independence and attendance at school.

To manage the delivery and development of the Passenger Transport Team to maintain a high quality, value for money transport service and develop the operation in line with customers’ expectations.

To implement a culture of customer focus across the Team through effective leadership, training, staff development and management of staff in accordance with a wide range of HR policies.

To contribute to the continuous development of and maintenance of a performance management framework to ensure prompt problem resolution for customer feedback, queries and complaints.

To plan, collate and share schedules of planned service provision with key customers (Children’s, Young People and Family Services & Adult Social Care) to ensure completeness of service and to inform performance monitoring.

To be the point of contact for the team and respond efficiently and effectively to enquiries and complaints to promote and maintain positive, professional relationships with customers.

3. Performance Management – To contribute to championing a culture of performance management throughout the service, with emphasis on the Internal Service Delivery Team, to drive improvements.

To ensure the allocation of vehicles, drivers, passenger assistants and any other required specialised resource / equipment to defined routes. Work with the Team to produce a contingency plan to cope with unforeseen events (i.e. Sickness / vehicle breakdown) and lead, on its implementation and communication to stakeholders to ensure service delivery.

To implement and contribute to the development of a Performance Management Framework for the overall Passenger Transport Service . Measure, monitor and analyse a broad range of performance information including - actual service delivery against plan, asset utilisation, customer satisfaction, staff development and financials to inform decision making, the production of reports to stakeholders and a significant contribute to continual service improvement.

To identify service failures, devise and implement improvement actions and develop appropriate governance arrangements that incorporates clear decision making and sound monitoring procedures.

To collaborate with suppliers, particularly the councils fleet provider, to develop efficiencies and training.

4. Statutory Obligations – The Education Act 1996; the Education Act 2002 and the Education and Inspections Act 2006 places a duty on the Council to provide free home to school transport for eligible children of compulsory school age living in the local authority’s area.

5. To lead, motivate and direct the Team including recruitment, induction, staff development, performance management, holiday planning, sickness absence and conducting grievance and disciplinary procedures to contribute to the effective and efficient delivery of the service.

6. To work with the Team to ensure that all drivers hold a clean, current PSV or PCV license and an in-date HCC Drivers Permit; that both drivers and passenger assistants are enhanced DBS compliant and that a training programme that meets best practice for Safeguarding and Health and Safety is attended by all staff and recognised in Learning Plans to progress staff development and ensure best practice.

7. To ensure that there is positive communication throughout the Team; that regular contact is made to allow for cascade of information and to receive comments and concerns from the staff (particularly in terms of safeguarding concerns for and/or challenging behaviour of passengers). Take independent action or escalate where appropriate to maintain team morale / motivation and safe service delivery.

8. To collaborate with the Fleet management Team and the council’s fleet provider to make certain that the required number of vehicles are available to deliver the service. Contribute to the production and implementation of a vehicle replacement programme and develop and present vehicles in line with a vehicle servicing / MOT schedule to ensure that they are fit for purpose, efficiencies and savings are identified and taken and service provision is maintained.

9. To provide guidance and assurance on the undertaking of investigations and reporting of all incidents, accidents and near misses in accordance with policy and legislation. Ensure that information is shared with all stakeholders and recorded on Airs web to inform potential review of the service, risk assessments, training and instruction.

10. To manage Operational Service delivery within revenue budget. To sanction overtime, approve vehicle and plant charges and inform recharges to internal customers within financial limits to inform good financial control / budget monitoring.

11. To lead on responses to Internal Audits and or Investigations (e.g. Financial, Safeguarding, Health and Safety) for the Team to maintain assurance and inform process / service development.

12. To identify and manage risk for the Team; produce and share a Risk Register for the team that records risks and mitigating actions and informs the composite Risk Register for Streetscene Services.

13. The above principal accountabilities are not exhaustive and may vary without changing the character of the job or level of responsibility.

This senior leadership role oversees global safety operations, quality management systems, and inspection readiness across clinical development and post-marketing activities. You will drive the development of scalable processes, strengthen safety governance, and ensure alignment with international regulatory standards. Working closely with clinical development, regulatory affairs, and external partners, you will translate complex requirements into effective operational strategies. You will also oversee CROs and service providers, driving accountability, performance, and continuous improvement. This is an opportunity to shape global patient safety capabilities within a dynamic and evolving biotechnology environment.

Accountabilities

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve pharmacovigilance processes, policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), safety databases, and supporting systems.

  • Lead global safety operations, including individual case safety report (ICSR) processing, aggregate reporting, safety surveillance, signal detection, and risk management activities.

  • Establish and oversee cross-functional safety governance, benefit-risk assessments, and risk management initiatives.

  • Chair executive safety review committees and manage safety data exchange agreements with external partners.

  • Collaborate with clinical development teams to integrate pharmacovigilance requirements into clinical trial protocols, safety charters, and risk management plans.

  • Provide pharmacovigilance oversight for regulatory submissions, including IND, BLA, and MAA filings, and contribute to Clinical Overviews, Integrated Summaries of Safety (ISS), and Risk Management Plans (RMPs).

  • Review Investigator's Brochures (IBs), Development Safety Update Reports (DSURs), and relevant Clinical Study Report (CSR) sections, participating in regulatory meetings when required.

  • Oversee medical review of ICSRs and ensure compliance with applicable global pharmacovigilance regulations and quality standards.

  • Lead quality management, compliance monitoring, audit and inspection readiness activities across global safety operations.

  • Manage CROs, vendors, and external service providers, monitoring performance, deliverables, and adherence to contractual and regulatory requirements.

  • Recruit, develop, mentor, and manage pharmacovigilance professionals, establishing clear performance expectations and supporting continuous team development.

  • Drive operational excellence through effective governance, risk-based processes, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Requirements

  • Healthcare professional qualification, such as RN, PharmD, or MD, supported by relevant clinical and pharmaceutical industry experience.

  • At least 15 years of experience in drug safety and pharmacovigilance within the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry.

  • Proven experience leading pharmacovigilance operations and managing global drug safety activities across clinical development and/or post-marketing environments.

  • Extensive knowledge of international pharmacovigilance regulations, quality standards, and compliance requirements, particularly EMA, FDA, and ICH guidelines.

  • Demonstrated expertise in safety reporting, ICSR management, aggregate reporting, signal detection, benefit-risk assessment, and risk management.

  • Experience developing and implementing pharmacovigilance quality management systems, SOPs, and operational frameworks.

  • Strong understanding of regulatory submissions and safety documentation, including IND, BLA, MAA, DSUR, IB, ISS, and RMP requirements.

  • Proven ability to manage CROs, vendors, and outsourced pharmacovigilance activities through effective governance and performance oversight.

  • A successful track record of building, leading, and developing high-performing teams.

  • Excellent strategic thinking, decision-making, and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical operational solutions.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across clinical, regulatory, quality, and safety functions.

  • Adaptability and confidence operating in a dynamic biotechnology environment where priorities and organizational needs evolve.

Benefits

  • Estimated annual salary: $220,000–$260,000 USD.

  • Equity participation opportunities.

  • Performance-based bonus opportunities.

  • Remote working opportunities within the United States.

  • Potential work location in Boston, Massachusetts.

  • Senior leadership position with significant strategic influence over global pharmacovigilance operations.

  • Opportunity to build and strengthen global safety, quality, and compliance capabilities.

  • Collaborative environment working alongside experienced professionals across clinical development and patient safety.

Role overview

Detail

Information

Versa is looking for a seasoned Project/Program Manager to own end-to-end bid submissions for the India and APAC Sales team and manage customer onboarding programs. This role supports RFPs across the APAC region and combines RFP and tender management (including Indian Government customers), with program management for customer engagements.

You will be the single point of coordination across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Engineering, Finance, Logistics, Legal, HR, Admin and external partners, covering Indian Government and PSU tenders as well as enterprise RFPs across APAC.

You will be measured by two outcomes:

  • Timely submission of compliant, complete and winning bids by working closely with sales account owner and SE Team members.

Key responsibilities

RFP / Bid management

Program management

  • Manage customer on-boarding projects/programs, including hardware delivery/shipment tracking, project coordination between Versa Internal teams and customer.

Must have

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business or a related field.

  • A sharp eye for RFP detail: able to spot non-compliance and commercial or legal risk, and explain it clearly to Sales and leadership.
  • A track record of running complex, multi-stakeholder projects across Engineering, Finance, Logistics, HR and Admin.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, documentation and presentation skills.
  • Highly organized, with the ability to run several bids in parallel against tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and CRM tools such as Salesforce.
  • Flexibility to work outside standard hours to support APAC time zones and bid deadlines.

Good to have

  • Background in networking, security, SD-WAN / SASE or broader IT and telecom solutions.

  • Exposure to PSU, defense or large enterprise tenders, and to RFPs in India & APAC markets.
  • Experience working with OEMs and third-party service providers.
  • PMP, PRINCE2 or APMP certification.

title: Director, User Experience Design -InsurTech
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. As a Director, User Experience Design - InsureTech, you are a design, practice, and thought leader who leads from the work as much as from strategy. You bring together vision, execution, and craft—translating Expedia Group's brand strategy into coherent, high-quality product experiences across surfaces and platforms.

This role is ideal for a leader who still loves being close to the work. You will operate as a true player-coach, staying connected to the details, guiding teams through critical design decisions, and stepping in when needed to elevate outcomes. You set the bar for design craft and systems thinking while shaping an organization where bold ideas, hands-on execution, and rigorous delivery coexist.

  • Lead and shape end-to-end traveler experiences across the insurance lifecycle, raising the quality bar for the brand while staying actively involved in key moments of the design process.

  • Evolve and scale design systems and shared frameworks, ensuring consistency, speed, and coherence across products, including AI-driven experiences.
  • Partner across functions and divisions to identify opportunities and guide adoption of scalable AI/ML-enabled solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Track record of executing a large-scale customer experience vision.
  • Experience building and scaling design systems.

  • Expertise in storytelling and stakeholder influence.
  • Experience leading AI/ML-enabled product design efforts.

title: Verkada Physical Security Engineer- Freelancing
description:
Job De ion: Verkada Physical Security Engineer (Remote Configuration)

Company: InOpTra

Role: Verkada Physical Security Engineer – Remote Configuration and Commissioning

Experience: 5–8 years in physical security systems, with at least 2 years of hands-on Verkada experience

Location: Remote, with working-hours overlap with US Eastern Time [to be confirmed]

About The Role

InOpTra is looking for a hands-on Verkada engineer to remotely configure and commission a new office site for an enterprise client. This is Phase 2 of a multi-site rollout. The client's Verkada Command tenant and Microsoft 365 identity integration are already live from Phase 1.

You will add the new site to the existing tenant, adopt all devices, and configure access control, video, intercoms, alarms and sensors to match the client's existing standards. A local installation partner will handle all physical installation and cabling. You will coordinate remotely with the on-site technicians during joint testing.

If this engagement goes well, more regional sites of a similar size (10–15 doors and 10–20 cameras per site) are expected to follow.

Hardware in Scope (39 Devices)

CategoryDevicesAccess control1 × AC62 16-door controller, 11 × AD34 multi-format readersIntercoms2 × TD53 video intercoms, 2 × TK74 touchscreen intercomsVideo8 × CD43 indoor dome cameras, 2 × CF83-E fisheye camerasAlarms and sensors1 × BP52 alarm panel (cellular backup), 1 × WH32 wireless repeater, 3 × hardwired panic buttons, 4 × SV21 air quality sensors, 4 × BR35 wireless water leak sensors

Key Responsibilities

  • Tenant Adoption and Standards
  • Create the new site in the existing Verkada Command tenant
  • Claim and adopt all 39 devices into the new site
  • Apply the client's existing naming conventions to all devices, access levels and cameras
  • Create the three site access levels (Full Access, Lobby Access and Office Access) following the client's existing convention
  • Assign default Verkada system roles only (such as Access Site Admin, Site Admin and Site Viewer)
  • Access Control and Schedules
  • Map the existing synced M365 groups (an Office group and an Admins group) to the new site's access levels
  • Create three base door schedules (business hours, after-hours and weekends) and apply them to all new doors
  • Support a parallel run with the legacy access control system during the transition
  • Video and Camera Alerts
  • Configure 30-day video retention, subject to the capabilities of the installed cameras
  • Configure baseline motion alerts and alert recipients
  • Restrict viewing permissions for designated sensitive-area cameras (gym and safe room) to Admins only
  • Intercoms
  • Configure the four intercoms with local station routing, using reception as the primary receiver followed by a defined fallback sequence
  • Set up door unlock logic for intercom calls
  • Alarms and Sensors (new for this site)
  • Configure the BP52 alarm panel for 24×7 professional monitoring, with monitoring-agent video access disabled
  • Program the three hardwired panic buttons for immediate dispatch alerting
  • Configure partitions, arm/disarm schedules, keycodes, emergency contacts and dispatch instructions
  • Set threshold alerts for SV21 sensors (temperature, humidity and air quality) and BR35 water leak sensors
  • Testing and Handover
  • Lead one remote joint testing session with on-site installers, covering readers, door unlocks, intercoms, cameras, alarms, panic buttons and sensors
  • Prepare as-built documentation
  • Run a remote review and handover session with the client's IT team

Out of Scope

  • Physical installation, cabling and high-voltage electrical work
  • Fire alarm panel integration
  • Network switch provisioning and VLAN routing (handled by client IT)
  • SCIM/SSO provisioning, mapping and troubleshooting (groups can be created in advance if needed)
  • Alarm permitting (handled by the client)
  • Raising alarms from SV21 sensors, which Verkada's New Alarms platform does not support

Must-Have Requirements

  • Verkada Command: Hands-on experience with site creation, device claiming and adoption, and multi-site tenant administration
  • Verkada access control: Experience configuring AC-series controllers, readers, access levels, door schedules and system roles
  • Identity integration: A clear understanding of how M365/Entra ID groups sync to Verkada through SCIM/SSO, and how to map them to access levels
  • Verkada intercoms: Experience configuring call routing, receivers, fallback sequences and door unlock from intercom calls
  • Verkada video: Experience with retention settings, motion alerts and camera-level permission restrictions
  • Verkada alarms: Experience configuring professionally monitored alarm panels, hardwired inputs and zones, partitions, and dispatch settings, plus knowledge of the differences between New Alarms and Classic Alarms
  • Environmental sensors: Experience setting threshold alerts for air quality and water leak sensors
  • Remote commissioning: A proven ability to run joint testing remotely with on-site installers
  • Documentation: The ability to produce clear as-built documentation and run client handover sessions

Nice-to-Have

  • Verkada product certifications or partner training
  • Experience with other physical security platforms (such as Genetec, Avigilon, Lenel, Milestone or Brivo), as the client works with multiple vendors
  • Experience with multi-site rollouts and replicating standards across sites
  • Experience working with financial-services clients

Key Deliverables

No.Deliverable1New site created and all 39 devices adopted2Access levels, role assignments and group mappings configured3Three door schedules created and applied4Video retention, motion alerts and restricted camera permissions configured5Intercom routing and door unlock logic configured6Alarm panel, panic buttons and sensor alerts configured7Joint testing completed with results recorded8As-built documentation and handover session

Client Inputs Required Before Configuration

These inputs are listed so that the engineer can confirm they have been received before starting:

  • Naming conventions or a reference configuration from the existing site
  • User and group mappings, door permissions and admin role assignments
  • Business hours, applicable doors and the intended behaviour for each schedule
  • Intercom receivers, fallback order and station assignments
  • List of sensitive-area cameras, approved Admin viewers and motion alert recipients
  • Alarm panel zones, wiring details, partitions, schedules, keycodes, the emergency contact list and dispatch instructions
  • Confirmation of alarm permit status before joint testing

Notes on this draft

  • I left out the client, installer and partner names (Abrams Capital, Stark Tech, SSI and SVHEC) because JDs are usually shared externally. Please add them back if this is for internal use only.
