title: Land Surveyor
description:
Job Title: Land Survey Engineer

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka (Project Sites & Land Parcels across Bengaluru)

Department: Engineering / Land & Development / Projects

Experience: 1-2 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Land Survey Engineer to lead land acquisition surveys, boundary demarcations, topographical mapping, and master-plan layout execution across our real estate developments in Bengaluru. The role requires high precision in handling DGPS/RTK, Total Station, and AutoCAD/Civil 3D, alongside strong familiarity with Karnataka revenue records, village maps, and BBMP/BDA/BMRDA/BIAPPA regulatory norms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Land Acquisition & Due Diligence Surveys: Conduct reconnaissance, perimeter surveys, and extent verification for prospective land parcels, matching physical boundaries against revenue maps, tippani, atlas, and survey sketches.
  • Boundary Demarcation & Master-Plan Layout: Establish permanent boundary pillars, setback lines, internal road alignments, civic amenity (CA) sites, and individual plot demarcations in compliance with sanctioned plans (BDA/BMRDA/BBMP/RERA).
  • Topographical & Contour Mapping: Execute detailed topographical surveys capturing natural ground levels (NGL), existing trees, borewells, HT/LT lines, nalas/rajakaluves (buffer zones), and neighboring structures.
  • Construction Setting-Out & Control Networks: Establish primary and secondary control stations, Temporary Benchmarks (TBMs), building footprints, and infrastructure levels (roads, storm-water drains, STP, underground sumps).
  • CAD Drafting & Volume Calculations: Process raw survey data in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to generate contour maps, longitudinal/cross-sections, cut-and-fill earthwork quantities, and As-Built drawings.
  • Government & Statutory Coordination: Liaise with Taluk surveyors, ADLR/DDLR officials, and external survey consultants during phodi, hadbast, land conversion, and plan sanction inspections.
  • Instrument Management: Maintain and calibrate DGPS/RTK, Total Station, and Auto Level instruments, ensuring zero data loss and accurate coordinate logging.

Qualifications & Technical Skills

  • Education: Diploma or B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering / Geomatics / Land Surveying.
  • Experience: 1-2 years of dedicated land surveying experience in Bengaluru real estate (plotted developments, villa townships, residential/commercial layouts, or land acquisition).
  • Technical Proficiency:
  • Hands-on expertise in DGPS / RTK, Total Station, (Differential Global Positioning System / Real-Time Kinematic.) and Auto Level.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and MS Excel (coordinate conversion, area/volume calculation).
  • Deep understanding of Karnataka land measurement units (Acre, Gunta, Sq. ft., Sq. m) and local revenue terminology (Survey Number, Hissa, Kharab, Rajakaluve buffer norms).
  • Ability to superimpose revenue village maps onto Google Earth / CAD layouts.

It has been close to almost 2 decades since we embarked on our mission to equip economically disadvantaged children and youth with education and foundational skills, galvanizing them towards a better future. Our Inch Wide Mile Deep approach and home-grown projects focused on quality education for the low-income segment have been instrumental in shaping the success of our projects across India. KEF's approach is primarily three-pronged:

1. holistic interventions with children and educators in school,

2. equitable scholarships for higher studies, and

3. vocational education and skills training for livelihood.

Strengthening school leadership and teacher capacity building, creating a digital ecosystem and learning environment in schools, equipping middle school students with confidence and skills of communicative English, upskilling teachers to provide foundational literacy and numeracy skills, and supporting districts in building and running model schools—these are key interventions run by KEF. KEF launched the Kotak Kanya Scholarship in 2021 to offer financial and academic support to meritorious girl students in pursuit of higher education from all over India. Kotak Junior Scholarship supports meritorious students from the Mumbai Metropolitan Region in pursuing 11th and 12th standards. KEF's Vocational Education and Livelihood Project upskills unemployed youth from economically weaker sections of society and coaches them in domain know-how, the basics of IT and spoken English, life skills, and personality development. It ensures placements for all eligible participants so they can stride with confidence into any professional sphere.

KEF is now on the cusp of change as it prepares for the next chapter in its journey toward empowering the youth with quality education and livelihood. Armed with its vast experience and expertise, the organization now aims to scale its depth as well as the breadth of its reach. KEF's philosophy is evolving from school as a unit to working toward district/state-level education transformation. As KEF expands its ambit, it will help drive systemic reform and state education transformation to create long-term impact at scale.

Kotak Education Foundation is the primary implementing agency for the CSR initiatives of Kotak Mahindra Group in Education. Kotak Karma is the corporate social responsibility (CSR) identity of Kotak Mahindra Group companies.

title: Network Security Architect -SASE - Firewalls - Zero Trust
description:

Location: Pune / Mumbai / Bangalore / Chennai / Hyderabad

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Network Security Architect on a 6-month contract basis to strengthen our security engineering team and lead enterprise transformation across Network Security, SASE/SSE, Zero Trust, and hybrid cloud environments.

This role combines architecture design, migration leadership, technical governance, and deep hands-on expertise—specifically across Palo Alto, FortiGate firewalls, and Palo Alto Prisma Access (SASE). You will go beyond standard BAU operations to guide complex deployments, troubleshoot high-level architectural bottlenecks, and advise senior stakeholders across global client environments.

Key Responsibilities

Firewall Architecture & Migration Leadership

  • Architect, deploy, and manage advanced Palo Alto, Check Point, and Fortinet (FortiGate) firewall solutions across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments using centralized management tools (Panorama, FortiManager, Check Point SmartConsole).
  • Lead end-to-end firewall and SASE platform migrations covering discovery, planning, design, execution, cutover governance, and post-migration optimization.
  • Define security zoning, network segmentation, policy governance, high availability (HA), VPN, routing, SSL decryption, and lifecycle standards.

SASE / SSE Architecture

  • Architect, deploy, and manage SASE/SSE solutions—primarily Palo Alto Prisma Access, alongside platforms such as Zscaler, Fortinet Universal SASE, and Cisco Secure Access.
  • Design and integrate core SASE capabilities including ZTNA, SWG, CASB, DLP, FWaaS, RBI, and SD-WAN connectivity.

Security Strategy, Zero Trust & GRC

  • Define current-state, target-state, and transformation roadmaps for Network Security, SASE/SSE, and Zero Trust aligned with business goals and ISO 27001 standards.
  • Conduct Zero Trust cybersecurity and maturity assessments using NIST SP 800-207, NIST CSF, and CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model, translating findings into phased remediation roadmaps.

Technical Leadership, Operations & Consulting

  • Provide deep hands-on architectural support and problem-solving beyond standard BAU network security operations.
  • Create and review High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs), and migration plans while providing technical oversight during high-risk cutover activities.
  • Perform network traffic log analysis and troubleshooting to fine-tune WAF solutions and write precise microsegmentation rules (e.g., Guardicore, Illumio, ColorTokens).
  • Mentor security engineers and specialists within the delivery team.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Engage with CISOs, Security Directors, IT Leadership, and Audit Teams; support technical proposals and RFPs.
  • Manage third-party vendors, system integrators, and technology partners, presenting project status, risks, and architectural decisions in governance forums and SteerCo reviews.

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience: 10 to 15 years in Network Security, including 7–10 years designing and delivering enterprise SASE/SSE, firewall, and Zero Trust transformation programs.
  • Core Firewalls & SASE: Deep hands-on and architectural mastery of Palo Alto, FortiGate (Fortinet), Check Point, and Cisco Firewalls, alongside Palo Alto Prisma Access (or equivalent leading SASE/SSE platforms like Zscaler/Netskope).
  • Centralized Management: Proven experience with Panorama, SCM, FortiManager, and Check Point SmartConsole.
  • Core Networking & Security: Strong command of LAN/WAN/WLAN, SD-WAN, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, NAT, IPS/IDS, SSL decryption, and hybrid cloud connectivity.
  • Compliance & Frameworks: Working knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST SP 800-207, NIST CSF, and CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Security, or an equivalent discipline.

Good-to-Have Skills & Preferred Certifications

  • Adjacent Security Tech: Cloud Security (AWS Native Security), NAC (Cisco ISE), SIEM (IBM QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel), SOC Operations, WAF, and Microsegmentation (Illumio, Guardicore).
  • Governance: Project governance and strong executive stakeholder management.
  • Preferred Certifications: PCNSE / Palo Alto Prisma Access, Fortinet NSE 4 or higher, Check Point CCSE, Zscaler/Cisco Security certifications, CISSP, CCSP, CISM, SABSA, or TOGAF.

title: Firewall Rule Review, Cyber Tech - Associate - Mumbai
description:
Job de ion

About Company:

BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. It's a leading service provider for the mid markets with client service at its heart.

BDO India Services Private Limited (or BDO India) is the India member firm of BDO International. About Cyber

BDO India cyber security practice is one of the fastest growing areas of the business with significant ambition for the future through additional recruitment and acquisition. As part of our cyber team / tech risk you will be managing teams and projects delivering advisory and technical support to help our clients to improve their information / cyber security posture and respond to the dynamic nature of technology risks / cyber security threats. You will provide security domain expertise and utilise your business insight to work closely with our clients to advise, design, build and deploy pragmatic security solutions that will provide real and tangible benefits to protect their organisations. Furthermore, often carryout out IT Risk Assessments in line with industry better practices (NIST / ISF / Cloud Security / etc.), regulatory mandates (RBI / IRDAI), and various compliance standards focusing on data security, data privacy, etc.

Role:

Support the governance, assessment, and optimization of firewall and network security controls across enterprise environments. Conduct firewall rule reviews, assess cybersecurity technologies against security standards and best practices, and identify opportunities to strengthen security posture and reduce risk. Collaborate with network, infrastructure, and security teams to ensure effective implementation, governance, and compliance of critical security technologies, with a focus on Palo Alto Networks and Check Point firewalls.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform periodic firewall rule reviews across Palo Alto Networks and Check Point firewalls to validate compliance with security policies, standards, and business requirements.
  • Assess firewall configurations, rule bases, network segmentation controls, NAT policies, and access control implementations to identify security risks and optimization opportunities.
  • Review firewall change requests and validate business justification, source and destination details, ports, protocols, risk considerations, and approval requirements.
  • Support firewall recertification activities by validating rule ownership, business necessity, and compliance with established governance processes.
  • Identify excessive access permissions, redundant rules, stale rules, shadowed rules, and misconfigurations that may introduce security risks.
  • Document assessment findings, risk observations, and remediation recommendations in accordance with established review methodologies.
  • Track remediation activities and coordinate with network, infrastructure, application, and security teams to facilitate timely resolution of identified findings.
  • Support governance and security assessments of cybersecurity technologies, including firewalls, VPN solutions, web application firewalls (WAF), intrusion prevention systems (IPS), and secure web gateways.
  • Assist with audit, compliance, and regulatory review activities by preparing evidence, reports, and supporting documentation.
  • Maintain review trackers, evidence repositories, dashboards, and operational reporting related to firewall governance and cybersecurity technologies.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of firewall review methodologies, cybersecurity governance processes, and security control effectiveness.
  • Monitor emerging security threats, vendor recommendations, and best practices to support enhancements to network security controls.

Key Technical Skills:

  • Hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks and Check Point firewall technologies.
  • Strong understanding of firewall policy management, rule lifecycle management, access control governance, and network segmentation principles.
  • Knowledge of network security concepts, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, NAT, VPNs, ports, protocols, and traffic flow analysis.
  • Experience reviewing firewall configurations, security policies, rule recertifications, and access control implementations.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity technologies such as Web Application Firewalls (WAF), Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS), Secure Web Gateways (SWG), and Network Access Control (NAC) solutions.
  • Understanding of security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), CIS Controls, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Ability to analyze firewall logs, network traffic patterns, security events, and configuration reports to identify potential security risks.
  • Experience using ticketing systems, reporting platforms, and governance documentation processes.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively with network, infrastructure, application, and security teams in a complex enterprise environment.

Certifications:

  • PCCET
  • PCNSA
  • PCNSE
  • Check Point CCSA
  • Check Point CCSE
  • Security+
  • CCNA Security.

Its design team creates experiences and communication across the entire payments journey, including brand campaigns, product marketing, in-app experiences, merchant-facing creatives, and large-scale festive and sale-event campaigns.

Preferred Qualifications

title: RD Director
description:
We are seeking a technically strong, commercially aware Director of R&D to lead our multidisciplinary research and development team across software, hardware, firmware, computer vision, applied AI, prototyping and testing. Based in India and reporting directly to the CTO, you will turn emerging technologies and complex business problems into validated capabilities for future products and platforms.

You will combine technical judgement with people leadership: shaping the innovation portfolio, challenging assumptions, guiding experiments, building integrated prototypes and developing the team. You will lead all disciplines within R&D and coordinate contributions from global specialists, working closely with Product, Architecture, Software Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Quality and Operations.

Core mandate: Discover, prove and de-risk new technology, then enable an agreed transition into product engineering.

Technology and innovation scopeDomainIllustrative areas of explorationAdvanced software and experiences

Algorithms, experimental services and applications, APIs, mobile and connected-table experiences, and integration with existing platforms.

Computer vision and applied AI

Card and chip recognition, tracking, gameplay understanding, sensor fusion, edge inference, training data and robust model evaluation.

RFID, hardware and sensing

Readers, antennas, chip detection and location, electronics, mechanical integration, cameras, displays and new table-device concepts.

Embedded systems and firmware

Device control, reader interfaces, real-time processing, calibration, communications, diagnostics and hardware-software integration.

Simulation and validation

Emulators, synthetic data, test rigs, hardware-in-the-loop testing, automated experiments and representative customer-environment testing.

Key responsibilities

1. Shape the innovation portfolio

Translate the CTO's technology direction into a focused R&D roadmap. Maintain a common backlog of customer-led opportunities and technology-led ideas, prioritized with the CTO and Product leadership. Identify new possibilities proactively rather than waiting only for product requirements. Define each initiative's hypothesis, intended value, resource ceiling, success measures, review date and stop criteria; recommend when to continue, redirect, partner or stop.

2. Lead the entire multidisciplinary R&D team

Build, mentor and manage engineers, researchers, technical leads and test specialists across software, hardware, firmware and computer vision. Establish clear ownership, development plans and performance expectations. Create integrated project teams rather than disconnected discipline silos, and resolve cross-team dependencies. Work effectively with global colleagues while developing strong technical leadership and execution capability in India.

3. Provide hands-on technical and systems leadership

Lead architecture discussions, design reviews, experiments and difficult root-cause investigations. Challenge assumptions across sensing, electronics, firmware, algorithms, applications and system behaviour. Guide trade-offs involving accuracy, latency, compute, power, cost, reliability and integration. Stay close enough to the engineering evidence to distinguish a credible result from a promising demonstration, while empowering specialists to own detailed implementation.

4. Move concepts into validated prototypes and controlled pilots

Own progression from feasibility to integrated prototypes and approved trials. Agree acceptance criteria and the receiving engineering owner early. Deliver reproducible builds, source code, firmware, relevant hardware designs and bills of materials, model and dataset records, test evidence and documented limitations. Support productization through an accepted handover to the responsible Engineering and HWE teams; do not treat a demonstration as a production release.

5. Make testing and research evidence central

Embed testing from the first experiment, with repeatable benchmarks, instrumentation and traceable results. Develop simulation, automated testing and hardware-in-the-loop capability. Validate whole-system performance under realistic operating conditions, including lighting changes, occlusion, chip configurations, device variation and failure scenarios. Address security, privacy, reliability, manufacturability, serviceability and certification considerations early, in partnership with the relevant specialists.

6. Scout emerging technology and protect intellectual property

Evaluate relevant advances in RFID, sensing, embedded computing, computer vision, AI, communications and human-machine interaction. Build purposeful relationships with universities, technology partners, suppliers and research organizations. Assess build-versus-buy-versus-partner options against measurable value, feasibility and lifecycle cost. Capture inventions and technical knowledge, supporting patent evaluation, confidentiality and third-party IP review with the appropriate experts.

7. Run an accountable, visible R&D operation

Manage people, laboratories, equipment, vendors and project budgets within CTO-approved plans. Publish clear progress, experimental evidence, risks, capacity constraints and decisions required. Use approved AI-assisted engineering and automation tools where they improve measurable outcomes. Collaborate with the separate AI Engineering function without duplicating its mandate, and coordinate productization capacity with Engineering rather than creating unplanned delivery or support commitments.

Experience and qualifications

  • Leadership experience. Typically 15+ years in engineering, applied R&D or technology development, including 5+ years leading multidisciplinary teams, technical leaders or complex product-development programmes.

  • Integrated product development. A demonstrated record of taking new technologies from concept through experimentation, prototypes and validation into products used in real operating environments. Experience must span software and physical-device or embedded-system development, not solely application delivery.

  • Technical depth and breadth. Deep expertise in at least one relevant discipline, with credible working knowledge across software, electronics, firmware, computer vision and system validation. Able to challenge specialist decisions and understand interfaces without being the principal expert in every field.

  • Research and engineering judgement. Strong capability in experimental design, quantitative evaluation, systems thinking, technical risk assessment and root-cause analysis. Comfortable with incomplete requirements and willing to change direction when evidence contradicts an assumption.

  • Practical development fluency. Experience working with software and embedded development environments, source control, automated testing and technical documentation. Familiarity with relevant technologies such as C/C++, Python or Java, embedded Linux or real-time systems, and vision or machine-learning tooling; mastery of every listed technology is not required.

  • People and stakeholder leadership. Proven hiring, coaching, performance-management and cross-functional leadership skills. Able to communicate technical trade-offs clearly to executives, Product, customers and partners, and collaborate effectively across geographies and time zones.

  • Education. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Robotics or a related field. A PhD in a relevant discipline is preferred, but not mandatory; practical innovation and product-development outcomes are essential.

Experience that would be particularly valuable

RFID or RF systems; sensor fusion; edge AI; computer vision in uncontrolled environments; industrial automation, robotics, connected devices, automotive electronics, medical devices or other high-reliability products. Exposure to regulated gaming, manufacturing partners, prototype-to-production transfer, invention disclosures or university collaboration would be an advantage. Prior casino-industry experience is useful, but not essential.

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
Entity

Technology

IT&S Group

Job De ion

Your opportunity:

Join Digital Delivery - Upstream and take ownership of delivering the software products that make up the Engineering portfolio, the digital tools and platforms bp's engineering community relies on every day. As Staff Delivery Manager, you will lead the end-to-end delivery of these Engineering portfolio products, platforms and services, from idea and backlog through build, release and live operation, that help engineers design, maintain and operate our assets safely, reliably and efficiently.

You will bring people together across business engineering and operations teams, product managers, software engineers, architects, data, QA, DevOps, cyber security, service and external partners. You will turn business priorities into practical, well-governed delivery plans and roadmaps, guide multi-disciplinary software squads through design, build, test, release and transition into service, and mentor the Product and Project Managers who deliver alongside you. This is a senior, visible role with the opportunity to influence how delivery is done across the portfolio.

What You Will Do

  • Lead the delivery of multiple strategic software initiatives across the Engineering portfolio, covering new products, platform builds, enhancements and sustain, and keep teams focused on business priorities, value and achievable plans.
  • Lead and support squad members through effective line management, ensuring appropriate assignments, continuous development, wellbeing and strong performance.
  • Develop and maintain integrated delivery plans, including schedules, budgets, resource allocation, roadmaps and milestones, using the methods that best fit the work: Agile, hybrid, waterfall or service delivery.
  • Coordinate across sustain and transformation teams to align BAU objectives with product roadmaps, program increments and release milestones, resolve cross-team dependencies and keep working software flowing to users.
  • Work with engineering subject-matter experts, product owners and architects to turn business needs into clear scope, well-shaped backlogs, user stories, non-functional requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Keep delivery transparent by leading plans, risks, issues, decisions, costs, resources and change, and by raising trade-offs early and at the right level.
  • Champion modern software engineering and DevOps practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, quality engineering, secure-by-design and release management, so teams ship frequently and safely.
  • Guide testing, deployment, cutover and post-launch stabilization, and support a smooth transition into service with clear ownership, observability and monitoring, incident management, change control and support models.
  • Partner with external software vendors, system integrators and SaaS providers, clarifying responsibilities, commercial commitments, service expectations and performance, and constructively testing estimates and assumptions.
  • Mentor and guide a team of Product and Project Managers, building capability, confidence and consistent delivery practice.
  • Lead continuous improvement of delivery practices, building repeatable, measurable processes that improve efficiency, reduce risk and strengthen outcomes.
  • Use practical measures, such as delivery predictability, flow and cycle time, deployment frequency, failure rate, defect trends, service stability, cost and benefits realized, to track outcomes and drive improvement.
  • Lead global deployment of strategic software initiatives across all the upstream regions including engagement, change management, deployment & configuration, customer acceptance and early life support.

What Success Looks Like

  • Priority engineering software products and platforms are released regularly against clear, credible and well-understood plans and roadmaps.
  • A high-performing squad whose people are supported to develop, grow and reach their potential.
  • Business, engineering and technology partners share a common view of priorities, decisions, responsibilities and progress.
  • Risks, dependencies and conflicting priorities are surfaced early and resolved before they affect delivery or operations.
  • Software releases are high quality, transition cleanly into service and remain stable, secure, supportable and cost-effective.
  • Delivery and engineering practices across the portfolio, from backlog to production, become more consistent, automated, repeatable and measurable.
  • Product and Project Managers grow in capability, and internal teams and external partners work together towards shared outcomes.
  • Global deployments completed in accordance with agreed plans with good customer feedback.

What You Will Bring

  • A commitment to bp's core values: Live our Purpose, Play to Win and Care for Others
  • More than 10 years experience in software delivery, programme or project management, leading the delivery of software products and digital change of increasing scope and complexity.
  • Significant experience in digital service management or a related field, leading the delivery and sustain of IT or digital technology.
  • Significant experience in software deployment on a large scale into multiple sites on challenging timeframes
  • A proven track record of managing large-scale, multi-team software deliveries, including custom-built applications, platforms, integrations and SaaS solutions, while navigating organizational complexity.
  • Expertise in delivery approaches such as Agile, Lean, waterfall and scaling frameworks, and the judgement to use what fits the work.
  • Strong grounding in the software development lifecycle (SDLC), systems development, change management, governance, budgets, testing, release management and transition to service.
  • A solid understanding of modern software engineering, including DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, cloud-native architecture, APIs and quality engineering, so you can engage credibly with software engineering teams.
  • Experience working with third-party vendors and suppliers, including managing commitments, performance and dependencies.
  • Clear, inclusive communication, with the ability to explain complex ideas simply, build alignment and make data-driven decisions.
  • Leadership and relationship skills motivate cross-functional teams, and the ability to attract, develop and grow talent.

Useful, but not crucial

  • Exposure to engineering, oil and gas, energy or other asset-intensive industrial environments.
  • Familiarity with engineering, asset integrity, maintenance or operations technology and data.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (for example Azure), delivery tooling such as Azure DevOps, Jira or GitHub, enterprise systems, integration or data-rich products.
  • Knowledge of operational resilience, cyber security, controls or service transition.
  • A project, programme or Agile delivery qualification (for example PMP, PRINCE2, MSP, SAFe or similar), or equivalent practical experience.

How You Will Lead

You will lead through ownership, collaboration and influence as well as line leadership. You will set a clear delivery rhythm across multi-disciplinary software squads, built around planning, reviews, release readiness and retrospectives, balance constraints and competing priorities, coach your squad to deliver with confidence, and make timely decisions when outcomes, controls or service continuity are at risk. You will role-model bp's values and help build an inclusive team where people can do their best work.

title: Advisor Data Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Advisor Data Analyst based in the United States.

The Advisor Data Analyst plays a critical role in designing and modernizing complex Medicaid and healthcare technology solutions through advanced data analysis, integration, conversion, and reporting expertise. This senior-level position bridges business requirements, healthcare regulations, system configuration, and technical delivery to ensure accurate, reliable, and efficient data solutions. You will lead data-related analysis across multiple workstreams, including system interfaces, legacy data conversions, reporting, and cross-platform integrations. Working closely with state clients, architects, developers, testing teams, and operational stakeholders, you will translate complex requirements into actionable technical specifications. The role also provides strategic guidance on data quality, implementation risks, and solution design while supporting large-scale healthcare technology transformations. This is a fully remote opportunity offering professional development and meaningful opportunities to improve healthcare services for vulnerable populations.

Accountabilities

As an Advisor Data Analyst, you will serve as a senior subject matter expert responsible for guiding data analysis, integration, conversion, and reporting activities throughout healthcare technology implementation and modernization projects. You will ensure that business and regulatory requirements are accurately translated into technical solutions, while maintaining data integrity, system alignment, and comprehensive project documentation.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert and advisor on Medicaid data, system interfaces, data conversions, reporting, system configuration, and cross-platform integration.

  • Translate complex business, contractual, operational, and regulatory requirements into practical data and technical solutions.

  • Evaluate proposed solution designs for completeness, feasibility, data integrity, maintainability, and alignment with Medicaid program requirements.

  • Review RFPs, contractual requirements, proposal responses, requirements traceability matrices, legacy specifications, file layouts, business process models, and client documentation.

  • Conduct detailed requirements and data gap analyses to identify missing information, conflicting requirements, unsupported assumptions, and incomplete business rules.

  • Lead the design of inbound and outbound batch, near-real-time, real-time, file-based, API-based, and standards-based healthcare interfaces.

  • Define interface requirements, including source and target systems, file structures, data elements, processing sequences, frequencies, dependencies, error handling, logging, balancing, and reconciliation processes.

  • Create and maintain Interface Control Documents, interface specifications, companion guides, process flows, file layouts, error-code inventories, and operational documentation.

  • Lead legacy data profiling to identify invalid values, missing relationships, duplicate records, overlapping data spans, referential integrity issues, and other data quality concerns.

  • Define data conversion strategies, mappings, and transformation rules to ensure legacy data is accurately transferred into target systems.

  • Determine how historical records, coverage hierarchies, precedence rules, retroactive changes, and configuration-dependent structures should be handled during conversion.

  • Analyze reporting and data extract requirements, identifying the appropriate data sources and layers supporting each report or outbound extract.

  • Define reporting and extract specifications, including data elements, selection criteria, business rules, valid values, and calculation logic.

  • Develop validation queries, reconciliation processes, exception reports, and audit queries to verify reporting accuracy and data consistency.

  • Collaborate with configuration teams to establish crosswalks, valid values, defaults, attributes, and allowable combinations, ensuring data mappings align with target-system configurations.

  • Develop unit-testing scenarios and expected results covering positive, negative, boundary, and complex data conditions.

  • Maintain traceability across requirements, solution designs, data mappings, business rules, test cases, defects, client decisions, and remediation activities.

  • Produce and maintain accurate technical documentation, ensuring consistency in system names, field definitions, valid values, file frequencies, and interface directions.

  • Review legacy documentation, identify outdated or inaccurate information, and ensure project artifacts remain clear and technically reliable.

  • Advise project leadership on data quality, implementation risks, solution decisions, and opportunities for improvement.

Requirements:

The ideal candidate is a highly experienced data and business systems professional with strong SQL expertise and a proven background in healthcare technology implementations. You should be comfortable analyzing complex relational databases, translating business requirements into technical specifications, and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams. Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and the capacity to work independently are essential for success in this senior advisory role.

  • 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in data analysis, data integration, business systems analysis, solution design, or a related discipline.

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience using SQL to analyze, validate, reconcile, transform, and troubleshoot complex relational data.

  • 5+ years of experience supporting Medicaid, Medicare, healthcare payers, pharmacy benefits, claims administration, or another highly regulated healthcare environment.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting at least one large-scale system implementation, modernization, data conversion, or Design, Development, and Implementation (DDI) program.

  • Proven ability to develop interface specifications, data conversion mappings, reporting and extract specifications, and testing documentation.

  • Strong understanding of data integration, relational database structures, data quality management, and system interoperability.

  • Experience translating complex business, contractual, and regulatory requirements into detailed technical documentation and executable business rules.

  • Ability to conduct comprehensive data profiling, identify discrepancies, and develop appropriate transformation and reconciliation strategies.

  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to technical accuracy and detail.

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical teams, business stakeholders, and state clients.

  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and provide technical and functional direction across project workstreams.

Benefits:

title: Senior Manager Strategic Forecasting
description:
Job De ion

Senior Manager Strategic Forecasting

Position Overview

We are leveraging analytics and technology as we invent for life on behalf of patients around the world. We seek colleagues who are passionate about combining data, analytics, business judgment and insight to improve decisions across the end-to-end commercialization process, from business development and pipeline planning through launch and late lifecycle management.

Strategic Forecasting is a global capability responsible for long-range pharmaceutical asset forecasting across Human Health, including Oncology, Vaccines, Hospital, Specialty and Primary Care. The portfolio spans early- and late-stage clinical assets, business development opportunities and launched products. Our forecasts inform consequential decisions across commercial, finance, manufacturing, supply, research and development, and senior leadership.

Beyond delivering high-quality forecasts, the team advances forecasting standards, methodologies and tools to bring greater rigor, speed, consistency and scalability to decision-making.

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Strategic Forecasting who combines deep forecasting expertise with strong strategic judgment, stakeholder influence and a continuous-improvement mindset. The role will remain anchored in pharmaceutical forecasting while helping the function selectively use advanced analytics, automation and AI to improve the quality and efficiency of forecasting work. The successful candidate will not simply apply established methods; they will shape perspectives, challenge conventional approaches and contribute thought leadership that advances the forecasting discipline.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Conceptualize, build and deliver high-quality strategic forecasts for pipeline and in-line assets using fit-for-purpose qualitative, epidemiology-based, patient-based, demand-based and statistical approaches.
  • Translate complex and ambiguous business questions into clear forecasting frameworks, scenarios and assumptions, selecting the right methodology based on the decision context, data availability, uncertainty, required accuracy and timeline.
  • Own the end-to-end forecast story, including key assumptions, sources of growth, risks and opportunities, ranges, scenarios, sensitivities and implications for business decisions.
  • Apply strong pharmaceutical and commercial judgment to identify the few critical forecast levers, distinguish signal from noise, and ensure models remain decision-relevant, transparent and appropriately simple.
  • Partner with Commercial, Finance, Market Access, Manufacturing, Supply, country teams and senior leaders to develop robust assumptions, reconcile divergent perspectives and build alignment around forecast outputs.
  • Communicate complex analyses with clarity and influence, elevating insights and implications rather than only presenting model outputs. Proactively surface uncertainty, trade-offs and areas requiring leadership decisions.
  • Drive continuous improvement of forecasting capabilities, including methodology, scenario planning, range forecasting, model design, governance, documentation and performance monitoring.
  • Provide thought leadership on strategic forecasting by developing distinctive points of view on emerging methodologies, anticipating future business needs, challenging legacy practices with evidence, and translating external best practices into pragmatic improvements for the organization.
  • Act as a forecasting subject-matter expert and trusted advisor, raising the quality of problem framing and decision discussions across teams and helping establish standards that can be adopted at scale.
  • Selectively leverage AI, machine learning and automation as enablers within the forecasting workflow, for example to accelerate research and synthesis, support assumption development, identify analogs, prepare data, detect events or anomalies, enable scenario exploration and streamline repeatable activities.
  • Critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, bias, explainability and business plausibility. Maintain human accountability for forecast logic, assumptions, judgment and final recommendations.
  • Identify high-value use cases for AI and advanced analytics, partner with technical teams to pilot and scale appropriate solutions and ensure that technology improves forecasting quality or productivity rather than adding unnecessary complexity.
  • Apply or guide advanced analytical techniques where relevant, such as Monte Carlo simulation, range forecasting, analog analysis, conjoint approaches, clustering, natural language processing, agent-based modeling, dynamic transmission modeling and machine learning-based triangulation.
  • Contribute to standardization and automation of forecasting models, processes and reusable assets while preserving flexibility for asset- and market-specific needs.
  • Mentor colleagues, share best practices and strengthen forecasting capability through coaching, peer reviews, training and communities of practice.
  • Support talent selection and development and, where applicable, coordinate resources to ensure timely, high-quality delivery



Qualification and Skills

  • Postgraduate degree in business, engineering, pharmaceutical sciences, economics, statistics, data science or a related discipline.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience, including substantial hands-on experience in pharmaceutical strategic forecasting, commercial analytics or closely related decision-support roles.
  • Demonstrated mastery of core pharmaceutical forecasting, including forecast framework design, epidemiology and patient flow, market and share assumptions, analogs, launch curves, scenario and sensitivity analysis, uncertainty and range forecasting, and forecast communication.
  • Strong understanding of pharmaceutical development and commercialization, including clinical development, regulatory milestones, market access, competitive dynamics, manufacturing, supply and lifecycle management.
  • Proven ability to form and articulate an independent point of view, challenge assumptions constructively, influence senior stakeholders and convert analysis into decisions and action.
  • Evidence of thought leadership, such as developing new forecasting approaches, shaping enterprise standards, introducing scalable best practices, publishing or presenting perspectives, or leading capability-building initiatives.
  • Hands-on experience with Monte Carlo simulation and range forecasting; exposure to advanced methods such as agent-based or dynamic transmission models is advantageous.
  • Practical understanding of how generative AI, machine learning and automation can support forecasting. Direct experience applying these tools to forecasting or analytics workflows is preferred, but deep AI engineering expertise is not required.
  • Ability to assess the limitations and risks of analytical and AI-enabled methods, including data quality, model validation, explainability, bias, confidentiality and responsible use.
  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity and comfort operating in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, actionable and executive-ready insights.
  • Proven collaboration across diverse global functions and stakeholder groups.

Additional location(s) Compensation Information

Required Skills

Business Analysis, Marketing, Numerical Analysis, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Strategic Planning, Waterfall Model

Preferred Skills

description:
Celeros Flow Technology, LLC

Job Summary

The Proposal Sourcing Engineer - Supplier-Engineered Equipment supports Celeros Flow Technology's Inquiry-to-Order (ITO) process by developing supplier strategies and commercial solutions that improve proposal win rates, competitiveness, margin, and lead-time optimization.

Working closely with Application Engineering, Commercial Operations, and Sales teams, the Proposal Sourcing Leader serves as the primary supplier-facing commercial lead during the proposal phase. The role is responsible for developing sourcing strategies, negotiating supplier commitments, assessing commercial and supply chain risks, and strengthening customer proposals through collaborative supplier engagement.

Supplier-Engineered Equipment is externally engineered and manufactured equipment supplied against Celeros performance and interface requirements. Celeros defines what the equipment must do and how it must integrate with the overall solution, while suppliers are responsible for detailed design, engineering, and manufacture. Typical examples include electric motors, variable frequency drives (VFDs), mechanical seal systems, lubrication systems, gearboxes, and other auxiliary equipment. This role will be based at Bangalore location

Key Responsibilities

Proposal Competitiveness

  • Develop supplier strategies and commercial solutions that improve proposal win rates, margin, and lead-time optimization.
  • Influence proposal outcomes through supplier engagement, commercial negotiation, and market intelligence.
  • Support proposal reviews by providing sourcing recommendations, commercial insights, and risk assessments.
  • Identify opportunities to improve proposal competitiveness and increase probability of award.

Supplier Engagement

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers of Supplier-Engineered Equipment.
  • Negotiate pricing, lead times, contractual terms, warranty provisions, and commercial commitments that strengthen customer proposals.
  • Develop competitive sourcing alternatives that improve customer value propositions.
  • Monitor supplier capabilities, capacity constraints, market conditions, and industry developments.

Commercial and Contractual Risk Management

  • Evaluate supplier commercial offerings, contractual commitments, and supply chain risks.
  • Identify and mitigate commercial, schedule, capacity, and execution risks during proposal development.
  • Support the development of executable and commercially sound customer solutions.
  • Provide commercial guidance regarding supplier terms and conditions, warranties, qualifications, and risk allocation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Application Engineering, Commercial Operations, Sales, and Supply Chain teams throughout the Inquiry-to-Order process.
  • Support development of technically compliant and commercially competitive customer solutions.
  • Translate complex supplier, commercial, technical, and supply chain issues into concise business-focused recommendations and executive-level summaries.
  • Ensure effective transfer of supplier commitments, assumptions, and risks from proposal teams to execution teams.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to develop sourcing strategies that improve proposal win rates, commercial competitiveness, margin, and lead-time competitiveness.
  • Strong negotiation skills with a demonstrated ability to secure commercially advantageous pricing, lead times, contractual terms, and supplier commitments.
  • Working knowledge of commercial contracts, supplier agreements, terms and conditions, warranties, risk allocation, and related contractual language.

  • Ability to simplify complex technical, commercial, and supply chain topics into concise business-focused recommendations and executive-level summaries.
  • Strong analytical and business judgment skills with the ability to assess supplier offerings, commercial opportunities, contractual exposure, and supply chain risks and recommend actions that improve proposal outcomes.

Success Measures

  • Commercial competitiveness of supplier solutions.
  • Margin of awarded opportunities.

title: Construction HS Specialist
description:
ERM is the world's largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.

Our Consulting Delivery Hub (CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM's global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.

As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.

Why this role matters

As a Construction Health & Safety Specialist, you will support ERM's global consulting delivery by providing construction-focused H&S expertise that helps clients and project teams manage higher-risk works safely and in compliance with legislation and standards. Working within the Safety & Sustainable Operations (SSO) service line of the Consulting Delivery Hub – and partnering with regional consultants, designers, contractors and client H&S representatives across EMEA, SEBU and North America – you will, as a developing specialist working with minimal supervision, independently deliver and review the construction-safety documentation and analysis that underpins safe execution on site. This role is critical to preventing incidents on dynamic construction projects, strengthening contractor performance, and enabling ERM to scale trusted, high-quality construction H&S delivery from the hub.

What your impact is

  • Construction H&S deliverables – RAMS, method statements, JSAs, hazard registers, safety plans and CDM / pre-construction information – are produced and reviewed independently to a standard regional teams can rely on with minimal rework.
  • Higher-risk construction activities (work at height, lifting, excavation, confined space, hot work) are competently risk-assessed and controls are verified against design, method and legislation.
  • Contractor H&S plans, method statements and corrective-action evidence are reviewed rigorously, driving measurable improvement in contractor compliance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently prepare and review construction H&S deliverables – RAMS, method statements, JSAs, hazard registers, construction-phase plans, CDM / pre-construction information and safety files – to ERM and client standards.

title: Contract Engineer
description:

Job Title: Contracts Engineer / Contracts Manager

Department: Contracts / Projects

Location: Head Office / Project Site with site travel

Job Purpose

To identify, evaluate, negotiate, appoint, and manage contractors for execution of various civil, finishing, MEP, infrastructure, and allied activities in residential and commercial building projects, ensuring competitive pricing, proper contractual terms, timely execution support, contractor performance monitoring, smooth billing coordination, and alignment with project cost, quality, and schedule objectives.

  • Coordinate with accounts and finance teams for payment tracking, retention, advances, deductions, TDS/GST compliance, and reconciliation.

  • B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering
  • Additional qualification in Construction Management / Contracts Management / Quantity Surveying preferred

Experience

  • 8 to 15 years of experience in real estate / building construction projects

  • Experience in contractor finalization, rate negotiation, contract administration, billing coordination, and contractor performance monitoring

Required Skills

  • Strong knowledge of residential and commercial building construction activities
  • Good understanding of civil, finishing, MEP, infrastructure, and allied work packages
  • Contractor identification, evaluation, negotiation, and finalization skills
  • Sound knowledge of work orders, contract terms, scope definition, and billing conditions
  • Ability to prepare rate comparisons, cost analysis, and negotiation summaries
  • Good understanding of RA bills, measurements, extra items, debit notes, and final bills
  • Contractor performance monitoring and coordination ability
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills
  • Problem-solving ability with practical site understanding
  • Ability to coordinate effectively with Project Managers, site teams, billing teams, and management
  • Knowledge of quality, safety, statutory, and compliance requirements at project sites
  • Good documentation, MIS, and reporting skills

Key Performance Indicators

  • Timely identification and finalization of suitable contractors
  • Cost savings achieved through effective negotiation
  • Contractor performance against agreed timelines and productivity targets
  • Reduction in contractor disputes, claims, and execution delays
  • Timely issuance of work orders and contract documentation
  • Accuracy and timeliness of contractor billing coordination
  • Quality and safety compliance by contractors
  • Support provided to Project Managers for improving contractor output
  • Timely MIS reporting to management
  • Development of reliable contractor/vendor database for future projects

Qualifications

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) or Construction Management
  • Diploma in Civil Engineering (with relevant experience can also be considered)

Experience:

  • 3–6 years of experience in contracts management within the real estate / construction industry
  • Experience in handling contractor agreements, tendering, and billing processes

Alexa+ is Amazon's next-generation personal assistant powered by generative AI – more conversational, smarter, personalized, and built to get things done on any device.

The Alexa 3P Experiences team is on a mission to expand what Alexa+ can do for customers by building consumer-facing experiences with trusted third-party partners like Thumbtack, Yelp, Uber and more. Using frontier AI technologies – including Large Language Models (LLMs), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) capabilities – we create agentic experiences that connect customers with an ever-expanding selection of services through natural conversation.

As an SDE II on this team, you will design and build category-defining experiences that millions of customers interact with daily. You will work closely with product, design, and partner teams to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions that drive customer discovery, engagement, task completion, and monetization. You will contribute to category scaling frameworks – reusable components that enable partners to build sophisticated experiences with minimal effort.

We're a team that moves fast, builds with AI-native technologies, and measures success by customer impact. If you want to work at the intersection of generative AI and consumer experiences, this is the place.

Key job responsibilities

– Building high-quality, consumer-facing 3P experiences and Agentic Experts that enable customers to complete tasks through trusted partners on Alexa+.

– Designing and developing components for category scaling frameworks that enable partners to build sophisticated experiences with minimal effort.

– Collaborating closely with product, design, and partner teams to deliver experiences that drive customer discovery, engagement, and task completion.

– Understanding the business impact of your systems and showing good judgment when making technical trade-offs between speed of delivery and long-term scalability.

– Driving engineering best practices (e.g., Operational Excellence, Security, Quality) within the team.

– Contributing to the professional development of colleagues by sharing knowledge, participating in code reviews, and improving engineering practices.

A day in the life

A typical day will start with a morning huddle to catch up on what you and your team worked on the previous day. This is usually followed by some whiteboard design discussions on the problems the team is working on. The afternoon is mostly spent on project design and implementation work with a heavy dose of code reviews from and for your team along the way. We are a fun, close-knit team where everyone is ready to roll up their sleeves and help each other out, push boundaries, and have fun doing it!

About The Team

Alexa 3P Experiences is a dedicated organization within Alexa Domains, purpose-built to rapidly expand the choices and selection of agentic experiences on Alexa+. Building on early launches with marquee partners, our mission is to offer customers choice and expanded selection in Alexa's agentic capabilities – positioning Alexa to lead in the next generation of ambient AI interactions. We work closely with cross-functional teams across Alexa for core platform capabilities while owning the end-to-end consumer experience and category innovation.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
  • 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
  • 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
  • Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. BDO India is led by more than 300+ Partners & Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. Preferred Candidate Profile

title: Head of Financial Control
description:
About WeRize

India's first social distribution AI fintech platform for the underserved aspirational middle-class- delivering Secured & Unsecured loans, Insurance, and Investment products across 5,000+ small cities of India (referred as India-2). Founded in 2019, WeRize is at an annualized-run-rate of $60 Mn (Gross revenues) and $32Mn (Net) and $7Mn+ of net profits before taxes (3x Y-o-Y growth) with ROE > 20%. We are projecting 2x growth in topline and 3x growth in profits over the next 12 months.

WeRize operates as a category creator three-sided marketplace connecting 17,000+ trained local freelancers with India-2 customers and partner financial institutions, all powered by a full-stack AI operating layer that creates a flywheel of trust with self-reinforcing network effects.

  • Distributor trust: Freelancers are empowered through AI-led tools that help them act in the long-term best interests of their customers.
  • Customer trust: End customers rely on WeRize's assisted distributor, data-driven recommendations across both asset and liability products
  • Manufacturer trust: Financial Institutions rely on WeRize's data, risk management and distribution intelligence to reach small city customers that they can't serve on their own.

Key highlights: What do we do

  1. Large, underpenetrated market opportunity:India's 300Mn+ aspirational middle-class captures 30% of GDP, yet remains financially underserved across credit, insurance, and investments. Pure-digital models lack the required trust, while physical branches are economically unviable.
  2. Differentiated, asset-light social distribution: WeRize leverages 17,000+ financially literate freelancers across 5,000+ small cities. This branchless, zero-sales-team model delivers high-trust human touchpoints, superb unit economics, and strong freelancer retention through a broad product suite.
  3. Proprietary AI driven tech stack: Trained on 20Bn+ data points across 4Mn+ households, WeRize's AI powers end-to-end operations. For distribution, it optimizes lead gen, selling, and engagement—turning freelancers into professional advisors. For manufacturing, it sharpens risk management, underwriting, and product structuring for high-margin expansion.

To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com/

About the Role

Based out of our Bengaluru headquarters, you will own the integrity of the company's financial statements, ensure strict adherence to Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and statutory regulations, and build scalable financial processes to support our next phase of growth.

Reporting directly to the Group CFO

Key Responsibilities

Financial Reporting, Revenue reconciliation & Accounting:

  • Own the end-to-end monthly, quarterly, and annual book closure processes with zero material misstatements.
  • Ensure accurate preparation of standalone and consolidated financial statements in strict compliance with Ind AS / IGAAP.
  • Drive balance sheet hygiene, working capital management, and rigorous reconciliation of key ledger accounts.

Internal Controls & Risk Management:

  • Design, implement, and monitor a robust Internal Financial Controls (IFC) framework across all business units and functions.
  • Partner with cross-functional leaders (Operations, Procurement, Sales, IT) to plug revenue leakages, optimize costs, and enforce delegation of authority (DoA) matrices.

Audit, Taxation & Statutory Compliance:

  • Lead and manage statutory audits, internal audits, and tax audits, ensuring timely closure with Big 4 / top-tier audit firms.
  • Oversee direct and indirect tax compliance (Income Tax, GST, TDS), regulatory filings (ROC, FEMA/RBI if applicable), and litigation management.

Team Leadership & Process Automation:

  • Mentor, coach, and manage a 15-member finance team across controllership, accounts payable/receivable, payroll, and taxation.
  • Spearhead ERP optimization and finance automation initiatives to reduce manual intervention and accelerate close timelines.

Strategic Business Partnering:

  • Provide actionable financial insights, variance analyses, and MIS dashboards to the CFO and Board/Audit Committee.
  • Evaluate financial implications of new business models, vendor contracts, and capital expenditure proposals.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) is mandatory. Additional certifications (CPA, CMA, CS) are a plus.
  • Experience:12–16+ years of post-qualification experience in financial controllership, accounting, and audit.
  • Scale: Proven track record of managing financial control for a business with 1,000 Cr – 3,000+ Cr annual revenue. Prior experience in Big 4 audit firms followed by leadership roles in high-growth corporate setups is strongly preferred.
  • Team Management: Demonstrated experience leading, structuring, and upskilling a team of 10–20+ finance professionals.
  • Technical Skills: Deep expertise in Ind AS, GST, Direct Tax, IFC, and hands-on proficiency in enterprise ERPs (SAP S/4HANA, Oracle NetSuite, or Microsoft Dynamics).

Core Competencies

  • High degree of ownership, integrity, and attention to detail.
  • Strong stakeholder management and ability to influence non-finance leaders.
  • Analytical mindset with a bias for process automation and continuous improvement.

title: Principal I, IT Business Systems Analysis -Lead Business Analyst
description:
Summary of Position:

The Lead Business Analyst supports the strategy, discovery, development, and delivery of the ISS digital product portfolio. The role translates complex business, customer, process, data, and technical needs into clear, testable requirements that enable high-quality product delivery.

This role serves as a bridge among business stakeholders, Product Owners, customers, UX, Architecture, Backend, Frontend, QA, DevOps, Data teams, and third-party partners. The Lead Business Analyst brings structure to ambiguity, drives alignment across multiple workstreams, and helps ensure delivered capabilities are valuable, feasible, compliant, traceable, and ready for release.

Key Responsibilities:

Product Discovery, Requirements, And Process Analysis

  • Partner with business stakeholders and Product Owners to elicit, analyze, challenge, prioritize, and validate business and product requirements.
  • Plan and facilitate discovery sessions and requirements workshops with internal teams, customers, and third-party partners.
  • Synthesize information from multiple sources, resolve conflicts, and translate high-level needs into detailed, workable requirements.
  • Define epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, process flows, functional specifications, and non-functional considerations.
  • Analyze and document current-state and future-state business processes using BPMN or comparable process-modeling standards.
  • Define decision logic and business rules using DMN or another structured, unambiguous, and testable approach.

Technical analysis, UX, and delivery collaboration

  • Analyze REST API endpoints, API contracts, JSON payloads, integrations, system behavior, error scenarios, and end-to-end data flows.
  • Collaborate with Backend, Frontend, QA, DevOps, UX, Data, and Architecture teams to ensure shared understanding and correct implementation of requirements.
  • Coordinate UX activities, including user-flow definition, wireframe review, usability feedback, and alignment between user needs and functional requirements.
  • Support implementation of business process changes and assess, document, and coordinate project-related change requests.
  • Lead or contribute to problem-solving sessions, dependency management, defect analysis, and identification and mitigation of delivery risks.

Agile execution, traceability, and stakeholder coordination

  • Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, UAT, defect triage, release readiness, and post-release validation.
  • Coordinate work across customer teams, internal teams, and third-party vendors, maintaining clarity on decisions, actions, dependencies, risks, and ownership.
  • Maintain requirements traceability across Jira, Confluence, specifications, test cases, validation evidence, and release documentation.
  • Analyze product, project, and operational data and communicate actionable insights, decisions, and recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Promote consistent, scalable business-analysis and requirements practices across the ISS product portfolio.

Key Responsibilities/Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field; equivalent experience acceptable.
  • 10+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Lead Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or comparable product-delivery role in a complex enterprise environment.
  • Experience in Life Sciences, Medical Technology, Healthcare, or another regulated technology domain.
  • Strong product management capabilities, including shaping features, prioritizing requirements, incorporating user feedback and research, and balancing business value, technical complexity, risk, and delivery constraints.
  • Excellent analytical skills and demonstrated ability to decompose complex capabilities into clear, complete, and testable requirements.
  • Strong experience analyzing business processes, workflows, user journeys, system behavior, exceptions, and complex business rules.
  • Ability to analyze REST APIs, API contracts, JSON payloads, integration behavior, data models, SQL queries, relational databases, and NoSQL concepts.
  • Working knowledge of solution design patterns, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder-management, decision-documentation, and executive-ready presentation skills.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional work, manage multiple workstreams, and coordinate customer, internal, and third-party teams.
  • Hands-on experience with VS Code, GitHub, Git, and AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code.
  • Experience preparing wireframes or partnering directly with UX designers.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience with device management, telemetry, log processing, predictive insights, or anomaly detection.
  • Experience with GxP, validation, audit trails, data integrity, design controls, or other regulated product-delivery practices.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence administration or project-level configuration.
  • Experience with AWS data, integration, and analytics services.
  • Knowledge of enterprise system integrations, and related business and operational workflows.
  • Creates clarity, owns outcomes, influences without authority, identifies risks early, and maintains a strong customer and patient focus.

title: Mainframe Developer (MY)
description:

title: Senior Data Engineer | AWS & GCP

Improve Spark and BigQuery performance, reduce costs. Enforce data quality checks and governance with Glue Data Quality and Dataplex. Automate cloud infrastructure and data pipeline deployments with Terraform and GitHubActions. Collaborate with Data Architects, Analytics Engineers, and pharma teams. Senior Data Engineer with AWS and GCP experience. Experience building enterprise cloud data platforms. Background in data ingestion, processing and analytics.

Diagnose whether poor AI responses originate from:

Prompt design

User inputs

Retrieved content

RAG/retrieval performance

Vectorization or data

Application behavior

Collaborate directly with AI engineers, data engineers, data scientists, SMEs, and content builders.

Apply a strong understanding of RAG architecture, retrieval, embeddings/vectorization, tokenization, and context/token limits.

Help determine how AI applications should guide users toward effective inputs and reliable responses.

Work with data originating from Snowflake/data lake environments and AWS-based AI services.

Use Python and modern AI development tools to test, evaluate, and improve GenAI application behavior.

  • Component Protection & Dunnage: Design specialized component-specific inserts and protective dunnage (such as foam, PVC, or sheet metal slots) to prevent transit damage for EV parts. Line Integration:
  • Collaborate with the industrial engineering team to size and align trolleys for clean interaction within a multi-station, two-sided assembly line environment. Ergonomics & Efficiency:
  • Optimize spatial placement on the carts to support clean part retrieval, minimizing unnecessary operator movement and increasing assembly efficiency.
  • Documentation: Draft accurate fabrication drawings, engineering tolerances, Bill of Materials (BOM), and mechanical load distributions for production teams.

Required Skills & Qualification

  • Currently pursuing or recently graduated with a Degree/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Production, Packaging Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Highly proficient with SOLIDWORKS 3D for complex part modeling, structural assemblies, and 2D drafting production.
  • Technical Knowledge: Solid understanding of basic manufacturing workshop practices, sheet metal fabrication, hardware selection, and automotive parts packaging mechanics.
  • Strong spatial visualization skills with the capability to translate floor demands into robust, protective mechanical structures

About The Company

Arbor Mobility is a 2W EV start-up based out of Bengaluru, India. We at Arbor Mobility are developing a performance two-wheeler EV motorcycle. The three Co-Founders have done their Masters in Automotive Engineering from the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, USA, and have worked for various Automotive companies in India and the USA and are now determined to create something exciting in the EV space. The company was started in November, 2022 and is now rapidly expanding. We, at Arbor Mobility are trying to answer the basic question of how to increase the adoption of EVs in India. EV usage is a paradigm shift in consumer behaviour. It requires us to think how to tackle the issues such as charging, range anxiety & safety for a consumer. We at Arbor Mobility think it is essential to make it easy for the customers to switch to EVs. Hence, we have taken an innovative customer centric approach for our product development. This provides an exciting opportunity for anyone who want to join the efforts to build the future of automotive industry in India & the world.
