title: Associate Director Clinical Data Foundation
description:
JOIN AMGEN'S MISSION OF SERVING PATIENTS

At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission to serve patients living with serious illnesses drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas, Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease, we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Associate Director – Clinical Data Foundation (CDF)

What You Will Do

In this vital role, you will lead the Clinical Data Foundation (CDF) capability across the clinical systems landscape as a governed, reusable data foundation for clinical and clinical operations use cases. You will translate the integrated data strategy into sequenced work, governed delivery, and measurable improvements in interoperability and data usability. Working in close partnership with business functions such as Global Development Operations (GDO), you will onboard high-value business use cases onto CDF and ensure the foundation is AI-ready, with trusted, well-governed, and fit-for-purpose data that enables analytics and AI at scale.

Strategic Leadership

  • Own the CDF capability roadmap and delivery priorities, aligned with GDO, AI&D, Digital, Technology & Innovation (DTI), enterprise architecture, and business needs.
  • Establish clear ownership, standards, governance, and design practices for Clinical Data Foundation (CDF).
  • Ensure CDF is AI-ready by defining and enforcing standards for data quality, semantic consistency, metadata, lineage, and access controls so data can be trusted and reused for analytics, machine learning, and generative AI.
  • Identify opportunities to improve trusted data exchange and reduce manual reconciliation across clinical systems.

Execution and Delivery Leadership

  • Lead delivery of integration or data foundation initiatives from requirements through design, testing, release, and operational handoff.
  • Manage dependencies across source systems, vendors, data consumers, security, privacy, quality, and architecture.
  • Monitor delivery outcomes, data quality, exceptions, and operational risks; ensure issues have owners and remediation plans.
  • Own the intake, prioritization, and onboarding of business use cases onto CDF, from value assessment and data requirements through delivery, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Maintain traceable documentation of data flows, interfaces, controls, decisions, and evidence.

People Leadership

  • Manage and develop direct reports supporting CDF, setting goals, coaching performance, and building capability depth.
  • Coordinate capacity across planned roadmap work, operational support, and urgent cross-system needs.
  • Build a collaborative team culture focused on data stewardship, quality, and continuous improvement.

External Representation and Internal Stakeholder Partnerships

  • Work as a close partner to business functions such as GDO, embedding business leaders to understand priorities, shape the use case pipeline, and ensure CDF delivers value aligned to clinical development goals.
  • Partner with leaders within GDO, as well as system owners, AI&D, DTI, architecture, security, privacy, quality, and analytics teams.
  • Coordinate with technology and service providers to deliver integrations, data products, and platform changes.
  • Communicate dependencies, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations to clinical systems and enterprise governance groups.

What We Expect From You

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The candidate we seek is a capable clinical systems professional with the following qualifications.

Basic Qualifications

  • Master's degree and 10+ years of experience in clinical systems integration, data architecture, data flow, or related work in regulated technology environments OR
  • Bachelor's degree and 13+ years of experience in related work in regulated technology environments.
  • 2+ years of direct people management experience or demonstrated experience supervising and developing employees.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Clinical Data Foundation (CDF) or comparable enterprise clinical data capabilities.
  • Understanding of clinical platforms, interface patterns, data quality, traceability, and regulated change controls.
  • Experience leading a team or complex cross-functional technology delivery.
  • Experience preparing enterprise data for AI and advanced analytics, including data quality, metadata, lineage, and governance practices.
  • Ability to translate business use cases into clear data or integration requirements.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of clinical system interfaces, data standards, and downstream data use.
  • Experience with integration lifecycle, data governance, testing, and operational support.
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms, APIs, or analytics environments.
  • Business partnership, use case prioritization, and AI-ready data practices.
  • People leadership, stakeholder alignment, and structured delivery.

They will also embody the Amgen leadership attributes which are:

  • Inspire: Create a connected, inclusive, and inspiring work environment that empowers talent to thrive
  • Accelerate: Enable speed that matches the urgency of patient needs by encouraging progress over perfection
  • Integrate: Connect the dots to amplify the collective power of Amgen to drive results for patients, staff, and shareholders
  • Adapt: Lead through change by adapting to an ever-changing environment and defining a clear course of action to deliver results

What You Can Expect From Us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we'll support your journey every step of the way.

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

This position was originally posted to ratified SEIU members from 10/21/26 – 10/29/26. The position is now available to be filled by internal candidates that are not members of the ratified Bargaining Unit or External candidates to Sharp.


What You Will Do
Coordinates all registration functions necessary to ensure the processing of a clean claim including but not limited to obtaining and processing patient demographics, visit and financial information in a manner that facilitate maximum financial reimbursement and promotes premier customer service. This role utilizes Patient Secure to identify the accurate patient medical record while adhering to EMTALA regulations and performs face-to-face interviews directly with patients and/or their designated representatives. Accurate identification and delivery of regulatory documents and securing patient financial responsibility is a key responsibility.

Required Qualifications

  • 2 Years experience in a business service setting.
  • Must have experience communicating effectively both verbally and in writing professionally.


Preferred Qualifications

  • H.S. Diploma or Equivalent
  • Experience communicating and discussing personal and financial matters with patients and/or their representatives is preferred.


Other Qualification Requirements

  • HFMA certifications preferred.


Essential Functions

  • Collections
    Follow department guidelines for providing patient with estimate letter.
    Request payment of co-pay, deductible, estimated out of pocket or good-faith deposit in a manner specified in department and hospital policies. If patient unable to pay requested amount, negotiate some portion.
    Receive and process funds, print and file receipt, and update Centricity visit comments. Secure all funds and receipts in accordance with department standard.
  • Completes insurance verification and evaluation
    Insurance/Plan Selection:
    After medical screening (ER settings), obtain health benefit coverage including possible accident related coverage. Input all insurance coverage information into Centricity Insurance Verification (IF). If patient unable to provide insurance, search for potential coverage through MCA for SRS/SCMG and MPV (or Portal) for potential Medicare or Medi-Cal.
    Use Coordination of Benefits (COB) standards to prioritize billing order of insurance plans.
    Medicare patients - Medicare Secondary Payer (MSP) questionnaire is completed.
    Validate insurance eligibility electronically (e.g. MPV, Experian) when applicable. Validate health benefit coverage including possible accident related coverage.
    Validate and identify the Primary Medical Group on Health Maintenance Organizations (HMO) patients. Notify the clinical staff, including physician, on patients that are out-of-network.
    Follow process to estimate patient out of pocket based upon department guidelines and collect patient financial responsibility.
    Communicate to patient and leadership when unusually high out of pocket, unusually limited coverage, and/or if insurance is out of network (OON) following the guidelines established for the facility.
    Unfunded:
    Initiate interview on unfunded/underfunded patients. Input financial screening results into Pointcare fields as appropriate and provide patient with potential coverage options. Complete the process by recording the outcome through X8 function.
    Complete HPE (Hospital Presumptive Eligibility) process when appropriate.
    Document in Centricity visit comments if patient declined or completed financial screening.
    Follow self-pay process (aka toolkit) to discuss the Sharp out of pocket expectation.
  • Customer service
    Use AIDET, key words at key times, On-Stage Behavior and support 5-star results on patient satisfaction.
    Communicates effectively both orally and in writing sufficient to perform the essential job functions. Use tact and empathy in working with customers under stressful situations and with frequent interruptions.
    Avoid abbreviations when communicating to patient.
    Adapt and protect patient privacy as needed (i.e. lowering voice, using face sheets vs. verbal interviews).
    Practice good interpersonal and communication skills and ability to work well with others contributing to a team environment.
    Practice a positive and constructive attitude at all times.
    Negotiates with others, handles minor complaints by settling disputes, grievances, and conflicts.
    Perform service recovery when The Sharp Experience does not go right in accordance to the department standards and Sharp's Behavior Standard Service Recovery.
    Identify solutions to issues not covered by verbal or written instructions.
  • Demonstrates initiative and teamwork
    Prioritize job responsibilities effectively. Keep management informed of backlogs or slow volume. Round on patients when volumes are low as identified by your department.
    Patients are processed timely based upon depart standards such as quality audits, time, and production measurements.
    Offer to assist others and asks for assistance in completing of assignments, as needed.
    Inform patient/families of admission delays and cause if known or allowed.
    Promotes a team approach in completion of department duties.
    Contributes to department production by maintaining expected level of productivity designated by the department.
  • Other duties
    As directed by Leadership, provide ongoing support of department and hospital needs as assigned.
    When applicable, collect patient valuables according to policy and secure them by entering into log and dropping into department safe. Follow hospital policy to release valuables.
    When applicable, update Patient Type, Bed Placement, Accommodation Code, Attending Physician.
    ED Unit Clerk (SCO only):
    Responsible for handling outgoing/incoming Emergency Department calls including outgoing calls for consultations and ancillary services. Calls to physicians and ancillary service areas will be documented in the EMR.
    Obtain medical records and facilitate transfers from/to outside facilities.
    Create patient chart for physician and organize charts for the HIM department. Compile workers' compensation paperwork for the ED physician.
    Monitor ED cafe supplies.
    Handle outgoing calls to other departments for ED.
    Input discharge disposition information obtained from EHR orders into patient admission-discharge-transfer (ADT) application.
    Customer Information Center duties (SCO only):
    Initiate ED Code calls using the overhead paging system and Code Log Book online.
    Answer CIC phone lines after business hours and monitor alarm panels for incoming Codes.
  • Patient registration
    Patient Safety:
    Authenticate and/or enroll patient at workstations where Patient Secure palm scanner is available. Follow established guidelines such as scripting and picture identification for enrollment and authentication.
    In absence of Patient Secure workstation, use at least two patient identifiers to confirm patient identity.
    Notify DUPREG and document potential duplicate and overlap registrations when identified.
    Demographic Collection:
    Populate all demographic screens for new and established patients. In applicable cases, follow registration guidelines for Doe and Trauma patients.
    Update regulatory fields in demographic data with patient choices on regulatory forms such as Notice of Privacy Practice (NPP), Advanced Directive for Health Care (ADHC), Health Information Exchange (HIE).
    Secure patient signature on address attestation.
    If service is accident related, update appropriate visit fields indicating known details.
    Follow defined documentation process with homeless patient (i.e. notating 'SB1152' in FirstNet and Edit Visit (EV) form comments).
  • Regulatory responsibilities
    Observe EMTALA regulations (Emergency Room/ER settings) by avoiding communication of financial information (such as eligibility, copays, authorization) until medical screening is completed. This includes avoiding discussion of financial issues with clinical counterparts, health insurances, or patient family/friends until after medical screening.
    Using scripting, review Conditions of Admission (COA). If unable to secure signature, indicate reason in Centricity visit comments. Based upon COA patient review, update appropriate Centricity fields related to status of ADHC, No Publish, Notice of Privacy Practices, and Patient Rights. More fields may be added as regulations change.
    In cases where Tricare or Medicare/Medicare Advantage is primary or secondary, use scripting to review and deliver appropriate regulatory form (Tricare Rights, Tricare Third Party Liability, and Important Message from Medicare (IMM) form). If signature secured, update Centricity fields in appropriate insurance follow-up field. If unable to secure signature, indicate reason in Centricity visit comments.
    Follow guidelines for delivery of Medicare Outpatient Observation (MOON) and Outpatient Observation Notice (OON) to all patients being admitted in an Observation status.
    Request and input Primary Care Provider (PCP) information and initiate Health Information Exchange (HIE) process as appropriate.
    In areas performing post regulatory review, address outstanding alerts in the Centricity Alerts Manager based upon your department's workflow.
    Document Imaging - Secure necessary Access Service related documents and scan to correct form/identifier.



Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Knowledge of insurances, billing and collections guidelines/criteria.
  • Knowledge of Local, State, and Federal regulations governing registration/billing activities including Joint Commission, Title XXII, Medicare and Medi-Cal regulations.
  • Knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, and/or RVS coding.
  • Knowledge of Medicare Important Message, Medicare Secondary Payor, Tricare Third Party Liability; Auto Accident and Work Comp, Medicare/Outpatient Observation Notice.

title: Exercise Physiologist
description:
Pay Range:$25.00 - $31.88

The Exercise Physiologist provides individualized and group-based cardiac rehabilitation and clinical exercise services to support cardiovascular recovery, functional improvement, and long-term health. Working within approved protocols and medical direction, this position performs exercise assessments, develops and progresses exercise prescriptions, monitors patient responses, and provides patient and caregiver education. The position collaborates with the interdisciplinary team to support safe care, individualized treatment plans, program quality, and access to services across SEARHC communities, including approved hybrid or virtual services.

SEARHC is a non-profit health consortium which serves the health interests of the residents of Southeast Alaska. We see our employees as our strongest assets. It is our priority to further their development and our organization by aiding in their professional advancement.

Working at SEARHC is more than a job, it’s a fulfilling career. We offer generous benefits, including retirement, paid time off, paid parental leave, health insurance, dental, and vision benefits, life insurance and long and short-term disability, and more.

Key Essential Functions and Accountabilities of the Job


Patient Assessment and Exercise Management

  • Reviews referrals, medical history, medications, precautions, functional limitations, risk factors, and patient goals to guide exercise assessment and planning.
  • Performs initial and follow-up functional and exercise assessments using approved protocols.
  • Develops, implements, and progresses individualized aerobic, resistance, flexibility, and balance exercise prescriptions based on assessment findings, risk stratification, patient response, and medical direction.
  • Leads individual and group exercise sessions in person and through approved hybrid or virtual programs, consistent with program safety and supervision requirements.

Clinical Monitoring and Safety

  • Monitors cardiac rhythm, heart rate, blood pressure, perceived exertion, symptoms, and other indicated measures before, during, and after exercise.
  • Recognizes abnormal responses, telemetry changes, precautions, and contraindications; modifies or terminates exercise and promptly escalates concerns according to established protocols.
  • Responds to medical emergencies within current training, certification, demonstrated competency, and assigned team responsibilities.
  • Maintains equipment readiness and follows infection-prevention practices, emergency procedures, and equipment safety requirements.

Education and Self-Management

  • Educates patients and caregivers on exercise safety, symptom monitoring, cardiovascular risk reduction, home activity, and transition to independent exercise.
  • Uses patient-centered goal setting and behavior-change strategies to support participation, adherence, and long-term self-management.
  • Provides approved education within demonstrated competency and coordinates referrals for nutrition, psychosocial, tobacco cessation, or other specialized needs.
  • Adapts instruction to health literacy, communication needs, available resources, and barriers to participation.

Care Coordination and Documentation

  • Collaborates with the cardiac rehabilitation manager, registered nurse, medical director, referring providers, rehabilitation clinicians, and other team members to develop, implement, and update individualized treatment plans.
  • Documents assessments, exercise prescriptions, monitoring findings, interventions, education, patient response, and progress accurately and promptly in the electronic health record.
  • Communicates significant findings and recommendations and supports discharge planning and connections to appropriate home or community exercise resources.

Program Quality and Professional Practice

  • Tracks patient outcomes and participates in quality improvement, case review, program evaluation, and certification or accreditation readiness.
  • Supports patient orientation, staff education, competency validation, and development of program workflows.
  • Follows organizational policies, confidentiality requirements, documentation standards, and applicable service and reimbursement requirements.

Other Functions

  • Participates in community education, outreach, and program development as assigned.
  • Supports other rehabilitation assignments appropriate to education, training, demonstrated competency, and departmental needs.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • No formal supervisory responsibilities are proposed.
  • May assist with orientation and mentoring of staff, students, or interns as assigned.

Additional Details:

Education, Certifications, and Licenses Required


  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in exercise physiology, exercise science, kinesiology, or a closely related field.
  • Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification within 3 months.
  • Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) certification at hire or within six months of hire.
  • Completion and ongoing validation of cardiac rhythm interpretation, exercise monitoring, emergency response, and other assigned clinical competencies within department-established timeframes and before independent performance of those duties.

Preferred Certifications

  • ACSM Certified Clinical Exercise Physiologist (ACSM-CEP).
  • AACVPR Certified Cardiac Rehabilitation Professional (CCRP).

Knowledge of

  • Clinical exercise physiology, cardiovascular conditions and procedures, and the effects of common medications on exercise response.
  • Exercise assessment, risk stratification, exercise prescription and progression, precautions, contraindications, and termination criteria.

  • 2-4 Years of relevant consulting experience in record to report transformation (not Industry user experience)

What Working At EY Offers

At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

The Director, Global Medical Affairs (GMA) Inflammation is a key member of the GMA Liver, Inflammation, Emerging Viruses, and Established Products (LIVE) team, reporting to the Senior Director, GMA Inflammation. This person will provide strategic medical leadership for T cell engager in inflammation pipeline assets, integrating hematology, immunology, and translational science to shape development decisions and long-term value.

This role brings the voice of patients, clinicians, and other external stakeholders into early- and mid-stage asset strategy, with a focus on immune-mediated and inflammatory hematologic diseases, as well as other indications. The Director leads through influence in a highly matrixed environment and represents Global Medical Affairs in cross-functional governance forums.

Key responsibilities:

  • Owns the global medical strategy for assigned inflammation pipeline assets across early and mid‑stage development.
  • Serves as Medical Affairs asset lead for T cell engagers, delivering objective scientific input to disease strategy, target product profile, trial/endpoint design, go/no‑go criteria, and lifecycle sequencing.
  • Anchors development plans in unmet medical need and future evidence requirements of autoimmune hematology and other inflammatory diseases.
  • Leads the medical evidence and scientific communication strategy, including integrated evidence plans, early medical narratives, publication planning, and core scientific platforms.
  • Identifies and maps external experts across priority disease areas.
  • Builds and maintains credible, ethical scientific partnerships to inform development strategy, disease/treatment landscape insights, and patient/payer evidence expectations.
  • Represents Global Medical Affairs on Development Project Teams, governance forums, and key decision bodies.
  • Partners with Clinical Development/Early Research, Global Strategic Marketing, Global Value & Access, Regulatory, and other cross‑functional teams to advance pipeline assets.
  • Ensures medical insight is integrated early, consistently, and with clear decision impact.
  • Provides medical due diligence to support business development and partnering evaluations.
  • Shapes portfolio discussions by articulating scientific differentiation, evidence risk, and opportunity.

Specific Knowledge, Education, and Experience Requirements

  • Advanced scientific degree (MD, DO, PharmD, PhD, or equivalent) required, with at 8+ years of relevant industry/clinical experience required, preferably within the inflammation therapeutic area. MD/DO with training in hematology or an inflammation-related therapeutic area preferred (rheumatology, immunology, etc)
  • Excellent verbal, written, visual communication, and interpersonal skills are required
  • Ability to develop productive, credible collaborations with cross-functional partners
  • Strong qualitative and quantitative analytical skills demonstrated by the ability to identify and interpret complex issues. Opportunistic thinker with strong judgement and analytical mindset
  • Ability to synthesize findings and clearly articulate implications from multiple sources of information, and to formulate strong, actionable recommendations
  • Organized; attention to detail and ability to meet timelines in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously and effectively prioritize workload
  • Must be able to work with a level of autonomy and independence
  • Ability to travel to domestic and international conferences and internal meetings (15-20% expected)

People Leader Accountabilities:

  • Create Inclusion - knowing the business value of diverse teams, modeling inclusion, and embedding the value of diversity in the way they manage their teams.
  • Develop Talent - understand the skills, experience, aspirations and potential of their employees and coach them on current performance and future potential. They ensure employees are receiving the feedback and insight needed to grow, develop and realize their purpose.
  • Empower Teams - connect the team to the organization by aligning goals, purpose, and organizational objectives, and holding them to account. They provide the support needed to remove barriers and connect their team to the broader ecosystem.

As a Product Counsel, you will provide strategic legal guidance across the development, launch, and evolution of innovative technology products and digital platforms. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Compliance, and Sales teams to identify legal risks and develop practical solutions that support business growth and innovation.   • Provide strategic and practical legal advice to Product, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, and other business teams throughout the entire product development lifecycle, from initial concept and design through launch and ongoing improvements.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex legal concepts clearly, concisely, and effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A practical, solution-oriented mindset, with a strong commitment to customer service, collaboration, and continuous professional development.

title: Customer Relationship Management Manager
description:
Department : Customer Relationship Management (CRM)

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka

Reports To : CEO

Experience : Minimum 5 years, with at least 3 years in a CRM, customer experience, or dealer-relations leadership role

Qualification: Bachelor's degree in marketing, Business Administration, Information Technology, or MBA in a related field.

We are looking for the candidates who are currently based in Bangalore for this position.

About KisanKraft

KisanKraft Limited is a Bengaluru-headquartered agricultural equipment and power tools company, serving farmers across India through a dealer network of 5,000+ and exporting to 16+ countries worldwide. Our 46-acre manufacturing facility in Nellore anchors a business built on reliability, innovation, and farmer-first thinking.

As we scale our reach and deepen our farmer and dealer relationships, we are looking for a CRM Manager to lead the systems, processes, and people that keep our customers and channel partners at the center of everything we do.

Role Summary

The CRM Manager owns the development, execution, and continuous refinement of KisanKraft's multi-channel Customer and Dealer Relationship Management function — from lead management and complaint resolution to loyalty, retention, and dealer-engagement programs.

This is a hands-on, cross-functional role that requires strong project management, process discipline, data fluency, and the ability to work closely with Sales, IT, Branding, and Product teams to ensure every farmer and dealer interaction reflects KisanKraft's standards of trust and service.

You will need to set an example to other members of the CRM team.

Key Responsibilities

1. Customer & Dealer Relationship Management

• Own the end-to-end enquiry pipeline generated from website, calls, emails, social media, print, IndiaMART, exhibitions, and other sources — connecting with leads accurately and promptly. Afterwards routing the potential leads to the relevant sales team across India or to e-commerce purchase.

• Manage resolution of customer and dealer complaints by coordinating with the relevant service and sales personnel and tracking cases through to closure.

• Maintain and continuously update dealer master data and sales-team employee data, ensuring accuracy across all CRM and reporting systems.

• Continuous customer engagement through seasonal greetings, dealer offers/discount communications, social media leads follow-up, and other company announcements to dealers and employees through appropriate channels.

2. Sales Enablement & Lead Conversion

• Perform the first-level screening of incoming enquiries/leads to assess genuineness and purchase potential before routing them to the relevant sales team.

• Support the sales team in converting enquiries to closed sales through structured daily follow-ups, reminders, and lead-nurturing cadences.

• Track lead-to-conversion funnel performance and flag drop-off points to Sales leadership for corrective action.

• Drive initiatives to increase e-commerce purchase conversion and repeat online orders from dealers and customers.

• Manage paid communication and campaigns to dealers and customers for promotions, product updates, and service alerts.

3. CRM Systems, Data & Analytics

• Analyze CRM team performance and productivity — enquiry volumes, response times, resolution rates, conversion rates — and maintain an up-to-date performance tracker/dashboard.

• Work with the Branding and IT teams to keep e-commerce lead and customer data clean and accurate.

• Own implementation and ongoing maintenance of CRM-related IT projects, including periodic upgrades and issue resolution.

• Coordinate with IT teams to update and design inhouse CRM system.

4. Training & Content Development

• Create and maintain user manuals for KisanKraft products, keeping content current as the product portfolio evolves.

• Develop training content on agricultural products and power tools.

• Localize training and customer-facing content into regional and other country languages to serve KisanKraft's pan-India and global dealer and farmer base.

5. Branding & Marketing Support

• Provide coordinated support to the Branding, Marketing and Sales team on farmer events, exhibitions, and campaigns to improve customer engagement.

What We're Looking For

• Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to juggle multiple CRM workstreams simultaneously.

• Comfort with CRM tools, dealer/customer databases, and basic data analysis; exposure to web/app analytics is a plus.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills; multilingual ability (including regional Indian languages, Hindi, and English) is a strong advantage.

• A process-oriented, farmer- and dealer-first mindset, with the ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, IT, Branding, and zonal teams.

• Prior experience in agri-equipment, industrial products, FMCG, or a dealer/distributor-led business is preferred.

Travel

Occasional travel is required to visit exhibitions, dealers, customers, farmer events, and branches across India.

title: Candidate Engagement & Endorsements Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Candidate Engagement & Endorsements Manager based in the United States.

The Candidate Engagement & Endorsements Manager will lead candidate recruitment and endorsement strategies designed to strengthen environmental advocacy through political engagement. This role focuses on identifying and encouraging values-aligned individuals to run for local and state elected office, particularly those from communities directly affected by environmental issues. Working closely with internal leadership, policy teams, and external partners, the successful candidate will build lasting relationships, provide mentorship, and assess candidates for political endorsements. The position combines long-term electoral planning with the flexibility to respond to unexpected election opportunities. It also involves shaping endorsement criteria, coordinating candidate evaluations, and supporting broader voter engagement initiatives. This is a full-time opportunity for an experienced political professional passionate about environmental justice, inclusive representation, and meaningful political change.

Accountabilities:

The Candidate Engagement & Endorsements Manager will oversee candidate recruitment and the endorsement process, ensuring that political engagement strategies reflect organizational values and long-term priorities. The role requires close collaboration with leadership, internal departments, coalitions, and external partners to identify promising candidates, evaluate their suitability, and support their development.

  • Lead the candidate endorsement program and uphold its fundamental principles, values, and strategic priorities.

  • Identify and recruit potential candidates for local and state elected offices, with particular attention to individuals from communities directly affected by environmental issues.

  • Build and maintain values-based relationships with prospective candidates, encouraging them to pursue public office and providing mentorship or technical coaching when appropriate.

  • Develop and refine the criteria, evaluation frameworks, and rationale used to recruit and endorse candidates.

  • Draft candidate questionnaires and coordinate their distribution, review, and evaluation.

  • Organize candidate endorsement meetings and conduct interviews to assess candidates' qualifications, priorities, and alignment with strategic objectives.

  • Lead internal discussions with relevant teams to review candidate responses and gather feedback.

  • Make final endorsement recommendations to senior leadership and, when necessary, the organization's President.

  • Collaborate across departments to identify priority races and provide strategic support to electoral leadership.

  • Cultivate partnerships with peer organizations, coalitions, and relevant stakeholders.

  • Support political fundraising initiatives in collaboration with development teams.

  • Assist with voter contact strategies and related electoral activities when needed.

  • Track the work of endorsed and recruited candidates after they take office to support accountability.

  • Ensure that recruitment and endorsement decisions reflect the organization's Justice Framework and commitment to diverse representation.

  • Support legal compliance across campaigns and organizational activities.

  • Recruit, hire, and supervise additional staff when appropriate.

  • Formulate and monitor budgets related to the program.

Requirements:

The ideal candidate will bring substantial experience in political campaigns, candidate recruitment, and endorsement programs, combined with a strong understanding of political advocacy and coalition-building. They should demonstrate excellent communication and leadership abilities, sound political judgment, and a proven capacity to develop trusted relationships with candidates and partners.

  • Bachelor's degree required; Juris Doctor (JD) preferred.

  • At least six years of relevant political experience, including work on political campaigns, independent expenditure activities, and/or within 501(c)(4) organizations.

  • Experience in legal advocacy involving government entities or nonprofit organizations.

  • Demonstrated experience managing candidate endorsement programs involving state, local, and federal candidates.

  • Extensive experience and a successful track record in cultivating and recruiting individuals to run for elected office.

  • Experience with legal advocacy that can inform efforts to recruit lawyers for judicial positions.

  • Strong understanding of 501(c)(4) organizations and/or substantial political campaign experience.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear and effective external-facing materials.

  • Proven leadership and team management capabilities.

  • Experience developing and managing budgets.

  • Strong interpersonal, relationship-building, and stakeholder engagement skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to establish, maintain, and strengthen relationships with coalitions and partner organizations.

  • Ability to work collaboratively across departments and with senior leadership.

  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically approximately 15% of the time.

  • Residence within 90 minutes of a major commercial airport offering frequent nationwide flights.

  • Ability to work remotely from within the contiguous United States or in a hybrid arrangement from an office, subject to available space.

Benefits:

  • Competitive annual salary based on work location and relevant experience:

  • San Francisco, CA and New York, NY: $158,500–$176,100.

  • Seattle, WA, Washington, DC, Chicago, IL, and Los Angeles, CA: $150,600–$167,300.

  • Texas, Florida, and Bozeman, MT: $134,700–$149,700.

title: Credit Analyst - Credit Initiation
description:
Job Summary

This role exists to support sustainable retail portfolio growth by making prudent, timely and consistent credit decisions for mortgage and wealth management products. The role evaluates customers creditworthiness, risk exposure, affordability and application quality to ensure lending decisions align with the Bank's credit policies, risk appetite, regulatory obligations and business objectives.

The role balances risk management with customer experience by ensuring credit applications are assessed accurately, efficiently and consistently. It contributes to portfolio quality, operational effectiveness and business growth through sound underwriting judgement, risk assessment and continuous process improvement.

The role also supports the evolution of credit operations by identifying opportunities to improve turnaround times, strengthen controls, support product launches and contribute to operational initiatives that enhance service delivery and decision-making effectiveness. Where applicable, the role provides operational guidance, supports team capability development and helps maintain underwriting consistency across the function.

Key Responsibilities

Credit Assessment & Underwriting

  • Assess retail mortgage and wealth management applications to deliver prudent credit decisions that balance customer needs with portfolio risk objectives.
  • Evaluate customer financial profiles, affordability, repayment capacity and credit history to determine appropriate lending outcomes.
  • Apply credit policies, underwriting standards and delegated authorities consistently to support high-quality credit decision-making.
  • Escalate complex or higher-risk cases appropriately to ensure sound risk governance and decision integrity.

Credit Risk & Fraud Management

  • Identify, assess and mitigate credit and fraud risks that may affect portfolio quality or customer outcomes.
  • Apply regulatory requirements and internal risk controls to ensure lending decisions remain compliant and defensible.
  • Detect indicators of potential fraud, misrepresentation or suspicious activity and initiate appropriate escalation processes.
  • Support a strong risk culture through disciplined application of credit policies and controls.

Operational Excellence & Process Improvement

  • Improve underwriting efficiency by identifying process enhancements that reduce turnaround times while maintaining control effectiveness.
  • Contribute to operational initiatives that enhance service quality, productivity and customer experience.
  • Support the implementation of new products, policy changes and process enhancements to ensure operational readiness.
  • Use operational insights and performance trends to recommend improvements in credit assessment and workflow management.

Business Support & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Partner with Product, Sales, CRM, Fraud Risk, Lending Operations and support teams to facilitate effective credit assessment and application processing.

title: Process Manager - Fin Ops
description:
Job Summary

The Finance Manager, Accounting - India is responsible for leading and developing supervisors, accounting professionals, and support staff across assigned accounting functions. The role translates Accounting and Finance strategy, policies, and business priorities into clear operating plans, measurable objectives, and consistent execution.

This leader is accountable for people leadership, service delivery, process improvement, and partnership with global stakeholders. The scope includes accounts payable, accounts receivable and cash application, close support, reporting, supplier and customer accounting, employee expenses, and other accounting activities assigned to the India team.

Business needs, systems, organizational structures, and accounting priorities will continue to evolve. The Finance Manager must be flexible and willing to take on new or changing responsibilities, reallocate team capacity, and lead work outside the role's initial scope when needed. Duties may be added, removed, or reassigned to support business continuity, growth, transformation, and changing operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities

· Provide visible, hands-on people leadership; set clear expectations, coach performance, build accountability, and create development and succession plans.

· Build an inclusive, high-performing team culture grounded in trust, ownership, timely communication, collaboration, and continuous learning.

· Manage employee performance and employee relations matters in partnership with Human Resources, including feedback, recognition, development plans, corrective action, and performance improvement plans when appropriate.

· Assess workforce capacity, skills, and organizational design; coordinate recruiting, onboarding, cross-training, backup coverage, and retention plans to meet current and future needs.

· Lead staff meetings and operating reviews; communicate business priorities, decisions, risks, and changes, and ensure action items are completed on time.

· Own the performance of assigned accounting operations against service levels, departmental strategy, controls, and key performance indicators.

· Plan, organize, and control daily, monthly, quarterly, and year-end activities, including appropriate assignment of work, prioritization, review, escalation, and continuity coverage.

· Oversee assigned accounts payable activities, which may include supplier onboarding, invoice processing, vendor payments, expense reimbursements, cash forecasting, statutory reporting, and resolution of complex supplier or payment issues.

· Oversee assigned accounts receivable activities, which includes receipt and remittance processing, cash application, posting, reconciliation, customer accounting, collections support, and resolution of complex unapplied cash or customer issues.

· Support additional accounting responsibilities such as balance sheet reconciliations, close activities, journal entries, reporting, master data, audit support, and other finance processes as assigned.

· Ensure accounting transactions are timely, accurate, complete, properly authorized, and supported by appropriate documentation in accordance with company policy and applicable accounting requirements.

· Develop and monitor dashboards, service levels, and KPIs. Identify root causes, implement corrective actions, and provide concise reporting on performance, risks, capacity, and improvement plans.

· Analyze processes and lead simplification, standardization, automation, and self-service initiatives that improve accuracy, cycle time, customer or supplier experience, scalability, and control effectiveness.

· Serve as a change leader who can explain the reason for change, gain alignment, address resistance, and sustain new processes and behaviors.

· Build strong working relationships across cultures, locations, and time zones; provide appropriate overlap with global teams and participate in meetings outside standard India business hours when business needs require it.

· Manage escalations with sound judgment, communicate risks early, and recommend practical solutions that balance service, control, cost, and business impact.

· Participate in or lead cross-functional projects, system implementations, migrations, shared-services transitions, and other strategic initiatives.

· Travel domestically or internationally as needed.

· Perform other duties and lead additional accounting or finance activities as assigned. The nature and scope of responsibilities may change based on business priorities, organizational needs, technology, regulatory requirements, and team capability.

People Leadership Expectations

· Lead through managers and supervisors while remaining close enough to the work to understand risks, remove barriers, and make informed decisions.

· Establish measurable goals and consistently follow up on commitments, quality, timeliness, and behaviors.

· Develop critical thinking and problem-solving capability rather than creating dependence on the manager for routine decisions.

· Provide regular coaching, career discussions, and actionable feedback; recognize strong performance and address gaps promptly and fairly.

· Create cross-training and succession coverage for critical processes and leadership roles.

· Model professionalism, integrity, adaptability, inclusion, and accountability.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

· Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

· Typically 12 or more years of progressive accounting or finance experience, including at least 3 years of people leadership experience. Experience leading managers or supervisors is preferred.

· Strong working knowledge of accounting operations, reconciliations, internal controls, audit support, and period-end processes. Experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash application, or shared services is strongly preferred.

· Demonstrated ability to lead teams through changing priorities, ambiguous requirements, process transitions, and organizational change.

· Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, prioritization, and decision-making skills.

· Ability to interpret operational data, establish meaningful KPIs, identify root causes, and drive sustainable corrective action.

· Strong verbal and written English communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively with employees, senior leaders, and global stakeholders.

· Ability to build credibility and productive relationships across functions, cultures, and time zones.

· High attention to detail, sound judgment, professionalism, customer and supplier focus, and commitment to confidentiality and ethical conduct.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and experience with a major ERP or financial system. Experience with Oracle Fusion or similar cloud ERP platforms is preferred.

· Professional accounting qualification such as CA, CMA, ACCA, or CPA is preferred but not required unless mandated by local business needs.

Working Conditions and Flexibility

This role is based in India and may support teams and stakeholders in multiple countries and time zones. The work arrangement, office attendance expectations, schedule overlap, travel, and assigned responsibilities are subject to change based on business needs. The employee must be able to adapt working hours reasonably to support critical close activities, projects, escalations, and global collaboration, while following company policy and applicable local requirements.

Success Measures

· A capable, engaged, and accountable team with strong leadership depth and succession coverage.

· Consistent achievement of quality, timeliness, productivity, service, and control KPIs.

· Timely resolution of operational risks, audit items, aged transactions, and stakeholder escalations.

· Measurable improvements in process standardization, automation, scalability, and customer or supplier experience.

· Effective execution of changing business priorities without loss of control, service continuity, or employee engagement.

title: Google Merchant Center Specialist -Full-Time
description:
About Vysta

Vysta Paid Media Group specializes in Google and YouTube advertising for ecommerce brands. Strong Merchant Center accounts and high-quality product feeds are essential to our clients performance. We're hiring a dedicated specialist to own that foundation across our client portfolio.

The Role

Your mission is simple: keep our clients Google Merchant Center accounts healthy, compliant, accurate, and ready to support profitable growth.

You'll own day-to-day account health, product-feed optimization, issue resolution, and proactive monitoring. We need someone who spots problems before they disrupt campaigns, fixes root causes rather than symptoms, and follows through until the resolution is verified.

Strong, hands-on AI proficiency is a requirement—not a nice-to-have. You should already use AI to accelerate analysis, troubleshoot technical issues, improve product data, and build repeatable workflows while maintaining human quality control.

This is a dedicated Merchant Center and feed-operations role, not a generalist media-buying position.

What You'll Own
  • Daily account health: Monitor product eligibility, disapprovals, warnings, account issues, feed-processing errors, and unexpected drops in eligible inventory. Prioritize issues affecting best-selling products and active campaigns.
  • Troubleshooting and resolution: Resolve price and availability mismatches, missing or invalid attributes, identifier issues, image problems, broken product URLs, variant errors, and feed-sync failures.
  • Policy compliance: Review product data and website consistency, including business information, shipping, returns, and product claims. Coordinate corrections and manage support cases and review requests where appropriate—without policy workarounds.
  • Feed optimization: Improve titles, de ions, categories, product types, images, identifiers, variant attributes, and custom labels using accurate product information and relevant search intent.
  • Feed infrastructure: Manage data sources, feed rules, supplemental data, scheduled updates, and ecommerce integrations. Keep Merchant Center aligned with actual store prices, inventory, and product details.
  • Launch readiness: QA new products, catalog changes, seasonal promotions, and market expansions before they affect live campaigns.
  • AI-assisted operations: Use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini for feed audits, structured data cleanup, troubleshooting, documentation, and workflow improvement. Validate outputs before implementation and protect client data.
  • Ownership and communication: Maintain an account-health tracker, clear priorities, change logs, and reusable SOPs. Work with media buyers, account leads, developers, and clients to close issues and verify results.
What We're Looking For
  • Proven hands-on experience managing Google Merchant Center and ecommerce product feeds, ideally across multiple brands or agency accounts.
  • A track record of resolving product disapprovals, feed errors, and account-level policy issues—not just identifying them.
  • Strong knowledge of product-data requirements and how feed quality and eligibility affect Google Shopping and Performance Max.
  • Practical experience with Shopify and feed-management tools such as DataFeedWatch, Feedonomics, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong spreadsheet skills for auditing, reconciling, and improving large product catalogs.
  • Demonstrable AI proficiency beyond basic copywriting: you can explain a workflow you built, how you validated its output, and what it improved.
  • Excellent attention to detail, clear written English, and the ability to manage priorities independently in a remote team.

title: Director BD
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Business Development based in the United States.

As Director of Business Development, you will lead global business development operations and drive sustainable revenue growth through strategic sales initiatives and new client acquisition. You will own the entire new business development lifecycle, from market strategy and prospecting to negotiations and contract execution. Leading and developing a high-performing team of Business Development Managers and Sales Development Representatives, you will establish scalable processes and build a predictable sales pipeline. You will focus on acquiring software vendors across the US market while developing strategic partnerships and expanding commercial opportunities. Working closely with Marketing and Client Success teams, you will ensure alignment across the customer acquisition journey. This fully remote leadership opportunity is ideal for a commercially driven professional with strong B2B SaaS expertise and a proven track record of exceeding ambitious growth targets.

Accountabilities:

You will oversee the business development strategy, lead revenue generation initiatives, and build a high-performing sales organization capable of delivering consistent commercial results. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Develop and execute the overall Business Development strategy to achieve ambitious revenue growth objectives.

  • Own quarterly and annual revenue targets, sales pipeline performance, and software vendor acquisition goals.

  • Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Business Development Managers and Sales Development Representatives.

  • Drive outbound sales initiatives targeting software vendors across the United States.

  • Design and implement scalable prospecting strategies using cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, referrals, and strategic partnerships.

  • Identify, engage, negotiate, and secure new software vendor partnerships.

  • Lead complex negotiations and close mid-market and enterprise-level contracts.

  • Build and maintain a healthy, predictable sales pipeline while ensuring accurate forecasting.

  • Monitor and optimize key sales performance indicators, including pipeline generation, conversion rates, sales velocity, average deal size, and win rates.

  • Establish, refine, and implement sales processes, playbooks, and best practices to improve team efficiency.

  • Collaborate with Marketing to align demand generation strategies with business development objectives.

  • Partner with Client Success to ensure smooth client onboarding and transition following contract execution.

  • Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer insights to identify new business opportunities.

  • Represent the organization at industry events, conferences, networking forums, and strategic business meetings.

  • Prepare regular sales forecasts, performance analyses, and strategic reports for executive leadership.

Requirements:

The ideal candidate is an experienced business development leader with a strong background in enterprise sales, B2B SaaS, and team management. You should combine strategic thinking and commercial expertise with hands-on sales leadership, analytical capabilities, and excellent communication skills.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related discipline. An MBA is considered an advantage.

  • 8–12 years of experience in Business Development, Enterprise Sales, or B2B SaaS Sales.

  • At least 3–5 years of experience leading Business Development or Sales teams.

  • Mandatory experience selling to the US market.

  • Proven track record of consistently achieving and exceeding revenue targets.

  • Strong expertise in enterprise and consultative sales, including complex and multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Experience selling SaaS solutions, technology products, software marketplaces, or digital services is highly preferred.

  • Hands-on experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.

  • Proficiency in sales intelligence and prospecting tools, including Apollo, ZoomInfo, Seamless.ai, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

  • Excellent negotiation, presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Strong commercial acumen and the ability to identify, evaluate, and capitalize on growth opportunities.

  • Analytical mindset with experience using sales metrics, pipeline reporting, and forecasting to drive business performance.

  • Demonstrated ability to recruit, coach, motivate, and develop high-performing sales teams.

  • Strong leadership and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Highly self-motivated, results-oriented, and comfortable working in a performance-driven organization.

  • Native or near-native English proficiency, with excellent written and verbal communication skills suited to US business environments.

Benefits:

  • Fully remote work arrangement.

  • Leadership opportunity within a growing global business development function.

  • Opportunity to shape and execute commercial strategy across the US software market.

  • Responsibility for building and developing a high-performing international sales organization.

  • Exposure to the B2B SaaS ecosystem, software vendors, and enterprise-level partnerships.

  • Opportunity to work cross-functionally with Marketing, Client Success, and executive leadership.

  • Dynamic, fast-paced environment with significant opportunities to influence business growth and organizational development.

title: Senior IAM - SSO MFA Engineer -0-15 day ONLY, F2F Interview mandatory
description:
Senior IAM / SSO & MFA Engineer

Job Requisition (JR) & RH ID: 1493837 & 896119

Location: Pune or Chennai (Hybrid)

Experience Required: 8 – 14 Years (Minimum 10 years of hands-on IAM experience preferred)

Shift Timings: 24x5 Support / On-Call Rotation (including night shifts)

Interview Process: Client Interview (Face-to-Face / F2F Mandatory)

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Identity and Access Management (IAM) Engineer on a 6-month contract basis in Pune or Chennai. In this technical, hands-on role, you will design, implement, troubleshoot, and manage enterprise IAM solutions with a primary focus on Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). You will collaborate closely with application owners, infrastructure, security teams, and third-party vendors to enable secure authentication and strengthen the organization's Zero Trust architecture.

Key Responsibilities

  • L3 Support & Incident Management: Provide L3 technical support and Subject Matter Expert (SME)-level troubleshooting for SSO, MFA, and identity authentication issues, resolving incidents and service tickets within defined SLAs.
  • SSO & Federation Engineering: Design, implement, and troubleshoot SSO integrations for enterprise and SaaS applications using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC) protocols.
  • Microsoft Entra ID Administration: Configure and manage Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) Enterprise Applications, App Registrations, Service Principals, authentication policies, and day-to-day Active Directory tasks.
  • MFA & Conditional Access: Implement and manage MFA and Conditional Access policies aligned with business and security requirements.
  • Application Onboarding: Lead end-to-end application onboarding to SSO—covering requirements gathering, configuration, claims/attribute mapping, UAT, and production rollout.
  • Deep-Dive Troubleshooting & Monitoring: Resolve complex authentication issues involving federation, claims, tokens, and certificates; monitor sign-in activity and investigate failures using Entra ID logs and security tools.
  • Automation & Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IAM, SSO, and MFA operational tasks to improve efficiency.
  • Governance, RCA & Mentoring: Participate in major incident resolution and Root-Cause Analysis (RCA), maintain technical documentation and SOPs, ensure compliance with Zero Trust principles, and mentor L2 IAM engineers.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience: 8 to 14 years of overall IT experience, including a minimum of 10 years of hands-on IAM / Identity Engineering experience and 3+ years at an L3/SME level supporting enterprise SSO/MFA environments.
  • Core IAM & Cloud Identity: Deep hands-on expertise with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) (Enterprise Apps, App Registrations, Service Principals) alongside Active Directory and hybrid identity environments.
  • Authentication Protocols: Proven experience implementing and troubleshooting SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, and OIDC, including claims, attributes, token configuration, certificates, and federation concepts.
  • Security & Access Policies: Strong command of Conditional Access, MFA, authentication methods, identity protection, RBAC, least privilege, Zero Trust, and identity lifecycle concepts.
  • Troubleshooting & Automation: Strong diagnostic skills using sign-in and application-side logs, paired with PowerShell or ing experience for IAM automation.
  • ITSM & Processes: Working knowledge of ITIL practices and hands-on experience with ServiceNow.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with third-party Identity Providers (IdPs) or federation platforms.
  • Experience integrating externally hosted and SaaS applications with enterprise IAM platforms.
  • Knowledge of SCIM-based user provisioning and automated application lifecycle management.
  • Familiarity with PKI, digital certificates, TLS, and application authentication dependencies.

Soft Skills & Operational Readiness

  • Communication & Documentation: Clear verbal and written communication skills to coordinate across technical teams and produce clean configuration standards and troubleshooting guides.
  • Analytical & Customer-Focused: Structured root-cause troubleshooting mindset paired with strong customer service orientation and SLA-driven priority management.
  • Shift & Interview Availability: Must be willing to work in a 24x5 rotational shift/on-call model (including night shifts) and be available for a mandatory Face-to-Face (F2F) client interview in Pune or Chennai.

title: Presales Consultant
description:
Job Title: Presales Consultant – Payments Domain

Location: Chennai (Siruseri), Tamil Nadu(Work From Office)

Experience: 4 – 10 Years


Role Overview


We are looking for a dynamic Presales Consultant with strong Payments domain expertise to join our team in Chennai. Acting as the strategic bridge between Sales, Product Management, Architecture, and Delivery, you will translate complex banking requirements into compelling payment transformation propositions, lead solutioning workshops, orchestrate high-impact product demonstrations, and own RFP/RFI responses to drive deal closures across global markets.


Key Responsibilities


  • Discovery & Consultative Value Selling: Engage with banking executives, transaction banking heads, and operations leaders to understand payment modernization priorities, legacy pain points, and revenue drivers. Articulate measurable business outcomes, ROI, and value propositions aligned with client goals.
  • Solutioning & Proposal Development: Design tailored, end-to-end payment solutions leveraging Intellect’s cloud-native Payments Hub capabilities. Create scope documents, high-level integration topologies, effort estimates, implementation plans, and commercial inputs.
  • Product Demonstrations & Client Workshops: Conduct tailored product demos, discovery workshops, and proof-of-concept (PoC) sessions. Build payment-specific demo scenarios and user journeys that align directly with client use cases and regional clearing mandates.
  • RFP / RFI & Bid Ownership: Lead and manage end-to-end responses to complex RFPs, RFIs, and due diligence questionnaires. Ensure functional, technical, and regulatory write-ups are accurate, differentiated, and aligned with customer requirements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product Management, Enterprise Architects, and Engineering teams to validate solution feasibility, API extensions, localization requirements, and delivery risks.
  • Sales Enablement & Market Feedback: Equip global sales teams with pitch decks, competitive battle cards, demo scripts, and ROI calculators. Capture market trends, regulatory shifts, and client feedback from pursuits to inform the product roadmap.
  • Transition to Delivery: Ensure a seamless handover from Sales to Delivery post-deal closure by clearly documenting agreed scope, architectural assumptions, custom commitments, and risks.


Required Qualifications & Skills


  • Experience: 4 to 10 years of experience in BFSI Presales, Solution Consulting, Product Management, or Functional Consulting specifically within the Payments / Transaction Banking domain.
  • Education: Full-time MBA / PGDM from a Tier-1 or Tier-2 institution.
  • Deep Payments Domain Knowledge: Hands-on functional understanding of end-to-end payment lifecycles—including payment initiation, validation, routing, clearing, settlement, liquidity/nostro management, and reconciliation.
  • Payment Rails & Messaging Standards: Strong familiarity with domestic and cross-border payment rails and schemes (e.g., ISO 20022, SWIFT, SEPA, FedNow / RTP, Faster Payments, UPI / IMPS / RTGS / NEFT).
  • Technical & Architectural Acumen: Working knowledge of cloud-native architectures, microservices, Open Banking APIs, payment hubs, and integration with Core Banking Systems (CBS), AML/Sanctions screening, and fraud engines.
  • Presales Execution: Proven track record of leading RFP/RFI responses, running discovery workshops, and delivering persuasive product demonstrations to both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional storytelling, presentation, and consultative selling skills with the confidence to engage senior banking stakeholders (CIOs, Heads of Payments, Enterprise Architects).


Preferred Qualifications


  • Prior experience working with a modern Payments Hub or Transaction Banking software vendor.
  • Exposure to international banking markets (Middle East, Europe, APAC, or North America) and willingness to travel occasionally for client workshops and pitches.
  • Knowledge of emerging payment trends such as Request-to-Pay (R2P), cross-border instant payments, and CBDCs.

title: Project Manager III
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project Manager III based in the United States.

The Project Manager III will lead complex projects from contract award through final delivery, ensuring they are completed on schedule, within budget, and to customer expectations. Acting as the primary point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders, you will coordinate cross-functional teams across design, engineering, procurement, manufacturing, and installation. You will oversee project financials, manage schedules and costs, address technical challenges, and proactively mitigate risks and variances. This role requires strong leadership and communication skills, along with the ability to manage vendor relationships and maintain customer satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle. You will also contribute to continuous improvement by applying established project management practices and mentoring junior colleagues. The position follows a hybrid working arrangement and is available in several U.S. locations.

Accountabilities:

As Project Manager III, you will take ownership of all aspects of assigned projects, coordinating internal resources and external partners to ensure successful execution. You will balance operational, financial, and customer priorities while providing clear direction, resolving issues, and maintaining visibility into project performance.

  • Serve as the primary interface between customers and internal project stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Monitor and control project schedules and costs, identify deviations, and implement corrective actions to mitigate variances.

  • Review, interpret, and manage customer specifications, contractual obligations, and project requirements.

  • Draft, review, and issue project change orders, ensuring changes are properly documented and communicated.

  • Provide regular project updates to customers, management, and relevant internal stakeholders.

  • Lead and coordinate in-house teams across design, engineering, procurement, manufacturing, and installation activities.

  • Provide technical guidance and support problem resolution to keep projects progressing effectively.

  • Coordinate material purchasing requirements, prepare requisitions, and monitor vendor performance and delivery progress.

  • Manage customer invoicing and follow up on overdue payments.

  • Ensure compliance with established company processes, procedures, and project management standards.

  • Maintain project management tools, methodologies, and best practices.

  • Prepare and deliver management reviews covering assigned project performance, progress, and key issues.

  • Mentor junior project management staff and support their professional development.

Requirements:

The ideal candidate brings extensive project management experience, preferably within a manufacturing environment, and a strong track record of delivering complex projects involving multiple stakeholders and business functions. You should combine financial and operational expertise with effective leadership, technical understanding, and the ability to communicate confidently at all organizational levels.

  • At least 8 years of relevant project management experience, preferably in manufacturing.

  • Extensive experience managing high-impact projects involving multiple stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

  • Proven ability to develop and manage project financials, including forecasting, cost accruals, and financial reconciliation.

  • Experience managing vendor relationships, expectations, and performance.

  • Demonstrated leadership, team-building, and mentoring capabilities.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to engage effectively with customers, management, and internal teams.

  • Familiarity with industry standards and codes such as ASME, B31, ASTM, AWS, and OSHA, or equivalent international standards, is an advantage.

  • Excellent computer skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office and Microsoft Project.

  • Experience using Quickbase is beneficial; familiarity with JD Edwards is a plus.

  • Ability to work in both office and production-floor environments, including sitting, standing, walking, stooping, and bending.

  • Ability to lift up to 15 pounds.

Benefits:

  • Hybrid working arrangement.

  • Work location options in New Prague, Minnesota; Tulsa, Oklahoma; or Theodore, Alabama.

  • Opportunity to lead high-impact, cross-functional projects from contract award through completion.

  • Exposure to a broad range of project activities, including engineering, procurement, manufacturing, and installation.
