title: Principal Business Analyst – US P&C Insurance & Product Specialist
description:
Job Description

Principal Business Analyst – Insurance Domain & Product Specialist

Company: Solartis Location: Chennai, India Experience: 12–18 Years Function: Product Engineering / Business Analysis / Insurance Domain Employment Type: Full-time Domain Preference: US Property & Casualty (P&C) Insurance / InsurTech

1. Role Overview

Techfully is looking for a highly experienced Principal Business Analyst – Insurance Domain & Product Specialist to strengthen its insurance domain expertise, product analysis capabilities, and functional delivery excellence.

The individual will play a critical role in bridging the gap between complex insurance business requirements, Solartis platform capabilities, product configuration, and engineering implementation.

The role requires a combination of deep insurance domain expertise, strong business analysis capabilities, product functional knowledge, and the ability to independently lead complex requirements and product definition initiatives.

The successful candidate will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Customer Engineering, QA, and AI Engineering teams to translate insurance business concepts into structured product definitions, functional specifications, business rules, workflows, validations, and implementation-ready requirements.

An important part of this role is to build organizational knowledge and improve the competency of junior Business Analysts through mentoring, structured knowledge sharing, functional reviews, and reusable documentation.

This is a senior individual-contributor and functional leadership role. The person is expected to be hands-on with complex insurance analysis while providing functional guidance and mentoring to the broader BA organization.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Insurance Domain Expertise and Functional Leadership



Act as a subject matter expert in US P&C insurance business processes, products, and workflows.



Interpret complex insurance product documentation, policy forms, rating manuals, underwriting guidelines, and regulatory requirements.

 Develop a deep understanding of insurance product structures, coverages,

limits, deductibles, endorsements, exclusions, and policy conditions.

 Understand insurance product configuration, rating methodologies,

underwriting rules, and policy lifecycle processes.

 Provide functional guidance to Business Analysts, Product Managers,

Architects, and Engineering teams.

 Identify missing, ambiguous, contradictory, or incomplete insurance

requirements.

 Validate functional interpretations against insurance business practices and

applicable source documentation.

 Establish standardized insurance terminology, definitions, and reusable

functional reference models.

 Act as a point of escalation for complex insurance domain questions and

functional interpretation.

B. Complex Business Analysis and Requirement Management

 Independently lead complex business analysis initiatives from discovery

through functional specification and validation.

 Conduct requirement discovery workshops with customers, business

stakeholders, product teams, and internal SMEs.

 Analyse business requirements and convert them into detailed functional

specifications.

 Define business processes, functional workflows, business rules, field

metadata, dependencies, and validations.

 Develop detailed user stories, epics, acceptance criteria, and functional

requirement documents.

 Identify functional gaps, process exceptions, business dependencies, and

edge cases.

 Evaluate the impact of requirement changes across products, workflows,

rating, underwriting, forms, and integrations.

 Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, traceable, and

implementation-ready.

 Independently manage complex requirements without continuous supervision

from existing senior BAs.

 Review and validate functional deliverables prepared by junior and

intermediate BAs.

C. Insurance Product Definition and Configuration

 Lead functional analysis of insurance product definitions and product

configuration requirements.

 Translate insurance product manuals and related documents into structured

product definitions.

 Define product hierarchy, product attributes, coverages, limits, deductibles,

rating factors, and underwriting conditions.

 Analyse insurance rating methodologies, rating tables, factors, formulas,

modifiers, and calculation dependencies.

 Interpret state-specific insurance variations, product exceptions, and

applicability rules.

 Define policy forms, endorsements, form applicability, and document-related

functional requirements.

 Identify statistical coding and regulatory reporting requirements where

applicable.

 Ensure insurance product definitions are consistent across source documents

and functional specifications.

 Work with platform specialists to determine how insurance product concepts

should be represented in Solartis.

 Identify reusable product capabilities versus customer-specific requirements.

D. Solartis Platform Functional Expertise

 Develop a comprehensive understanding of Solartis platform capabilities,

architecture, configuration mechanisms, and functional workflows.

 Understand how insurance products are represented and configured within

the Solartis platform.

 Analyse product requirements against existing platform functionality and

configuration options.

 Identify standard platform capabilities, configuration opportunities, extension

requirements, and functional gaps.

 Work with solution architects and engineering leads to validate functional

feasibility.

 Help define reusable configuration patterns and standardized functional

implementation approaches.

 Maintain functional documentation covering platform capabilities, limitations,

dependencies, and implementation patterns.

 Support platform knowledge transfer to new BAs and other engineering

teams.

 Participate in functional design reviews, solution walkthroughs, and product

acceptance activities.

E. Product Management Support and Product Capability Development

 Collaborate with Product Managers to evaluate customer requirements and

identify opportunities for common product capabilities.

 Identify recurring customer requirements that can be converted into reusable

platform features.

 Provide functional inputs for product roadmap planning and backlog

prioritization.

 Evaluate the business impact, functional complexity, dependencies, and

implementation implications of proposed features.

 Challenge requirements that introduce unnecessary customization or

duplicate existing functionality.

 Contribute to product capability documentation, functional specifications, and

feature acceptance criteria.

 Support product demonstrations and functional walkthroughs when required.

 Help maintain alignment between customer requirements, product strategy,

and platform capabilities.

F. Business Analyst Mentoring and Capability Development

 Act as a functional mentor for junior and intermediate Business Analysts.

 Guide BAs in insurance domain understanding, requirement analysis,

functional documentation, and platform knowledge.

 Conduct regular knowledge-sharing sessions on P&C insurance concepts and

Solartis platform capabilities.

 Review BA deliverables and provide structured feedback.

 Establish templates, standards, checklists, and functional documentation

guidelines.

 Create reusable examples of insurance product definitions, business rules,

rating specifications, and workflows.

 Develop practical learning paths and competency assessments for junior BAs.

 Gradually enable junior BAs to independently handle standard and

moderately complex requirements.

 Reduce dependency on existing senior BAs for routine requirement

clarification and functional reviews.

G. AI-Assisted Business Analysis and Knowledge Management

 Collaborate with AI Engineering teams to identify opportunities to automate

repetitive business analysis activities.

 Provide insurance domain expertise for AI-assisted insurance document

understanding and product digitization.

 Define expected extraction structures for insurance products, coverages,

rating factors, underwriting rules, and forms.

 Validate AI-generated insurance product definitions and functional

requirements.

 Help establish canonical insurance data models, business terminology, and

domain taxonomies.

 Define business validation rules and exception scenarios for AI-generated

outputs.

 Contribute to AI-assisted requirements generation, test case generation, and

functional validation workflows.

 Help create an approved insurance domain knowledge repository containing

validated business concepts, examples, and reusable functional patterns.

 Ensure that AI-generated insurance interpretations are traceable to source

documents and validated by authorized domain experts.

3. Insurance Domain Knowledge – Mandatory / Strongly Preferred

Strong experience in US P&C insurance is highly preferred.

The candidate should have substantial knowledge of:

Insurance Product and Policy Lifecycle

 Property & Casualty insurance products.

 Policy administration and policy lifecycle management.

 Quote, rating, underwriting, binding, issuance, endorsement, renewal, and

cancellation.

 Carrier, MGA, broker, and agent operating models.

Insurance Product Configuration

 Product definitions and product structures.

 Coverages, limits, deductibles, exclusions, and endorsements.

 Insurance forms and form applicability.

 State-specific product variations.

 Product eligibility and underwriting rules.

Rating and Underwriting

 Insurance rating methodologies.

 Rating factors, rating tables, and calculation rules.

 Premium calculation and rating dependencies.

 Underwriting eligibility, referrals, restrictions, and exceptions.

 Risk classification and rating-related data requirements.

Insurance Documentation and Compliance

 Insurance product manuals.

 Rating manuals.

 Underwriting guidelines.

 Policy forms and endorsements.

 State-specific supplements and regulatory requirements.

 Statistical coding and insurance reporting requirements.

 Familiarity with ACORD standards is an advantage.

Experience with US insurance carriers, MGAs, policy administration platforms, rating

engines, and insurance product configuration solutions will be particularly valuable.

4. Technical and Functional Knowledge

 Strong understanding of enterprise insurance technology platforms.

 Experience with product configuration and policy administration systems.

 Understanding of business rules engines, rating engines, workflow engines,

and integration concepts.

 Ability to understand APIs, data structures, JSON, XML, and database

concepts.

 Experience working with Agile product development and software engineering

teams.

 Familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, and requirement

management tools.

 Ability to interpret technical architecture and evaluate functional implications.

 Awareness of AI/ML, GenAI, RAG, and document intelligence applications in

insurance technology.

 Experience working with structured metadata, data dictionaries, and canonical

data models.

5. Experience and Qualifications

Mandatory:

 12–18 years of overall professional experience in insurance, InsurTech, or

enterprise technology.

 Significant experience in Business Analysis, Insurance Product Analysis, or

Insurance Functional Consulting.

 Strong hands-on experience in US P&C insurance business processes.

 Proven experience independently handling complex insurance requirements.

 Experience translating insurance business needs into detailed functional

specifications.

 Experience with insurance product configuration, rating, underwriting, and

policy lifecycle processes.

 Strong stakeholder communication and requirement management skills.

 Demonstrated experience mentoring or reviewing the work of other BAs.

Preferred:

 Experience with insurance SaaS platforms and policy administration systems.

 Experience with rating engines and insurance product configuration platforms.

 Experience with US insurance carriers, MGAs, or insurance technology

vendors.

 Previous experience as an Insurance Product Specialist, Lead BA, Business

Architect, or Insurance Functional Consultant.

 Experience with Solartis or similar insurance technology platforms.

 Experience supporting product modernization and digital transformation

initiatives.

 Exposure to AI-driven insurance product digitization and document

intelligence.

title: Customer Field Technician I Adelaide Metro

title: Clinical Product & Engagement Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Clinical Product & Engagement Specialist based in the United States.

The Clinical Product & Engagement Specialist operates at the intersection of clinical care, provider engagement, and healthcare technology, helping physicians unlock the full potential of AI-powered clinical solutions. This role combines hands-on clinical expertise with product knowledge and technical collaboration to improve healthcare workflows and patient outcomes. You will work directly with physicians, advanced practice providers, coding professionals, and care teams to drive product adoption and demonstrate measurable clinical value. Acting as a bridge between customers and engineering teams, you will translate frontline feedback into clear technical requirements and help ensure solutions address real-world clinical needs. The position also involves validating product enhancements, investigating technical issues, and supporting continuous product improvement. This is an autonomous, customer-facing opportunity within a fast-growing digital health environment, with regular travel for onsite engagements.

Accountabilities:

As a Clinical Product & Engagement Specialist, you will serve as a clinical subject matter expert and strategic partner to healthcare providers, customer success teams, and technical stakeholders. You will drive product adoption, identify workflow challenges, translate clinical feedback into actionable development requirements, and demonstrate the value of digital health solutions through measurable outcomes.

  • Develop deep expertise in the product and support the professional development and upskilling of the Customer Success team.

  • Deliver onsite and virtual training sessions for physicians, advanced practice providers (APPs), medical coders, and care teams across a portfolio of clients.

  • Collaborate with Customer Success and Implementation teams to identify adoption barriers and take ownership of action plans to address them.

  • Support quarterly business reviews (QBRs) and customer check-ins by providing clinical insights, relevant context, and actionable talking points.

  • Create role-specific guidance explaining how the product supports clinical workflows, risk adjustment, and quality initiatives, while clearly communicating its limitations and capabilities.

  • Translate frontline customer feedback, workflow challenges, feature gaps, and clinical accuracy concerns into clear, prioritized, and technically detailed requirements.

  • Develop user stories, acceptance criteria, and representative clinical examples to help engineering teams understand and address product needs.

  • Serve as the primary clinical point of contact for a dedicated development taskforce, answering questions, validating fixes, and removing implementation blockers.

  • Investigate technical and clinical issues involving data, business rules, integrations, electronic health record (EHR) data flows, and product accuracy.

  • Communicate investigation findings and clinical recommendations clearly to engineering teams.

  • Test and validate product releases against real-world clinical workflows before and after deployment.

  • Use adoption, engagement, and accuracy metrics to demonstrate customer value and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Help guide development priorities by connecting customer outcomes and clinical insights with the taskforce's work.

  • Stay informed about new product features, evolving clinical guidelines, and client-specific workflows to maintain strong clinical and technical expertise.

Requirements:

The ideal candidate is an experienced nursing professional with a strong understanding of clinical workflows, healthcare technology, and provider engagement. You should be comfortable working with both clinical and technical teams, translating complex healthcare needs into actionable product requirements, and independently driving initiatives forward. Strong communication skills, technical curiosity, and a proactive mindset are essential.

  • Active Registered Nurse (RN) license.

  • Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) required.

  • Nurse informatics certification or a relevant graduate degree is strongly preferred.

  • Minimum of 5 years of clinical experience in primary care, internal medicine, or value-based care environments.

  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to work with data and understand healthcare technology concepts.

  • Familiarity with SQL, business intelligence (BI) tools, electronic health records (EHRs), and healthcare data integrations is an advantage.

  • Experience in health technology, product management, EHR implementation, or clinical informatics is strongly preferred.

  • Understanding of value-based care models, including Accountable Care Organizations (ACOs), Medicare Advantage, and risk-based contracting, is a strong plus.

  • Knowledge of risk adjustment methodologies and healthcare quality measures is preferred.

  • Ability to translate clinical workflows, provider feedback, and technical issues into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build credibility with physicians and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, particularly when investigating clinical accuracy, data quality, and workflow challenges.

  • Self-starter mentality, with the ability to develop expertise independently, take ownership of responsibilities, and move projects forward without constant supervision.

  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately twice per month for onsite customer engagements.

Benefits:

  • Opportunity to work in a fast-growing digital health and healthcare technology environment.

  • Direct involvement in improving clinical workflows and supporting better patient outcomes.

  • Opportunity to collaborate with physicians, healthcare professionals, customer success specialists, and engineering teams.

  • Exposure to AI-powered healthcare solutions and innovative clinical technologies.

  • High level of autonomy and ownership over customer engagement and product-related initiatives.

  • Opportunity to contribute clinical expertise to product discovery, validation, and continuous improvement.

  • Professional growth through collaboration with multidisciplinary teams and exposure to healthcare technology innovation.

  • Customer-facing role combining clinical expertise, technology, and strategic problem-solving.

title: CT technologist, Full Time Nights
description:
Job Profile Summary

​This role focuses on using various imaging techniques and practices to aid in the diagnosis and treatment of patients. In addition, this role focuses on performing the following CT Scan duties: Utilizes CT Scan Technology to provide images of internal organs, bones, and soft tissue. A clinical technologist role that has specialized knowledge or skills gained through a combination of vocational education, training, and experience. This role will be most commonly applied to patient care and/or scientific/laboratory jobs. An experienced level role requiring basic knowledge of job procedures and tools obtained through work experience and requiring vocational or technical education. Works under moderate supervision, works through problems of a routine nature, but may at times require interpretation or deviation from standard procedures and communicates information that requires some explanation or interpretation.

Job Overview

Perform Computed Tomography (CT) scan procedures on assigned patients according to the policies, procedures, philosophy, and objectives of the department and hospital. Perform CT scan procedures that follow radiological standards in a safe, accurate and timely manner, meet the American College of Radiology (ACR) imaging standards and allow the radiologist and/or physician to make a radiological diagnosis. Responsible for designated areas and/or procedures as assigned. Work cooperatively within departments and other service lines to create a system of quality health care. Work independently as required.

Minimum Qualifications:

1. Associate degree in Radiology or related field.

2. Radiologic Technologist Certification (ARRT).

3. CT Certification (ARRT) or (NMTCB).

4. Radiologic Technologist state license eligible.

5. Two (2) years of experience as a CT Technologist.

6. Basic Life Support Certification.

Preferred Qualifications:

1. X-Ray experience.

Duties and Responsibilities: The duties and responsibilities listed below are intended to describe the general nature of work and are not intended to be an all-inclusive list. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

1. Independently perform CT scans on patients as assigned according to policy and radiological standards.

2. Verify patient and procedure to be performed.

3. Provide clear and accurate instructions to patients.

4. Verify and perform correct imaging protocol, step, procedures, and scanner parameters for each patient.

5. Ensure patient and staff safety for CT equipment used.

6. Ensure IV access has been obtained and administer IV contrast.

7. Participate in ongoing education and training.

8. Perform quality control on equipment and devices as required.

9. Communicate with other staff/departments to coordinate care of patients.

10. Maintain supply stock and request stock to be ordered when necessary.

11. Keep all work areas clean and functional according to DPH and The Joint Commission.

12. May teach students and support new technologists.

Physical Requirements:

1. Frequent standing, occasional sitting, walking, and lifting 30-35 lbs.

2. Manual dexterity using fine hand manipulation to operate radiology equipment.

3. Hearing and visual acuity sufficient to perform examinations, observe patients, read monitors and documents, and hear audible equipment alarms.

4. Exposure to bodily fluids and communicable diseases.

Skills & Abilities:

1. Knowledge of radiologic equipment, examinations, and procedures.

2. Knowledge of radiation safety protocols.

3. Good communication skills.

4. Good customer service skills.

5. Ability to organize and set priorities.

6. Ability to work independently.

Brand Communications & Partnerships

Location

Okhla, Delhi

Position Overview

Looking for a strategic and proactive Brand Communications & Partnerships professional to lead the brand's communications, collaborations, partnerships, and cultural presence.

This role will be responsible for identifying and building meaningful relationships with brands, artists, cultural institutions, media, and relevant partners. From pitching collaboration ideas and developing proposals to negotiating contracts, coordinating execution, and managing post-launch communications, the role will own the end-to-end partnership process.

The individual will also lead communications for Almost Gods and its founder, manage brand events and activations, and work closely with the Marketing Head to strengthen brand positioning, launch strategies, and overall marketing initiatives.

This is a role for someone who understands fashion, culture, and contemporary brand building, and can translate relationships and ideas into meaningful business and brand opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

1. Brand Collaborations & Partnerships — Core Responsibility

Own the end-to-end brand collaboration and partnership pipeline for Almost Gods.

Identify and research potential brand partners, artists, designers, cultural institutions, creative platforms, and businesses aligned with the brand's vision.

Proactively reach out to brands and partners to explore collaboration opportunities.

Develop compelling collaboration pitches, partnership proposals, concept notes, and presentations.

Pitch Almost Gods to potential partners and communicate the brand's vision, positioning, and collaboration opportunities.

Manage inbound collaboration enquiries and evaluate opportunities based on brand alignment, commercial potential, and strategic relevance.

Coordinate with internal teams to develop collaboration concepts, product directions, marketing plans, and execution requirements.

2. Brand Communications & Public Relations

Build and maintain relationships with fashion, lifestyle, culture, business, and relevant media contacts.

Lead collaboration-specific media outreach, press releases, press kits, concept notes, and communication plans.

Plan and execute regular Almost Gods programming outreach, including relevant editorial and cultural opportunities.

Identify and pursue relevant CAT A media opportunities and high-value editorial placements.

Manage newswire activations and collaboration-led PR opportunities wherever relevant.

Coordinate with external PR agencies, media partners, and publications as required.

Track media coverage, brand mentions, press opportunities, and communication outcomes.

3. Founder Communications & Visibility

Own communications and outreach initiatives for the founder in alignment with Almost Gods brand positioning.

Identify and build relationships with schools, universities, podcasts, cultural platforms, publications, and relevant industry forums.

Proactively pitch the founder for speaking opportunities, podcasts, interviews, panel discussions, guest sessions, and other relevant platforms.

Manage communication and coordination with external stakeholders on behalf of the founder, wherever required.

4. Events, Activations & Cultural Programming

Own the planning and execution of Almost Gods brand events, store activations, launches, and partnership-led experiences.

Lead activations across Delhi, Bombay, and other relevant locations.

Develop event concepts and activation ideas in line with the brand's positioning and marketing objectives.

Coordinate with brands, artists, venues, vendors, production teams, and external partners.

Manage event timelines, budgets, vendor coordination, guest lists, invitations, production, and visual setup.

Support event communications, guest outreach, press coordination, and post-event coverage.

5. Sourcing, Stylist & Product Coordination

Own sourcing requests and product coordination for stylists, media, collaborations, and relevant external partners.

Manage cataloguing of available products and maintain an updated sourcing database.

Coordinate stylist requests, product pulls, dispatches, returns, and follow-ups.

Support product visibility through relevant styling, editorial, and cultural opportunities.

7. Marketing & Brand Strategy Support

Work closely with the Marketing Head to support the overall marketing and brand strategy.

Contribute to campaign planning, product launch strategies, and collaboration rollouts.

Provide insights from partnerships, media, cultural conversations, and external relationships to strengthen brand positioning.

Assist in research, competitor tracking, cultural insights, and identifying opportunities relevant to Almost Gods.

Support marketing planning, execution, reporting, and other strategic initiatives as required.

Qualifications & Skills

Experience

3–5 years of experience in brand partnerships, collaborations, brand communications, PR, or a related role.

Experience in fashion, lifestyle, luxury, culture, creative industries, or contemporary brands preferred.

Proven experience in initiating and managing brand collaborations and partnerships.

Experience in pitching to brands, developing proposals, and managing external relationships.

Skills

Strong understanding of brand positioning, storytelling, and communications.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to manage multiple partnerships, events, and communication initiatives simultaneously.

Understanding of PR, media relations, and brand visibility.

Strong presentation and proposal-writing skills.

Ability to work cross-functionally with marketing, creative, product, and external teams.

Strong attention to detail and ability to manage timelines and deliverables.

title: Manager, Category Excellence - Capability Lead ExM GP 1
description:
We Are Teva

We're Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it's innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we're dedicated to addressing patients needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.

Our Team, Your Impact

The Category Excellence & Capability Lead is responsible for partnering with the EXM Procurement team to standardize and continuously improve ways of working to imbed best-in-class category management and sourcing processes, practices, tools, and capabilities. This role ensures that category and sourcing teams operate with a consistent, high-impact approach to strategy development, sourcing execution, and value delivery.

The role work with teams to imbed pre-defined methodology, playbooks, and capability building, enabling category and sourcing managers to deliver superior outcomes across cost, risk, supply continuity, and innovation.

How You'll Spend Your Day

  • Work with procurement teams to implement and track the end-to-end category management framework, including strategy development, sourcing execution, and supplier management
  • Track and report that standardized approaches to category segmentation, opportunity identification, and strategy formulation are being developed and planned for execution
  • Advise teams to maintain alignment with procurement policy, governance, and enterprise objectives
  • Track and report that procurement teams execute accordingly to category playbooks, templates, and toolkits (e.g., strategy templates, negotiation guides, should-cost models)
  • Assist Procurement teams to standardize best practices across categories to ensure consistency and repeatability
  • Continuously assist the EXM Procurement LT to refine tools and methodologies based on internal performance benchmarks
  • Where appropriate, partner with Procurement COE teams to deliver training programs to build category management and sourcing capabilities across EXM procurement
  • Use established capability maturity models to assess team proficiency through developed reporting for EXM Procurement LT
  • Execute onboarding programs for new category and sourcing managers and continuous learning initiatives
  • Support category teams to leverage advanced sourcing techniques (e.g., should-cost modeling, market analysis, value engineering)
  • Support procurement managers through development of category and sourcing strategies for high-impact or complex categories
  • Partner with Analytics and Finance to ensure robust business cases and value tracking are being used consistently within the EXM Procurement team
  • Work with EXM Procurement LT to define and track category management effectiveness metrics (e.g., strategy quality, sourcing cycle time, value delivered)
  • Establish governance forums and review processes to ensure adherence to standards and that results are reported to EXM Procurement LT
  • Conduct maturity assessments and drive continuous improvement initiatives
  • Partner with COE functions (Analytics, Finance Governance, Risk) to embed best practices into category and sourcing teams
  • Collaborate with category teams to identify capability gaps and improvement opportunities
  • Work with leadership to align capability development with business priorities

Your Qualification And Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related field (advanced degree preferred)
  • 5-8+ years of experience in procurement, category management, or strategic sourcing
  • Proven experience in developing or leading category strategies and sourcing initiatives
  • Experience deploying training, playbooks, or operating frameworks within procurement or similar functions
  • Working Knowledge of category management principles and sourcing strategies
  • Ability to work with leaders to standardize category strategies across diverse spend areas
  • Working knowledge of sourcing tools, techniques, and value levers
  • Experience in training, coaching, and capability building
  • Ability to translate complex methodologies into simple, scalable frameworks
  • Strong instructional design and communication skills
  • Ability to influence without direct authority across category teams
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills
  • Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on operational excellence

How We'll Take Care Of You

At Teva India, care is at the heart of how we work. From your first day, you'll be welcomed into a people-first culture built on inclusion, respect, and belonging.

That support extends to you and your loved ones through benefits designed for real life.   • Vendor Partnership and Release Management: Serve as the technical liaison with the platform vendor, coordinate software releases, monitor product roadmaps, document enhancement requests, and resolve complex system issues.

  • Requirements Gathering: Gather and document business requirements, develop functional specifications, and create process flow diagrams to guide system enhancements.

  • Change Governance: Coordinate platform governance and change management initiatives, facilitate user forums, collect feedback, and communicate new features and system updates.

  • Training Collaboration: Ensure the technical accuracy of training materials and partner with operational leaders to develop structured training programs for credentialing specialists.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on healthcare systems administration experience with a strong understanding of provider credentialing and enrollment operations. You should be comfortable translating operational needs into technical improvements while managing multiple projects and working with diverse stakeholders. Key qualifications include:

title: Enterprise System Architect
description:
Company De ion InomERP is an ERP consulting and implementation company specializing in Odoo ERP solutions that help organizations streamline operations, improve efficiency, and scale confidently. The team manages the full Odoo lifecycle, including requirement analysis, implementation, customization, integration, migration, and ongoing support. InomERP works closely with clients across industries such as manufacturing, trading, retail, services, healthcare, and distribution to align systems with real business processes. Its services span Odoo implementation and deployment, custom module development, version upgrades, third-party and API integrations, performance optimization, and long-term support and maintenance, all with a focus on simplifying business operations.
Role De ion The Enterprise System Architect is a full-time, on-site role based in Noida. This role is responsible for designing end-to-end Odoo-based enterprise architectures that support scalable, secure, and high-performing business solutions. Day-to-day tasks include analyzing client requirements, defining system architecture and integration patterns, guiding system design and configuration, and collaborating with development and implementation teams to ensure alignment with technical standards. The Enterprise System Architect will oversee complex integrations, performance optimization, and system engineering activities, review technical designs and code, and provide architectural governance and best practices across projects. The role also involves stakeholder communication, technical documentation, and mentoring team members on architecture and design principles.
Qualifications

  • Candidates should possess strong skills in System Architecture and Systems Design for large-scale, modular enterprise solutions.
  • Candidates should possess practical experience in Software Development and Systems Engineering to translate architecture into robust implementations.
  • Candidates should possess hands-on expertise in Integration, including APIs, third-party systems, and data migration between platforms.
  • Experience with Odoo ERP architecture, customization, and deployment or similar ERP platforms is highly beneficial.
  • Proficiency in Python and related web technologies, relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL), and cloud or on-premise infrastructure is preferred.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and clients.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Prior experience in enterprise solution design for industries such as manufacturing, retail, services, or distribution is an advantage.

title: Sales Engineer

title: ST - Telco-Aria Billing Cloud -Senior
description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

Technology Consulting – Senior – Telecom Billing Analyst

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY's global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

The Opportunity

As a Telecom Billing Domain Analyst, you will help clients assess, design and implement telecom BSS billing solutions. You will bring strong telecom billing-domain knowledge and hands-on experience with platforms such as Aria Billing Cloud, Ericsson Billing, Netcracker Revenue Management or comparable telecom billing and monetization products. If you have hands-on experience for Aria Billing Cloud, it will be an added advantage.

You will work with a strong focus on providing managed services and stable production operations of deployed billing platforms. You will work with telecom customer's business, IT, finance, operations and vendor teams to translate business requirements into practical billing processes and solution designs.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the telecom billing-domain specialist across production support, managed services, consulting, implementation and migration engagements. Hands-on experience in Aria Billing Cloud will be a definitive advantage.
  • Investigate production billing issues, perform root-cause analysis and coordinate resolution across product, integration, data and operations teams.
  • Identify opportunities to improve billing accuracy, operational efficiency, revenue assurance, customer experience and time to market.
  • Work effectively with client stakeholders, product vendors, system integrators and distributed delivery teams.
  • Conduct stakeholder workshops and document as-is and to-be billing processes, requirements, pain points, controls and business rules.
  • Translate business requirements into functional designs, user stories, configuration requirements, interface requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support billing transformation decisions covering platform consolidation, legacy modernization, product and pricing migration, integration rationalization and phased decommissioning.
  • Define and review migration requirements for customer accounts, billing accounts, products, services, balances, open items and billing history.
  • Support data mapping, cleansing, reconciliation, mock migration, parallel billing, cutover and post-migration validation activities.
  • Define and deliver solution designs, interface specifications, test strategies, test cases and migration-reconciliation reports for billing completeness and accuracy.
  • Support system integration testing, end-to-end testing, user acceptance testing, bill validation, cutover rehearsals and production support.

Skills And Attributes For Success

  • 4–8 years of experience in telecom BSS, with significant techno-functional, hands-on experience in billing and revenue management.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major billing platform such as Aria Billing Cloud, Ericsson Billing, Netcracker Revenue Management or an equivalent platform. Hands-on experience on Aria Billing will be a definitive advantage.
  • Strong understanding of the telecom billing lifecycle, including customer and billing-account management, product and pricing configuration, usage processing, rating, recurring and one-time charges, bill calculation, invoicing, taxation, payments, adjustments, collections and dunning.
  • Hands-on proficiency in Java, XML, SQL, APIs, data-analysis tools and cloud environments is required.
  • Should be willing to work in shifts
  • Experience migrating customers, accounts, products, sub ions, balances and billing history from one billing platform to another.
  • Knowledge of billing data profiling, mapping, cleansing, mock migrations, financial reconciliation, parallel billing, fallout management and cutover validation.
  • Experience in production support or managed services for billing products, including incident, problem, change and release management; bill-cycle monitoring; root-cause analysis; defect resolution; and SLA-based support.
  • Understanding of integrations between billing and CRM, order management, mediation, charging, product catalog, payment, tax, ERP/general ledger, customer-care and reporting platforms.
  • Working knowledge of TM Forum eTOM, SID, Open Digital Architecture and Open APIs, particularly billing-account and customer-bill management.
  • Experience preparing functional specifications, process flows, business requirements, user stories, solution-design inputs and test scenarios.
  • Experience in leveraging latest AI tools to deliver projects within time, budget and quality.
  • A bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, business systems or a related discipline.
  • Relevant TM Forum or billing-product certifications are an advantage.

What We Look For

Highly motivated telecom billing professionals who combine strong domain knowledge with hands-on delivery experience. You should be able to analyze complex billing scenarios, translate requirements into practical solutions and support clients through transformation, migration and production support operations while maintaining a clear focus on billing accuracy, revenue integrity and customer outcomes.

What We Offer You

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion.

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Associate Director RBQM Platforms and Technologies
description:
JOIN AMGEN'S MISSION OF SERVING PATIENTS

At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission to serve patients living with serious illnesses drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas, Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease, we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Associate Director – RBQM Platforms and Technologies

What you will do:

In this role, you will lead the RBQM platform capability, translating the RBQM strategy into fit-for-purpose technology, data, and delivery plans. You will connect risk-based quality management processes with platform configuration, analytics, integrations, and study adoption across the global portfolio.

Strategic Leadership

  • Own the RBQM platform capability roadmap and backlog, aligning priorities with GDO quality objectives and study needs.
  • Partner with functional leaders to translate risk-based quality management processes into scalable platform requirements and operating practices.
  • Promote an integrated RBQM ecosystem with trusted data, clear governance, and appropriate automation.

Execution and Delivery Leadership

  • Lead platform enhancements, configuration, integrations, releases, and implementation work from requirements through adoption.
  • Ensure quality, validation, testing, data integrity, and change controls are embedded in delivery.
  • Monitor platform performance, data quality, use, and issue trends; prioritize remediation and improvements.
  • Enable consistent study use through guidance, training, and practical support for study teams.

People Leadership

  • Manage and develop direct reports, building RBQM platform, process, and data expertise.
  • Set priorities and allocate team capacity across platform lifecycle, study support, and improvement work.
  • Foster collaboration across quality, operations, data, and technology teams.

External Representation and Internal Stakeholder Partnerships

  • Partner with RBQM, Clinical Operations, Data Management, DTI, AI&D, quality, regulatory, and platform providers.
  • Coordinate vendor roadmap, service, release, and issue management.
  • Communicate platform decisions, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to leadership and study stakeholders.

What we expect of you:

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The candidate we seek is a capable clinical systems professional with the following qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Master's degree and 10+ years of experience in clinical systems, RBQM technology, clinical quality, data analytics, or related regulated technology work OR
  • Bachelor's degree and 13+ years of experience in clinical systems, RBQM technology, clinical quality, data analytics, or related regulated technology work
  • 2+ years of direct people management experience, or demonstrated experience supervising and developing employees.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with RBQM platforms, central monitoring, quality analytics, or clinical technology delivery.
  • Understanding of clinical trial processes, quality risk management, and regulated system controls.
  • Experience leading teams or coordinating cross-functional platform delivery.
  • Ability to translate business needs into platform requirements and adoption plans.

Core Competencies:

  • Knowledge of risk-based quality management principles, risk indicators, and central monitoring.
  • Experience with platform implementation, data integration, validation, and release management.
  • Experience using metrics and user feedback to improve platform outcomes.
  • People leadership and global stakeholder management.

They will also embody the Amgen leadership attributes which are:

  • Inspire: Create a connected, inclusive, and inspiring work environment that empowers talent to thrive
  • Accelerate: Enable speed that matches the urgency of patient needs by encouraging progress over perfection
  • Integrate: Connect the dots to amplify the collective power of Amgen to drive results for patients, staff, and shareholders
  • Adapt: Lead through change by adapting to an ever-changing environment and defining a clear course of action to deliver results

What You Can Expect Of Us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we'll support your journey every step of the way.

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

title: Ralph Lauren Financial Planning Analysis Analyst
description:
Company De ion

For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.

Position Overview

  • Provide financial and operational reporting & analysis to the business leadership team accurately and on time.
  • Monitor the P&L of a corporate function, analyzing operating expenses, headcount, and ad hoc needs and compare budget and forecast projections. In addition, analyze and interpret variances, prepare reports, and provide recommendations to management where required.

  • Support and test new capital features in SAP and Hyperion

  • Oversee global funnel of CAR submissions through capital planning inbox

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Deliver files & reports/ month-end / monthly forecast / annual budget reporting packs that clearly communicate business performance to support management decision making.
  • Support Daily/Weekly/Monthly business report preparation including, but not limited to, P&L Models, KPI Reporting and SG&A analyses.
  • Ensure accuracy and integrity of information stored in our systems, enabling a single source of truth.
  • Monitor the actual financial performance and compare budget and forecast projections.
  • Liaise with the GL Accounting team to post monthly adjustments like accruals, reclass, prepayments, etc., to ensure accuracy of expense bookings and P&L view.
  • Analyze and interpret variances with commentaries across periods/cycles, prepare reporting that clearly explains business drivers, trends and future implications.
  • Identify financial risks and opportunities and provide recommendations to mitigate to support achievement of annual financial targets.
  • Headcount management and reporting.
  • Co ordinating with different vertical leads and managing expectations proactively will be a primary task. Sending out monthly reports and scheduling calls as required to remain aligned.
  • Deliver ad-hoc reports and analyses as required.
  • Drive continuous improvement and ways of working through adoption of AI and automation to increase efficiency, reduce time, and improve financial visibility.
  • Roll-over of existing templates, building of new templates to suit changing requirements.
  • Complete ownership of the activities with minimal supervision, while ensuring timeliness and accuracy

Professional Skills

Experience, Skills & Knowledge

  • CA/MBA, CIMA, CMA(US) or any other master's degree with a focus in Finance and Accounting.
  • 2-3 years of combined Accounting, Controlling, Reporting or Financial Planning & Analysis experience.
  • Excellent understanding of accounting principles and financial analysis.
  • Solid experience in preparing financial & operational reporting and analytics, preferably in the retail environment.

description:

Job De ion

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Engineer - UA Link Switch Architecture to lead the

architecture and microarchitecture definition of the switching subsystem for next-generation UA Link

multi-die SoC products. In this role, you will be responsible for defining and driving the architecture

of the switch fabric that enables high-bandwidth, low-latency communication between accelerators,

memory, and compute resources. You will work closely with SoC architects, protocol architects,

design, verification, firmware, and system teams to develop scalable switching solutions optimized

for AI and HPC workloads.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead architecture and microarchitecture definition of the switch subsystem within UA Link multi-die

SoC products.

• Define switching fabric architecture, datapaths, buffering structures, arbitration schemes, routing

mechanisms, and packet processing pipelines.

• Drive architecture decisions for latency, bandwidth, scalability, reliability, and power efficiency.

• Architect low-latency, high-bandwidth switching fabrics utilizing crossbar, hierarchical fabric, NoC,

or related switching mechanisms.

• Define flow-control, scheduling, congestion management, virtual channels, QoS, and traffic

management strategies.

• Collaborate with SoC architects to ensure seamless integration of the switch subsystem within the

overall multi-die architecture.

• Provide technical leadership across architecture, RTL, verification, emulation, and post-silicon

validation teams.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer

Science, or related discipline.

• 15+ years of experience in architecture and development of complex ASICs, networking silicon, or

high-performance SoCs.

• Proven experience architecting and delivering Ethernet switch ASICs, PCIe switch products, NoC

fabrics, HPC interconnect fabrics, AI accelerator communication fabrics, or other low-latency

switching architectures.

• Deep understanding of switching fabric architectures, crossbar architectures, packet switching

systems, routing and forwarding mechanisms, flow control, buffering, arbitration, scheduling,

congestion management, and QoS.

• Experience with architecture definition, performance analysis, and microarchitecture specification.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, UALink, UCIe, InfiniBand, or similar high-speed

interconnect technologies.

• Experience designing switch fabrics for AI, HPC, networking, or datacenter applications.

• Familiarity with multi-die and chiplet-based SoC architectures.

Leadership Expectations:

• Own the switch architecture and serve as the technical lead for the switching subsystem.

• Drive architectural excellence from concept through silicon realization.

• Mentor engineers and contribute to the growth of the switching architecture team.

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

title: Clinical Quality Assurance Reviewer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Clinical Quality Assurance Reviewer based in Michigan, United States.

The Clinical Quality Assurance Reviewer plays a vital role in protecting the health, safety, and well-being of individuals receiving home and community-based services. This position is responsible for conducting comprehensive clinical audits, reviewing participant records, and performing in-person home visits to assess the quality and compliance of care. Working closely with state agencies and healthcare professionals, you will help ensure that services meet federal and state requirements while supporting participants' independence and quality of life. The role combines clinical expertise, analytical thinking, and strong communication skills to identify improvement opportunities and promote accountability. This is a remote position for professionals based in Michigan, with regular travel required for on-site reviews and home visits.

Accountabilities:

As a Clinical Quality Assurance Reviewer, you will oversee clinical quality reviews for the MI Choice Home and Community-Based Services program, ensuring that participating agencies meet established standards and that individuals receive appropriate, safe, and effective care. You will collaborate with internal teams and state stakeholders to monitor compliance, address findings, and support continuous quality improvement.

  • Conduct comprehensive clinical quality assurance reviews at MI Choice waiver agencies through clinical record evaluations and in-person participant home visits.

  • Assess participants' health, safety, and welfare, considering their clinical, social, emotional, cognitive, behavioral, and environmental needs.

  • Schedule and coordinate review appointments with waiver agencies in accordance with program requirements and state protocols.

  • Prepare and submit detailed quality assurance reports within established deadlines, communicating proactively about any potential delays.

  • Audit clinical records and issue citations based on federal performance standards and applicable review protocols.

  • Collaborate with team members and state agency representatives to monitor compliance, follow up on audit findings, and support corrective action plans.

  • Apply clinical expertise to identify participant needs and determine appropriate resources that promote independence and well-being.

  • Analyze data and emerging trends to inform compliance strategies and strengthen quality improvement initiatives.

  • Uphold professional standards and represent the organization's interests in all interactions.

  • Perform additional responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements:

The ideal candidate is an experienced nursing or social work professional with a strong background in clinical quality assurance, case management, or home and community-based care. You should bring sound clinical judgment, excellent analytical abilities, and the confidence to conduct independent reviews and communicate findings effectively with diverse stakeholders.

  • Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Social Work, or a related field.

  • 5–7 years of experience in quality assurance, home or community-based care, case management, or clinical record reviews.

  • Valid Michigan licensure as a Registered Nurse (RN) or Social Worker.

  • Valid Michigan driver's license and ability to travel for on-site reviews and home visits.

  • Experience conducting in-person home visits and comprehensive clinical audits is preferred.

  • In-depth knowledge of MI Choice Waiver programming and applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

  • Strong clinical assessment and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to evaluate complex participant circumstances.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for interacting with participants, state agency representatives, and other stakeholders.

  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities, with the capacity to manage deadlines and work independently as well as collaboratively.

  • Leadership, adaptability, and problem-solving skills to improve audit processes and support continuous quality improvement.

  • Ability to analyze data trends, identify compliance gaps, and recommend appropriate corrective actions.

  • Commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion in all professional interactions.

Benefits:

  • Annual salary range of $64,936–$77,923.

  • Remote work arrangement for candidates who live and work in Michigan.

  • Opportunity to contribute to meaningful public health initiatives and improve the quality of care for vulnerable populations.

  • Professional environment focused on collaboration, continuous improvement, and community well-being.

  • Work that combines independent responsibilities with collaboration across multidisciplinary teams.

  • Opportunities to apply clinical expertise while supporting participant independence and safety.

⭐ Collaboration & Communication - You work well across teams and can explain technical concepts clearly

⭐ Adaptability - You thrive in a dynamic environment and embrace change

Language Requirements

Key Qualities : Ownership, proactiveness, strong follow-up, vendor coordination, discretion with confidential information, and a service mindset.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Job De ion

Opportunity Summary

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to join our India-based Center of Excellence (CoE) team. This senior delivery leader will own complex enterprise search and AI orchestration implementations for global BA Insight customers, partnering closely with North America Professional Services and offshore technical teams. Beyond managing assigned projects, the role will provide delivery leadership, mentor Project Managers, strengthen governance, and drive predictable customer outcomes across the portfolio. The position will directly manage a team of Project Managers, providing people leadership, delivery oversight, and accountability for team performance and customer outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines executive-level customer communication, sound commercial judgment, technical fluency, and a hands-on approach to resolving delivery challenges in a fast-paced global environment.

What would you do

  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex, high-visibility BA Insight implementations, from discovery and planning through acceptance and transition to support.
  • Lead a portfolio of concurrent projects; establish priorities, dependencies, resource plans, and clear delivery accountability across teams and geographies.
  • Serve as a trusted customer-facing delivery leader, including executive steering meetings, escalations, recovery plans, and difficult scope or schedule discussions.
  • Lead integrated project plans, milestones, critical paths, RAID logs, phase-gate reviews, and proactive quality and risk management.
  • Partner with Solution Architects and technical leads on requirements, solution readiness, dependencies, and delivery decisions while maintaining clear accountability for project execution.
  • Directly manage and lead a team of Project Managers, including workload allocation, performance management, coaching, career development, and accountability for consistent project delivery.
  • Own SOW delivery governance, scope and change control, effort and budget tracking, forecasting, project profitability awareness, and timely escalation of commercial risks.
  • Drive cross-functional coordination with Product, Engineering, Support, Sales, and Customer Success to unblock issues and deliver customer outcomes.
  • Lead daily/weekly execution cadences and communicate concise, decision-oriented project and portfolio updates to customers and senior leadership.
  • Identify systemic delivery risks and implement measurable process improvements, reusable templates, automation, and lessons learned.
  • Maintain accurate project data and forecasts in Upland PSA, Jira, Salesforce, Teams, and related systems.
  • Own PM team capacity and resource planning across India and North America, including staffing assignments, prioritization, workload balancing, and delivery coverage.

What are we looking for

  • 8+ years of project/program management experience, including significant ownership of complex enterprise software, SaaS, or professional services implementations.
  • Demonstrated experience directly managing a team of Project Managers, including performance reviews, coaching, resource allocation, and professional development, while overseeing multiple concurrent customer projects.
  • Proven ability to manage executive stakeholders, critical escalations, delivery recovery, and cross-functional teams across geographies.
  • Strong knowledge of SOWs, change requests, financial tracking, delivery forecasting, utilization, and project margin drivers.
  • Working understanding of enterprise content and data integration platforms (e.g., SharePoint, iManage, Documentum) and enterprise search / AI solution delivery.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including concise executive reporting and the ability to translate technical issues into decisions and actions.
  • Advanced project planning, risk management, and governance skills; proficiency with Jira, Smartsheet, PSA systems, or similar tools.
  • Ability to work overlapping hours with North American teams and customers (evening IST).

Primary Skills

  • Senior-level ownership, sound judgment, and proactive problem-solving under pressure.
  • Portfolio and project governance, dependency management, and delivery predictability.
  • Customer leadership, executive presence, negotiation, and conflict resolution.
  • People management, team development, coaching, performance accountability, and cross-functional influence.
  • Commercial acumen, scope discipline, and data-driven reporting.
  • Strong organization, attention to detail, responsiveness, and technical literacy.

Secondary Skills

  • Experience in AI orchestration, content ingestion/indexing, enterprise search, or retrieval-augmented generation.
  • Familiarity with BA Insight products, connectors, and orchestration technologies.
  • Experience with legal, life sciences, or other regulated enterprise customers.
  • Agile or hybrid delivery methodologies; cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
  • Experience improving Professional Services operating models within a global Center of Excellence.

Growth Skills

Builds and develops a high-performing team of Project Managers, continuously improves delivery practices, and contributes to scalable Professional Services operations and customer success.

Work Schedule

India-based working schedule with mandatory 3–4 hours of overlap with North American business hours (for example, 6:00 PM–10:00 PM IST). Flexibility to coordinate coverage with other CoE Project Managers and adjust schedules to support critical customer needs.

Qualification

Bachelor's degree or technical institute degree/certificate in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of knowledge and experience. PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project/program management certification is preferred. This role requires regular collaboration across time zones; Upland India offers flexibility in managing working hours.

Upland Software is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Director, Medical Writing (Clinical and Regulatory) based in the United States.

The Associate Director, Medical Writing (Clinical and Regulatory) will provide scientific and strategic leadership for the development of high-quality clinical, regulatory, and preclinical documentation supporting innovative gene therapy programs. Reporting to the Head of Medical Writing, this role will translate complex scientific and clinical data into clear, accurate, and compliant documents for regulatory authorities and other stakeholders. Working closely with multidisciplinary teams across Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Biometrics, Medical Affairs, and Nonclinical Development, the successful candidate will drive document strategy and execution. The position also offers the opportunity to strengthen medical writing infrastructure, establish best practices, and improve processes across a growing biotechnology organization. This is an impactful opportunity for an experienced scientific writer to contribute to the advancement of precision medicines for individuals living with genetic disorders.

Accountabilities

  • Lead and manage assigned clinical, regulatory, and preclinical writing deliverables supporting the organization's development programs.

  • Author, edit, and coordinate a broad range of regulatory and clinical documents, including clinical study protocols and amendments, Investigator Brochures, clinical study reports, patient narratives, IND submissions, CTD components, safety updates, annual reports, integrated summaries, briefing books, and clinical development plans.

  • Contribute to BLA and MAA submissions, particularly Modules 1, 2, and 5, ensuring documents are scientifically accurate, consistent, and aligned with regulatory expectations.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to analyze and interpret clinical data from internal and external sources, translating findings into clear scientific narratives, conclusions, and key messages.

  • Conduct literature reviews and scientific database searches to support document development, background research, and clinical or regulatory analyses.

  • Support consistency, clarity, and efficiency across assigned deliverables and ensure alignment with program objectives.

  • Establish and maintain document management, editing, publishing, and review standards to support high-quality and submission-ready deliverables.

  • Develop realistic timelines in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and communicate potential risks, resource requirements, and schedule changes.

  • Coordinate workload and priorities with the Head of Medical Writing to ensure timely delivery of critical program documents.

  • Collaborate with internal and external authors, vendors, service providers, and clinical investigators to align expectations, manage milestones, and coordinate document development.

  • Lead document review cycles, consolidate and adjudicate stakeholder comments, and deliver final documents that meet scientific, regulatory, and quality standards.

  • Ensure all documentation complies with applicable regulatory guidelines and standards, including ICH, FDA, EMA, and relevant internal requirements.

  • Review Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs) and Tables, Figures, and Listings (TFLs), providing feedback to ensure appropriate data presentation in clinical study reports and other regulatory documents.

  • Maintain current scientific, medical, regulatory, and technical knowledge relevant to the development pipeline, gene therapy platform, clinical studies, and associated disease areas.

Requirements:

  • Advanced scientific degree (PhD, PharmD, MD, or equivalent) preferred, with at least 5 years of relevant biopharmaceutical, scientific, medical, or regulatory experience.

  • Alternatively, a Master's degree with at least 8 years of relevant experience, or a Bachelor's degree in Molecular Biology, Genetics, or a related scientific discipline with at least 12 years of relevant experience.

  • Previous experience working within a biotechnology or pharmaceutical company is preferred, particularly in a smaller organization or rare disease environment.

  • Demonstrated experience contributing to multiple BLA or NDA submissions is highly desirable.

  • Strong track record of authoring and delivering high-quality scientific, clinical, and medical documents for internal and external audiences.

  • Comprehensive understanding of clinical and regulatory documentation requirements and the ability to translate complex scientific information into clear, accurate, and well-structured content.

  • Ability to interpret clinical data, collaborate with scientific experts, and develop consistent messaging across regulatory and clinical deliverables.

  • Strong knowledge of applicable regulatory standards and guidance, including ICH, FDA, and EMA requirements.

  • Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple deliverables, manage competing deadlines, and anticipate potential challenges.

  • Strong judgment, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities, with a proactive approach to identifying process improvements and operational efficiencies.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate transparently and effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • A collaborative and adaptable working style, suited to a data-driven, fast-paced, and evolving biotechnology environment.

  • Exceptional computer skills and proficiency with document creation and editing tools, including Microsoft Office and Adobe applications.

description:
