Oil & Gas | Senior Manager

Job Title Principal Data Scientist – Senior Manager

 Experience Level 15+ Years

Job De ion

At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.

We are seeking a hands-on Principal Data Scientist to solve complex modelling problems across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas. You will formulate operational challenges, establish defensible scientific approaches, develop critical modelling components, and define the evidence required for reliable deployment across wells, fields, equipment, process units, and sites.

Role Details

Key responsibilities include:

Scientific formulation and advanced modelling

  • Formulate operational problems as predictive, diagnostic, causal, or pre ive tasks, defining targets, objective functions, constraints, decision variables, acceptance criteria, and evaluation methods.
  • Assess data sufficiency, measurement quality, sampling bias, confounding, identifiability, and operating coverage to determine whether available evidence supports the intended outcome.
  • Select statistical, machine learning, simulation, or hybrid approaches suited to noisy measurements, heterogeneous assets, sparse labels, rare events, censored histories, and distribution shifts.
  • Apply probabilistic or hierarchical modelling, uncertainty quantification, survival analysis, semi-supervised learning, transfer learning, or domain adaptation where appropriate.
  • Develop methods for multivariate forecasting, state estimation, change detection, degradation modelling, and industrial time-series analysis while distinguishing process dynamics from measurement artefacts.
  • Combine learned models with engineering equations, mass and energy balances, simulation outputs, or physical constraints, evaluating accuracy, plausibility, extrapolation behaviour, and uncertainty propagation.
  • Connect predictions with constrained optimization, assessing feasibility, sensitivity, robustness, and decision quality under uncertainty; design experiments or causal analyses when observational evidence is insufficient.

Upstream applications

  • Define modelling approaches for production forecasting, well surveillance, artificial-lift performance, drilling analytics, and production-system optimization.
  • Separate the effects of reservoir behaviour, operating constraints, equipment condition, interventions, formation changes, and operating practices when interpreting performance.
  • Collaborate with reservoir engineers and geoscientists on property prediction, uncertainty analysis, and simulation-assisted modelling.
  • Determine whether models can transfer between wells or fields and define the data, recalibration, adaptation, and validation required.

Downstream applications

  • Define modelling approaches for product-quality prediction, yield modelling, equipment degradation, blending, and process or energy optimization.
  • Account for feedstock composition, throughput, catalyst age, equipment condition, process configuration, and control-system behaviour.
  • Combine data-driven methods with engineering relationships, process simulations, and mass and energy balances.
  • Connect predictive models with operating, planning, blending, or optimization workflows within defined physical and operational constraints, validating across feedstock changes, campaigns, grades, and configurations.

Model assurance and generalization

  • Establish standards for baselining, benchmarking, feature-ablation studies, calibration, sensitivity analysis, robustness, and out-of-distribution evaluation.
  • Challenge apparent improvements caused by leakage, weak baselines, inappropriate metrics, selective testing, or inadequate engineering interpretation.
  • Distinguish models that reproduce historical associations from models capable of evaluating proposed operating changes.
  • Define applicability limits, uncertainty treatment, monitoring requirements, fallback behaviour, and recalibration or retraining criteria.
  • Assess predictive performance separately from recommendation feasibility and quality, and establish adaptation and validation strategies across assets, sites, configurations, and operating regimes.

Technical leadership and scalable delivery

  • Remain hands-on in experiments, model development, prototyping, and troubleshooting.
  • Resolve failures across data preparation, measurement quality, engineering assumptions, model formulation, software implementation, and production behaviour.
  • Develop reusable modelling components, adaptation strategies, technical standards, and reference implementations; design reproducible experiments whose conclusions can be reviewed and defended.
  • Evaluate emerging techniques through controlled comparisons with established methods and review production implementations for consistency with the intended scientific approach.
  • Conduct scientific reviews, challenge modelling decisions, mentor Lead Data Scientists, and collaborate with engineering, data, ML engineering, and product teams to integrate validated models into operational workflows.

Must Have Qualifications & Experience

  • A degree in a relevant engineering, scientific, or quantitative discipline.
  • Substantial hands-on experience developing and deploying Oil & Gas analytical solutions.
  • Deep expertise in at least one upstream or downstream area, with working knowledge across both segments.
  • Advanced expertise in at least one relevant applied modelling specialization.
  • Strong foundations in statistics, machine learning, mathematical modelling, industrial time series, scientific computing, experimental design, and uncertainty assessment.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, including scientific prototyping, implementation of critical modelling components, and review of production code.
  • Experience integrating engineering knowledge into model formulation and validation, together with reproducible experimentation, production ML, model generalization, and deployment across varied operating conditions.
  • Evidence of personally resolving a difficult methodological problem and establishing an approach adopted by others.
  • Experience conducting technical reviews and guiding multidisciplinary data science teams.
  • Ability to defend technical decisions using quantitative evidence and clearly communicate assumptions, trade-offs, limitations, and operational implications.

Good to Have

  • Delivery experience across both upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
  • A master's degree, PhD, or relevant applied research experience.
  • Expertise in system identification, robust optimization, physics-informed learning, simulation surrogates, or uncertainty propagation.
  • Experience with distributed scientific computing, scalable inference, cloud ML platforms, and production MLOps.
  • Experience combining validated numerical models with knowledge graphs, specialized language models, or agentic decision-support workflows.
  • Publications, patents, open-source contributions, or reusable technical assets demonstrating applied scientific contribution.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to solve high-impact modelling and decision-support challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations.
  • A role with hands-on technical authority, scientific leadership, and the opportunity to establish reusable methods and standards for multidisciplinary teams.
  • A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data science, ML engineering, product, and global EY teams.
  • Access to EY's global network, technology ecosystem, and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

What We Look For

A hands-on technical authority who can explain a difficult Oil & Gas problem they personally solved, why established approaches were insufficient, how the alternative was formulated and validated, where it can and cannot generalize, and how the resulting approach enabled other data scientists to deliver reliable solutions.

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: AI Governance & Risk Lead
description:
APCO Holdings partners with dealerships across North America to deliver innovative vehicle protection products and services that enhance the ownership experience for customers and drive growth for our partners. Through our family of brands, we bring together industry expertise, technology, and data-driven insights to help dealers strengthen their finance and insurance performance and build lasting relationships with their customers.

Our teams work collaboratively across operations, technology, risk, finance, marketing, and sales to deliver solutions that create measurable value and support the continued growth of APCO and the partners we serve.

Summary

The AI Governance & Risk Lead owns how APCO Holdings selects, builds, deploys, and monitors AI so it is safe, compliant, and trusted by dealers, customers, and regulators. This role will stand up and run the AI governance program end to end: policy, model inventory, IT risk assessment, controls, vendor oversight, and reporting to leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Governance framework and policy

  • Design and maintain the enterprise AI governance framework, aligned to the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and ISO/IEC 42001.
  • Write, review, update, and own the AI acceptable use policy, enterprise policy, model risk standards, and approval workflows for internal, vendor and generative AI tools.
  • Chair or run the AI governance committee; prepare decisions, track actions, and escalate issues.

Risk assessment and controls

  • Maintain a complete inventory of AI systems and use cases, each with a risk tier and owner.
  • Run pre-deployment risk and impact assessments covering bias and fairness, explainability, privacy, security, accuracy, and consumer harm.
  • Define controls for data quality, human oversight, model validation, monitoring and decommissioning, and test that they work.
  • Lead response and root-cause review for AI incidents, model failures, and complaints.

Regulatory and compliance

  • Track AI-related laws and guidance (state AI and privacy laws, FTC and CFPB guidance, insurance regulator AI bulletins, the EU AI Act where relevant) and translate them into requirements.
  • Partner with Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Information Security on fair lending, UDAAP, consumer disclosure and data protection obligations as they apply to AI.
  • Prepare evidence for internal audit, regulators, and business partner due diligence.

Third-party AI risk

  • Assess AI capabilities embedded in vendor products before purchase and renewal.
  • Set contract requirements for data use, model transparency, security, and incident notice.
  • Review and assess of third-party risk and capabilities of AI Tool connector(s).

Enablement and reporting

  • Advise product, technology, claims, sales, and operations teams on responsible AI design early in projects.
  • Build training and awareness on safe AI use for employees and leaders.
  • Report program status, risk posture and key metrics to executive leadership and the board on a regular cadence.

Qualifications

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, law, risk management, information systems, or related field.
  • 7+ years in technology risk, model risk management, compliance, privacy, or information security, including 2+ years focused on AI or machine learning.
  • Working knowledge of how ML and generative AI models are built, evaluated, and fail, enough to challenge data scientists and vendors credibly.
  • Hands-on experience applying NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, SR 11-7 model risk guidance, or a comparable framework.
  • Experience in a regulated industry such as financial services, insurance, or automotive finance.
  • Track record of writing policy and running cross-functional programs without direct authority.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with executives, engineers, and auditors.

Preferred qualifications

  • Master's degree or JD.
  • Certifications such as IAPP AIGP, CIPP/US, CRISC, CISA or CISSP.
  • Experience with vehicle service contracts, warranty, insurance, or dealer-facing products.
  • Familiarity with AI governance and monitoring tools (model registries, bias testing, LLM evaluation and guardrail platforms).
  • Experience building a governance program from scratch at a mid-sized company.
At APCO, the way we work matters just as much as the results we deliver. Our values guide how we work, how we partner, and how we deliver results.

title: Engineer-Senior Engineer, DFT
description:
Renesas is a global semiconductor leader shaping the backbone of next‑generation automotive, industrial, cloud, and IoT innovation. With over $9.3 billion in annual revenue (2024) and a world‑class team of 22,700+ employees, Renesas operates at scale while retaining the agility to drive category‑defining breakthroughs. The company's footprint spans more than 30 countries, enabling deep customer proximity and a uniquely global innovative engine. As Japan's semiconductor powerhouse and a top global player in microcontrollers, analog, and power technologies, Renesas delivers real‑world impact across EVs, smart factories, renewable energy infrastructure, and edge intelligence. For ambitious problem‑solvers who want to work on meaningful, systems‑level challenges with huge industry leverage, Renesas offers the scale, stability, and strategic clarity of a market leader—paired with the transformative momentum of a company reinventing how the world computes, connects, and electrifies.

Renesas has a growing presence in India with HC approaching 1000+ and significant presence with active government and university collaboration as well as OSAT footprint (JV with CG India). With the growing importance of India as a market (Growing semiconductor market and government goals / mandates of localization needs) and talent hub, our division's (India for India) mission is to grow India market. We aspire to create products (SoCs, Software, Power and Analog chips etc) which serve needs for local market. Renesas is a leading electronics supplier globally, and this is a unique opportunity to directly influence the future products which will be offered to our customers in a new, fast growing and large Indian market with specific needs and applications.

Job De ion

We are looking for a motivated and hands-on Engineer/Senior Engineer, Design-for-Test (DFT) to support DFT implementation, verification, ATPG, and silicon bring-up activities for complex Automotive MCU/SoC products. The candidate will work closely with DFT leads, Design, Verification, Physical Design, Product Engineering, and Test Engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support DFT implementation for MCU/SoC designs, including scan insertion, scan compression, MBIST, and JTAG/boundary scan integration.
  • Participate in DFT planning and execution under the guidance of DFT leads and architects.
  • Develop and maintain DFT constraints, s, and flows required for implementation and verification.
  • Perform DFT verification including scan-chain validation, MBIST verification, test-mode verification, and gate-level simulations.
  • Generate and validate ATPG patterns for stuck-at, transition, and other fault models as required.
  • Analyze fault coverage results and support closure of coverage gaps.
  • Work with SoC integration teams to support DFT integration across IPs and subsystems.
  • Debug DFT-related issues during RTL, netlist, ATPG, and gate-level verification stages.
  • Collaborate with Product and Test Engineering teams in test pattern validation and production test preparation.
  • Support silicon bring-up activities, pattern debug, and failure analysis.
  • Participate in design reviews and support DFT sign-off activities.
  • Document DFT implementation, verification results, and test deliverables.

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience:

  • 2-5 years of experience in DFT implementation and verification for ASIC, SoC, or MCU designs.
  • Good understanding of scan insertion, scan compression, ATPG, MBIST, and JTAG/boundary scan methodologies.
  • Experience with industry-standard DFT tools such as:
    • Siemens Tessent
    • Synopsys DFT Compiler / TestMAX
    • Cadence Modus
  • Understanding of digital design concepts including RTL, clocks, resets, timing, and power domains.
  • Experience with Verilog/SystemVerilog and simulation environments.
  • Familiarity with ATPG pattern generation, fault coverage analysis, and pattern validation.
  • Experience debugging DFT and test-related issues at RTL and gate level.
  • Basic understanding of semiconductor production testing and ATE environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience working on Automotive MCU or SoC products.
  • Knowledge of ISO 26262 functional safety concepts.
  • Exposure to Logic BIST (LBIST) and memory repair methodologies.
  • Experience with TCL, Perl, Python, or shell ing for automation.
  • Understanding of silicon bring-up and yield/debug analysis.
  • Familiarity with hierarchical DFT methodologies.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for an engineer who has a solid foundation in DFT methodologies and is eager to contribute to complex Automotive MCU/SoC products. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working hands-on with DFT tools, verification, ATPG, and debug activities while collaborating effectively across design, verification, and test engineering teams. The role offers opportunities to grow into broader DFT ownership and architecture responsibilities over time.

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

The Chief Architect is the senior technical leader responsible for defining and governing the end to end architecture across the enterprise. This role ensures that technology strategy aligns with business goals, promotes scalable and secure solutions, and drives consistency across platforms, systems, and development practices. Standards, Quality & Best Practices

title: Managing Director, Breakthrough Models
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Managing Director, Breakthrough Models based in United States.

In this senior leadership role, you will lead an ambitious, multi-year initiative focused on transforming teaching and learning through innovative, community-driven educational models. You will establish the strategic vision, operating structures, and partnerships needed to reimagine student experiences and improve educational outcomes across school systems. Working closely with educators, students, families, district leaders, funders, and community organizations, you will guide collaborative discovery, co-design, and prototyping initiatives. You will translate bold ideas into practical implementation strategies, using research, evidence, and stakeholder insights to inform critical decisions. As the initiative's founding leader, you will oversee early-stage development, evaluate pilot readiness, and build the foundations for sustainable impact. This is an opportunity to shape the future of education while contributing to broader organizational strategy and leading transformative change across the education sector.

Accountabilities:

  • Strategic Leadership: Establish and lead the strategic direction of the Breakthrough Models initiative, translating an ambitious vision for the future of teaching and learning into actionable priorities, operating structures, and measurable objectives.
  • Initiative Development: Lead the initial design and readiness phase, developing clear implementation roadmaps, decision-making frameworks, timelines, and milestones to guide the initiative's progress.
  • Innovative Learning Model Design: Oversee the development of innovative educational models that rethink instructional approaches, student experiences, staffing structures, and assessment practices to improve student learning and engagement.
  • Human-Centered Design: Facilitate collaborative discovery, co-design, prototyping, testing, and iterative improvement processes that incorporate the perspectives and needs of educators, students, families, and communities.
  • Strategic Partnerships: Build and maintain trusted relationships with school-system leaders, educators, families, funders, community organizations, and external innovation partners.
  • Cross-Organizational Collaboration: Manage the co-design partnership with external collaborators and coordinate with internal teams to align resources, expertise, and strategic priorities.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Organize and facilitate collaborative planning sessions, workshops, and decision-making discussions, bringing diverse stakeholders together around shared objectives and actionable solutions.
  • Evidence-Based Decision-Making: Analyze research, implementation insights, and student outcome data to evaluate proposed approaches, identify effective practices, and determine which models should advance, be refined, or be discontinued.
  • Impact Measurement: Examine longitudinal and disaggregated student performance data to understand what is working, for whom, and why, ensuring that emerging models contribute to meaningful and sustained improvements.
  • Pilot Readiness and Implementation: Establish the conditions required for successful pilot programs, including partner readiness, implementation plans, resource allocation, and evaluation frameworks.
  • Operational and Financial Management: Oversee budgets, timelines, dependencies, and stakeholder accountability across complex, multi-organization initiatives.
  • Team Leadership and Development: Lead, coach, and develop team members and senior leaders, strengthening strategic judgment, adaptive leadership, and a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Organizational Strategy: Contribute to broader organizational priorities as a member of the extended leadership team, helping shape long-term strategies for the future of teaching and learning.
  • Program Expansion: As funding, partnerships, and implementation plans develop, take on expanded responsibility for pilot oversight, team growth, and the long-term sustainability of the initiative.

Requirements:

  • Professional Experience: Minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience, including at least 5 years in management or leadership roles, with a strong background in education, instructional leadership, and school-district partnerships.
  • Educational Innovation: Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and launching innovative learning models within schools or educational systems, with measurable evidence of improved student learning outcomes or experiences beyond an individual classroom or isolated program.
  • Strategic Leadership: Proven ability to lead complex, multi-year initiatives involving multiple organizations, manage budgets and timelines, and maintain stakeholder accountability without relying on direct reporting authority.
  • Human-Centered Design: Deep expertise in human-centered design, change management, prototyping, testing, and evidence-informed iteration, with the ability to translate research and stakeholder insights into practical solutions.
  • Instructional Expertise: Strong understanding of teaching and learning, instructional leadership, future-of-learning models, learner agency, mastery-based approaches, and meaningful assessment practices.
  • Education System Knowledge: Familiarity with school-system operations, district partnerships, and the educational landscape in Houston, Texas.
  • Data Analysis and Impact Evaluation: Ability to interpret longitudinal and disaggregated student outcome data, assess program effectiveness, and distinguish sustained improvements from short-term results.
  • Team Management: Demonstrated experience leading and coaching teams, including managing managers or senior leaders, and contributing to organization-wide strategy and decision-making.
  • Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to establish trusted partnerships with district executives, educators, families, funders, and community organizations.
  • Facilitation and Communication: Excellent facilitation, coaching, presentation, and executive communication skills, with the ability to guide complex discussions and build alignment among stakeholders with different priorities.
  • Strategic and Analytical Thinking: Strong judgment and problem-solving abilities, particularly when making evidence-based decisions in complex environments with incomplete information.
  • Adaptability and Innovation: Ability to balance ambitious innovation with disciplined execution, embrace uncertainty, and foster adaptive mindsets and continuous improvement.
  • Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work for any employer in the United States without requiring employment sponsorship.
  • Location Requirements: Must reside in Houston, Texas, or the surrounding area, with the ability to work remotely from a home office.
  • Travel Requirements: Must be available for frequent in-person engagement with Houston-area school systems and community partners, as well as additional national travel for organizational retreats, programming, professional development, and other business-related activities.

Benefits:

  • Competitive Annual Compensation: Base salary range of $172,036 to $214,029.
  • Standard Starting Salary: The expected starting salary for this position is $189,645.
  • Higher Starting Salary for Additional Experience: Candidates with more than 10 years of directly relevant experience may qualify for an adjusted starting salary of up to $201,836, depending on their experience.
  • Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage: 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums for individual employees.
  • Dependent Healthcare Support: 60% of additional premium costs covered for partners and dependents enrolled in medical, dental, and vision plans.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.
  • Flexible Spending Accounts: Access to accounts for eligible medical, childcare, and commuting expenses.
  • Employee Assistance Program: Access to additional resources and support through an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • Valuable Benefits Package: Employee benefits valued at $9,000 or more annually.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Full-time employees accrue 22 days of annual leave during their first three years of employment.
  • Additional Vacation Accrual: Five additional days of annual leave after the third and sixth years of employment.
  • Paid Holidays: 22 additional paid days off for holidays, including three floating holidays that employees can use at their discretion.
  • Remote Work Environment: Work remotely from a home office in the Houston area, with flexibility outside required in-person engagements and travel.
  • Meaningful Professional Impact: Opportunity to influence educational innovation, strengthen school systems, and contribute to improved outcomes for students and educators nationwide.
  • Collaborative Culture: Join a nationwide community of professionals committed to continuous learning, inclusive leadership, innovation, and educational excellence.
  • Leadership Development: Opportunities to shape strategic initiatives, develop teams, and contribute to organization-wide leadership and decision-making.

title: FIRE SAFETY SYSTEMS MANAGER
description:
LOCATION : Corporate Office - Chennai, Annasalai

EXPERIENCE : 10 to 15 years


Required Qualifications :

  1. Bachelor of Engineering or Bachelor of Technology (Fire or Mechanical or Electrical) with minimum 10 years of experience in design review, installation, commissioning, maintenance and troubleshooting of active and passive fire protection system OR
  2. Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical or Electrical) with 15 to 20 years of experience in design review, installation, commissioning, maintenance and troubleshooting of active and passive fire protection system


JOB DESCRIPTION

  • The Fire Safety Systems Manager will be responsible to ensure adequacy, suitability, quality, reliability and readiness of fire protection system throughout all MRF Plants.
  • Perform adequacy study of fire protection system of all the plants in terms of practical requirement, regulatory requirement, fire code, design aspect, operationality, maintenance feasibility and reliability
  • Establish and maintain SOP / Policy for selection, installation, commissioning, handover and maintenance of fire protection system in MRF considering local, national and international codes and best industrial practices
  • Decide on best suited appliances appropriate for our industry, environmental condition, hazard, emergency protocol, operation and maintenance feasibility
  • Support plants in finalizing Bill of Quantity, drawings, specifications, relevant certificates, OEM manuals, warranty certificates, preferred make for any fire protection system requirement
  • Verify the design, engineering calculations and drawings for all fire protection system requirements from plant to ensure requirements of relevant standards are met
  • Oversee fire protection system installation projects in plants to ensure quality of supplies and workmanship
  • Collaborate with engineering team for the commissioning & testing of fire protection system to ensure reliability
  • Assist plants to prepare inspection and maintenance calendar of fire system, oversee the implementation and monitor the effectiveness
  • Audit and verify the maintenance documents including AMC related documents and follow up with plant team for the timely closure of issues if any
  • Advice plants to create repository of firefighting equipment with their maintenance schedule and records
  • Find solutions for long term issues and repetitive troubles in the existing fire protection system
  • Develop methodology to measure uptime of firefighting system and achieve 100% uptime
  • Bring digital solution for improved governance of the maintenance indicators and documentation
  • Discover suitable solution for centralization of fire protection system at plant and corporate levels
  • Drive process hazard analysis study such as HAZOP, HAZID, Dust Explosion Potential etc. through competent partners. Validate the findings and recommendations
  • Drive the implementation of the finalized recommended actions coordinating with relevant stakeholders. Track the effectiveness of the implemented control measures


LINGUISTIC REQUIREMENTS : English, Hindi & Tamil

OTHER REQUIREMENTS :

  • In-depth knowledge of fire codes and building regulations such as NBC Part 4, NBCS 2026 requirements, NFPA, FM Global and Indian Standard code of practice for designing, installation and maintenance of fire protection and detection system
  • Hands-on expertise in design evaluation, hydraulic calculation of fire suppression system
  • Proven ability in diagnosing and troubleshooting complex circuit faults related to fire alarm system
  • Travel to all MRF plants across India

title: Manager Laboratory
description:
Shape the future of reliable electricity distribution—join Ensto India as Manager – Laboratory.

We are looking for a hands-on and detail-oriented laboratory professional with strong experience in electrical, mechanical, and environmental testing to support product quality, reliability, compliance, and innovation for electricity distribution solutions.

Ensto is an international, growth-oriented family business and technology company that creates smart solutions for electricity distribution networks. For 65 years, we have been dedicated to electricity with a long-term and human-centric approach. Our aim is to become a leading expert for distribution system operators, help them succeed, and create a more sustainable tomorrow.

We offer innovative and reliable, long-lifecycle overhead lines, underground networks, network automation and new smart technology products and solutions for electricity distribution networks. Our own R&D, manufacturing, and laboratories give us the expertise to continually innovate and serve our customers on an individual level.

Position: Manager – Laboratory

Function: Laboratory / Testing / Quality / Product Validation

Location: Ensto India, Manesar, Haryana

Experience: A minimum of 812+ years of relevant experience in an electrical / electronics / power products testing laboratory or similar industrial test environment.

This role reports to the Laboratory Manager in India and works closely with product development, product management, quality, and manufacturing teams to plan, execute, document, and improve laboratory testing activities in line with applicable standards, specifications, and safety requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a global organization, with experience managing diverse and multifaceted teams across complex environments.
  • Conduct electrical, mechanical, environmental, reliability, and product validation tests in a laboratory environment as per approved test plans, standards, and customer / internal specifications.
  • Prepare, review, and maintain laboratory test procedures, work instructions, test records, and techncal documentation with accuracy and traceability.
  • Operate, monitor, maintain, and coordinate readiness of laboratory test equipment, fixtures, instruments, environmental chambers, and related testing facilities.
  • Analyze test results, identify deviations or failures, support root cause analysis, and provide clear technical inputs to product development, quality, and product management teams.
  • Ensure adherence to laboratory quality management systems, calibration plans, safety guidelines, housekeeping standards, and applicable regulatory / industry requirements.
  • Support continuous improvement in testing methods, equipment utilization, reporting formats, turnaround time, and overall laboratory efficiency.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams for test requirements, sample readiness, test scheduling, reporting, and closure of technical actions.
  • Guide junior engineers / technicians where required and promote a safe, disciplined, and quality-focused laboratory culture.

Required Qualifications, Experience & Skills

  • B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Electrical & Electronics, Electronics & Communication, Instrumentation, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Minimum 812+ years of relevant experience in a product testing laboratory, R&D test lab, quality validation lab, certification lab, or manufacturing industry test environment.
  • Hands-on exposure to electrical, mechanical, and environmental testing of industrial / electrical / power distribution / switchgear / connector / cable accessory / similar engineered products.
  • Excellent understanding of testing methodologies, engineering principles, product specifications, calibration discipline, test documentation, and safety requirements.

title: AI QA Engineer
description:

These Applications are used by our customers to design, develop, produce and market their Products and/or Services to end consumers.   • Evaluate RAG-based applications, retrieval quality, embeddings, semantic similarity, and LLM response accuracy.
  • Test AI agents, MCP integrations, tool interactions, and non-deterministic agent responses.
  • Develop and maintain automation s for Web Services/APIs using frameworks such as Selenium and Playwright.
  • Investigate failed test cases and automation s, report defects, and provide defect and product quality metrics to the QA Manager.
  • Integrate AI model, prompt, and agent workflow evaluations into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Work closely with cross-functional and remote teams in an Agile/POD environment to ensure compliance with SQA standards and deliverable quality.

Qualifications

  • BE/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech professional who has 2-4 years of experience in Manual and Automation Testing of AI based Software Applications involved in development and execution of functional, integration & regression tests of both Web and Client-Server Applications using best in class AI concepts and strategies.
  • Working Knowledge and hands-on experience in Core AI & LLM systems as user and tester
  • Experienced in define and implementation of various testing strategies for AI virtual assistants, RAG based applications.
  • Experience with using AI-assisted coding tools and methods
  • Automation Testing of Web Services/APIs & good understanding of its Automation Framework (like Selenium, Playwright).
  • Should have the motivation and ability to learn new Tools (including in-house ones), and Processes in order to deliver global objectives.
  • Experience in any of the ing language like Java/Python is must.
  • Good Knowledge of SDLC/STLC Processes and Tools.
  • Investigate failed test cases/ automated s and report issues in defect tracking system, and provide Defect and Product metrics to QA Manager as appropriate.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure project compliance with SQA standards and overall deliverable quality.
  • Work with remote teams in an agile/agile POD environment.
  • Knowledge/Experience of working in a DevOps/CI-CD Environment would be an added advantage.
  • Ability to communicate well, work as part of a team and interact effectively with others.
  • Displays initiative, self-motivation, and effective time-management skills.

What's In It For You

  • Be at the forefront of building software products that are being deployed in mission-critical projects world wide
  • Be offered avenues to develop yourself for career progression
  • Not a low-level development opportunity, as you would get to work in the real business world and with a wide range of customers & coworkers

Inclusion statement

As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it's our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

  • Knowledge of construction and interior execution processes to ensure designs are practical and technically feasible.
  • Ability to manage multiple design projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.

  • A professional portfolio showcasing completed 3D visualization and interior/exterior design projects is mandatory.

Key Position Requirements

Education

Job Experience

  • Hands-on exposure to item or material creation, BOMs, specifications, packaging trials, supplier coordination, document control, D365, or another ERP system is an advantage.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Good written English for technical documentation, project updates, issue summaries, supplier communication, and stakeholder correspondence.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams; ability to maintain trackers, perform basic data checks, and prepare clear presentations.
  • Exposure to D365 or another ERP system, including item master, BOM, planning, purchasing, or workflow transactions, is preferred.

  • Good coordination and follow-up skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, materials, suppliers, and deadlines.

Desirable Job Competencies

  • Quick learner, high attention to detail and commitment to data and documentation accuracy.
  • Structured, logical, and methodical approach to project follow-up.
  • Proactive ownership of assigned actions and timely escalation of risks or delays.
  • Ability to work independently on routine tasks while seeking guidance for technical exceptions, commitments, and approvals.
  • Clear communication, teamwork, and stakeholder focus across global and cross-functional teams.

Additional Requirements

  • Availability to support critical trials, launches, production start-ups, or urgent material issues when reasonably required.
  • Ability to handle confidential product, supplier, costing, specification, and master-data information responsibly.

Role Boundaries and Decision Support

  • The role is expected to flag risks early, organize accurate supporting information, and recommend practical next steps rather than independently approving exceptions outside delegated authority.

Suggested Performance Measures

  • Quality and timeliness of trackers, reports, presentations, trial documentation, and stakeholder updates.

  • Effective escalation of risks affecting material availability, trial readiness, launch timing, quality, or production continuity.
  • Compliance with approved processes, change controls, system access, safety requirements, and required training.

About the Company

LifeStyles has a history dating back to 1905 when Eric Ansell first started making condoms in Richmond Australia.

Today LifeStyles is a Global leader in the sexual wellness sector, comprising a broad range of condoms, personal lubricants, and other related products and other products in over 60 countries.

title: Head of Media Relations
description:
Position Title: Head of Media Relations

Department: Communications

Reporting to: Chief Communications Officer

Terms of employment: Full Time, Salaried


Overview of Position

Spencer Stuart, a premier leadership advisory and executive search firm, is seeking a Media Relations Leader to shape and execute a global media strategy that strengthens the firm’s reputation with influential business, leadership and industry journalists. This role requires strong news instincts, sound judgment, high energy and a genuine passion for storytelling. The successful candidate will identify compelling ideas, build trusted media relationships and advise senior leaders on effective engagement with the press.


Working closely with the Chief Communications Officer, firm leaders and external agency partners, the successful candidate will help define where Spencer Stuart has the right to lead in the conversation and ensure its perspectives reach the audiences that matter most. The role calls for a hands-on communications leader who can move easily from strategy to execution.


The ideal candidate will bring a global mindset, strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, and the confidence to counsel senior stakeholders in fast-moving situations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute media engagement strategies that advance Spencer Stuart’s reputation and business priorities globally.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with key journalists across business, leadership, talent, governance and industry media.
  • Partner with senior leaders to define media priorities, identify opportunities and prepare for press engagement.
  • Translate firm priorities and market insights into compelling storylines, pitches, messaging, talking points and briefing materials.
  • Create communications plans, press materials, social media content and related assets.
  • Monitor the news environment and identify timely opportunities for Spencer Stuart to contribute relevant perspectives.
  • Manage communications agency partners, setting direction, aligning priorities and ensuring high-quality execution.
  • Collaborate across Communications, Marketing, Legal, HR, practices and regions to ensure coordinated, accurate messaging.
  • Track media activity and outcomes to assess effectiveness and refine future engagement.
  • Support broader communications priorities with a team-first, roll-up-your-sleeves approach.

Required Skills

  • Strong media instincts, sound judgment and a clear understanding of what makes a story timely, credible and compelling.
  • Demonstrated experience building media engagement strategies for a major organization.
  • Proven ability to advise senior leaders on positioning, messaging and interview preparation.
  • Excellent writing and editing skills across plans, pitches, talking points, press materials and social media content.
  • Knowledge of emerging media platforms, digital storytelling, social media best practices and the impact of AI on news and information.
  • Strong problem-solving, critical-thinking and prioritization skills in complex or fast-moving situations.
  • A global mindset and the ability to adapt across markets, cultures and stakeholder groups.

Competencies

  • Passionate, energetic and curious, with a strong interest in news, business, leadership and the broader media landscape.
  • Strategic and practical, able to connect communications activity to firm priorities while executing with discipline and attention to detail.
  • Trusted adviser to senior leaders, with the confidence and judgment to provide clear counsel.
  • Collaborative team player who builds strong working relationships across functions, geographies and levels.
  • Agile and solutions-oriented, able to navigate ambiguity and move work forward.

Ideal Experience

  • Demonstrated success leading media engagement on behalf of a major organization, professional services firm or similarly complex global business is required.
  • Strong preference for strategic communications agency experience.
  • Experience working directly with senior executives or subject-matter experts to shape media strategy and prepare for interviews or public engagement.
  • Experience managing communications agency partners.
  • Former journalists with successful corporate communications experience will be considered.
  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, public relations, marketing or a related field preferred.

Key Relationships

  • Reports to the Chief Communications Officer.
  • Partners with senior leaders across the organization, as well as colleagues across Communications, Marketing, Legal, HR, Finance and other functions.
  • Manages external communications agency partners.

The base compensation range for this position is $240,000 per year. The actual base compensation offered within this range will be dependent on the individual’s skills, experiences, and qualifications. This position will be eligible to participate in our annual discretionary bonus program.

Spencer Stuart also offers a competitive benefits package, which includes:

  • Retirement savings plan with discretionary profit sharing contribution and employer match;
  • PTO (minimum 15 days per year, increases with tenure), paid sick time (10 days per year), company holidays (12 days per year), and paid leaves of absence when applicable;
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, and healthcare flexible spending account;
  • Life Insurance, and short-term and long-term disability insurance;
  • Wellness benefits, including an employee assistance program, virtual mental health program, and mindfulness program; and
  • Voluntary benefit options, including supplemental life insurance, identity theft protection, and whole life insurance with long-term care and critical illness coverage.

title: Founding Product Manager
description:
Experience: 8.00 + years

Salary: Confidential (based on experience)

Expected Notice Period: 30 Days

Shift: (GMT+05:30) Asia/Kolkata (IST)

Opportunity Type: Office ()

Placement Type: Full Time Permanent position(Payroll and Compliance to be managed by: Astra)

(*Note: This is a requirement for one of Uplers client - Astra)

What do you need for this opportunity

Must have skills required:

System Logic, State thinking, Product Workflow Automation, Agentic AI, Large Language Model (LLM), API Integrations, API, SQL, Figma

Astra is Looking for:

  • Astra is a US healthcare AI startup building the agentic operating system for behavioral health clinics. We are targeting the $250B behavioural health market, starting with the administrative work that makes care expensive, slow, and hard to scale.
  • Location: Bangalore, with quarterly US travel.

About Astra


  • Mental healthcare is growing fast, but the infrastructure behind it is broken. Clinicians spend hours on documentation. Clinics spend meaningful revenue on manual admin work. Back-office teams wait on hold with insurance payers, verify benefits by hand, file claims through payer portals, and chase denials months after a visit.
  • These workflows were built for a different era. They cannot scale to meet the demand coming online.
  • Astra automates the invisible work of running a mental health practice: intake, benefits verification, prior authorization, clinical documentation, claims filing, denial follow-up, payment tracking, and reporting. Our agents make calls, use browser workflows, reason through payer-specific rules, hand off to humans when needed, and learn from every outcome.
  • We are not selling dashboards. We are replacing the work itself.

The Role


  • We are looking for a founding PM to own the product function at Astra.
  • This is a product role for a fully agentic system: AI that takes action, makes decisions, traverses APIs, browser workflows, and phone calls, and knows when to ask a human for help. You will work directly with the founder and engineering team to define what we build, how these systems behave, how they earn trust, and how they improve over time.
  • The problem is genuinely hard. A mental health practice is a dense system of intake, scheduling, documentation, eligibility, prior authorization, claims, denials, payments, and clinical operations. Decisions in one workflow ripple into the next. Most of what we are building has no playbook. You will help write it.
  • You may be the only PM for a while. That means high leverage, low cover, and real ownership.

What You'll Own


  • Product strategy and execution across Astra's core product surfaces: intake, scheduling, benefits verification, prior authorization, documentation, claims, denials, payments, reporting, and internal operations.
  • Agentic workflow design: agent behavior, confidence thresholds, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, escalation paths, decision traces, and feedback loops.
  • Deep customer work: discovery, onboarding, implementation, rollout, support, and sales support. You need to understand how clinicians, billers, operators, and practice owners actually work.
  • Product design: flows, wireframes, UI specs, internal tools, and operator experiences. Design is how complex AI systems become legible to humans.
  • Technical requirements: system logic, state transitions, agent behavior specs, edge cases, integrations, and failure modes.
  • Execution: scoping, sequencing, milestones, releases, rollout plans, risk management, and unblocking engineering.
  • The company feedback loop: turning customer calls, operator pain points, payer quirks, clinical workflows, and denial patterns into product decisions that make Astra smarter every week.

What We're Looking For


  • 8-10 years in product management, with meaningful ownership of a complex product or major product surface.
  • Experience building B2B, enterprise, workflow, vertical SaaS, fintech, healthcare, insurance, compliance, or other operationally complex products.
  • Strong customer obsession. You spend time with users, understand their workflows in detail, and can translate messy reality into product clarity.
  • Strong technical literacy. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable reasoning with engineers about architecture, systems, integrations, and tradeoffs.
  • Strong product design instincts. You care about how the product works and how it feels, especially for internal operators and customers using AI systems they need to trust.
  • Clear writing. You can write PRDs, customer emails, implementation docs, and decision memos that reduce ambiguity.
  • Agentic AI experience or strong mental models for products where AI takes action, gets things wrong, asks for help, and improves over time.
  • Early-stage operating experience or the temperament for it: no playbook, high ambiguity, fast shipping, and direct exposure to customers.
  • US-first product sensibility, ideally from working with US customers or at a US-focused company.
  • Have a B1/B2 visa and can travel to the US regularly (

You Might Be a Fit If


  • You are energized by hard, messy problems without obvious answers.
  • You like being close to customers, operators, and engineering.
  • You can move from strategy to PRD to wireframe to rollout plan in the same week.
  • You make crisp scope calls and are comfortable defending what not to build.
  • You communicate early, clearly, and without needing to be chased.
  • You care about building beautiful, trustworthy products in a complex domain.

Not a Fit If


  • You need established processes, rituals, and support systems to do your best work.
  • You want to manage PMs more than build product.
  • You prefer to stay away from customers or implementation details.
  • You do not enjoy working through operational complexity.
  • Your background and interests are primarily consumer product.
  • You do not care much about design.

Interview Process


  • L1- Intro conversation with the founders.
  • L2- Product deep dive on something you have shipped and one Astra product problem.
  • L3- Paid work trial on a real product problem.

How to apply for this opportunity

  • Step 2: Complete the Screening Form & Upload updated Resume

title: Campaign Operations Executive
description:
Job De ion

Location: Mumbai, BKC

Department: Brand Solutions

Role: Operations / Campaign Execution

Reporting To: Taplight Business / Operations Lead

About the Role

The role will be responsible for managing the day-to-day execution of campaigns, coordinating with internal teams, clients, vendors and on-ground partners, and ensuring that all deliverables are executed within timelines and agreed scope.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously, have strong follow-up skills, and be able to drive execution from planning to closure.

Key Responsibilities

1. Campaign & Execution Management

  • Coordinate end-to-end execution of campaigns, activations and brand projects.
  • Translate approved plans into clear execution checklists and timelines.
  • Track campaign deliverables against agreed scope and ensure timely closure.
  • Coordinate with relevant teams for print, digital, social media, events and on-ground requirements.
  • Ensure all execution is aligned with client-approved plans and deliverables.
  • Cost Managament is going to be a crucial part of the role.

2. Internal Coordination

  • Work in the Taplight team exclusively coordinating with sales, creative, digital, editorial, print and other internal teams.
  • Share clear briefs, timelines and execution requirements with respective teams.
  • Follow up regularly to ensure tasks are completed within deadlines.
  • Identify execution gaps or delays and escalate them proactively.

3. Vendor & Partner Management

  • Coordinate with vendors, agencies, production partners and on-ground teams.
  • Obtain quotations, compare costs and coordinate procurement wherever required.
  • Track production, delivery, installation and deployment timelines.
  • Ensure vendors deliver as per agreed specifications and quality standards.

4. On-Ground Execution

  • Coordinate logistics and on-ground requirements for activations and events.
  • Ensure branding assets and campaign elements are deployed as per the approved plan.
  • Coordinate manpower, permissions, production, transportation and other operational requirements.
  • Conduct regular checks during execution and resolve operational issues quickly

5. Documentation & Reporting

  • Maintain campaign trackers, execution reports and status updates.
  • Collect and maintain deployment photographs, proof of execution and other closure documents.
  • Prepare regular updates for internal stakeholders and clients.
  • Ensure all campaign-related documentation is properly organised for billing and closure.

6. Budget & Commercial Coordination

  • Track campaign costs against approved budgets.
  • Coordinate with finance/procurement teams for POs, invoices and vendor payments.
  • Flag any additional cost or scope deviation before commitment.
  • Ensure no additional deliverables are committed without the required internal/client approval.

7. Client Servicing & Communication

  • Maintain timely and proactive communication with the client during the execution phase, ensuring all relevant updates, progress and requirements are communicated appropriately.
  • Coordinate with the Client Servicing / BS team to ensure the client is kept informed on execution status, milestones and any changes.
  • Ensure client queries, concerns or execution-related requirements are addressed and closed within agreed timelines.
  • Maintain professionalism and clarity in all client communication and ensure commitments made to the client are aligned with the approved scope.

8. Internal Updates & Crisis Communication

  • Provide timely updates to the Reporting Manager and BS Team on campaign progress, execution status and any anticipated challenges.
  • Immediately flag any potential execution crisis, delay, quality issue, vendor concern or client-sensitive matter to the Manager and BS Team.
  • Keep the BS Team updated on all key execution details, including deployment status, pending deliverables, changes, delays and closures.
  • Ensure that any crisis or deviation is communicated internally before it escalates to the client, wherever possible, allowing the team to align on the appropriate response.
  • Maintain a clear and updated execution tracker to ensure complete visibility for the Manager and BS Team.

9. Team Confidentiality & Commercial Sensitivity

  • Maintain strict confidentiality regarding pricing, commercial negotiations, vendor rates, revenue streams, margins, client commercials and internal business information.
  • Ensure vendor pricing, client commercials and internal revenue-related information are not disclosed to unauthorised personnel or external parties.
  • Maintain confidentiality of internal discussions, business strategies, client information and team-related matters.
  • Share commercial and sensitive information strictly on a need-to-know basis and as per internal protocols.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong coordination and follow-up skills.
  • Excellent organisational and time-management abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
  • Good vendor and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to work under tight deadlines and pressure.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
  • Ability to maintain trackers and execution documentation.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Willingness to travel for on-ground campaign execution when required.

Desired Experience

  • 2–5 years of experience in operations, campaign execution, events, activations, media, advertising or marketing.
  • Experience in managing vendors and on-ground execution will be an advantage.
  • Candidates from media agencies, event agencies, brand activation agencies or integrated marketing teams would be preferred.

What We Expect

The person should be someone who takes ownership rather than just follows up—from receiving the brief to ensuring the final execution is completed, documented and closed.

The role requires someone who can:

  • Keep multiple stakeholders aligned.
  • Ensure timelines are met.
  • Anticipate operational challenges.
  • Escalate issues at the right time.
  • Maintain execution discipline.
  • Ensure that what is promised is actually delivered.
  • Close every campaign with proper documentation and reporting.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Timely completion of campaign deliverables.
  • Quality and accuracy of execution.
  • Effective vendor and internal coordination.
  • Adherence to approved scope and budgets.
  • Timely submission of execution reports and documentation.
  • Speed of issue resolution.
  • Overall campaign closure and operational efficiency.

title: AI Workflow Specialist -On-site in Dubai
description:
Turn AI into everyday operational impact for a $1Billion+ e-commerce brand. Build and run workflows that eliminate repetitive work, connect teams and systems, and deliver faster, more reliable results.

Up to AED 264,000 (tax-free) total annual cash compensation

(Base salary up to AED 20,000/month, plus a monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base)

Location: Dubai, UAE (On-site) with relocation assistance and visa support

Growth path from here is Senior AI Workflow Specialist → AI Workflow Lead. What takes 4-5 years elsewhere happens in 1-2 here.

We've been AI-first since December 2023: You'll personally map business processes, build and test AI-powered automations, and monitor and refine them in daily use. You remain accountable for output accuracy, reliable execution, exception handling, and measurable improvements in quality and turnaround time.

Role Overview

Puffy, a market-leading, nine-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1Billion in sales, is hiring an AI Workflow Specialist to own hands-on workflow delivery across process mapping, AI production, systems integration and team adoption, reporting directly to Mars Bai, Chief AI Operations Officer.

This role exists to turn business needs into reliable AI-enabled work, building reusable workflows and operating guides that help teams deliver accurate results without constant technical support.

The Problems You'll Own

  • Primary: Less effort, dependable results: The challenge is turning business requests into AI-enabled work that produces useful results consistently. Less manual effort is only a gain if quality holds when real inputs and exceptions arrive. The problem you own is making that improvement repeatable, with clear inputs, reliable outputs and checks that protect quality.
  • Secondary: Workflows that outlast the handoff: A solution has limited value if its users depend on its creator to keep it running. The supporting challenge is making workflows understandable, maintainable and usable by the teams they serve, without constant technical support.

The Career Accelerator

This is not a role where you collect prompts, run isolated demos or pass unchecked AI output to another team. You'll work across business functions, personally build and test workflows, and take evidence and decisions directly to the Chief AI Operations Officer.

Your first 12 months: turn agreed business priorities into usable workflows, reusable components, reliable connections and operating guides. Shape how teams at Puffy use AI to improve work quality and reduce total human effort.

  • Map the work. Establish the required outcome, inputs, decisions, handoffs and current quality and human-effort baseline. Use AI to draft workflow specifications, then validate them with the people doing the work.
  • Build and test. Personally produce AI instructions, workflow configurations and reusable components. Test real inputs and exceptions, check accuracy and usefulness, and refine the workflow before deployment.
  • Connect systems reliably. Configure information flows between business tools and AI. Validate mappings and outputs, handle permissions carefully and retain appropriate human review before consequential actions.
  • Improve performance. Evaluate output quality, total human effort, elapsed turnaround, model and tool costs, reliability and maintenance needs. Use evidence to simplify work and correct failure patterns.
  • Enable adoption. Use AI to produce clear operating instructions, guides and knowledge resources, then verify them with users. Train teams, support troubleshooting and maintain reusable solutions.

Deliver usable workflows and checked outputs, not demonstrations alone. Good work is accurate, useful on real inputs, repeatable, understandable to its users and maintained after handoff.

Contribute early and work with fast turnaround on agreed priorities, without bypassing checks. Make quality, review effort, rework and handoff effort visible; measure elapsed turnaround separately. Own defects and improvements through resolution rather than passing an unverified AI output to the next team.

What Is In It For You

This isn't just another workflow automation role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.

1. Own the Workflow From Business Need to Daily Use

You build the workflow, validate the output and own the result.

You'll connect business requirements, AI production and team adoption in one hands-on role. Working directly with Mars, you'll use evidence on quality, effort and reliability to guide improvements, with appropriate human review before consequential actions.

2. Join a High-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:

Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1Billion USD in Sales

Great Place to Work Certified

Join an AI-first organization led by a Forbes Council Member CEO

Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high-velocity execution that drives a global brand

3. Experience a World-Class Lifestyle

Dubai offers a tax-free salary, world-class infrastructure, year-round sunshine, and a global lifestyle that most professionals only experience later in their careers. Your entire compensation package lands in your account — no deductions, no surprises.

4. Become the Person Who Knows When a Workflow Is Ready

In most companies, automation work ends with a demo. Here, you're the person who can explain whether a workflow is useful, repeatable and ready for real inputs. When teams consider changing how they work, your test evidence helps them decide what to trust and where human review belongs. You'll build judgment about AI output quality and the communication skills to make that judgment usable. Puffy has been AI-First since December 2023, so you'll build that judgment with an AI-native toolbox behind you rather than a queue of manual fixes in front of you.

What You'll Need

  • Relevant experience. 2–3 years of experience in workflow automation, process optimization, operations or similar work involving systematic problem-solving. Logical reasoning and proven delivery matter more than job titles.
  • Hands-on AI delivery. Experience designing and delivering multi-step workflows using AI tools and workflow platforms, including practical application to business work.
  • Sound judgment and validation. Ability to translate a business problem into a clear workflow, test real inputs and judge whether the output is accurate, useful and repeatable. Strong logical reasoning is essential; coding experience is not required.
  • Curiosity and communication. Curiosity about AI, judgment about where new capabilities are useful, and clear communication and documentation skills for training and supporting business teams.
  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed.

Good-to-Have

  • Experience using workflow automation platforms, such as n8n, to connect applications and automate multi-step processes
  • Experience diagnosing issues in automated workflows; basic understanding of APIs and webhooks; ability to explain workflows with simple diagrams or flowcharts.

Resources Provided

You'll have access to our latest company-provided AI tools, including ChatGPT and Claude, multiple AI agents, bots, plugins, AI projects, and automations through platforms such as n8n. You'll also receive the department tools, relevant data, assets and specialist support needed to deliver your work. We expect you to use these resources to automate routine work and deliver high-quality results quickly.

The Puffy DNA:

We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.

  • Be the Owner: We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
  • Execute with Urgency: We thrive in high-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
  • Demand Excellence: We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
  • Be AI-First: Daily multi-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
  • Go All-In: When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.

Your Total Compensation & Benefits

Compensation:

Up to AED 264,000 (tax-free) total annual cash compensation (base + monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base)

Annual salary review every January

Tax-free income

Annual return flight allowance to your home country

AI-First organization with access to AI-native tool stack

Premium office environment in Dubai Internet City

Up to $5,000 annual learning budget for courses and certifications

International team collaboration, 16+ nationalities in one office. Your assumptions get challenged daily.

title: Senior Threat Researcher - Windows
description:
Hiring for Lean SuperIntelligence — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

ABOUT US

We are a stealth Frontier AI security startup building foundation models for security. Backed by Tier 1 venture capital firms and built by experts in sovereign AI, foundation models, and cybersecurity.

We have built models that already outperform frontier LLMs on cybersecurity benchmarks.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Founding Senior Threat Researcher to own Windows threat research, telemetry, detection, vulnerability discovery, and deep technical escalation.

You will reverse engineer malware and EDR behavior, fuzz Windows attack surfaces, develop exploits to prove impact, and build realistic environments used to benchmark autonomous offensive systems. Windows is the center of gravity, with meaningful work across identity, cloud, and containers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Research Windows tradecraft end to end: process injection, LSASS credential access, token and handle abuse, UAC and privilege escalation, and persistence via services, COM, WMI, scheduled tasks, and registry.

  • Define Windows telemetry strategy across kernel callbacks, ETW and ETW-TI, minifilters, AMSI, and user-mode instrumentation.

  • Reverse engineer malware and offensive tooling to reconstruct behavior, capabilities, and command-and-control protocols.

  • Research EDR evasion and tampering, including driver abuse, BYOVD, ETW or AMSI bypass, callback removal, and PPL abuse; build counter-detections.

  • Build continuous fuzzing against services, RPC/COM, parsers, IOCTL handlers, and drivers using WinAFL, honggfuzz, TTD-assisted approaches, or custom harnesses.

  • Triage crashes to root cause and develop proof-of-impact exploits against CFG/XFG, CET, ACG, ASLR/KASLR, SMEP, VBS, HVCI, and other modern mitigations.

  • Audit Windows-facing open-source and third-party code, drive fixes, and support responsible disclosure.

  • Build intentionally vulnerable Windows labs and multi-stage kill chains for AI training and evaluation.

  • Ship detections with documented data sources, evasion boundaries, tests, and measured false-positive rates.

  • Follow endpoint compromise into Active Directory, Entra ID, Azure, and Windows container attack paths; support incidents and purple exercises.

  • Cover Windows containers and Docker on Windows hosts, including image abuse and container-escape classes; publish rigorous internal research and external work where appropriate.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Deep Windows internals knowledge across processes, threads, tokens, objects, handles, memory management, loaders, and drivers.

  • Strong memory-corruption fundamentals and understanding of modern exploit mitigations.

  • Hands-on fuzzing, crash analysis, reproducer minimization, and root-cause determination.

  • Reverse-engineering and debugging experience with IDA, Ghidra, Binary Ninja, WinDbg, x64dbg, or equivalent tools.

  • Practical ETW, endpoint, and EDR knowledge, including blind spots and evasion boundaries.

  • Development ability in at least two of C, C++, Rust, Go, C#, or Python; enough C or C++ to audit the code being attacked is required.

  • Track record writing detection logic in Sigma, KQL, EQL, YARA, or a vendor language and measuring alert quality.

  • Working knowledge of cloud identity and audit telemetry, preferably Azure and Entra ID, plus container fundamentals.

  • Strong technical judgment, creative attack-path reasoning, and clear written communication.

  • We value demonstrated ability over formal credentials, certifications, or a fixed number of years of experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Windows kernel security research, driver development, kernel debugging, or kernel exploitation.

  • Weaponized exploit development and modern mitigation-bypass chains.

  • Published research, CVEs, bug-bounty findings, conference talks, or open-source security contributions.

  • Deep Active Directory expertise, including ADCS, delegation, Kerberos, and hybrid identity attack paths.

  • Experience building or bypassing a commercial EDR.

  • Experience with AI agents, autonomous systems, security automation, or benchmark environments.

  • Threat-intelligence experience spanning actor tracking, campaign analysis, or infrastructure pivoting.
