title: VFX Consultant--Feature Films
description:
VFX Consultant-Vendor Management & Delivery (Feature Films)

Vendor Costing, Pipeline & Delivery

Location - Kochi / remote, with vendor-site and review attendance as required

Duration - 3-6 months, renewable

The role

We commission feature VFX from external studios. This role independently vets what those studios quote — scope, effort, rates, schedule — and then owns the client-side relationship through production: pipeline and turnover standards, day-to-day vendor communication, and holding vendors to schedule, spec and quality until final delivery.

Costing and delivery sit with one person deliberately: whoever challenges a bid should be accountable for whether it was achievable. The consultant advises us as a client and must hold no commercial ties to bidding vendors.

Responsibilities

Bid vetting and award

  • Review quotes at shot, sequence and asset level: man-days by discipline, seniority mix, iteration allowance, supervision overheads, render and licence costs.
  • Identify padding, missing scope, unrealistic schedules and unpriced dependencies — plates, on-set data, delivery specs.
  • Maintain internal rate cards and cost-per-shot benchmarks; flag deviation in both directions.
  • Test vendor capability against claims — headcount, render capacity, security readiness, subcontracting — and treat an under-priced bid as a risk, not a win.
  • Produce comparison matrices and a written award recommendation; support negotiation with technical arguments and viable de-scopes.
  • Review SOWs, assumptions and exclusions, change-order and overage terms with legal and procurement.

Pipeline and turnover

  • Set hand-off standards in both directions: plates, resolutions, colour space and LUTs, naming conventions, EDL/XML turnover packages, camera and on-set data.
  • Ensure vendor pipelines interoperate — essential where sequences split across studios or assets are reused between them.
  • Own cross-vendor asset and version control, so nothing is built, or paid for, twice.
  • Manage the VFX-to-DI interface: conform, final pulls, deliverable formats, handover schedule.

Vendor communication and delivery

  • Single point of contact between production, the VFX Supervisor, editorial, DI and every vendor.
  • Run weekly vendor calls, shot reviews and note transmission — most overage traces back to late or ambiguous notes.
  • Own the master cross-vendor shot schedule and status tracker; catch slippage early and drive recovery rather than post-mortems.
  • Manage cross-vendor dependencies so no studio idles waiting on another.
  • Enforce delivery: technical QC on receipt, retake tracking, final sign-off, source-file turnover.

Cost control

  • Track actuals against approved bids; validate every change order and overage claim.
  • Escalate variance early, with a recommended course of action.
  • Post-show cost debrief and vendor performance review, feeding back into benchmarks.

Requirements

  • Feature films, mandatory — credits on 3–4+ released features, turnover through to final delivery. Episodic and advertising credits are welcome additions but not substitutes.
  • 8–12+ years in VFX with direct ownership of bidding and budgeting: VFX Producer, Line Producer, Head of Production, or VFX Supervisor with commercial exposure.
  • Proven multi-vendor delivery — 8+ vendors and 3000+ shots concurrently on a single feature at 15-50 Cr scale, delivered on schedule.
  • Command of feature turnover mechanics: colour pipeline and ACES, conform, EDL/XML, deliverable specs, DI handover.
  • Working knowledge of Nuke, Houdini, Maya, Flame/Resolve, and fluent daily use of ShotGrid/Flow or ftrack as the delivery backbone.
  • Strong Excel/Sheets modelling — auditable cost models and schedules.
  • Firm but constructive with vendors; exceptional written communication; assumes nothing is understood until it is confirmed in writing.
  • Preferred: experience on both vendor and client side; familiarity with RFP and tender processes; vendors across [India, SEA, EU] and multiple time zones.

Deliverables

Cost vetting report and comparison matrix per bid

  • rate-card and cost-per-shot benchmark database
  • turnover specification issued to all vendors
  • master shot schedule and weekly status report
  • QC and retake log with delivery sign-off
  • post-show cost and vendor review.

Success measures

Validated savings against original quotes

  • reduced change orders and budget variance
  • on-time final delivery
  • first-pass technical QC acceptance rate
  • fewer avoidable retakes traceable to notes or turnover errors
  • no delivery-blocking surprise reaching leadership unwarned.

Terms

Signed NDA before access to bid data. Written declaration of interests — no financial or employment relationship with bidding vendors during the engagement or for 3 months either side, and no commissions or referral fees. All benchmarks, templates and reports created remain our intellectual property.

Skills: vendor coordination,pipeline,feature films,vfx,bid vetting

title: Senior Unix/Infrastructure Systems Engineer
description:
Job Category:

Global IT

Infrastructure, Operations & Security

Job Description:

The Senior Systems Engineer is the technical owner and Tier 3 escalation point for our enterprise Linux and IBM AIX environments, including 300+ Red Hat Linux servers that remain a core part of our infrastructure. This role works independently on complex systems, makes sound production risk decisions, and leads significant portions of infrastructure projects, upgrades, and service improvements.


Beyond Linux, you will bring broad infrastructure knowledge across storage, networking, virtualization, monitoring, and security. You will develop and mentor Tier 2 engineers, partner with managed-service providers and vendors, and drive an automation- and AI-first approach to infrastructure operations, eliminating repetitive work and building the knowledge foundation that enables AI agents to support troubleshooting and remediation.


Hybrid: This role offers a flexible hybrid work schedule (Monday-Friday) located at our Home Office in Green Bay, Wisconsin. The hybrid work schedule is 3 days/week onsite at Home Office and 2 days/week from home.


Relocation Benefits: Receive a $10,000 relocation bonus PLUS a generous relocation package if relocating more than 50 miles for this position.


About our Green Bay, WI Home Office:

You’ll find lots to love in our beautiful home office in downtown Green Bay, Wisconsin. Our jeans-friendly environment has indoor and outdoor collaboration spaces, state-of-the-art R&D and sensory labs, culinary kitchens, a pilot plant, innovation center and more.


Take advantage of outdoor workspaces. Sample and provide feedback on new products from our R&D team. Enjoy free coffee, soda and popcorn. Take a short walk to restaurants, breweries, the YMCA and a weekly farmer’s market on the scenic Fox River. You can even see Lambeau Field from our top floor.



What You'll Do

Technical Ownership & Leadership

  • Serve as the overall technical owner and Tier 3 escalation point for enterprise Linux and IBM AIX environments.
  • Lead significant portions of complex projects, upgrades, implementations, and service improvements.
  • Develop and mentor Tier 2 engineers, building team capability through training and practical technical guidance rather than performing all routine administration personally.
  • Communicate technical recommendations, risks, and operational impacts to IT partners and department stakeholders.
  • Maintain the company-specific knowledge required to support the environment as more routine execution moves to managed-service partners and automation.

Linux & AIX Administration

  • Oversee administration of Linux and IBM AIX servers across production, non-production, and disaster recovery environments, including provisioning, configuration, maintenance, and decommissioning.
  • Manage filesystems, LVM/volume groups, disk capacity, users, groups, sudo access, SSH configuration, service accounts, and system services.
  • Perform IBM AIX administration including LPAR, VIOS, NIM, PowerVM, volume group, logical volume, filesystem, and device management.
  • Define and maintain server build and configuration standards.

Patching & Lifecycle Management

  • Own Linux and AIX patching and maintenance, including validation of application and infrastructure services before and after patching.
  • Resolve complex patching failures, dependency issues, repository problems, and failed package installations.
  • Lead operating system upgrades and remediation of unsupported or end-of-life systems.

Incident, Problem & Production Support

  • Resolve complex Linux/AIX incidents escalated from Tier 2 teams and managed-service partners.
  • Perform root-cause analysis on performance degradation, boot and service failures, network and DNS issues, authentication and Active Directory integration, storage, and application connectivity problems.
  • Analyze incidents, recurring issues, and performance trends to improve reliability and reduce risk; lead problem management for recurring infrastructure issues.
  • Make sound production risk decisions during incidents and scheduled maintenance.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and provide after-hours support for production incidents and scheduled maintenance.

Infrastructure, Monitoring & Disaster Recovery

  • Apply a strong understanding of storage, networking, VMware vSphere, monitoring, and security to support Linux workloads on virtual and IBM Power platforms.
  • Troubleshoot server-side connectivity to SAN, NAS, NFS, and other enterprise storage platforms.
  • Use enterprise monitoring and operational tooling to track server health, capacity, and availability, and identify issues before they cause outages.
  • Support VMware and disaster recovery activities, including DR testing, server recovery, and documentation of recovery results.
  • Provide hands-on support for the Home Office datacenter when necessary.

Security & Compliance

  • Apply operating system security standards and lead vulnerability remediation, coordinating with application owners where necessary.
  • Oversee privileged access, sudo, SSH, service-account, and certificate management.
  • Support audit evidence collection and compliance requests while following change-management, security, and access-control processes.

Automation & AI-Enabled Operations

  • Bring an automation and Infrastructure-as-Code mindset, using Ansible, Python, Bash/shell scripting, and other approved tools.
  • Eliminate repetitive operational work by developing scripts, playbooks, and automated workflows.
  • Think strategically about how AI changes infrastructure support, not just how to use today's tools.
  • Consolidate Linux and infrastructure knowledge into an authoritative knowledge source that AI agents can use for troubleshooting and remediation recommendations.
  • Over time, help enable AI agents to safely carry out increasingly sophisticated operational actions.

Vendor & Managed-Service Partnership

  • Work with and help lead managed-service providers that support the Linux/AIX environment.
  • Clearly define what should remain internally owned and what can move to managed-service partners, vendors, or automation.
  • Maintain key vendor relationships, technology knowledge, and contract awareness.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Develop and maintain standards, procedures, runbooks, support documentation, and knowledge articles.
  • Make sure documentation supports recovery of critical Linux/AIX services and keeps server configuration records accurate.

What You Will Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 4+ years of hands-on Linux systems administration experience, with strong Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) skills. Oracle Linux experience is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of IBM AIX administration.
  • Strong understanding of storage, networking, VMware vSphere, monitoring, and security.
  • Strong automation skills with Ansible, Python, Bash/shell scripting, and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience with SSH and sudo, LVM and filesystems, Linux package management, DNS and TCP/IP, Active Directory integration, backup and recovery, monitoring and log analysis, and ITSM/change-management processes.
  • Experience working with or leading managed-service providers and vendors.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and production risk decision-making skills.
  • Ability to mentor others, influence within the department, and explain technical topics clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • IBM Power Systems, PowerVM, VIOS, NIM, and LPAR experience.
  • Red Hat, Oracle Linux, or IBM AIX certification.
  • VMware administration and disaster recovery experience.
  • Enterprise SAN/NAS experience.
  • Experience supporting high-availability environments.
  • Familiarity with certificate and PKI management.
  • Experience applying AI tools or agents to infrastructure operations.
  • Experience working within an ITIL-based support organization.

In addition to an 8% 401(k) match into the ESOP, Schreiber will contribute an extra amount – about 8% of your earnings – toward your retirement every year. title: Forensic Regulatory Data Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Forensic Regulatory Data Analyst based in the United States.

Join a specialized team uncovering hidden billing errors and recovering significant savings for large commercial and industrial clients. In this entry-level role, you will combine Python programming, forensic data analysis, and regulatory research to identify opportunities that conventional audits often overlook. You will develop expertise in complex utility tariffs, billing structures, and regulatory frameworks while turning detailed analysis into actionable financial claims. Working across multiple accounts and jurisdictions, you will collaborate with experienced analysts and contribute to analytical tools that improve audit capabilities. A structured training program will help you build a rare, highly valuable skill set, with a clear path toward greater responsibility and performance-based earning potential.

Accountabilities

  • Analyze utility billing data using Python and specialized analytical tools to identify billing errors, misapplied rates, overlooked credits, and other cost-saving opportunities.

  • Learn and interpret complex tariff schedules, demand charge calculations, rider provisions, tax codes, regulatory requirements, and jurisdiction-specific billing rules.

  • Conduct retrospective audits covering the full applicable statute of limitations, often six years or more, to maximize potential client recoveries.

  • Develop original, technically defensible claim theories by combining regulatory knowledge with pattern recognition across billing histories, meter data, and account classifications.

  • Prepare persuasive claim submissions, client summaries, and regulatory correspondence that explain complex billing issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Communicate with clients, utility providers, tax authorities, and regulatory agencies to pursue claims and secure identified savings.

  • Follow up on disputed or delayed claims and escalate matters through appropriate administrative and regulatory channels when necessary.

  • Coordinate with external legal specialists when claims require additional legal or regulatory support.

  • Maintain accurate documentation of claims, supporting evidence, correspondence, deadlines, and recovery outcomes from identification through payment.

  • Collaborate with technical and information systems teams to develop and improve analytical tools, automate anomaly detection, and strengthen account review processes.

  • Manage changing priorities across accounts, jurisdictions, and claim types while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.

Requirements:

  • Approximately 1–3 years of relevant experience, or equivalent academic, internship, or project experience demonstrating the ability to master complex, rule-based systems and translate that knowledge into practical opportunities.

  • Completed undergraduate degree, or expected completion within six months. STEM, economics, finance, regulatory affairs, and pre-law backgrounds are preferred, although candidates from other disciplines are welcome.

  • Proficiency in Python is required, particularly for extracting, cleaning, analyzing, and interrogating large datasets and automating anomaly detection. Experience with additional programming languages is an advantage.

  • Strong analytical reasoning and the ability to absorb detailed regulatory codes, tariff schedules, tax rules, accounting standards, or comparable technical frameworks.

  • Intellectual curiosity and tenacity, with the determination to pursue well-supported claims through challenges and setbacks.

  • Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to develop original, technically sound approaches that can withstand regulatory scrutiny.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare persuasive reports and present findings confidently to clients, utility representatives, and regulators.

  • Comfort working with ambiguity, interpreting complex or inconsistent regulatory language, and identifying opportunities others may overlook.

  • Adaptability and strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, shifting priorities, and deadlines without sacrificing precision.

  • Experience working for a regulated public utility, particularly in rate billing analysis or customer-facing operations, is a significant advantage.

  • Must reside in the Eastern or Central Time Zone. Eligible Central Time locations include Missouri, Arkansas, Mississippi, and Alabama.

  • Must be a U.S. citizen or an active Green Card holder. Visa sponsorship is not available.

  • Availability for full-time remote work, with core working hours from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time.

Benefits:

  • Base salary: $40,000 annually, increasing to $45,000 upon successful completion of auditing skills benchmarks.

  • Performance bonuses: Monthly bonuses begin after onboarding and are directly linked to the refunds and savings claims generated. Established analysts regularly earn $1,000–$3,000 or more per month in bonuses.

  • Total earning potential: Strong performers can reach approximately $55,000–$76,000 or more annually, with further potential as expertise and claim results grow.

  • Paid training: Three-month intensive onboarding program designed to build expertise in utility auditing, regulatory billing, and forensic analysis.

  • Career progression: Opportunities to advance to Senior Analyst, Practice Lead, or Client Relationship Manager, with high performers potentially progressing within two to three years.

  • Healthcare coverage: Health, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Retirement: 401(k) plan with company matching.

title: Software Development Engineer, Last Mile Platform Services, SDE
description:
De ion

Amazon's Last Mile Technology team brings new technology to the hardest problems in last mile delivery. We want a top-in-class experience, not only for the customer receiving a package but also for the transporters who deliver millions of them every day. Real innovation in this space is part of who we are.

How Amazon speaks to its transporters is one of the most critical systems in Last Mile. The Rabbit Communications Platform owns every surface Amazon uses to reach a Delivery Partner, Delivery Associate or Flex driver: Newsfeed, push notifications, in-app messaging, automated calls and automated customer contact. It runs on Android, iOS and wearables, worldwide. When a severe-weather shelter-in-place directive has to reach a driver in their own language, or a customer's gate code needs to travel from one delivery to the next, those journeys run on what we build. And for the driver, every one of them ends on the phone in their hand.

We are looking for talented Android and iOS Software Development Engineers to design and build the client side of these mission-critical systems. You will work on hard problems at fleet scale, on devices that are moving, often offline and running low on battery, and you will have the autonomy to deliver impactful solutions. You will develop and operate tier-1 communication surfaces in native Android (Kotlin) and iOS (Swift).

You will learn how to build server-driven, self-service client surfaces that take app releases off the critical path for communications. You'll design driver-safe interaction patterns for people who are behind the wheel or walking to a door. You'll engineer offline-first sync and message delivery across 1-to-N broadcast and 1-to-1 push. You'll internationalize and localize an app that runs in dozens of languages, including right-to-left s, across global markets. You'll extend these experiences to wearables. And you'll hold the crash-free rate, startup latency, battery, data-usage and accessibility standards that a Tier-1 app must meet on a wide range of devices, while the team that builds it also runs it.

It's always Day 1 at Amazon. Are you up for the challenge

Key job responsibilities

As a key member of the Last Mile Delivery Technology team you will be an innovator, playing a direct role in shaping and building products that partner teams rely on and customers love on top of Amazon's technology. You will be part of a strong team in a fast-paced, start-up like environment where agile development is embraced, innovation is encouraged, large-scale projects are the norm, and work-life balance is a top priority. We aim to work smarter, not harder, and regularly iterate to maintain and improve work-life balance. As an SDE-II at Amazon, you will have the opportunity to positively impact millions of customers by identifying opportunities, designing solutions, collaborating with world-class engineers and delivering large, impactful, end-to-end projects and improvements.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
  • 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
  • Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. Title: Director, Data Governance Transformation & Enablement

Position Summary

Serves as a senior member of the Data Office leadership team and strategic deputy to the Head of the Data Office. This role is responsible for helping shape the bank's enterprise data governance and operating model to ensure data is trusted, accessible, and leveraged as a strategic asset that drives business growth, operational excellence, informed decision-making, and AI-enabled innovation. The role will help define enterprise priorities, influence executive decision-making, and drive the organizational change required to modernize how data is managed and used across the bank.

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives, helping solve complex business challenges through the effective use of data while shaping the future direction of the Data Office. This individual will balance strategic vision with practical execution, ensuring data-related investments, governance practices, and transformation initiatives deliver measurable business value and sustainable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Data Office Leadership & Enterprise Strategy

  • Serve as the delegate for the Head of the Data Office, representing the function in executive, regulatory, and strategic forums and helping drive enterprise priorities across the Data Office portfolio.
  • Partner with the Head of the Data Office to define enterprise priorities, operating plans, investment strategies, and transformation objectives.
  • Help shape and execute the enterprise data strategy, ensuring Data Office initiatives are aligned to business priorities, regulatory expectations, risk objectives, and technology transformation.
  • Establish and drive strategic roadmaps for enterprise data capabilities, including data quality, lineage, metadata, data risk management, AI readiness, and trusted data enablement.
  • Provide senior-level perspective on enterprise data policy, operating model, and accountability decisions, ensuring requirements are practical, sustainable, and aligned to business outcomes.

Business Enablement & Strategic Advisory

  • Partner with senior business leaders to identify opportunities where improved data management can unlock business value, operational efficiency, risk reduction, client outcomes, and better decision-making.
  • Help business leaders improve decision-making speed, operational effectiveness, client experience, and business performance through better use of trusted, accessible, and well-understood data.
  • Connect enterprise data investments and capabilities to strategic business objectives, measurable outcomes, and priority transformation initiatives.
  • Challenge existing practices and recommend practical solutions that improve how data is created, managed, controlled, and used across the enterprise.

Enterprise Transformation & Operating Model Modernization

  • Lead enterprise data and operating model modernization initiatives that improve business performance, transparency, efficiency, accountability, and decision-making.
  • Identify systemic issues, organizational barriers, manual processes, and operating model inefficiencies that limit the effective use of trusted data.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce process complexity, eliminate manual workarounds, and improve business outcomes through enhanced data practices.
  • Lead resolution of cross-functional data challenges where business objectives, technology constraints, operational processes, and risk considerations require executive alignment and decision-making.

Governance, Accountability & Risk Alignment

  • Drive the development of pragmatic data management practices that balance business enablement, regulatory expectations, risk management, and operational sustainability.
  • Provide leadership across the enterprise accountability model, driving clear ownership and execution of data-related responsibilities within business and technology organizations.
  • Drive adoption of trusted data capabilities that support business strategy, analytics, regulatory reporting, AI initiatives, and enterprise decision-making.
  • Establish enterprise performance measures that track business adoption, operational effectiveness, data trust, risk reduction, and value realization from Data Office initiatives.
  • Support the modernization of data governance practices so they are embedded into business operations and viewed as enablers of business outcomes rather than administrative requirements.

Executive Engagement, Communications & Culture

  • Develop executive communications, strategic updates, and decision materials that clearly articulate Data Office priorities, risks, progress, and business value.
  • Promote a culture of data ownership, accountability, and practical problem-solving across business and technology teams.
  • Elevate data literacy and business adoption by helping stakeholders understand how trusted data supports business performance, risk management, AI, and operational resilience.
  • Represent the Data Office as a credible business partner that helps the organization solve enterprise challenges through better use of data.

Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in financial services, consulting, operations, analytics, data management, or related disciplines.
  • Experience influencing senior executives and driving organizational change without direct authority.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing materials for executive, board, audit, and regulatory audiences.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments and lead large-scale transformation efforts.
  • Strong understanding of how data supports business processes, customer outcomes, financial reporting, risk management, analytics, or operational decision-making.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise change initiatives and influencing strategic decisions across multiple business functions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading large-scale business transformation or operating model modernization initiatives.
  • Experience advising senior executives on strategic planning, organizational change, or enterprise operating model design.
  • Experience working directly within business functions such as Operations, Finance, Risk, Corporate Banking, Capital Markets, or similar disciplines.
  • Experience identifying and delivering measurable business value through improved data management practices.
  • Experience modernizing or designing enterprise data governance frameworks/policies.

What Success Looks Like

  • Business leaders have greater confidence in the data used to make critical decisions.
  • Governance processes are streamlined and viewed as enablers rather than administrative requirements.
  • Data ownership and accountability are embedded within business operations.
  • Strategic business initiatives, analytics, and AI capabilities can leverage trusted and well-understood data.
  • Regulatory expectations are satisfied through sustainable operating practices rather than point-in-time remediation efforts.

What This Role Is Not

  • Not a data engineering, software development, architecture, or data science role.
  • Not a report production or analytics delivery role.

title: QA-QC Engineer
description:
Job De ion

Ensures projects meet quality standards, building codes, and specifications by developing, implementing, and monitoring project-specific QA/QC plans. Key roles include conducting site inspections (RCC, masonry, finishing), material testing, managing non-conformance reports (NCRs), coordinating with consultants, and overseeing final handover documentation.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Quality Assurance & Planning
  • Review Good for Construction (GFC) drawings, specifications, and project plans to prevent rework and dimensional errors.
  • Assist in the implementation of the Project Quality Plan (PQP) and Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs).
  • Prepare and implement checklists for various construction stages, such as formwork, steel reinforcement, concrete pouring, masonry, and plastering.
  • Site Quality Control & Inspections
  • Conduct daily inspections of civil, structural, and finishing works (waterproofing, tiling, flooring, painting, etc.).
  • Establish QA/QC procedures, ITPs, checklists, and method statements specific to high-rise luxury construction.
  • Oversee concrete works-monitor slump, prepare cube registers, and manage slump/cube testing results.
  • Check and verify the quality of incoming materials against approved submittals before they are used on-site.
  • Conduct regular site inspections, audits, and surveillance
  • Raise Inspection Requests (IRs) and coordinate walkdowns with consultants, architects, and clients.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Maintain comprehensive quality documentation, including material testing checklists, calibration logs for testing equipment, and non-conformance reports.
  • Prepare Non-Conformance Reports (NCR) and Site Observation Reports (SOR) for any deviations and track them until corrected.
  • Compile handover documents, red-line drawings, and as-built drawing verifications.

Qualifications

  • Diploma/ Degree in Civil Engineering.
  • 8-10 years of hands-on experience in residential or high-rise building projects.
  • Deep knowledge of finishing works, structural QA/QC processes, Non-Conformance Management, and local building codes.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, excellent coordination skills, and a high attention to detail.

Brief staff on BCAS orders, circulars, alert messages, and other communications from government agencies, ensuring they are read, understood, signed, and securely recorded for scrutiny by al pass section staff.

Collaborate with airlines, concessioners, Aux service providers for AEP and AVSEC related requirement for the asset.

Act as the primary point of contact for AEP requirement access control and access management issues, ensuring prompt resolution and alignment with regulatory requirements.

Coordinate with BCAS , regional office for matters pertaining to the issue of AEPs/ TAEPs.

Ensure the availability and optimal performance of all IT equipment and essential supplies required for seamless operations within the Pass Section.

Generate in-depth reports for senior management on operational performance, compliance audits, and risk assessments.

Budgeting And Resource Management

Oversee the budget for the Pass Section, ensuring efficient allocation of resources and cost-effective operations. Analyze expenditures and identify opportunities for cost savings without compromising service quality.

Develop forecasts and reports to support financial decision-making and resource allocation in alignment with operational goals.

Outsourced Manpower Management

Monitor the strength of outsourced staff, ensuring that deployed personnel meet defined operational parameters.

Supervise the activities and performance of outsourced security employees, ensuring compliance with operational standards and expectations.

Crisis Management And Resolution

Develop and implement crisis management protocols for incidents involving pass security or compliance breaches. Lead investigations and coordinate responses with relevant authorities and stakeholders.

Ensure that lessons learned from incidents are documented and used to enhance future protocols and training.

Process Enhancement

Identify areas for improvement within Pass Section operations and implement necessary changes to enhance efficiency and security.

Drive initiatives aimed at continuously improving data management processes and workflows, leveraging technology and best practices to streamline operations.

Team Leadership And Development

Supervise and mentor team in the Pass Section. Foster a collaborative and efficient work environment.

Conduct regular training sessions and drills to enhance team performance ensuring that all staff are well-equipped to adapt to evolving security challenges.

Digital Mindset

Oversee the use of security technology and system in the Pass Section, ensuring that systems are properly maintained and updated.

Advocate for the integration of innovative security solutions that enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness, fostering a culture of technological adaptability among team members.

Visual accuracy - Eyesight shall be equal or better than 20/60 in both eyes without glasses / lenses or equal or better that 20 / 20 in one eye and 20 / 30 in the other when using glasses or contact lenses. Adequate color perception shall be required.

title: Executive Director, Gilead and Kite Global Oncology Public Affairs
description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

At Gilead our pursuit of a healthier world for all people has yielded a cure for hepatitis C, revolutionary improvements in HIV treatment and prevention as well as advancements in therapies for viral and inflammatory diseases and certain cancers.


We set and achieve bold ambitions in our fight against the world's most devastating diseases, united in our commitment to confronting the largest public health challenges of our day and improving the lives of patients for generations to come.


As an Executive Director, Gilead and Kite Global Oncology Public Affairs, at Gilead you will shape and lead integrated Public Affairs strategy across Kite and Gilead’s global oncology portfolio. You will lead communications and patient advocacy strategies supporting key business priorities, product launches and portfolio milestones while strengthening Kite and Gilead’s leadership and reputation in oncology and cell therapy.


You will serve as a trusted strategic advisor to senior leaders and highly visible cross-functional teams, bringing external stakeholder, patient and reputation perspectives to critical business decisions. This role requires the ability to create alignment across functions and geographies, influence without direct authority and translate complex scientific and business priorities into clear, integrated Public Affairs strategies.


You will lead and develop a global Public Affairs team working across multiple geographies and areas of expertise.

Strategic Leadership and Business Partnership

  • Lead the overarching Public Affairs strategy for Kite and Gilead’s global oncology portfolio, aligning communications, patient advocacy, stakeholder engagement and reputation priorities with business and development strategies.
  • Serve as a senior strategic counselor to leadership and cross-functional teams, ensuring external stakeholder, patient and reputational considerations inform business decisions.
  • Advise senior leaders on changes in the external environment, emerging opportunities and potential risks to Kite, Gilead and the oncology portfolio.
  • Translate complex scientific, clinical and business priorities into clear Public Affairs strategies, narratives and engagement plans.
  • Build alignment across functions, geographies and business units with differing priorities, and drive decisions and execution through influence.

Oncology Portfolio and Launch Leadership

  • Lead integrated Public Affairs strategies for priority oncology and cell therapy products and pipeline assets across clinical, regulatory and commercial milestones.
  • Provide strategic Public Affairs leadership for U.S. and global product launches, integrating communications and patient advocacy into launch planning at an early stage.
  • Partner with Commercial, Medical Affairs, Development, Regulatory, Market Access, Government Affairs and other functions to support coordinated launch readiness and lifecycle management.
  • Develop differentiated product, disease-state and portfolio narratives grounded in scientific evidence, patient need and the changing oncology environment.
  • Maintain current knowledge of the oncology and cell therapy landscape, including scientific developments, competitors, stakeholder expectations and emerging reputation issues.

Communications, Reputation and Executive Counsel

  • Lead internal and external communications across Kite and Gilead Oncology, including corporate and product communications, media relations, executive communications, milestone communications and thought leadership.
  • Develop clear and compelling narratives for patient, scientific, healthcare professional, media, employee and other stakeholder audiences.
  • Identify reputation opportunities and risks and lead appropriate proactive and responsive communications strategies.
  • Partner with Corporate Communications and other Public Affairs teams to ensure oncology and cell therapy communications support Gilead’s broader enterprise narrative and reputation.
  • Counsel and prepare senior executives for high-profile internal and external engagements.

Patient Advocacy and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Embed patient perspectives in Public Affairs and relevant cross-functional strategies.
  • Develop patient advocacy strategies that elevate unmet need, strengthen relationships with oncology and cell therapy communities and support priority portfolio and product objectives.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with patient advocacy organizations and other influential external stakeholders.
  • Partner with Public Affairs, Medical Affairs, Commercial and other teams to identify opportunities for patient education, disease awareness and meaningful stakeholder engagement.
  • Ensure patient advocacy relationships and programs are conducted in accordance with applicable company policies and standards.

Team, Matrix and Agency Leadership

  • Lead, inspire and develop a high-performing Public Affairs team across geographies and areas of expertise.
  • Establish clear priorities, roles and accountability while enabling team members to operate with appropriate autonomy.
  • Bring functions, markets and business units together around shared objectives within a complex global matrix.
  • Oversee agency and external partner relationships, ensuring high-quality strategic counsel, effective execution and appropriate use of resources.
  • Manage budgets and resources against the organization’s highest priorities.
  • Establish meaningful measures of Public Affairs impact and use resulting insights to strengthen strategy and execution.



Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree and 16 years of relevant experience

OR

  • Master’s degree and 14 years of relevant experience

OR

  • PhD and 14 years of relevant experience



Preferred Qualifications

  • Senior-level Public Affairs, communications, corporate affairs or related experience within the biopharmaceutical, healthcare or life sciences industry.
  • Deep knowledge of oncology, including the scientific, treatment, stakeholder and reputation environment.
  • Cell therapy or gene therapy experience.
  • Experience leading communications and stakeholder strategies for U.S. and global product launches before, during and after launch.
  • Expertise across corporate communications, product communications, media relations, executive communications and reputation management.
  • Experience building relationships with patient advocacy organizations and incorporating patient perspectives into business and Public Affairs strategies.
  • Experience operating in a highly matrixed global organization and establishing alignment across functions and geographies.
  • Experience serving on or advising senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to connect external stakeholder developments with business priorities and anticipate emerging opportunities and risks.
  • Ability to communicate complex scientific, clinical and business information clearly for different audiences.
  • Demonstrated people leadership, coaching and talent-development experience.
  • Ability to lead multiple high-profile priorities in a changing environment using sound judgment and clear prioritization.

People Leader Accountabilities

  • Create Inclusion – knowing the business value of diverse teams, modeling inclusion, and embedding the value of diversity in the way they manage their teams.
  • Develop Talent – understand the skills, experience, aspirations, and potential of their employees and coach them on current performance and future potential. They ensure employees are receiving feedback and insight needed to grow, develop and realize their purpose.
  • Empower Teams – connect the team to the organization by aligning goals, purpose, and organizational objectives, and holding them to account. They provide the support needed to remove barriers and connect their team to the broader ecosystem.

  • Experience with ITSM processes (ITIL): incident, problem, change, and release management.
  • Familiarity with Unix/Linux and Windows environments, including log analysis and basic ing.
  • Experience with monitoring tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or Nagios.
  • Knowledge of APIs, web services (REST/SOAP), and middleware or integration tools.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with core banking platforms (e.g., FIS, Fiserv, Jack Henry, Temenos, Finacle).

  • Experience with batch scheduling tools (Control-M, Autosys).

Please find below the details of the six support domains currently in scope:

1. Consumer Digital – D3 / OAO

  • Coverage: 24×7
  • Support focus: Digital banking functionality, user access, transaction-related issues, and customer experience.

2. Commercial Treasury/Payments – Pay+ / Finastra (Wire)

  • Coverage: 16×7
  • Support focus: Payment initiation, processing exceptions, and integration-related troubleshooting.

3. Commercial Treasury/Payments – FIS Tracker (ACH)

title: Operational Tax Specialist
description:
Role Purpose

The Tax Specialist is responsible for managing and coordinating direct and indirect tax compliance activities across Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg. The role ensures that all corporate tax, indirect tax and statutory reporting obligations are fulfilled accurately and on time in accordance with local tax regulations, IFRS requirements and Allianz Partners tax governance framework.

The position acts as a key interface between local finance teams, external tax advisors, shared service centers and Group Tax, ensuring compliance with Corporate Income Tax, Deferred Tax, VAT, Withholding Taxes across the Benelux region.

The role also supports tax reporting, tax risk management, audits and tax transformation initiatives aimed at improving efficiency, standardization and compliance controls.

Key Responsibilities

Direct Tax Compliance

  • Coordinate the preparation, review and submission of Corporate Income Tax returns for Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg
  • Support quarterly and annual tax provision calculations under IFRS and local GAAP requirements
  • Prepare and review current and deferred tax calculations
  • Ensure accurate tax accounting and reporting in accordance with Allianz Group policies
  • Monitor deferred tax assets and liabilities, tax credits and tax loss carry-forwards
  • Coordinate annual tax compliance activities with external tax providers
  • Support the preparation and review of tax disclosures for statutory and consolidated reporting purposes
  • Support Transfer Pricing compliance activities, including reconciliations of intercompany transactions and preparation of supporting documentation

Indirect Tax Compliance

  • Coordinate and review VAT returns and related indirect tax reporting obligations across Benelux entities
  • Ensure timely submission of indirect tax declarations and related tax payments
  • Monitor VAT recovery positions and assess recoverability of input VAT
  • Support VAT compliance related to cross-border transactions and intercompany services
  • Monitor legislative developments affecting VAT and indirect taxation in the Benelux region

Withholding Tax and International Tax Matters

  • Review withholding tax obligations relating to dividends, interest, royalties and intercompany service arrangements
  • Coordinate collection and maintenance of tax residency certificates and related documentation
  • Assist with international tax compliance matters impacting Benelux entities

Tax Reporting and Reconciliations

  • Perform monthly and quarterly reconciliations of tax accounts and tax balance sheet positions
  • Reconcile tax returns to accounting records and statutory financial statements
  • Review tax-related journal entries and supporting documentation
  • Analyze tax variances and investigate unusual transactions or balances
  • Support tax reporting packages required by Group Tax and Finance management

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as primary contact for external tax advisors in Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg
  • Collaborate closely with local finance, accounting and controlling teams
  • Liaise with Allianz Group Tax on reporting, compliance and tax governance matters
  • Coordinate tax information requests and ensure timely delivery of required data

Tax Audits and Risk Management

  • Support internal and external tax audits and tax authority reviews
  • Prepare responses to tax authority information requests
  • Identify tax compliance risks and propose mitigation measures
  • Ensure compliance with Allianz internal control requirements and tax governance standards
  • Maintain appropriate tax documentation and audit trails

Process Improvement and Projects

  • Participate in regional tax transformation and harmonization initiatives
  • Support tax process automation and digitalization projects
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of tax compliance controls
  • Maintain and update tax process documentation and operating procedures
  • Support ad hoc Finance and Tax projects as requested by management

Qualifications And Experience

  • Degree in Tax, Accounting, Finance, Economics or Business Administration
  • 3-5 years of experience in Corporate Tax, Tax Compliance or Tax Reporting
  • Experience managing both direct and indirect taxes in multinational environments
  • Experience with Benelux tax jurisdictions is highly desirable
  • Insurance or financial services experience is a strong advantage

Functional Knowledge

  • Strong knowledge of Corporate Income Tax, Current and Deferred Tax Accounting, Withholding Taxes, VAT and indirect tax compliance
  • Solid understanding of tax reporting and tax reconciliations
  • Understanding of IFRS tax reporting requirements
  • Experience working with external tax advisers and tax authorities
  • Specific Benelux tax knowledge is an advantage, including Belgian, Dutch and Luxembourg Corporate Income Tax, VAT requirements and cross-border tax matters
  • Familiarity with EU VAT rules and intra-group transaction reporting

System Skills

  • Knowledge of ERP systems and SAP
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office

Languages

  • English (mandatory)
  • Dutch and/or French (highly desirable)

Soft Skills

  • Attention to detail and strong analytical mindset
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to work under deadlines
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management

  • Accountability, capacity to learn and ability to take initiative

title: Sr Software Development Manager, Search Relevance, Amazon Search
description:
De ion

Amazon Search is rebuilding relevance for an agentic world, where customers and AI shopping agents rely on Search to find the right product. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Manager to lead a manager-of-managers organization in Bangalore covering Vertical Search, Buy-It-Again in Search, and Relevance Measurement. You will be Search's primary partner to Amazon's vertical businesses: Music, Books, Amazon Business, Grocery and Amazon Health Services. With their leaders, you will jointly set the search strategy for each vertical. You will own how Search meets category-specific needs for these businesses, how customers find products they buy again, and how Amazon measures search relevance worldwide. You will be a core leader in moving Search Relevance to an agentic-native stack.

Key job responsibilities

  • Lead, coach and grow a manager-of-managers organization of SDMs, SDEs, Applied Scientists and MLEs. Hire and develop senior engineers and future managers.
  • Set the strategy and multi-year roadmap across Vertical Search, Buy-It-Again in Search and Relevance Measurement, and decide how investment is split between category features, repeat-purchase experiences and measurement.
  • Own vertical search relevance for Amazon Business, Grocery and Everyday Essentials, Books, Music, Amazon Health Services and other strategic categories, and turn business-unit needs into reusable search capabilities.
  • Set the search strategy jointly with the leadership of each vertical business. Each vertical has its own customers, catalog, constraints and business goals. You will reconcile those priorities with a shared search stack that serves all of them.
  • Influence vertical partners product roadmaps so that their launches work well in Search from day one, and secure commitments on the dependencies Search needs from them.
  • When vertical and Search priorities conflict, frame and lead the leadership debates needed to resolve them, for example category-specific ranking versus a shared relevance backbone. Write the narratives that drive those decisions at Director and VP level.
  • Build Buy-It-Again experiences across Search, from matching through ranking to Autocomplete.
  • Own the relevance measurement platform: LLM-based relevance metrics, weblab assessments, longitudinal Page 0 metrics, and regression detection and attribution. Keep it serving every Search Relevance team and business partner, not only the teams in this org.
  • Drive the agentic-native transition for Search Relevance. Redesign systems, metrics and evaluation so they serve agentic shopping surfaces as well as traditional search results.
  • Replace human-labeling and rule-based processes with LLM judges and learned models, while keeping the metrics trustworthy enough to gate launches and support WBR and QBR reporting.
  • Set a high bar for architecture, operational excellence and on-call health on services that run at Amazon Search scale under strict latency budgets.
  • Write clear strategy and narrative documents, and represent the org in senior leadership reviews.

About The Team

Search Relevance in Bangalore owns worldwide matching and relevance for Amazon Search. For every query, Search builds a match set of candidate products through lexical, semantic and behavioral matching, filters out irrelevant products, and ranks what remains against customer preferences. Our org owns that pipeline from match-set construction, through relevance filtering, to the relevance features used in ranking. It serves hundreds of millions of queries a day across a catalog of billions of products, within a latency budget of a few milliseconds. We also own Autocomplete, search relevance for international and emerging stores, LLM-based measurement of search relevance, and search for specialized contexts such as Amazon's vertical businesses. We own the improvement roadmap for Search's top-line relevance quality metric. We are moving these systems from compact language models to distilled LLMs, and building the relevance foundation for agentic shopping surfaces.

In this role, you will lead three areas within this org:

Vertical Search builds the best search experience for each category, because customer expectations differ across verticals. We partner with the leaders of Music, Books, Amazon Business, Grocery and Everyday Essentials, and Amazon Health Services to set a joint search strategy for each vertical, shape their product roadmaps, and resolve trade-offs between category-specific needs and the shared search stack. We then build search solutions that scale across the Amazon stack, and we give category partners tooling so they can serve themselves.

Buy-It-Again in Search helps customers find products they buy repeatedly with minimal effort, across matching, ranking and Autocomplete.

Relevance Measurement designs and runs, at scale, the metrics Search and business teams use to track and report search quality across every marketplace and language. The team gates relevance launches through weblab measurement, produces the Page 0 metrics behind leadership reviews, and detects regressions and traces them back to their causes.

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of engineering experience
  • 5+ years of engineering team management experience
  • 10+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience
  • Experience partnering with product or program management teams
  • Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience partnering with product and program management teams
  • Experience designing and developing large scale, high-traffic applications

Our systems run with high availability, low latency, and zero-downtime expectations, powered by modern technologies such as Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike, along with strong foundations in CI/CD, automation, and observability. title: Solicitor, Environment, Planning and Communities

Herbert Smith Freehills Kramer is a world-leading global law firm, where our ambition is to help you achieve your goals.

We are immersed in the sectors and challenges that impact you. We are recognised as standing apart in energy, infrastructure and resources. And we’re focused on areas of growth that affect every business across the world.

All of this is achieved by supporting the growth of our people, who help us deliver on our ambition – which is to help you achieve yours.

Herbert Smith Freehills Kramer: Your goals. Our ambition

The Opportunity

We have a unique opportunity for a Solicitor to join our market-leading Environment, Planning and Communities team (EP&C) in Sydney.


In this role, you will work closely with Partners Peter Briggs and Tom Dougherty. Our national EP&C team is part of our dynamic Projects, Energy and Infrastructure practice group, and acts on first in market and major projects, from concept to completion, for clients who are at the forefront of the energy transition, digital infrastructure, and other key sectors.


You will be involved in advising national and international clients on large-scale, high-stakes projects across energy, resources, infrastructure, mining, urban development, and real estate. You will work with our corporate, litigation, projects, and real estate teams, and provide strategic environment and planning advice for Australia’s largest corporate, property, and M&A deals.


Your work will span high-profile environment, planning, and valuation disputes, complex prosecutions, and regulatory investigations. You will gain hands-on experience working with clients, counsel, technical experts to develop case strategy, prepare court documents, navigate complex legal and scientific issues, and manage regulatory and commercial risk.


Our growing EP&C team has a full front-end and back-end environment and planning offering, giving you the opportunity to develop your litigation skills alongside a strong grounding in strategic advice. You will be part of a team that advises across the entire spectrum of environment and planning issues, including climate change, ESG, biodiversity, land access and compulsory acquisition, pollution and contamination, heritage, native title, cultural heritage, waste, water, and valuation issues.


Our national EP&C team are thought leaders, and you will contribute to shaping federal and state regulatory reform, keeping a pulse on industry developments, and working with peak advocacy bodies such as the Clean Energy Investor Group and Clean Energy Council.


Key responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with national EP&C partners and other team members in advising clients on a range of environment, planning, native title, and cultural heritage matters.
  • Advise clients at every stage of major energy, infrastructure (including data centres, ports, rail, and roads), mining and resources, urban development, and real estate project lifecycles, including securing approvals, identifying and managing risk, addressing stakeholder concerns, and post-approval compliance.
  • Act in environment, planning, compulsory acquisition, and other disputes in the Land and Environment Court of NSW, Supreme Court of NSW, Federal Court of Australia, and other courts.
  • Assist in the management of, and response to, environmental crises, regulatory investigations, and environmental prosecutions and litigation, including closely working with counsel and technical expert teams.
  • Assist in the preparation of legal documents, including environment and planning advice, contracts, and court documents.
  • Conduct legal research and analysis to support case strategies and client advice.

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • Admission to practice in Australia or New Zealand and between 2 to 4 years of demonstrated legal experience.
  • Demonstrated interest in environment, planning, native title, and cultural heritage law through relevant work experience, coursework, or internships, and ideally some litigation experience.
  • A strong academic record, coupled with excellent legal skills and a practical mindset.
  • Excellent research, writing, and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team environment.
  • An innovative mindset, with a desire and ability to embed AI and emerging technologies in day-to-day legal practice.
  • A drive to develop a professional profile and support the growth of the national EP&C team, including investing in business development and client relationships.

What you can expect from us

  • We’re a world leading international law firm with a global team of over 6,000 professionals across 26 offices. As the market leader in Australia, we are committed to high performance, collaboration, diversity and digital innovation. We are client-centred, commercially driven, and renowned for our solution-focused expertise. We will align your growth with our ambitions.
  • We make your personal and professional growth our business. And as part of the team, our ambition is yours too. Wherever you are in your career: grow and help the firm grow with you.
  • We will provide opportunities to learn on the job as well as a mix of learning opportunities tailored to you. Daily experiences, supportive challenges, team collaboration, mentors, and structured learning opportunities help you to expand your knowledge and reach your goals.
  • We value your wellbeing, both at home and work and we place a strong emphasis on mental health. If you need support, you’ll have it and we’ll empower you to harness your personal strengths, navigate uncertainty, embrace opportunities, and effectively manage things within your control.
  • For more benefits on offer such as our holistic wellbeing fund or home office allowance please click here.
  • Join us to be part of a human, bold and outstanding team at Australia’s market leading law firm.

We are committed to attracting people from all backgrounds and creating a respectful and inclusive culture where everyone thrives. We see this as essential to our success, including our ability to innovate and achieve sustained high performance. This is a key part of our Values - Human, Bold, and Outstanding.


Apply now with your resume and academic transcript, or contact Tamara Salem, Recruitment Manager (tamara.salem@hsfkramer.com) for a confidential discussion.

description:
Tier 3 Systems Engineer | Resilient IT


When a client’s VPN drops, a Microsoft 365 migration hits a snag, or a security control needs fixing before an assessment, you’re the person the team calls. What you’ll do

Work location and eligibility: You must be a U.S. citizen, live in the Northern Virginia or Washington, DC metro area, and be able to work from the Springfield office. The role includes occasional local client visits and some after-hours work.

Resilient IT offers medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid federal holidays, and ongoing technical training.

title: Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging Principal

Ready for a challenge?



Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.

Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.




About this role



We serve millions of diverse customers globally. To build for them, we need a business that reflects that diversity and a workplace where everyone belongs—a core priority alongside our commercial goals.

As Global Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging (ID&B) Principal within the CHRO department, you will shape and lead our global agenda across 110+ nationalities and 15 markets. We are looking for someone who embodies our values to lead, deliver, and care—using teamwork and evidence-based insights to empower leaders, remove barriers, and drive lasting positive change across JET.

  • Lead the global ID&B strategy and its delivery, driving company priorities on representation at every level, including gender diversity goals.
  • Identify and remove barriers in how we hire, promote, and develop talent so that career progression at JET is equitable and inclusive.
  • Lead cross-functional teams to deliver ID&B programmes and interventions, managing them from initial design through to measured adoption.
  • Functionally lead and mentor more junior ID&B team members, fostering collaboration and helping one another succeed.
  • Care for our people by enabling employee communities with direction and sponsorship to create empowering spaces across our markets.
  • Own external partnerships and sponsorships with key inclusion and community organisations.
  • Own ESG and diversity reporting across all markets, partnering with Legal to ensure we meet our regulatory obligations everywhere we operate.
  • Collaborate closely with Employee Experience, Wellbeing, Culture, Employee Listening, and Workplace Experience teams to embed inclusion into every touchpoint at JET.





What will you bring to the team?



  • A proven track record of leading and delivering a global inclusion and diversity agenda across multiple countries and cultures.
  • Experience taking an ID&B strategy from initial design through to measured, visible progress in a fast-moving, commercially demanding industry.
  • Strong credibility with senior leadership, with the confidence to challenge the status quo, address uncomfortable truths, and secure leadership commitment.
  • Fluency with data—able to interpret representation and engagement metrics to pinpoint root causes and drive accountability with stakeholders.
  • Deep knowledge of the global ID&B landscape, paired with sound judgement on how to adapt best practices to fit JET's unique context.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and writing proficiency in English.
  • A collaborative mindset focused on aiming high, driving excellence, and acting responsibly to make a lasting impact across the business.






At JET, this is how we play


Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.


Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side.

At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again.


Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition.




Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging



No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.




What else are we delivering?



Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET journeys.



Are you ready to join the team? Apply now!

title: Sr Product Manager
description:
Position Summary

CDK is looking for a technical, execution-focused Senior Product Manager, API & Developer Experience to own and evolve a portfolio of modern API products that power integrations across the automotive retail ecosystem.

This role is part of the Fortellis Marketplace & APIs team and reports to the Group Product Manager. The Senior Product Manager will be the execution owner for API product delivery, API lifecycle improvements, the developer experience on Fortellis, and day-to-day product management of CDK's API portfolio.

This role will own a portfolio of APIs and will be responsible for evolving, versioning, improving, and supporting those APIs to meet customer, partner, developer, and business needs. The role will also define requirements for new APIs that need to be built for the market and published on Fortellis for OEMs, ISVs, dealers, and internal CDK product teams.

The ideal candidate is a technical product manager who enjoys working closely with engineering, understands API products and developer workflows, and can turn strategy into clear requirements, prioritized backlogs, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes. This role will work directly with India-based engineering teams and cross-functional stakeholders to execute the API roadmap and help CDK deliver modern, scalable, high-quality API products.

Position Responsibilities

  • Own day-to-day product management for the portfolio of APIs, including roadmap execution, backlog prioritization, requirements, versioning, defect resolution, lifecycle management, adoption, and ongoing improvements.
  • Act as the product owner for new APIs built for the market and published on Fortellis for OEMs, ISVs, dealers, and internal CDK product teams.
  • Execute API roadmap priorities in partnership with the Group Product Manager, Engineering, Architecture, UX, Security, Data Platform, Product Marketing, Customer Success, Support, Professional Services, and Implementation teams.
  • Define clear API product requirements, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, launch criteria, documentation needs, and measurable outcomes for engineering delivery.
  • Own execution for modern APIs that modernize legacy data-sharing products and workflows, customer migration support, adoption tracking, utilization improvements, and legacy product sunset readiness.
  • Own execution of improvements to the Async API portfolio, including customer discovery, market requirements, product gaps, performance needs, developer experience improvements, and roadmap execution required to grow adoption and revenue.
  • Serve as a key stakeholder in the P&T API Operating Framework, helping execute API lifecycle improvements across intake, design, standards, documentation, governance, launch readiness, publishing, monetization, support, versioning, and retirement.
  • Define and execute developer experience requirements for Fortellis APIs to improve NPS, speed to market, and operational efficiencies.
  • Use customer feedback, developer feedback, API usage data, defect trends, support insights, operational metrics, and revenue/adoption signals to prioritize API improvements and measure outcomes.
  • Partner with engineering teams in India to maintain delivery momentum, clarify requirements, resolve trade-offs, manage dependencies, and ensure APIs are built with quality, usability, scalability, security, privacy, observability, and supportability in mind.
  • Support API launches and go-to-market readiness by partnering with Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, Professional Services, and Implementation teams on enablement, customer adoption, and issue resolution.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or equivalent industry experience.
  • 5+ years of Product Management, Technical Product Management, Product Owner, or equivalent experience in enterprise SaaS, API platforms, developer platforms, integration platforms, data products, or marketplace products.
  • Experience owning and building API products, integrations, developer tools, data services, platform capabilities, or other technical products.
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, Async APIs, API gateways, API documentation, authentication/authorization, developer onboarding, API versioning, API lifecycle management, and API quality practices.
  • Experience working directly with engineering teams to define requirements, manage backlogs, make trade-offs, resolve dependencies, and deliver technical products.
  • Ability to translate API strategy into clear epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, launch plans, documentation requirements, and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to use API usage data, product analytics, customer feedback, support trends, defect data, and operational metrics to make product decisions.
  • Experience working with globally distributed teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineering, product, business, and customer-facing teams.
  • Ability to operate with ownership, urgency, and sound judgment in a complex product and engineering environment.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience with automotive retail, dealer management systems, CRM, fixed operations, retail workflows, OEM integrations, or automotive data platforms.
  • Experience with API monetization, usage-based pricing, sub ion models, packaging, commercial API products, or API marketplace models.
  • Experience with self-service integration platforms, developer portals, app marketplaces, or integration marketplaces.
