title: Associate - ENR
description:
About Us

Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world's most ambitious change-makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition, and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. Expert Client Delivery (ECD) is an integral unit of BCN. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutions across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence, and Bain intellectual property.

Who You'll Work With

This role is ideal for a sector-focused Project Leader with expertise in Oil & Gas. The individual will combine deep industry knowledge, consulting problem-solving, and team leadership to support global case teams, develop impactful client solutions, and assist in developing new and differentiated capabilities for Bain's Oil & Gas Practice.

The Ideal Candidate Brings Broad Understanding Of The Energy & Natural Resources (ENR) Sector, Combined With Demonstrated Depth In At Least One Of The Following Domains

  • Upstream – Exploration and production including deep understanding in upstream economics and key terminologies used to assess quality and performance of upstream assets, gas processing and liquefaction, production operations and asset performance optimization
  • Downstream – Refining operations including deep understanding of refined products value chain, refinery economics and measurable KPIs to assess performance, margin optimization and operational performance improvement

This role requires a leader who is comfortable driving complex analysis, managing workstreams with 2-3 Associates / Analysts, and shaping innovative offerings that leverage emerging technologies, AI-enabled solutions and advanced analytics to create a high ENR client impact.

What You'll Do

  • Lead workstreams, and oversee and drive delivery for Oil & Gas client case work, client account development, and proposal support in collaboration with Bain consulting teams globally
  • Translate complex client situations into structured analytical approaches, identify key issues, and develop practical, actionable recommendations that create measurable client value
  • Apply deep industry expertise and consulting problem-solving to solve strategic, operational, commercial, and transformation challenges across the Oil & Gas value chain
  • Lead the development of Oil & Gas knowledge assets, intellectual property, and innovative sector-specific capabilities, including AI-enabled analytical products and decision-support solutions that leverage large and complex datasets
  • Ensuring high-quality execution, effective work planning, workload management and timely delivery of zero-defect output
  • Contribute to capability building within the ENR CoE through coaching, training, recruitment, and the development of Oil and Gas sector offerings and best practices

About You

  • 2–4 years of Oil & Gas experience in industry and/or consulting, with expertise in areas such as upstream, midstream, refining, marketing, or fuel retail.
  • Strong strategic and analytical capabilities, with experience leading business transformation, operational improvement, and consulting engagements.
  • Deep Energy & Natural Resources knowledge, including market trends, value chains, and commercial dynamics.
  • Leadership and stakeholder management skills, with experience managing teams, cross-functional workstreams, and engaging senior clients.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and familiarity with analytics, visualization, and AI-enabled tools.
  • Innovation mindset, with an interest in developing AI-powered solutions, analytical products, and reusable capabilities.
  • Able to combine industry expertise with consulting rigor, deliver measurable client impact, build strong relationships, coach teams, and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

What Makes Us a Great Place To Work

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. description:
Job De ion: Associate Director – Sales

ROLE PURPOSE

This is a business-building leadership role, not a conventional sales seat. The Associate Director – Sales will build the Office for Ownership business for RMZ Signature Offices end to end: strategy, market, channels, sales infrastructure and team. The role creates the market for premium office ownership among HNIs, family offices, institutional investors, wealth managers and corporate occupiers, builds long-term relationships, and delivers sustainable sales from day one.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Market strategy: Develop the market strategy for Office for Ownership; map competitors, pricing, positioning and target customer segments across markets.
  • Market creation: Establish RMZ Signature Offices as the preferred office-ownership platform through investor forums, broker programmes, CEO roundtables and leadership events.

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

A balanced scorecard, from day one, that weighs results and capability equally:

  • Results: bookings, collections, pipeline health and conversion ratios.
  • Capability: market creation, channel and partner ecosystem, brand position, customer experience (NPS and referrals) and team strength.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • Mobility: Based in Gurgaon and able to travel extensively across markets.

Role summary

The LDR turns APAC marketing-generated leads (MQLs) into BANT-qualified, sales-ready opportunities that Sales accepts and progresses. This is an inside Sales Rep.( ISR)-calibre role: the LDR holds credible business conversations with SME, mid-market and enterprise prospects, tests genuine intent, and does not push weak leads through to Sales.

The LDR owns each lead from first contact to a documented handover, then follows Sales accept, reject or recycle decision and reports progress to the LDR Manager on a regular cadence.

Key responsibilities

Qualify marketing leads

  • Research and prioritise assigned MQLs by company profile, contact role, product relevance and engagement signals.
  • Contact prospects by phone, email and approved digital channels within the agreed speed-to-lead standard.
  • Run consultative discovery on Budget, Authority, Need and Timeline, and discuss the prospect's business priorities, current environment and buying process in enough depth to judge real intent.
  • Apply BANT with integrity: do not force-fit weak leads into sales-accepted status. Recycle or nurture them with a clear reason and next action.
  • Handle common objections (send me information, no budget, incumbent vendor) and agree a concrete next step.

Assign qualified leads to Sales

It covers enterprise infrastructure engineering and operations while driving modernization initiatives such as Cloud Adoption and Network Resiliency. The group supports critical platforms including networking, end-user computing, cloud, databases, server/Unix engineering, communications, and global data centers (including low-latency colocations near exchanges).

Key Functions

  • Networking / Telecom / Multimedia Engineering
  • Windows / Desktop / Messaging Engineering.
  • Private / Public Cloud / Database / Unix Engineering.
  • Data Centers.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Cloud Engineer to help design, build, and operate enterprise cloud and Kubernetes platforms. This role will focus on delivering secure, reliable, scalable, and automated platform capabilities that enable application teams to adopt cloud-native technologies effectively.

The ideal candidate will have strong engineering experience in either AWS or Microsoft Azure, hands-on Kubernetes knowledge, and experience using infrastructure-as-code and DevOps practices to manage cloud environments at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate secure, scalable, and resilient cloud platform capabilities across AWS and Microsoft Azure.
  • Engineer and support enterprise Kubernetes platforms, including managed services such as Amazon EKS and Azure Kubernetes Service.
  • Manage Kubernetes platform capabilities including cluster lifecycle, upgrades, networking, ingress, DNS, security, observability, capacity, and operational governance.
  • Develop and maintain reusable infrastructure-as-code modules and patterns using Terraform.
  • Enable application teams to onboard applications and infrastructure through standardized, automated, and self-service platform capabilities.
  • Build and support CI/CD and GitOps-based deployment workflows for cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes platforms.
  • Build automation that solves complex problems with Agentic AI solutions
  • Implement cloud governance, security controls, identity and access management, and policy enforcement through automation.
  • Partner with application, architecture, cybersecurity, networking, and operations teams to deliver cloud-native solutions.
  • Troubleshoot complex cloud and Kubernetes platform issues across infrastructure, networking, security, and application integration layers.
  • Improve platform reliability through monitoring, observability, automation, operational standards, and continuous engineering improvements.
  • Support cloud modernization and migration initiatives, including the transformation of legacy applications into cloud-native architectures.
  • Evaluate emerging cloud and Kubernetes technologies and recommend practical improvements to the platform.

Required Qualifications

  • 3-5+ years professional hands-on experience with a major cloud provider
  • Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider, preferably AWS or Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience designing, engineering, or operating cloud platforms in an enterprise environment.
  • Experience with Kubernetes and managed Kubernetes services such as Amazon EKS or Azure Kubernetes Service.
  • Experience with Kubernetes platform engineering, including cluster lifecycle management, networking, ingress, security, observability, upgrades, and workload onboarding.
  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code, preferably Terraform.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD, GitOps, or other automated infrastructure and application delivery practices.
  • Hands-on experience in solving complex problems and build automation driven through Agentic AI solutions
  • Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging generative AI and code generation tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to enhance productivity, accelerate development workflows, and improve code quality; ability to evaluate AI-generated code critically, validate outputs, and integrate suggestions appropriately while maintaining security and maintainability standards.
  • Understanding of cloud networking, identity and access management, security controls, governance, and operational best practices.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure and cloud platform issues.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with application teams, architecture, cybersecurity, networking, and other engineering stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building reusable, self-service cloud or Kubernetes platform capabilities.
  • Experience with enterprise-scale cloud governance, policy automation, and infrastructure standardization.
  • Experience with observability, platform reliability, incident management, and operational automation.
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform, combined with strong expertise in AWS and/or Microsoft Azure, is a strong plus.
  • Broader multi-cloud experience across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud is a plus.

Certifications

The Following Certifications Are Preferred But Not Required

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.
  • A comparable Microsoft Azure associate-level certification.
  • Other relevant associate-level AWS or Microsoft certifications in cloud architecture, cloud engineering, operations, systems architecture, or DevOps.
  • HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate is a plus.

Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.
